functions.name: add_task_material_from_quote
functions.definition:
declare
  v_user_id uuid := auth.uid();
  v_task public.tasks%rowtype;
  v_material public.task_materials%rowtype;
  v_product public.products%rowtype;
  v_line record;
  v_left numeric(12, 3);
  v_moved numeric(12, 3);
begin
  if v_user_id is null then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'authentication required';
  end if;

  if not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.tasks.update') then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'task update permission required';
  end if;

  if p_quantity is null or p_quantity <= 0 then
    raise exception 'task material quantity must be greater than zero' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  select tasks.*
  into v_task
  from public.tasks
  where tasks.id = p_task_id
    and tasks.organization_id = p_organization_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'task not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  if v_task.status = 'done' then
    raise exception 'materials cannot be added or updated while the task is done'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if v_task.customer_id is null or not exists (
    select 1
    from public.quotes
    join public.quote_tasks
      on quote_tasks.quote_id = quotes.id
      and quote_tasks.task_id = p_task_id
    where quotes.id = p_quote_id
      and quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and quotes.customer_id = v_task.customer_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'quote must be linked to this task and share its customer'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  select products.*
  into v_product
  from public.products
  where products.id = p_product_id
    and products.organization_id = p_organization_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'task material product not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  select task_materials.*
  into v_material
  from public.task_materials
  where task_materials.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and task_materials.task_id = p_task_id
    and task_materials.product_id = p_product_id
  for update;

  if found and v_material.stock_state = 'consumed' then
    raise exception 'consumed task materials cannot be updated until the task is reopened'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if found and v_material.quote_id is not null and v_material.quote_id <> p_quote_id then
    raise exception 'task material is already linked to another quote' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  if not found then
    insert into public.task_materials (
      organization_id,
      task_id,
      product_id,
      quantity,
      unit,
      unit_price,
      vat_rate,
      currency,
      stock_state,
      quote_id,
      created_by,
      updated_by
    ) values (
      p_organization_id,
      p_task_id,
      p_product_id,
      p_quantity,
      v_product.unit_of_measure,
      coalesce(v_product.default_selling_price, 0),
      coalesce(v_product.vat_percentage, 0),
      coalesce(v_product.currency, 'EUR'),
      'untracked',
      p_quote_id,
      v_user_id,
      v_user_id
    )
    returning * into v_material;
  else
    update public.task_materials
    set
      quantity = quantity + p_quantity,
      quote_id = p_quote_id,
      updated_by = v_user_id
    where task_materials.id = v_material.id
    returning * into v_material;
  end if;

  v_left := p_quantity;

  for v_line in
    select
      quote_version_lines.id,
      coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) as held
    from public.quote_version_lines
    join public.quote_versions
      on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
    join public.inventory_allocations
      on inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
      and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
    where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
      and quote_versions.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and quote_version_lines.product_id = p_product_id
    group by quote_version_lines.id
    order by quote_version_lines.position, quote_version_lines.id
  loop
    exit when v_left <= 0;
    v_moved := public.transfer_allocations(
      p_organization_id,
      p_product_id,
      least(v_line.held, v_left),
      null,
      v_line.id,
      null,
      v_material.id,
      null,
      null,
      'task material took over quote hold',
      v_user_id
    );
    v_left := v_left - v_moved;
  end loop;

  if v_left > 0 then
    perform public.allocate_product_stock(
      p_organization_id,
      p_product_id,
      v_left,
      v_material.id,
      null,
      null,
      'task material reserved',
      p_quote_id,
      null,
      v_user_id
    );
  end if;

  update public.task_materials
  set
    stock_state = case
      when exists (
        select 1
        from public.inventory_stock_records
        where inventory_stock_records.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and inventory_stock_records.product_id = p_product_id
      ) then 'reserved'::public.task_material_stock_state
      else 'untracked'::public.task_material_stock_state
    end,
    consumed_at = null,
    updated_by = v_user_id
  where task_materials.id = v_material.id;

  return v_material.id;
end;
functions.complete_statement:

functions.name: agenda_default_time_zone
functions.definition:
with profile_zone as (
    select nullif(nullif(btrim(profiles.timezone), ''), 'UTC') as time_zone
    from public.profiles
    where p_user_id is not null
      and profiles.user_id = p_user_id
  ),
  country_zone as (
    select
      case upper(btrim(coalesce(
        organizations.operating_country,
        organizations.address_country,
        ''
      )))
        when 'AT' then 'Europe/Vienna'
        when 'AUSTRIA' then 'Europe/Vienna'
        when 'BE' then 'Europe/Brussels'
        when 'BELGIE' then 'Europe/Brussels'
        when 'BELGIË' then 'Europe/Brussels'
        when 'BELGIUM' then 'Europe/Brussels'
        when 'CH' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'DE' then 'Europe/Berlin'
        when 'DENMARK' then 'Europe/Copenhagen'
        when 'DEUTSCHLAND' then 'Europe/Berlin'
        when 'DK' then 'Europe/Copenhagen'
        when 'ES' then 'Europe/Madrid'
        when 'FI' then 'Europe/Helsinki'
        when 'FINLAND' then 'Europe/Helsinki'
        when 'FR' then 'Europe/Paris'
        when 'FRANCE' then 'Europe/Paris'
        when 'GB' then 'Europe/London'
        when 'GERMANY' then 'Europe/Berlin'
        when 'IE' then 'Europe/Dublin'
        when 'IRELAND' then 'Europe/Dublin'
        when 'IT' then 'Europe/Rome'
        when 'ITALIA' then 'Europe/Rome'
        when 'ITALY' then 'Europe/Rome'
        when 'NEDERLAND' then 'Europe/Amsterdam'
        when 'NETHERLANDS' then 'Europe/Amsterdam'
        when 'NL' then 'Europe/Amsterdam'
        when 'NO' then 'Europe/Oslo'
        when 'NORWAY' then 'Europe/Oslo'
        when 'OSTERREICH' then 'Europe/Vienna'
        when 'ÖSTERREICH' then 'Europe/Vienna'
        when 'PL' then 'Europe/Warsaw'
        when 'POLAND' then 'Europe/Warsaw'
        when 'PORTUGAL' then 'Europe/Lisbon'
        when 'PT' then 'Europe/Lisbon'
        when 'SE' then 'Europe/Stockholm'
        when 'SPAIN' then 'Europe/Madrid'
        when 'SWEDEN' then 'Europe/Stockholm'
        when 'SCHWEIZ' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'SUISSE' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'SWITZERLAND' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'UK' then 'Europe/London'
        when 'UNITED KINGDOM' then 'Europe/London'
        else null
      end as time_zone
    from public.organizations
    where organizations.id = p_organization_id
  )
  select coalesce(
    case when p_prefer_profile then profile_zone.time_zone end,
    country_zone.time_zone,
    profile_zone.time_zone,
    'UTC'
  )
  from (select 1) as sentinel
  left join profile_zone on true
  left join country_zone on true

        when 'SCHWEIZ' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'SUISSE' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'SWITZERLAND' then 'Europe/Zurich'
        when 'UK' then 'Europe/London'
        when 'UNITED KINGDOM' then 'Europe/London'
        else null
      end as time_zone
    from public.organizations
    where organizations.id = p_organization_id
  )
  select coalesce(
    case when p_prefer_profile then profile_zone.time_zone end,
    country_zone.time_zone,
    profile_zone.time_zone,
    'UTC'
  )
  from (select 1) as sentinel
  left join profile_zone on true
  left join country_zone on true
$function$

with membership as (
    select organization_users.role_id
    from public.organization_users
    join public.profiles
      on profiles.user_id = organization_users.user_id
    join public.organizations
      on organizations.id = organization_users.organization_id
    where organization_users.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and organization_users.user_id = p_user_id
      and profiles.disabled_at is null
      and organizations.disabled_at is null
  ),
  permission as (
    select permissions.id
    from public.permissions
    where permissions.key = p_permission
      and permissions.scope = 'organization'
  ),
  explicit as (
    select organization_permission_overrides.granted
    from public.organization_permission_overrides
    join membership
      on membership.role_id = organization_permission_overrides.role_id
    join permission
      on permission.id = organization_permission_overrides.permission_id
    where organization_permission_overrides.organization_id = p_organization_id
  )
  select case
    when exists (select 1 from explicit where granted = false) then false
    when exists (select 1 from explicit where granted = true) then true
    else exists (
      select 1
      from public.role_permissions
      join membership
        on membership.role_id = role_permissions.role_id
      join permission
        on permission.id = role_permissions.permission_id
    )
  end;

functions.name: apply_task_parts_hold
functions.definition:
declare
  v_reason_id uuid;
  v_backordered boolean;
begin
  select task_hold_reasons.id
  into v_reason_id
  from public.task_hold_reasons
  where task_hold_reasons.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and task_hold_reasons.system_key = 'parts';

  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.inventory_allocations
    join public.task_materials
      on task_materials.id = inventory_allocations.task_material_id
    where task_materials.task_id = p_task_id
      and inventory_allocations.state = 'backordered'
  )
  into v_backordered;

  if v_backordered then
    update public.tasks
    set status = 'on_hold', hold_reason_id = v_reason_id
    where tasks.id = p_task_id
      and tasks.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and tasks.status in ('todo', 'in_progress');
  else
    update public.tasks
    set status = 'todo'
    where tasks.id = p_task_id
      and tasks.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and tasks.status = 'on_hold'
      and v_reason_id is not null
      and tasks.hold_reason_id = v_reason_id;
  end if;
end;

functions.name: assign_task_agenda_projection
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.assign_task_agenda_projection(p_organization_id uuid, p_task_id uuid, p_calendar_id uuid, p_user_ids uuid[], p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_agenda_item_id uuid;
  v_calendar public.agenda_collections%rowtype;
  v_task public.tasks%rowtype;
begin
  if p_starts_at >= p_ends_at then
    raise exception 'planning end must be after start' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_task
  from public.tasks
  where id = p_task_id
    and organization_id = p_organization_id
    and parent_task_id is null
  for update;

  if v_task.id is null then
    raise exception 'root task not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  select *
  into v_calendar
  from public.agenda_collections
  where id = p_calendar_id
    and organization_id = p_organization_id
    and source = 'local';

  if v_calendar.id is null then
    raise exception 'editable calendar not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  update public.tasks
  set
    start_at = p_starts_at,
    end_at = p_ends_at,
    updated_by = (select auth.uid())
  where id = p_task_id
    and organization_id = p_organization_id;

  delete from public.task_assignees
  where task_id = p_task_id
    and organization_id = p_organization_id;

  insert into public.task_assignees (organization_id, task_id, user_id)
  select p_organization_id, p_task_id, requested.user_id
  from (
    select distinct user_id
    from unnest(coalesce(p_user_ids, '{}'::uuid[])) as input(user_id)
  ) as requested;

  select agenda_item_id
  into v_agenda_item_id
  from public.agenda_task_projections
  where task_id = p_task_id
    and organization_id = p_organization_id
  for update;

  if v_agenda_item_id is null then
    insert into public.agenda_items (
      organization_id,
      title,
      starts_at,
      ends_at,
      task_id,
      created_by,
      visibility,
      owner_user_id,
      agenda_collection_id
    ) values (
      p_organization_id,
      v_task.title,
      p_starts_at,
      p_ends_at,
      p_task_id,
      (select auth.uid()),
      v_calendar.visibility,
      v_calendar.owner_user_id,
      p_calendar_id
    )
    returning id into v_agenda_item_id;

    insert into public.agenda_task_projections (
      organization_id,
      task_id,
      agenda_item_id
    ) values (
      p_organization_id,
      p_task_id,
      v_agenda_item_id
    );
  else
    update public.agenda_items
    set
      title = v_task.title,
      starts_at = p_starts_at,
      ends_at = p_ends_at,
      is_all_day = false,
      task_id = p_task_id,
      visibility = v_calendar.visibility,
      owner_user_id = v_calendar.owner_user_id,
      agenda_collection_id = p_calendar_id
    where id = v_agenda_item_id
      and organization_id = p_organization_id;
  end if;

  perform public.replace_agenda_item_children(
    p_organization_id,
    v_agenda_item_id,
    p_user_ids,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'attendees',
      (
        select coalesce(
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'user_id', requested.user_id,
              'role', 'required',
              'participation_status', 'needs-action',
              'is_optional', false,
              'is_organizer', false
            )
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        from (
          select distinct user_id
          from unnest(coalesce(p_user_ids, '{}'::uuid[])) as input(user_id)
        ) as requested
      )
    )
  );

  return v_agenda_item_id;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_task_id uuid, p_calendar_id uuid, p_user_ids uuid[], p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone
functions.identity_argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_task_id uuid, p_calendar_id uuid, p_user_ids uuid[], p_starts_at timestamp with time zone, p_ends_at timestamp with time zone

functions.name: begin_ai_chat_turn
functions.definition:
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_approval jsonb;
  v_approval_count integer := 0;
  v_approval_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
  v_approval_record public.approval_requests%rowtype;
  v_approval_response_run_id uuid := null;
  v_approval_response_stream_id text := null;
  v_approval_response_workflow_run_id text := null;
  v_approval_replay_count integer := 0;
  v_approvals_valid boolean := true;
  v_created_thread boolean := false;
  v_deduplicated boolean := false;
  v_history jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_history_total integer := 0;
  v_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_message_found boolean := false;
  v_outcome text := 'started';
  v_part jsonb;
  v_replay_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_run public.ai_agent_runs%rowtype;
  v_run_metadata jsonb;
  v_takeover boolean := false;
  v_target_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_target_message_found boolean := false;
  v_target_user_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_thread public.chat_threads%rowtype;
  v_thread_found boolean := false;
  v_tool_match_count integer := 0;
  v_updated_count integer := 0;
  v_workflow_run_id text := null;
begin
  if v_actor_id is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Authentication is required.';
  end if;

  if p_mode not in ('ask', 'plan', 'agent')
    or p_trigger not in ('submit-message', 'regenerate-message')
    or p_active_stream_id is null
    or length(p_active_stream_id) not between 1 and 240
    or p_model is null
    or length(p_model) not between 1 and 160
    or p_request_id is null
    or length(p_request_id) not between 1 and 240
    or (p_route is not null and length(p_route) > 2048)
    or p_history_limit not between 1 and 100
    or jsonb_typeof(p_run_metadata) <> 'object'
    or pg_column_size(p_run_metadata) > 65536
    or jsonb_typeof(p_event_payload) <> 'object'
    or pg_column_size(p_event_payload) > 16384
    or jsonb_typeof(p_approval_responses) <> 'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 20
  then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid AI chat turn input.';
  end if;

  if (p_message_id is null) <> (p_user_client_message_id is null)
    or (p_message_id is null) <> (p_user_message_parts is null)
    or (
      p_trigger = 'submit-message'
      and p_message_id is null
      and jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) = 0
    )
    or (p_message_id is not null and jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 0)
    or (
      p_trigger = 'submit-message'
      and (
        (p_message_id is not null and p_target_message_id is not null)
        or (
          jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 0
          and p_target_message_id is null
        )
      )
    )
    or (
      p_trigger = 'regenerate-message'
      and (
        p_target_message_id is null
        or p_message_id is not null
        or jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 0
      )
    )
    or (
      p_message_id is not null
      and (
        length(p_user_client_message_id) not between 1 and 240
        or jsonb_typeof(p_user_message_parts) <> 'array'
        or jsonb_array_length(p_user_message_parts) not between 1 and 100
        or pg_column_size(p_user_message_parts) > 131072
      )
    )
    or ((p_mode = 'agent' and p_message_id is not null) <> (p_dispatch_id is not null))
  then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid AI chat message input.';
  end if;

  if p_user_message_parts is not null then
    for v_part in
      select part.value
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_user_message_parts) as part(value)
    loop
      if jsonb_typeof(v_part) <> 'object'
        or v_part ->> 'type' not in ('action', 'command', 'file', 'mention', 'text')
      then
        raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical user message part.';
      end if;

      case v_part ->> 'type'
        when 'action' then
          if exists (
              select 1
              from jsonb_object_keys(v_part) as action_key(key)
              where action_key.key not in (
                'actionId',
                'actionVersion',
                'approvalConfirmed',
                'contextFingerprint',
                'contextKinds',
                'intakeAnswers',
                'route',
                'safeReferences',
                'type'
              )
            )
            or coalesce(v_part ->> 'actionId', '') !~
              '^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
            or length(v_part ->> 'actionId') > 120
            or coalesce(v_part ->> 'actionVersion', '') !~
              '^[a-zA-Z0-9]+([.-][a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$'
            or length(v_part ->> 'actionVersion') > 40
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'approvalConfirmed') <> 'boolean'
            or coalesce(v_part ->> 'contextFingerprint', '') !~
              '^sha256:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
            or length(v_part ->> 'contextFingerprint') > 160
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'contextKinds') <> 'array'
            or jsonb_array_length(v_part -> 'contextKinds') not between 1 and 8
            or exists (
              select 1
              from jsonb_array_elements(v_part -> 'contextKinds') as context_kind(value)
              where jsonb_typeof(context_kind.value) <> 'string'
                or context_kind.value #>> '{}' not in (
                  'collection',
                  'entity',
                  'filter',
                  'form',
                  'organization',
                  'page',
                  'schedule',
                  'selection',
                  'template',
                  'thread',
                  'workflow'
                )
            )
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'route') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'route') not between 1 and 2048
            or left(v_part ->> 'route', 1) <> '/'
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'safeReferences') <> 'array'
            or jsonb_array_length(v_part -> 'safeReferences') > 20
            or exists (
              select 1
              from jsonb_array_elements(v_part -> 'safeReferences') as safe_reference(value)
              where jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value) <> 'object'
                or exists (
                  select 1
                  from jsonb_object_keys(safe_reference.value) as reference_key(key)
                  where reference_key.key not in ('id', 'kind', 'label', 'organizationId', 'path')
                )
                or jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value -> 'id') <> 'string'
                or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'id') not between 1 and 160
                or coalesce(safe_reference.value ->> 'kind', '') !~
                  '^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
                or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'kind') > 120
                or jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value -> 'label') <> 'string'
                or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'label') not between 1 and 160
                or (
                  safe_reference.value ? 'organizationId'
                  and coalesce(safe_reference.value ->> 'organizationId', '') !~
                    '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
                )
                or (
                  safe_reference.value ? 'path'
                  and (
                    jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value -> 'path') <> 'string'
                    or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'path') not between 1 and 1024
                    or left(safe_reference.value ->> 'path', 1) <> '/'
                  )
                )
            )
            or (
              v_part ? 'intakeAnswers'
              and (
                jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'intakeAnswers') <> 'array'
                or jsonb_array_length(v_part -> 'intakeAnswers') > 12
                or exists (
                  select 1
                  from jsonb_array_elements(v_part -> 'intakeAnswers') as intake_answer(value)
                  where jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value) <> 'object'
                    or exists (
                      select 1
                      from jsonb_object_keys(intake_answer.value) as answer_key(key)
                      where answer_key.key not in ('fieldId', 'value')
                    )
                    or coalesce(intake_answer.value ->> 'fieldId', '') !~
                      '^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
                    or length(intake_answer.value ->> 'fieldId') > 120
                    or (
                      jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value -> 'value') = 'string'
                      and length(intake_answer.value ->> 'value') > 10000
                    )
                    or (
                      jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value -> 'value') = 'array'
                      and (
                        jsonb_array_length(intake_answer.value -> 'value') > 12
                        or exists (
                          select 1
                          from jsonb_array_elements(intake_answer.value -> 'value') as answer_value(value)
                          where jsonb_typeof(answer_value.value) <> 'string'
                            or length(answer_value.value #>> '{}') > 1000
                        )
                      )
                    )
                    or jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value -> 'value') not in ('array', 'string')
                )
              )
            )
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical action part.';
          end if;
        when 'text' then
          if jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'text') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'text') > 50000
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical text part.';
          end if;
        when 'file' then
          if coalesce(v_part ->> 'attachmentId', '') !~
              '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'mediaType') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'mediaType') not between 1 and 240
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'name') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'name') not between 1 and 240
            or not exists (
              select 1
              from public.chat_attachments as attachment
              where attachment.id = (v_part ->> 'attachmentId')::uuid
                and attachment.thread_id = p_thread_id
                and attachment.organization_id = p_organization_id
                and attachment.created_by = v_actor_id
                and attachment.status = 'ready'
            )
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical file part.';
          end if;
        when 'mention' then
          if jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'id') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'id') not between 1 and 240
            or v_part ->> 'kind' not in (
              'contact',
              'customer',
              'customer-asset',
              'invoice',
              'product',
              'quote',
              'task',
              'team',
              'user'
            )
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'label') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'label') not between 1 and 240
            or (v_part ? 'href' and length(v_part ->> 'href') > 1024)
            or (v_part ? 'metadata' and jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'metadata') <> 'object')
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical mention part.';
          end if;
        when 'command' then
          if jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'command') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'command') not between 1 and 80
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'label') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'label') not between 1 and 240
            or v_part ->> 'status' not in ('executed', 'rejected', 'selected')
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical command part.';
          end if;
        else
          raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical user message part.';
      end case;
    end loop;
  end if;

  -- Serialize creation and turn-state transitions even when the thread row
  -- does not exist yet, where SELECT FOR UPDATE cannot take a row lock.
  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_thread_id::text, 0)
  );

  select thread.*
  into v_thread
  from public.chat_threads as thread
  where thread.id = p_thread_id
  for update;
  v_thread_found := found;

  if v_thread_found then
    if v_thread.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id
      or not public.has_chat_thread_access(v_thread.id)
    then
      raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'AI chat thread access denied.';
    end if;
  else
    if p_message_id is null
      or not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
      or p_expected_active_stream_id is not null
    then
      raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'AI chat thread access denied.';
    end if;

    insert into public.chat_threads (
      id,
      organization_id,
      owner_user_id,
      title,
      visibility,
      mode,
      metadata
    )
    values (
      p_thread_id,
      p_organization_id,
      v_actor_id,
      null,
      'private',
      p_mode,
      jsonb_build_object('createdFromRoute', to_jsonb(p_route))
    )
    returning * into v_thread;
    v_created_thread := true;
  end if;

  if p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then
    select message.*
    into v_target_message
    from public.chat_messages as message
    where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and message.role = 'assistant'
      and coalesce(message.client_message_id, message.id::text) = p_target_message_id
      and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
    for update;
    v_target_message_found := found;

    if not v_target_message_found then
      v_outcome := 'stale_regeneration';
    else
      select message.*
      into v_target_user_message
      from public.chat_messages as message
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and message.role = 'user'
        and (message.created_at, message.id) <
          (v_target_message.created_at, v_target_message.id)
        and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
      order by message.created_at desc, message.id desc
      limit 1;

      if not found then
        v_outcome := 'stale_regeneration';
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  for v_approval in
    select approval.value
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_approval_responses) as approval(value)
  loop
    if jsonb_typeof(v_approval) <> 'object'
      or exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_object_keys(v_approval) as approval_key(key)
        where approval_key.key not in (
          'approvalId',
          'approved',
          'messageId',
          'reason',
          'toolCallId'
        )
      )
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'approvalId') <> 'string'
      or length(v_approval ->> 'approvalId') not between 1 and 240
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'approved') <> 'boolean'
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'messageId') <> 'string'
      or length(v_approval ->> 'messageId') not between 1 and 240
      or (v_approval ? 'reason' and jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'reason') <> 'string')
      or length(coalesce(v_approval ->> 'reason', '')) > 1000
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'toolCallId') <> 'string'
      or length(v_approval ->> 'toolCallId') not between 1 and 240
    then
      v_approvals_valid := false;
      exit;
    end if;

    select count(*)
    into v_tool_match_count
    from public.chat_messages as message
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
      case
        when jsonb_typeof(message.parts) = 'array' then message.parts
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end
    ) as part(value)
    where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and message.role = 'assistant'
      and coalesce(message.client_message_id, message.id::text) = v_approval ->> 'messageId'
      and part.value ->> 'type' = 'tool'
      and part.value ->> 'toolCallId' = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId'
      and part.value -> 'approval' ->> 'id' = v_approval ->> 'approvalId'
      and (
        part.value ->> 'state' = 'approval-requested'
        or (
          part.value ->> 'state' = 'approval-responded'
          and part.value -> 'approval' -> 'approved' = v_approval -> 'approved'
          and (part.value -> 'approval' ->> 'reason')
            is not distinct from (v_approval ->> 'reason')
        )
      );

    select approval.*
    into v_approval_record
    from public.approval_requests as approval
    join public.ai_agent_runs as approval_run
      on approval_run.id = approval.agent_run_id
      and approval_run.thread_id = approval.thread_id
      and approval_run.organization_id = approval.organization_id
      and approval_run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and approval_run.mode = 'agent'
    join public.chat_messages as approval_message
      on approval_message.thread_id = approval.thread_id
      and approval_message.organization_id = approval.organization_id
      and approval_message.role = 'assistant'
      and coalesce(approval_message.client_message_id, approval_message.id::text) =
        v_approval ->> 'messageId'
      and approval_message.metadata ->> 'runId' = approval.agent_run_id::text
    where approval.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and approval.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and (
        approval.id::text = v_approval ->> 'approvalId'
        or approval.tool_call_id = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId'
      )
    order by
      (approval.id::text = v_approval ->> 'approvalId') desc,
      approval.requested_at desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if v_tool_match_count <> 1
      or not found
      or v_approval_record.status not in ('approved', 'consumed', 'denied')
      or (v_approval_record.status <> 'denied') is distinct from
        ((v_approval ->> 'approved')::boolean)
      or v_approval_record.decision_reason is distinct from (v_approval ->> 'reason')
      or v_approval_record.id = any(v_approval_ids)
    then
      v_approvals_valid := false;
      exit;
    end if;

    v_approval_count := v_approval_count + 1;
    v_approval_ids := array_append(v_approval_ids, v_approval_record.id);

    if v_approval_record.response_idempotency_key is not null then
      if v_approval_record.response_idempotency_key <> v_approval_record.id::text
        or v_approval_record.response_message_id is distinct from (v_approval ->> 'messageId')
        or v_approval_record.response_tool_call_id is distinct from
          (v_approval ->> 'toolCallId')
        or v_approval_record.response_approved is distinct from
          ((v_approval ->> 'approved')::boolean)
        or v_approval_record.response_reason is distinct from (v_approval ->> 'reason')
        or v_approval_record.response_run_id is null
        or v_approval_record.response_active_stream_id is null
        or (
          v_approval_response_run_id is not null
          and v_approval_record.response_run_id is distinct from v_approval_response_run_id
        )
        or (
          v_approval_response_stream_id is not null
          and v_approval_record.response_active_stream_id is distinct from
            v_approval_response_stream_id
        )
        or (
          v_approval_response_workflow_run_id is not null
          and v_approval_record.response_workflow_run_id is distinct from
            v_approval_response_workflow_run_id
        )
      then
        v_approvals_valid := false;
        exit;
      end if;

      v_approval_replay_count := v_approval_replay_count + 1;
      v_approval_response_run_id := coalesce(
        v_approval_response_run_id,
        v_approval_record.response_run_id
      );
      v_approval_response_stream_id := coalesce(
        v_approval_response_stream_id,
        v_approval_record.response_active_stream_id
      );
      v_approval_response_workflow_run_id := coalesce(
        v_approval_response_workflow_run_id,
        v_approval_record.response_workflow_run_id
      );
    end if;
  end loop;

  if v_approval_replay_count not in (0, v_approval_count) then
    v_approvals_valid := false;
  end if;

  if not v_approvals_valid then
    v_outcome := 'stale_approval';
  end if;

  if p_user_client_message_id is not null then
    select message.*
    into v_message
    from public.chat_messages as message
    where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.client_message_id = p_user_client_message_id
    for update;
    v_message_found := found;

    if v_message_found then
      if v_message.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id
        or v_message.created_by is distinct from v_actor_id
        or v_message.role <> 'user'
      then
        raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'AI chat message access denied.';
      end if;
      v_deduplicated := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started' and v_approval_replay_count > 0 then
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.id = v_approval_response_run_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode = 'agent'
      and run.workflow_run_id is not distinct from v_approval_response_workflow_run_id
      and (
        run.workflow_run_id is not null
        or run.active_stream_id = v_approval_response_stream_id
      );

    if not found then
      v_outcome := 'stale_approval';
    else
      v_workflow_run_id := v_approval_response_workflow_run_id;
      v_outcome := case
        when v_workflow_run_id is null then 'in_progress'
        else 'reconnect'
      end;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_trigger = 'submit-message'
    and p_mode in ('ask', 'plan')
    and v_message_found
  then
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode in ('ask', 'plan')
      and run.input_client_message_id = p_user_client_message_id
    order by run.created_at desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if found then
      v_deduplicated := true;
      if v_run.status in ('succeeded', 'partial_success')
        and v_run.active_stream_id is null
        and v_run.message_id is not null
      then
        select message.*
        into v_replay_message
        from public.chat_messages as message
        where message.id = v_run.message_id
          and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and message.role = 'assistant'
          and message.status = 'complete'
          and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId');

        v_outcome := case when found then 'replay' else 'in_progress' end;
      else
        v_outcome := 'in_progress';
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_mode = 'agent'
    and v_message_found
    and v_message.dispatch_linked_at is not null
    and nullif(v_message.metadata ->> 'workflowRunId', '') is not null
  then
    v_workflow_run_id := v_message.metadata ->> 'workflowRunId';
    v_outcome := 'reconnect';
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.message_id = v_message.id
      and run.workflow_run_id = v_workflow_run_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
    order by run.created_at desc
    limit 1;
  elsif v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_mode = 'agent'
    and v_message_found
    and v_message.dispatch_id is not null
    and v_message.dispatch_linked_at is null
    and v_message.dispatch_claimed_at >= (now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '60 seconds'
  then
    v_outcome := 'in_progress';
  elsif v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_mode = 'agent'
    and v_message_found
    and v_message.dispatch_id is not null
    and v_message.dispatch_linked_at is null
  then
    v_takeover :=
      v_thread.stream_status = 'submitted'
      and v_thread.active_workflow_run_id is null
      and v_thread.active_stream_id = v_message.dispatch_id::text
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.ai_agent_runs as run
        where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and run.created_by = v_actor_id
          and run.mode = 'agent'
          and run.active_stream_id = v_thread.active_stream_id
          and run.workflow_run_id is null
          and run.status not in (
            'canceled',
            'failed',
            'stopped',
            'succeeded',
            'partial_success'
          )
      );
    if not v_takeover then
      v_outcome := 'stream_conflict';
      v_workflow_run_id := v_thread.active_workflow_run_id;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_message_id is null
    and v_thread.stream_status in ('submitted', 'streaming', 'stopping')
  then
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.active_stream_id = v_thread.active_stream_id
      and coalesce(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses', '[]'::jsonb) = p_approval_responses
    order by run.created_at desc
    limit 1;

    if found then
      v_workflow_run_id := v_run.workflow_run_id;
      v_outcome := case
        when v_workflow_run_id is null then 'in_progress'
        else 'reconnect'
      end;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and not v_takeover
    and (
      v_thread.stream_status in ('submitted', 'streaming', 'stopping')
      or v_thread.active_stream_id is distinct from p_expected_active_stream_id
    )
  then
    v_outcome := 'stream_conflict';
    v_workflow_run_id := v_thread.active_workflow_run_id;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started' then
    if p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then
      update public.chat_messages as message
      set metadata = message.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'supersededByRunId', p_run_id,
        'supersededAt', now() at time zone 'utc'
      )
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and (message.created_at, message.id) >
          (v_target_message.created_at, v_target_message.id)
        and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId');
    end if;

    if not v_message_found and p_message_id is not null then
      insert into public.chat_messages (
        id,
        thread_id,
        organization_id,
        role,
        parts,
        metadata,
        status,
        created_by,
        client_message_id,
        dispatch_id,
        dispatch_claimed_at,
        dispatch_linked_at
      )
      values (
        p_message_id,
        p_thread_id,
        p_organization_id,
        'user',
        p_user_message_parts,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'outboxState',
          case when p_mode = 'agent' then 'pending' else 'completed' end,
          'route',
          to_jsonb(p_route)
        ),
        'complete',
        v_actor_id,
        p_user_client_message_id,
        p_dispatch_id,
        case when p_dispatch_id is null then null else now() at time zone 'utc' end,
        null
      )
      returning * into v_message;
      v_message_found := true;
    elsif v_message_found and p_mode = 'agent' then
      if v_takeover then
        update public.ai_agent_runs as run
        set
          active_stream_id = null,
          completed_at = coalesce(run.completed_at, now() at time zone 'utc'),
          status = 'stopped',
          summary = coalesce(run.summary, 'Superseded by an expired dispatch retry.')
        where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and run.created_by = v_actor_id
          and run.active_stream_id = v_thread.active_stream_id
          and run.workflow_run_id is null
          and run.status not in ('canceled', 'failed', 'stopped', 'succeeded', 'partial_success');
      end if;

      update public.chat_messages as message
      set
        dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id,
        dispatch_claimed_at = now() at time zone 'utc',
        dispatch_linked_at = null,
        metadata = jsonb_set(message.metadata, '{outboxState}', '"pending"'::jsonb)
      where message.id = v_message.id
      returning * into v_message;
    end if;

    v_run_metadata := case
      when jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) = 0 then p_run_metadata
      else jsonb_set(p_run_metadata, '{approvalResponses}', p_approval_responses, true)
    end;

    insert into public.ai_agent_runs (
      id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      message_id,
      request_id,
      workflow_run_id,
      mode,
      status,
      title,
      model,
      active_stream_id,
      metadata,
      created_by,
      input_client_message_id
    )
    values (
      p_run_id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      case when p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then v_target_message.id else null end,
      p_request_id,
      null,
      p_mode,
      case when p_mode = 'plan' then 'planning' else 'running' end,
      case
        when p_mode = 'plan' then 'Planning request'
        when p_mode = 'agent' then 'Agent request'
        else 'Assistant request'
      end,
      p_model,
      p_active_stream_id,
      v_run_metadata,
      v_actor_id,
      case
        when p_trigger = 'submit-message' and p_mode in ('ask', 'plan')
          then p_user_client_message_id
        else null
      end
    )
    returning * into v_run;

    if v_approval_count > 0 then
      for v_approval in
        select approval.value
        from jsonb_array_elements(p_approval_responses) as approval(value)
      loop
        update public.approval_requests as approval
        set
          response_idempotency_key = approval.id::text,
          response_run_id = p_run_id,
          response_active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id,
          response_message_id = v_approval ->> 'messageId',
          response_tool_call_id = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId',
          response_approved = (v_approval ->> 'approved')::boolean,
          response_reason = v_approval ->> 'reason',
          response_recorded_at = now() at time zone 'utc'
        where approval.id = any(v_approval_ids)
          and (
            approval.id::text = v_approval ->> 'approvalId'
            or approval.tool_call_id = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId'
          )
          and approval.response_idempotency_key is null;

        get diagnostics v_updated_count = row_count;
        if v_updated_count <> 1 then
          raise exception using
            errcode = '40001',
            message = 'Unable to claim AI approval response idempotency.';
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    insert into public.ai_agent_run_events (
      run_id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      request_id,
      kind,
      sequence,
      status,
      title,
      payload,
      metadata,
      created_by
    )
    values (
      v_run.id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      p_request_id,
      'run_started',
      1,
      'running',
      'Run started',
      p_event_payload,
      jsonb_build_object('mode', p_mode, 'route', to_jsonb(p_route)),
      v_actor_id
    );

    update public.chat_threads as thread
    set
      active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id,
      active_workflow_run_id = null,
      mode = p_mode,
      stream_status = case when p_mode = 'agent' then 'submitted' else 'streaming' end
    where thread.id = p_thread_id
      and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    returning * into v_thread;
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_history_total
  from public.chat_messages as message
  where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
    and (
      p_trigger <> 'regenerate-message'
      or (message.created_at, message.id) <=
        (v_target_user_message.created_at, v_target_user_message.id)
    );

  with
    latest_message_ids as (
      select message.id
      from public.chat_messages as message
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
        and (
          p_trigger <> 'regenerate-message'
          or (message.created_at, message.id) <=
            (v_target_user_message.created_at, v_target_user_message.id)
        )
      order by message.created_at desc, message.id desc
      limit p_history_limit
    ),
    approval_message_ids as (
      select message.id
      from public.chat_messages as message
      join jsonb_array_elements(p_approval_responses) as approval(value)
        on coalesce(message.client_message_id, message.id::text) =
          approval.value ->> 'messageId'
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
    ),
    selected_message_ids as (
      select latest_message_ids.id from latest_message_ids
      union
      select approval_message_ids.id from approval_message_ids
    ),
    selected_messages as (
      select message.*
      from public.chat_messages as message
      join selected_message_ids on selected_message_ids.id = message.id
    )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'clientMessageId', selected_messages.client_message_id,
        'createdAt', selected_messages.created_at,
        'createdBy', selected_messages.created_by,
        'id', selected_messages.id,
        'metadata', selected_messages.metadata,
        'organizationId', selected_messages.organization_id,
        'parts', selected_messages.parts,
        'role', selected_messages.role,
        'status', selected_messages.status,
        'threadId', selected_messages.thread_id
      )
      order by selected_messages.created_at, selected_messages.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_history
  from selected_messages;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'createdThread', v_created_thread,
    'deduplicated', v_deduplicated,
    'dispatchId', case when v_message_found then v_message.dispatch_id else null end,
    'message', case
      when not v_message_found then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'clientMessageId', v_message.client_message_id,
        'createdAt', v_message.created_at,
        'createdBy', v_message.created_by,
        'id', v_message.id,
        'metadata', v_message.metadata,
        'organizationId', v_message.organization_id,
        'parts', v_message.parts,
        'role', v_message.role,
        'status', v_message.status,
        'threadId', v_message.thread_id
      )
    end,
    'messages', v_history,
    'outcome', v_outcome,
    'pagination', jsonb_build_object(
      'hasMore', v_history_total > p_history_limit,
      'limit', p_history_limit,
      'offset', 0,
      'total', v_history_total
    ),
    'replayMessage', case
      when v_replay_message.id is null then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'clientMessageId', v_replay_message.client_message_id,
        'createdAt', v_replay_message.created_at,
        'createdBy', v_replay_message.created_by,
        'id', v_replay_message.id,
        'metadata', v_replay_message.metadata,
        'organizationId', v_replay_message.organization_id,
        'parts', v_replay_message.parts,
        'role', v_replay_message.role,
        'status', v_replay_message.status,
        'threadId', v_replay_message.thread_id
      )
    end,
    'replacementMessageId', case
      when p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then v_target_message.id
      else null
    end,
    'run', case
      when v_run.id is null then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'createdBy', v_run.created_by,
        'id', v_run.id,
        'title', v_run.title
      )
    end,
    'thread', jsonb_build_object(
      'activeStreamId', v_thread.active_stream_id,
      'activeWorkflowRunId', v_thread.active_workflow_run_id,
      'archivedAt', v_thread.archived_at,
      'createdAt', v_thread.created_at,
      'id', v_thread.id,
      'metadata', v_thread.metadata,
      'mode', v_thread.mode,
      'organizationId', v_thread.organization_id,
      'ownerUserId', v_thread.owner_user_id,
      'pinnedAt', v_thread.pinned_at,
      'streamStatus', v_thread.stream_status,
      'title', v_thread.title,
      'updatedAt', v_thread.updated_at,
      'visibility', v_thread.visibility
    ),
    'workflowRunId', v_workflow_run_id
  );
end;
