CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.begin_ai_chat_turn(p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_expected_active_stream_id text, p_mode text, p_model text, p_request_id text, p_route text, p_run_metadata jsonb, p_event_payload jsonb, p_message_id uuid, p_user_client_message_id text, p_user_message_parts jsonb, p_dispatch_id uuid, p_approval_responses jsonb, p_trigger text, p_target_message_id text, p_history_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_approval jsonb;
  v_approval_count integer := 0;
  v_approval_ids uuid[] := '{}'::uuid[];
  v_approval_record public.approval_requests%rowtype;
  v_approval_response_run_id uuid := null;
  v_approval_response_stream_id text := null;
  v_approval_response_workflow_run_id text := null;
  v_approval_replay_count integer := 0;
  v_approvals_valid boolean := true;
  v_created_thread boolean := false;
  v_deduplicated boolean := false;
  v_history jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_history_total integer := 0;
  v_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_message_found boolean := false;
  v_outcome text := 'started';
  v_part jsonb;
  v_replay_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_run public.ai_agent_runs%rowtype;
  v_run_metadata jsonb;
  v_takeover boolean := false;
  v_target_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_target_message_found boolean := false;
  v_target_user_message public.chat_messages%rowtype;
  v_thread public.chat_threads%rowtype;
  v_thread_found boolean := false;
  v_tool_match_count integer := 0;
  v_updated_count integer := 0;
  v_workflow_run_id text := null;
begin
  if v_actor_id is null then
    raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'Authentication is required.';
  end if;

  if p_mode not in ('ask', 'plan', 'agent')
    or p_trigger not in ('submit-message', 'regenerate-message')
    or p_active_stream_id is null
    or length(p_active_stream_id) not between 1 and 240
    or p_model is null
    or length(p_model) not between 1 and 160
    or p_request_id is null
    or length(p_request_id) not between 1 and 240
    or (p_route is not null and length(p_route) > 2048)
    or p_history_limit not between 1 and 100
    or jsonb_typeof(p_run_metadata) <> 'object'
    or pg_column_size(p_run_metadata) > 65536
    or jsonb_typeof(p_event_payload) <> 'object'
    or pg_column_size(p_event_payload) > 16384
    or jsonb_typeof(p_approval_responses) <> 'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 20
  then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid AI chat turn input.';
  end if;

  if (p_message_id is null) <> (p_user_client_message_id is null)
    or (p_message_id is null) <> (p_user_message_parts is null)
    or (
      p_trigger = 'submit-message'
      and p_message_id is null
      and jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) = 0
    )
    or (p_message_id is not null and jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 0)
    or (
      p_trigger = 'submit-message'
      and (
        (p_message_id is not null and p_target_message_id is not null)
        or (
          jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 0
          and p_target_message_id is null
        )
      )
    )
    or (
      p_trigger = 'regenerate-message'
      and (
        p_target_message_id is null
        or p_message_id is not null
        or jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) > 0
      )
    )
    or (
      p_message_id is not null
      and (
        length(p_user_client_message_id) not between 1 and 240
        or jsonb_typeof(p_user_message_parts) <> 'array'
        or jsonb_array_length(p_user_message_parts) not between 1 and 100
        or pg_column_size(p_user_message_parts) > 131072
      )
    )
    or ((p_mode = 'agent' and p_message_id is not null) <> (p_dispatch_id is not null))
  then
    raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid AI chat message input.';
  end if;

  if p_user_message_parts is not null then
    for v_part in
      select part.value
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_user_message_parts) as part(value)
    loop
      if jsonb_typeof(v_part) <> 'object'
        or v_part ->> 'type' not in ('action', 'command', 'file', 'mention', 'text')
      then
        raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical user message part.';
      end if;

      case v_part ->> 'type'
        when 'action' then
          if exists (
              select 1
              from jsonb_object_keys(v_part) as action_key(key)
              where action_key.key not in (
                'actionId',
                'actionVersion',
                'approvalConfirmed',
                'contextFingerprint',
                'contextKinds',
                'intakeAnswers',
                'route',
                'safeReferences',
                'type'
              )
            )
            or coalesce(v_part ->> 'actionId', '') !~
              '^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
            or length(v_part ->> 'actionId') > 120
            or coalesce(v_part ->> 'actionVersion', '') !~
              '^[a-zA-Z0-9]+([.-][a-zA-Z0-9]+)*$'
            or length(v_part ->> 'actionVersion') > 40
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'approvalConfirmed') <> 'boolean'
            or coalesce(v_part ->> 'contextFingerprint', '') !~
              '^sha256:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
            or length(v_part ->> 'contextFingerprint') > 160
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'contextKinds') <> 'array'
            or jsonb_array_length(v_part -> 'contextKinds') not between 1 and 8
            or exists (
              select 1
              from jsonb_array_elements(v_part -> 'contextKinds') as context_kind(value)
              where jsonb_typeof(context_kind.value) <> 'string'
                or context_kind.value #>> '{}' not in (
                  'collection',
                  'entity',
                  'filter',
                  'form',
                  'organization',
                  'page',
                  'schedule',
                  'selection',
                  'template',
                  'thread',
                  'workflow'
                )
            )
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'route') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'route') not between 1 and 2048
            or left(v_part ->> 'route', 1) <> '/'
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'safeReferences') <> 'array'
            or jsonb_array_length(v_part -> 'safeReferences') > 20
            or exists (
              select 1
              from jsonb_array_elements(v_part -> 'safeReferences') as safe_reference(value)
              where jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value) <> 'object'
                or exists (
                  select 1
                  from jsonb_object_keys(safe_reference.value) as reference_key(key)
                  where reference_key.key not in ('id', 'kind', 'label', 'organizationId', 'path')
                )
                or jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value -> 'id') <> 'string'
                or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'id') not between 1 and 160
                or coalesce(safe_reference.value ->> 'kind', '') !~
                  '^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
                or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'kind') > 120
                or jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value -> 'label') <> 'string'
                or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'label') not between 1 and 160
                or (
                  safe_reference.value ? 'organizationId'
                  and coalesce(safe_reference.value ->> 'organizationId', '') !~
                    '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
                )
                or (
                  safe_reference.value ? 'path'
                  and (
                    jsonb_typeof(safe_reference.value -> 'path') <> 'string'
                    or length(safe_reference.value ->> 'path') not between 1 and 1024
                    or left(safe_reference.value ->> 'path', 1) <> '/'
                  )
                )
            )
            or (
              v_part ? 'intakeAnswers'
              and (
                jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'intakeAnswers') <> 'array'
                or jsonb_array_length(v_part -> 'intakeAnswers') > 12
                or exists (
                  select 1
                  from jsonb_array_elements(v_part -> 'intakeAnswers') as intake_answer(value)
                  where jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value) <> 'object'
                    or exists (
                      select 1
                      from jsonb_object_keys(intake_answer.value) as answer_key(key)
                      where answer_key.key not in ('fieldId', 'value')
                    )
                    or coalesce(intake_answer.value ->> 'fieldId', '') !~
                      '^[a-z0-9]+([.-][a-z0-9]+)*$'
                    or length(intake_answer.value ->> 'fieldId') > 120
                    or (
                      jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value -> 'value') = 'string'
                      and length(intake_answer.value ->> 'value') > 10000
                    )
                    or (
                      jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value -> 'value') = 'array'
                      and (
                        jsonb_array_length(intake_answer.value -> 'value') > 12
                        or exists (
                          select 1
                          from jsonb_array_elements(intake_answer.value -> 'value') as answer_value(value)
                          where jsonb_typeof(answer_value.value) <> 'string'
                            or length(answer_value.value #>> '{}') > 1000
                        )
                      )
                    )
                    or jsonb_typeof(intake_answer.value -> 'value') not in ('array', 'string')
                )
              )
            )
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical action part.';
          end if;
        when 'text' then
          if jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'text') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'text') > 50000
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical text part.';
          end if;
        when 'file' then
          if coalesce(v_part ->> 'attachmentId', '') !~
              '^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[89abAB][0-9a-fA-F]{3}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$'
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'mediaType') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'mediaType') not between 1 and 240
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'name') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'name') not between 1 and 240
            or not exists (
              select 1
              from public.chat_attachments as attachment
              where attachment.id = (v_part ->> 'attachmentId')::uuid
                and attachment.thread_id = p_thread_id
                and attachment.organization_id = p_organization_id
                and attachment.created_by = v_actor_id
                and attachment.status = 'ready'
            )
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical file part.';
          end if;
        when 'mention' then
          if jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'id') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'id') not between 1 and 240
            or v_part ->> 'kind' not in (
              'contact',
              'customer',
              'customer-asset',
              'invoice',
              'product',
              'quote',
              'task',
              'team',
              'user'
            )
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'label') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'label') not between 1 and 240
            or (v_part ? 'href' and length(v_part ->> 'href') > 1024)
            or (v_part ? 'metadata' and jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'metadata') <> 'object')
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical mention part.';
          end if;
        when 'command' then
          if jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'command') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'command') not between 1 and 80
            or jsonb_typeof(v_part -> 'label') <> 'string'
            or length(v_part ->> 'label') not between 1 and 240
            or v_part ->> 'status' not in ('executed', 'rejected', 'selected')
          then
            raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical command part.';
          end if;
        else
          raise exception using errcode = '22023', message = 'Invalid canonical user message part.';
      end case;
    end loop;
  end if;

  -- Serialize creation and turn-state transitions even when the thread row
  -- does not exist yet, where SELECT FOR UPDATE cannot take a row lock.
  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_thread_id::text, 0)
  );

  select thread.*
  into v_thread
  from public.chat_threads as thread
  where thread.id = p_thread_id
  for update;
  v_thread_found := found;

  if v_thread_found then
    if v_thread.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id
      or not public.has_chat_thread_access(v_thread.id)
    then
      raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'AI chat thread access denied.';
    end if;
  else
    if p_message_id is null
      or not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
      or p_expected_active_stream_id is not null
    then
      raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'AI chat thread access denied.';
    end if;

    insert into public.chat_threads (
      id,
      organization_id,
      owner_user_id,
      title,
      visibility,
      mode,
      metadata
    )
    values (
      p_thread_id,
      p_organization_id,
      v_actor_id,
      null,
      'private',
      p_mode,
      jsonb_build_object('createdFromRoute', to_jsonb(p_route))
    )
    returning * into v_thread;
    v_created_thread := true;
  end if;

  if p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then
    select message.*
    into v_target_message
    from public.chat_messages as message
    where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and message.role = 'assistant'
      and coalesce(message.client_message_id, message.id::text) = p_target_message_id
      and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
    for update;
    v_target_message_found := found;

    if not v_target_message_found then
      v_outcome := 'stale_regeneration';
    else
      select message.*
      into v_target_user_message
      from public.chat_messages as message
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and message.role = 'user'
        and (message.created_at, message.id) <
          (v_target_message.created_at, v_target_message.id)
        and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
      order by message.created_at desc, message.id desc
      limit 1;

      if not found then
        v_outcome := 'stale_regeneration';
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  for v_approval in
    select approval.value
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_approval_responses) as approval(value)
  loop
    if jsonb_typeof(v_approval) <> 'object'
      or exists (
        select 1
        from jsonb_object_keys(v_approval) as approval_key(key)
        where approval_key.key not in (
          'approvalId',
          'approved',
          'messageId',
          'reason',
          'toolCallId'
        )
      )
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'approvalId') <> 'string'
      or length(v_approval ->> 'approvalId') not between 1 and 240
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'approved') <> 'boolean'
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'messageId') <> 'string'
      or length(v_approval ->> 'messageId') not between 1 and 240
      or (v_approval ? 'reason' and jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'reason') <> 'string')
      or length(coalesce(v_approval ->> 'reason', '')) > 1000
      or jsonb_typeof(v_approval -> 'toolCallId') <> 'string'
      or length(v_approval ->> 'toolCallId') not between 1 and 240
    then
      v_approvals_valid := false;
      exit;
    end if;

    select count(*)
    into v_tool_match_count
    from public.chat_messages as message
    cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(
      case
        when jsonb_typeof(message.parts) = 'array' then message.parts
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end
    ) as part(value)
    where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and message.role = 'assistant'
      and coalesce(message.client_message_id, message.id::text) = v_approval ->> 'messageId'
      and part.value ->> 'type' = 'tool'
      and part.value ->> 'toolCallId' = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId'
      and part.value -> 'approval' ->> 'id' = v_approval ->> 'approvalId'
      and (
        part.value ->> 'state' = 'approval-requested'
        or (
          part.value ->> 'state' = 'approval-responded'
          and part.value -> 'approval' -> 'approved' = v_approval -> 'approved'
          and (part.value -> 'approval' ->> 'reason')
            is not distinct from (v_approval ->> 'reason')
        )
      );

    select approval.*
    into v_approval_record
    from public.approval_requests as approval
    join public.ai_agent_runs as approval_run
      on approval_run.id = approval.agent_run_id
      and approval_run.thread_id = approval.thread_id
      and approval_run.organization_id = approval.organization_id
      and approval_run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and approval_run.mode = 'agent'
    join public.chat_messages as approval_message
      on approval_message.thread_id = approval.thread_id
      and approval_message.organization_id = approval.organization_id
      and approval_message.role = 'assistant'
      and coalesce(approval_message.client_message_id, approval_message.id::text) =
        v_approval ->> 'messageId'
      and approval_message.metadata ->> 'runId' = approval.agent_run_id::text
    where approval.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and approval.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and (
        approval.id::text = v_approval ->> 'approvalId'
        or approval.tool_call_id = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId'
      )
    order by
      (approval.id::text = v_approval ->> 'approvalId') desc,
      approval.requested_at desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if v_tool_match_count <> 1
      or not found
      or v_approval_record.status not in ('approved', 'consumed', 'denied')
      or (v_approval_record.status <> 'denied') is distinct from
        ((v_approval ->> 'approved')::boolean)
      or v_approval_record.decision_reason is distinct from (v_approval ->> 'reason')
      or v_approval_record.id = any(v_approval_ids)
    then
      v_approvals_valid := false;
      exit;
    end if;

    v_approval_count := v_approval_count + 1;
    v_approval_ids := array_append(v_approval_ids, v_approval_record.id);

    if v_approval_record.response_idempotency_key is not null then
      if v_approval_record.response_idempotency_key <> v_approval_record.id::text
        or v_approval_record.response_message_id is distinct from (v_approval ->> 'messageId')
        or v_approval_record.response_tool_call_id is distinct from
          (v_approval ->> 'toolCallId')
        or v_approval_record.response_approved is distinct from
          ((v_approval ->> 'approved')::boolean)
        or v_approval_record.response_reason is distinct from (v_approval ->> 'reason')
        or v_approval_record.response_run_id is null
        or v_approval_record.response_active_stream_id is null
        or (
          v_approval_response_run_id is not null
          and v_approval_record.response_run_id is distinct from v_approval_response_run_id
        )
        or (
          v_approval_response_stream_id is not null
          and v_approval_record.response_active_stream_id is distinct from
            v_approval_response_stream_id
        )
        or (
          v_approval_response_workflow_run_id is not null
          and v_approval_record.response_workflow_run_id is distinct from
            v_approval_response_workflow_run_id
        )
      then
        v_approvals_valid := false;
        exit;
      end if;

      v_approval_replay_count := v_approval_replay_count + 1;
      v_approval_response_run_id := coalesce(
        v_approval_response_run_id,
        v_approval_record.response_run_id
      );
      v_approval_response_stream_id := coalesce(
        v_approval_response_stream_id,
        v_approval_record.response_active_stream_id
      );
      v_approval_response_workflow_run_id := coalesce(
        v_approval_response_workflow_run_id,
        v_approval_record.response_workflow_run_id
      );
    end if;
  end loop;

  if v_approval_replay_count not in (0, v_approval_count) then
    v_approvals_valid := false;
  end if;

  if not v_approvals_valid then
    v_outcome := 'stale_approval';
  end if;

  if p_user_client_message_id is not null then
    select message.*
    into v_message
    from public.chat_messages as message
    where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.client_message_id = p_user_client_message_id
    for update;
    v_message_found := found;

    if v_message_found then
      if v_message.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id
        or v_message.created_by is distinct from v_actor_id
        or v_message.role <> 'user'
      then
        raise exception using errcode = '42501', message = 'AI chat message access denied.';
      end if;
      v_deduplicated := true;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started' and v_approval_replay_count > 0 then
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.id = v_approval_response_run_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode = 'agent'
      and run.workflow_run_id is not distinct from v_approval_response_workflow_run_id
      and (
        run.workflow_run_id is not null
        or run.active_stream_id = v_approval_response_stream_id
      );

    if not found then
      v_outcome := 'stale_approval';
    else
      v_workflow_run_id := v_approval_response_workflow_run_id;
      v_outcome := case
        when v_workflow_run_id is null then 'in_progress'
        else 'reconnect'
      end;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_trigger = 'submit-message'
    and p_mode in ('ask', 'plan')
    and v_message_found
  then
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode in ('ask', 'plan')
      and run.input_client_message_id = p_user_client_message_id
    order by run.created_at desc
    limit 1
    for update;

    if found then
      v_deduplicated := true;
      if v_run.status in ('succeeded', 'partial_success')
        and v_run.active_stream_id is null
        and v_run.message_id is not null
      then
        select message.*
        into v_replay_message
        from public.chat_messages as message
        where message.id = v_run.message_id
          and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and message.role = 'assistant'
          and message.status = 'complete'
          and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId');

        v_outcome := case when found then 'replay' else 'in_progress' end;
      else
        v_outcome := 'in_progress';
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_mode = 'agent'
    and v_message_found
    and v_message.dispatch_linked_at is not null
    and nullif(v_message.metadata ->> 'workflowRunId', '') is not null
  then
    v_workflow_run_id := v_message.metadata ->> 'workflowRunId';
    v_outcome := 'reconnect';
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.message_id = v_message.id
      and run.workflow_run_id = v_workflow_run_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
    order by run.created_at desc
    limit 1;
  elsif v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_mode = 'agent'
    and v_message_found
    and v_message.dispatch_id is not null
    and v_message.dispatch_linked_at is null
    and v_message.dispatch_claimed_at >= (now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '60 seconds'
  then
    v_outcome := 'in_progress';
  elsif v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_mode = 'agent'
    and v_message_found
    and v_message.dispatch_id is not null
    and v_message.dispatch_linked_at is null
  then
    v_takeover :=
      v_thread.stream_status = 'submitted'
      and v_thread.active_workflow_run_id is null
      and v_thread.active_stream_id = v_message.dispatch_id::text
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.ai_agent_runs as run
        where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and run.created_by = v_actor_id
          and run.mode = 'agent'
          and run.active_stream_id = v_thread.active_stream_id
          and run.workflow_run_id is null
          and run.status not in (
            'canceled',
            'failed',
            'stopped',
            'succeeded',
            'partial_success'
          )
      );
    if not v_takeover then
      v_outcome := 'stream_conflict';
      v_workflow_run_id := v_thread.active_workflow_run_id;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and p_message_id is null
    and v_thread.stream_status in ('submitted', 'streaming', 'stopping')
  then
    select run.*
    into v_run
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.active_stream_id = v_thread.active_stream_id
      and coalesce(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses', '[]'::jsonb) = p_approval_responses
    order by run.created_at desc
    limit 1;

    if found then
      v_workflow_run_id := v_run.workflow_run_id;
      v_outcome := case
        when v_workflow_run_id is null then 'in_progress'
        else 'reconnect'
      end;
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started'
    and not v_takeover
    and (
      v_thread.stream_status in ('submitted', 'streaming', 'stopping')
      or v_thread.active_stream_id is distinct from p_expected_active_stream_id
    )
  then
    v_outcome := 'stream_conflict';
    v_workflow_run_id := v_thread.active_workflow_run_id;
  end if;

  if v_outcome = 'started' then
    if p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then
      update public.chat_messages as message
      set metadata = message.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'supersededByRunId', p_run_id,
        'supersededAt', now() at time zone 'utc'
      )
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and (message.created_at, message.id) >
          (v_target_message.created_at, v_target_message.id)
        and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId');
    end if;

    if not v_message_found and p_message_id is not null then
      insert into public.chat_messages (
        id,
        thread_id,
        organization_id,
        role,
        parts,
        metadata,
        status,
        created_by,
        client_message_id,
        dispatch_id,
        dispatch_claimed_at,
        dispatch_linked_at
      )
      values (
        p_message_id,
        p_thread_id,
        p_organization_id,
        'user',
        p_user_message_parts,
        jsonb_build_object(
          'outboxState',
          case when p_mode = 'agent' then 'pending' else 'completed' end,
          'route',
          to_jsonb(p_route)
        ),
        'complete',
        v_actor_id,
        p_user_client_message_id,
        p_dispatch_id,
        case when p_dispatch_id is null then null else now() at time zone 'utc' end,
        null
      )
      returning * into v_message;
      v_message_found := true;
    elsif v_message_found and p_mode = 'agent' then
      if v_takeover then
        update public.ai_agent_runs as run
        set
          active_stream_id = null,
          completed_at = coalesce(run.completed_at, now() at time zone 'utc'),
          status = 'stopped',
          summary = coalesce(run.summary, 'Superseded by an expired dispatch retry.')
        where run.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and run.created_by = v_actor_id
          and run.active_stream_id = v_thread.active_stream_id
          and run.workflow_run_id is null
          and run.status not in ('canceled', 'failed', 'stopped', 'succeeded', 'partial_success');
      end if;

      update public.chat_messages as message
      set
        dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id,
        dispatch_claimed_at = now() at time zone 'utc',
        dispatch_linked_at = null,
        metadata = jsonb_set(message.metadata, '{outboxState}', '"pending"'::jsonb)
      where message.id = v_message.id
      returning * into v_message;
    end if;

    v_run_metadata := case
      when jsonb_array_length(p_approval_responses) = 0 then p_run_metadata
      else jsonb_set(p_run_metadata, '{approvalResponses}', p_approval_responses, true)
    end;

    insert into public.ai_agent_runs (
      id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      message_id,
      request_id,
      workflow_run_id,
      mode,
      status,
      title,
      model,
      active_stream_id,
      metadata,
      created_by,
      input_client_message_id
    )
    values (
      p_run_id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      case when p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then v_target_message.id else null end,
      p_request_id,
      null,
      p_mode,
      case when p_mode = 'plan' then 'planning' else 'running' end,
      case
        when p_mode = 'plan' then 'Planning request'
        when p_mode = 'agent' then 'Agent request'
        else 'Assistant request'
      end,
      p_model,
      p_active_stream_id,
      v_run_metadata,
      v_actor_id,
      case
        when p_trigger = 'submit-message' and p_mode in ('ask', 'plan')
          then p_user_client_message_id
        else null
      end
    )
    returning * into v_run;

    if v_approval_count > 0 then
      for v_approval in
        select approval.value
        from jsonb_array_elements(p_approval_responses) as approval(value)
      loop
        update public.approval_requests as approval
        set
          response_idempotency_key = approval.id::text,
          response_run_id = p_run_id,
          response_active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id,
          response_message_id = v_approval ->> 'messageId',
          response_tool_call_id = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId',
          response_approved = (v_approval ->> 'approved')::boolean,
          response_reason = v_approval ->> 'reason',
          response_recorded_at = now() at time zone 'utc'
        where approval.id = any(v_approval_ids)
          and (
            approval.id::text = v_approval ->> 'approvalId'
            or approval.tool_call_id = v_approval ->> 'toolCallId'
          )
          and approval.response_idempotency_key is null;

        get diagnostics v_updated_count = row_count;
        if v_updated_count <> 1 then
          raise exception using
            errcode = '40001',
            message = 'Unable to claim AI approval response idempotency.';
        end if;
      end loop;
    end if;

    insert into public.ai_agent_run_events (
      run_id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      request_id,
      kind,
      sequence,
      status,
      title,
      payload,
      metadata,
      created_by
    )
    values (
      v_run.id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      p_request_id,
      'run_started',
      1,
      'running',
      'Run started',
      p_event_payload,
      jsonb_build_object('mode', p_mode, 'route', to_jsonb(p_route)),
      v_actor_id
    );

    update public.chat_threads as thread
    set
      active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id,
      active_workflow_run_id = null,
      mode = p_mode,
      stream_status = case when p_mode = 'agent' then 'submitted' else 'streaming' end
    where thread.id = p_thread_id
      and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    returning * into v_thread;
  end if;

  select count(*)::integer
  into v_history_total
  from public.chat_messages as message
  where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
    and (
      p_trigger <> 'regenerate-message'
      or (message.created_at, message.id) <=
        (v_target_user_message.created_at, v_target_user_message.id)
    );

  with
    latest_message_ids as (
      select message.id
      from public.chat_messages as message
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
        and (
          p_trigger <> 'regenerate-message'
          or (message.created_at, message.id) <=
            (v_target_user_message.created_at, v_target_user_message.id)
        )
      order by message.created_at desc, message.id desc
      limit p_history_limit
    ),
    approval_message_ids as (
      select message.id
      from public.chat_messages as message
      join jsonb_array_elements(p_approval_responses) as approval(value)
        on coalesce(message.client_message_id, message.id::text) =
          approval.value ->> 'messageId'
      where message.thread_id = p_thread_id
    ),
    selected_message_ids as (
      select latest_message_ids.id from latest_message_ids
      union
      select approval_message_ids.id from approval_message_ids
    ),
    selected_messages as (
      select message.*
      from public.chat_messages as message
      join selected_message_ids on selected_message_ids.id = message.id
    )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'clientMessageId', selected_messages.client_message_id,
        'createdAt', selected_messages.created_at,
        'createdBy', selected_messages.created_by,
        'id', selected_messages.id,
        'metadata', selected_messages.metadata,
        'organizationId', selected_messages.organization_id,
        'parts', selected_messages.parts,
        'role', selected_messages.role,
        'status', selected_messages.status,
        'threadId', selected_messages.thread_id
      )
      order by selected_messages.created_at, selected_messages.id
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_history
  from selected_messages;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'createdThread', v_created_thread,
    'deduplicated', v_deduplicated,
    'dispatchId', case when v_message_found then v_message.dispatch_id else null end,
    'message', case
      when not v_message_found then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'clientMessageId', v_message.client_message_id,
        'createdAt', v_message.created_at,
        'createdBy', v_message.created_by,
        'id', v_message.id,
        'metadata', v_message.metadata,
        'organizationId', v_message.organization_id,
        'parts', v_message.parts,
        'role', v_message.role,
        'status', v_message.status,
        'threadId', v_message.thread_id
      )
    end,
    'messages', v_history,
    'outcome', v_outcome,
    'pagination', jsonb_build_object(
      'hasMore', v_history_total > p_history_limit,
      'limit', p_history_limit,
      'offset', 0,
      'total', v_history_total
    ),
    'replayMessage', case
      when v_replay_message.id is null then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'clientMessageId', v_replay_message.client_message_id,
        'createdAt', v_replay_message.created_at,
        'createdBy', v_replay_message.created_by,
        'id', v_replay_message.id,
        'metadata', v_replay_message.metadata,
        'organizationId', v_replay_message.organization_id,
        'parts', v_replay_message.parts,
        'role', v_replay_message.role,
        'status', v_replay_message.status,
        'threadId', v_replay_message.thread_id
      )
    end,
    'replacementMessageId', case
      when p_trigger = 'regenerate-message' then v_target_message.id
      else null
    end,
    'run', case
      when v_run.id is null then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'createdBy', v_run.created_by,
        'id', v_run.id,
        'title', v_run.title
      )
    end,
    'thread', jsonb_build_object(
      'activeStreamId', v_thread.active_stream_id,
      'activeWorkflowRunId', v_thread.active_workflow_run_id,
      'archivedAt', v_thread.archived_at,
      'createdAt', v_thread.created_at,
      'id', v_thread.id,
      'metadata', v_thread.metadata,
      'mode', v_thread.mode,
      'organizationId', v_thread.organization_id,
      'ownerUserId', v_thread.owner_user_id,
      'pinnedAt', v_thread.pinned_at,
      'streamStatus', v_thread.stream_status,
      'title', v_thread.title,
      'updatedAt', v_thread.updated_at,
      'visibility', v_thread.visibility
    ),
    'workflowRunId', v_workflow_run_id
  );
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_expected_active_stream_id text, p_mode text, p_model text, p_request_id text, p_route text, p_run_metadata jsonb, p_event_payload jsonb, p_message_id uuid, p_user_client_message_id text, p_user_message_parts jsonb, p_dispatch_id uuid, p_approval_responses jsonb, p_trigger text, p_target_message_id text, p_history_limit integer DEFAULT 100
functions.identity_argument_types: p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_expected_active_stream_id text, p_mode text, p_model text, p_request_id text, p_route text, p_run_metadata jsonb, p_event_payload jsonb, p_message_id uuid, p_user_client_message_id text, p_user_message_parts jsonb, p_dispatch_id uuid, p_approval_responses jsonb, p_trigger text, p_target_message_id text, p_history_limit integer

functions.name: binary_quantize
functions.definition: halfvec_binary_quantize
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.binary_quantize(halfvec)
 RETURNS bit
 LANGUAGE c
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE STRICT
AS '$libdir/vector', $function$halfvec_binary_quantize$function$

functions.name: binary_quantize

select

        or p_created_by = (select auth.uid())

                    where tm.team_id = grant_row.team_id

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_inventory_allocation_integrity(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_mismatches integer;
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null
    and p_organization_id is not null
    and not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.assets.view')
  then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'asset view permission required';
  end if;

  select count(*)
  into v_mismatches
  from public.inventory_stock_records
  where (p_organization_id is null or inventory_stock_records.organization_id = p_organization_id)
    and inventory_stock_records.allocated_quantity <> coalesce((
      select sum(inventory_allocations.quantity)
      from public.inventory_allocations
      where inventory_allocations.stock_record_id = inventory_stock_records.id
        and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
    ), 0);

  if v_mismatches > 0 then
    raise exception 'inventory allocation integrity failed for % stock records', v_mismatches
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
end;
$function$

functions.name: claim_agenda_external_calendars_for_sync
functions.definition:
begin
  return query
  with due as (
    select c.id
    from public.agenda_external_calendars c
    where c.enabled
      and (
        c.last_sync_status <> 'syncing'
        or c.updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => greatest(p_stale_seconds, 60))
      )
      and (
        c.last_synced_at is null
        or c.last_synced_at < now() - make_interval(secs => greatest(p_min_age_seconds, 0))
      )
    order by c.last_synced_at asc nulls first
    limit greatest(p_limit, 1)
    for update skip locked
  )
  update public.agenda_external_calendars c
  set last_sync_status = 'syncing',
      updated_at = now()
  from due
  where c.id = due.id
  returning c.id, c.organization_id;
end;
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.claim_agenda_external_calendars_for_sync(p_limit integer DEFAULT 25, p_min_age_seconds integer DEFAULT 240, p_stale_seconds integer DEFAULT 600)
 RETURNS TABLE(agenda_collection_id uuid, organization_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  with due as (
    select c.id
    from public.agenda_external_calendars c
    where c.enabled
      and (
        c.last_sync_status <> 'syncing'
        or c.updated_at < now() - make_interval(secs => greatest(p_stale_seconds, 60))
      )
      and (
        c.last_synced_at is null
        or c.last_synced_at < now() - make_interval(secs => greatest(p_min_age_seconds, 0))
      )
    order by c.last_synced_at asc nulls first
    limit greatest(p_limit, 1)
    for update skip locked
  )
  update public.agenda_external_calendars c
  set last_sync_status = 'syncing',
      updated_at = now()
  from due
  where c.id = due.id
  returning c.id, c.organization_id;
end;
$function$

begin
  return query
  with due_documents as (
    update public.employee_documents
    set last_reminded_at = (now() at time zone 'utc')
    where employee_documents.expires_on is not null
      and employee_documents.expires_on >= p_on
      and employee_documents.expires_on - employee_documents.reminder_days_before <= p_on
      and (
        employee_documents.last_reminded_at is null
        or employee_documents.last_reminded_at::date
          < employee_documents.expires_on - employee_documents.reminder_days_before
      )
    returning
      employee_documents.organization_id,
      'document-expiring'::text as kind,
      employee_documents.employee_id,
      employee_documents.id as subject_id,
      employee_documents.name as label,
      employee_documents.expires_on as due_on
  ),
  due_contracts as (
    update public.employee_contracts
    set ending_notified_at = (now() at time zone 'utc')
    where employee_contracts.ends_on is not null
      and employee_contracts.ends_on between p_on and p_on + 30

        from public.employee_contracts as follow_up

  where employees.archived_at is null;

functions.name: claim_inbox_automation
functions.definition:
declare
  v_run public.inbox_automation_runs%rowtype;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'claim_inbox_automation requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.inbox_threads as channel_thread
    join public.chat_messages as message
      on message.id = p_source_message_id
      and message.thread_id = channel_thread.chat_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = channel_thread.organization_id
      and message.role = 'user'
    where channel_thread.id = p_channel_thread_id
      and channel_thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'Invalid Inbox automation boundary'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_channel_thread_id::text, 0)
  );

  update public.inbox_automation_runs as automation_run
  set
    error = jsonb_build_object('code', 'lease_expired'),
    status = 'failed',
    updated_at = now() at time zone 'utc'
  where automation_run.channel_thread_id = p_channel_thread_id
    and automation_run.status = 'claimed'
    and automation_run.leased_until <= (now() at time zone 'utc');

  select automation_run.*
  into v_run
  from public.inbox_automation_runs as automation_run
  where automation_run.channel_thread_id = p_channel_thread_id
    and automation_run.source_message_id = p_source_message_id;

  if found and v_run.status = 'completed' then
    return jsonb_build_object('kind', 'completed', 'output', v_run.output);
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.inbox_automation_runs as automation_run
    where automation_run.channel_thread_id = p_channel_thread_id
      and automation_run.status = 'claimed'
  ) then
    return jsonb_build_object('kind', 'busy');
  end if;

  insert into public.inbox_automation_runs (
    organization_id,
    channel_thread_id,
    source_message_id,
    lease_token,
    leased_until,
    status
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_channel_thread_id,
    p_source_message_id,
    p_lease_token,
    (now() at time zone 'utc') + make_interval(secs => p_lease_seconds),
    'claimed'
  )
  on conflict (channel_thread_id, source_message_id)
  do update set
    error = null,
    lease_token = excluded.lease_token,
    leased_until = excluded.leased_until,
    status = 'claimed',
    updated_at = now() at time zone 'utc'
  returning * into v_run;

  return jsonb_build_object('kind', 'claimed', 'leaseToken', v_run.lease_token);
end;

functions.name: claim_stripe_webhook_event
functions.definition:
declare
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_processing_status public.stripe_webhook_processing_status;
  v_processing_started_at timestamptz;
  v_claim_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_now timestamptz := clock_timestamp();
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'Stripe webhook claims require service_role';
  end if;

  insert into public.stripe_webhook_events (
    stripe_event_id,
    type,
    livemode,
    stripe_created_at,
    processing_status,
    processing_started_at,
    processing_claim_id
  )
  values (
    p_stripe_event_id,
    p_type,
    p_livemode,
    p_stripe_created_at,
    'processing',
    v_now,
    v_claim_id
  )
  on conflict (stripe_event_id) do nothing
  returning id into v_event_id;

  if v_event_id is not null then
    return query
    select v_event_id, 'claimed'::text, v_claim_id, v_now;
    return;
  end if;

  select
    webhook_events.id,
    webhook_events.processing_status,
    webhook_events.processing_started_at
  into
    v_event_id,
    v_processing_status,
    v_processing_started_at
  from public.stripe_webhook_events as webhook_events
  where webhook_events.stripe_event_id = p_stripe_event_id
  for update;

  if v_processing_status = 'processed' then
    return query
    select v_event_id, 'already-processed'::text, null::uuid, null::timestamptz;
    return;
  end if;

  -- Fifteen minutes exceeds the webhook function's expected runtime while
  -- keeping claims from crashed workers recoverable without manual cleanup.
  if v_processing_status = 'processing'
    and v_processing_started_at > v_now - interval '15 minutes'
  then
    return query
    select v_event_id, 'in-progress'::text, null::uuid, v_processing_started_at;
    return;
  end if;

  update public.stripe_webhook_events as webhook_events
  set
    type = p_type,
    livemode = p_livemode,
    stripe_created_at = p_stripe_created_at,
    processing_status = 'processing',
    processing_started_at = v_now,
    processing_claim_id = v_claim_id,
    processed_at = null,
    error_message = null,
    retry_count = case
      when webhook_events.processing_status = 'pending' then webhook_events.retry_count
      else webhook_events.retry_count + 1
    end
  where webhook_events.id = v_event_id;

  return query
  select v_event_id, 'claimed'::text, v_claim_id, v_now;
end;

    select v_event_id, 'in-progress'::text, null::uuid, v_processing_started_at;
    return;
  end if;

  update public.stripe_webhook_events as webhook_events
  set
    type = p_type,
    livemode = p_livemode,
    stripe_created_at = p_stripe_created_at,
    processing_status = 'processing',
    processing_started_at = v_now,
    processing_claim_id = v_claim_id,
    processed_at = null,
    error_message = null,
    retry_count = case
      when webhook_events.processing_status = 'pending' then webhook_events.retry_count
      else webhook_events.retry_count + 1
    end
  where webhook_events.id = v_event_id;

  return query
  select v_event_id, 'claimed'::text, v_claim_id, v_now;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.close_purchase_order_short(p_organization_id uuid, p_purchase_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.purchase-orders.receive') then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'purchase order receive permission required';
  end if;

  update public.purchase_order_lines
  set quantity_cancelled = greatest(quantity_ordered - quantity_received, 0)
  where purchase_order_lines.purchase_order_id = p_purchase_order_id
    and purchase_order_lines.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and quantity_received < quantity_ordered;

  update public.purchase_orders
  set status = 'closed', closed_at = now()
  where purchase_orders.id = p_purchase_order_id
    and purchase_orders.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and purchase_orders.status in ('sent', 'partially_received', 'received');

  if not found then
    raise exception 'only sent purchase orders can be closed'
      using errcode = '22023', hint = 'purchase_order_not_sent';
  end if;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_promotion_redemptions(p_subject_type promotion_subject_type, p_subject_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_redemption record;
  v_reason text;
begin
  for v_redemption in
    select promotion_redemptions.id, promotion_redemptions.promotion_id,
      promotion_redemptions.customer_id, promotion_redemptions.state
    from public.promotion_redemptions
    where promotion_redemptions.subject_type = p_subject_type
      and promotion_redemptions.subject_id = p_subject_id
      and promotion_redemptions.state <> 'released'
    order by promotion_redemptions.promotion_id
    for update
  loop
    perform 1 from public.promotions
    where promotions.id = v_redemption.promotion_id
    for update;

    if v_redemption.state = 'pending' then
      v_reason := public.promotion_rejection(
        v_redemption.promotion_id, p_subject_type, v_redemption.customer_id,
        null, null, p_subject_id, true
      );
      if v_reason in ('limit_total', 'limit_customer') then
        raise exception 'promotion usage limit reached'
          using errcode = '22023', hint = 'promotion_' || v_reason;
      end if;
    end if;

    update public.promotion_redemptions
    set state = 'committed',
      committed_at = coalesce(promotion_redemptions.committed_at, now()),
      amount = public.promotion_redemption_amount(
        p_subject_type, p_subject_id, v_redemption.promotion_id
      )
    where promotion_redemptions.id = v_redemption.id;
  end loop;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.complete_stripe_webhook_event(p_event_id uuid, p_claim_id uuid, p_succeeded boolean, p_error_message text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_completed boolean;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'Stripe webhook completion requires service_role';
  end if;

  update public.stripe_webhook_events as webhook_events
  set
    processing_status = case
      when p_succeeded then 'processed'::public.stripe_webhook_processing_status
      else 'failed'::public.stripe_webhook_processing_status
    end,
    processing_started_at = null,
    processing_claim_id = null,
    processed_at = case when p_succeeded then clock_timestamp() else null end,
    error_message = case when p_succeeded then null else p_error_message end
  where webhook_events.id = p_event_id
    and webhook_events.processing_status = 'processing'
    and webhook_events.processing_claim_id = p_claim_id
  returning true into v_completed;

  return coalesce(v_completed, false);
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
with primary_contact as (
    select
      nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ', contact_profiles.first_name, contact_profiles.last_name)), '')
        as contact_name,
      (
        select nullif(btrim(contact_methods.value), '')
        from public.contact_methods
        where contact_methods.contact_profile_id = contact_profiles.id
          and contact_methods.type = 'email'
        order by contact_methods.is_primary desc, contact_methods.position asc, contact_methods.id
        limit 1
      ) as contact_email
    from public.customer_contacts
    join public.contact_profiles
      on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
    where customer_contacts.customer_id = p_customer_id
      and customer_contacts.is_primary
    order by customer_contacts.created_at asc, customer_contacts.id
    limit 1
  )
  select
    case
      when customers.is_business then
        coalesce(
          nullif(btrim(customers.company_name), ''),
          primary_contact.contact_name,
          primary_contact.contact_email,
          'Customer ' || customers.id::text
        )
      else
        coalesce(
          primary_contact.contact_name,
          nullif(btrim(customers.company_name), ''),
          primary_contact.contact_email,
          'Customer ' || customers.id::text
        )
    end
  from public.customers
  left join primary_contact on true
  where customers.id = p_customer_id;

consume_allocations
functions.definition:
declare
  v_allocation record;
  v_on_hand numeric(12, 3);
  v_reserved numeric(12, 3);
  v_consumed numeric(12, 3) := 0;
  v_product_id uuid;
begin
  select coalesce(
    (select task_materials.product_id from public.task_materials where task_materials.id = p_task_material_id),
    (select quote_version_lines.product_id from public.quote_version_lines where quote_version_lines.id = p_quote_version_line_id),
    (select invoice_lines.product_id from public.invoice_lines where invoice_lines.id = p_invoice_line_id)
  ) into v_product_id;

  if v_product_id is null then
    return 0;
  end if;

  perform public.lock_product_stock(p_organization_id, v_product_id);

  for v_allocation in
    select
      inventory_allocations.id,
      inventory_allocations.quantity,
      inventory_stock_records.id as stock_record_id,
      inventory_stock_records.product_id,
      inventory_stock_records.location_id,
      inventory_stock_records.on_hand_quantity,
      inventory_stock_records.allocated_quantity
    from public.inventory_allocations
    join public.inventory_stock_records
      on inventory_stock_records.id = inventory_allocations.stock_record_id
    where inventory_allocations.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
      and inventory_allocations.task_material_id is not distinct from p_task_material_id
      and inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id is not distinct from p_quote_version_line_id
      and inventory_allocations.invoice_line_id is not distinct from p_invoice_line_id
    order by inventory_stock_records.id
  loop
    if v_allocation.on_hand_quantity < v_allocation.quantity
      or v_allocation.allocated_quantity < v_allocation.quantity
    then
      raise exception 'allocation exceeds current stock reservation' using errcode = '23514';
    end if;

    update public.inventory_stock_records
    set
      on_hand_quantity = on_hand_quantity - v_allocation.quantity,
      allocated_quantity = allocated_quantity - v_allocation.quantity
    where inventory_stock_records.id = v_allocation.stock_record_id
    returning on_hand_quantity, allocated_quantity
    into v_on_hand, v_reserved;

    update public.inventory_allocations
    set state = 'consumed', consumed_at = now()
    where inventory_allocations.id = v_allocation.id;

    perform public.write_inventory_movement(
      p_organization_id,
      v_allocation.stock_record_id,
      v_allocation.product_id,
      v_allocation.location_id,
      'sale',
      -v_allocation.quantity,
      -v_allocation.quantity,
      v_on_hand,
      v_reserved,
      coalesce(p_reason, 'stock consumed'),
      p_created_by,
      p_task_material_id,
      p_quote_id,
      p_invoice_id
    );

    v_consumed := v_consumed + v_allocation.quantity;
  end loop;

  return v_consumed;
end;

functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.consume_free_product_stock(p_organization_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_quantity numeric, p_invoice_line_id uuid, p_reason text, p_invoice_id uuid, p_created_by uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_remaining numeric(12, 3);
  v_consumed numeric(12, 3) := 0;
  v_take numeric(12, 3);
  v_stock record;
  v_on_hand numeric(12, 3);
  v_reserved numeric(12, 3);
  v_variant_id uuid;
begin
  if p_quantity is null or p_quantity <= 0 or p_invoice_line_id is null then
    return 0;
  end if;

  perform public.lock_product_stock(p_organization_id, p_product_id);
  v_remaining := p_quantity;
  v_variant_id := public.allocation_owner_variant(p_product_id, null, null, p_invoice_line_id);

  for v_stock in
    select
      inventory_stock_records.id,
      inventory_stock_records.location_id,
      inventory_stock_records.on_hand_quantity,
      inventory_stock_records.allocated_quantity
    from public.inventory_stock_records
    where inventory_stock_records.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and inventory_stock_records.product_id = p_product_id
      and inventory_stock_records.variant_id = v_variant_id
      and inventory_stock_records.status = 'available'
      and (
        inventory_stock_records.expires_on is null
        or inventory_stock_records.expires_on >= current_date
      )
      and inventory_stock_records.on_hand_quantity > inventory_stock_records.allocated_quantity
    order by
      inventory_stock_records.expires_on asc nulls last,
      (inventory_stock_records.on_hand_quantity - inventory_stock_records.allocated_quantity) desc,
      inventory_stock_records.id
  loop
    exit when v_remaining <= 0;
    v_take := least(v_stock.on_hand_quantity - v_stock.allocated_quantity, v_remaining);

    update public.inventory_stock_records
    set on_hand_quantity = on_hand_quantity - v_take
    where inventory_stock_records.id = v_stock.id
    returning on_hand_quantity, allocated_quantity
    into v_on_hand, v_reserved;

    insert into public.inventory_allocations (
      organization_id,
      stock_record_id,
      product_id,
      quantity,
      state,
      invoice_line_id,
      consumed_at
    ) values (
      p_organization_id,
      v_stock.id,
      p_product_id,
      v_take,
      'consumed',
      p_invoice_line_id,
      now()
    )
    on conflict (invoice_line_id, stock_record_id) where invoice_line_id is not null
    do update set
      quantity = public.inventory_allocations.quantity + excluded.quantity,
      state = 'consumed',
      consumed_at = coalesce(public.inventory_allocations.consumed_at, now());

    perform public.write_inventory_movement(
      p_organization_id,
      v_stock.id,
      p_product_id,
      v_stock.location_id,
      'sale',
      -v_take,
      0,
      v_on_hand,
      v_reserved,
      coalesce(p_reason, 'stock consumed'),
      p_created_by,
      null,
      null,
      p_invoice_id
    );

    v_remaining := v_remaining - v_take;
    v_consumed := v_consumed + v_take;
  end loop;

  return v_consumed;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_quantity numeric, p_invoice_line_id uuid, p_reason text, p_invoice_id uuid, p_created_by uuid
functions.identity_argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_quantity numeric, p_invoice_line_id uuid, p_reason text, p_invoice_id uuid, p_created_by uuid

declare
  v_from_thread_id uuid;
  v_to_thread_id uuid;
begin
  select comment_thread.id
    into v_from_thread_id
  from public.comment_threads as comment_thread
  where comment_thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and comment_thread.subject_type = p_from_subject_type
    and comment_thread.subject_id = p_from_subject_id;

  if v_from_thread_id is null then
    return;
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.comments as comment
    where comment.thread_id = v_from_thread_id
  ) then
    return;
  end if;

  v_to_thread_id := public.ensure_comment_thread(
    p_organization_id,
    p_to_subject_type,
    p_to_subject_id,
    case when p_to_subject_type = 'customer' then p_to_subject_id::bigint else null end,
    case when p_to_subject_type = 'task' then p_to_subject_id::uuid else null end,
    case when p_to_subject_type = 'customer-asset' then p_to_subject_id::bigint else null end
  );

  insert into public.comments (
    organization_id,
    thread_id,
    parent_id,
    author_id,
    content_text,
    content_doc,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  select
    p_organization_id,
    v_to_thread_id,
    null,
    comment.author_id,
    comment.content_text,
    comment.content_doc,
    comment.created_at,
    comment.updated_at
  from public.comments as comment
  where comment.thread_id = v_from_thread_id
  order by comment.created_at;
end;

functions.name: count_unread_inbox_threads
functions.definition:
select count(*)
  from public.inbox_threads as channel_threads
  left join public.chat_threads as chat_threads
    on chat_threads.id = channel_threads.chat_thread_id
    and chat_threads.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
  left join lateral (
    select
      messages.role,
      messages.created_at
    from public.chat_messages as messages
    where messages.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and messages.thread_id = channel_threads.chat_thread_id
    order by messages.created_at desc
    limit 1
  ) as latest_message on true
  where channel_threads.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and chat_threads.archived_at is null
    and (
      coalesce((channel_threads.metadata ->> 'manuallyUnread')::boolean, false)
      or (
        latest_message.role = 'user'
        and latest_message.created_at > coalesce(
          nullif(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt', '')::timestamptz,
          '-infinity'::timestamptz
        )
      )
    );

declare
  v_actor_permissions text[];
  v_artifact public.ai_contextual_artifacts%rowtype;
  v_thread public.chat_threads%rowtype;
begin
  if auth.role() is distinct from 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'trusted contextual artifact service required' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if p_actor_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact actor required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select thread.*
  into v_thread
  from public.chat_threads as thread
  where thread.id = p_thread_id
  for share;

  if not found or v_thread.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact access denied' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  v_actor_permissions := public.resolve_actor_scope_permissions(
    p_actor_user_id,
    'organization',
    p_organization_id,
    array[p_origin_permission, 'organization.chats.view']
  );

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.profiles as profile
    where profile.user_id = p_actor_user_id
      and profile.disabled_at is null
  )
    or not p_origin_permission = any(v_actor_permissions)
    or (
      v_thread.owner_user_id <> p_actor_user_id
      and not exists (
        select 1
        from public.chat_thread_participants as participant
        where participant.thread_id = p_thread_id
          and participant.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and participant.user_id = p_actor_user_id
      )
      and not (
        v_thread.visibility = 'organization'
        and 'organization.chats.view' = any(v_actor_permissions)
      )
    )
  then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact actor access denied' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_message_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_messages as message
    where message.id = p_message_id
      and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact message mismatch' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if p_run_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_agent_runs as run
    where run.id = p_run_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact run mismatch' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform pg_catalog.pg_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_organization_id::text || ':' || p_idempotency_key, 602184)
  );

  select artifact.*
  into v_artifact
  from public.ai_contextual_artifacts as artifact
  where artifact.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and artifact.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;

  if found then
    if v_artifact.thread_id is distinct from p_thread_id
      or v_artifact.message_id is distinct from p_message_id
      or v_artifact.run_id is distinct from p_run_id
      or v_artifact.created_by is distinct from p_actor_user_id
      or v_artifact.action_id is distinct from p_action_id
      or v_artifact.action_version is distinct from p_action_version
      or v_artifact.origin_permission is distinct from p_origin_permission
      or v_artifact.origin_execution_policy is distinct from p_origin_execution_policy
      or v_artifact.origin_risk is distinct from p_origin_risk
      or v_artifact.origin_route is distinct from p_origin_route
      or v_artifact.context_kinds is distinct from p_context_kinds
      or v_artifact.kind is distinct from p_kind
      or v_artifact.schema_version is distinct from p_schema_version
      or v_artifact.context_fingerprint is distinct from p_context_fingerprint
      or v_artifact.source_references is distinct from p_source_references
      or v_artifact.payload is distinct from p_payload
      or v_artifact.apply_handler is distinct from p_apply_handler
    then
      raise exception 'contextual artifact idempotency conflict' using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    return to_jsonb(v_artifact);
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_contextual_artifacts (
    organization_id,
    thread_id,
    message_id,
    run_id,
    action_id,
    action_version,
    kind,
    schema_version,
    context_fingerprint,
    source_references,
    payload,
    apply_handler,
    idempotency_key,
    created_by,
    origin_permission,
    thread_owner_user_id,
    thread_visibility,
    origin_execution_policy,
    origin_risk,
    origin_route,
    context_kinds
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_thread_id,
    p_message_id,
    p_run_id,
    p_action_id,
    p_action_version,
    p_kind,
    p_schema_version,
    p_context_fingerprint,
    p_source_references,
    p_payload,
    p_apply_handler,
    p_idempotency_key,
    p_actor_user_id,
    p_origin_permission,
    v_thread.owner_user_id,
    v_thread.visibility,
    p_origin_execution_policy,
    p_origin_risk,
    p_origin_route,
    p_context_kinds
  )
  returning * into v_artifact;

  insert into public.ai_contextual_artifact_events (
    artifact_id,
    organization_id,
    kind,
    actor_user_id,
    payload_summary,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    v_artifact.id,
    p_organization_id,
    'proposed',
    p_actor_user_id,
    p_kind,
    '{}'::jsonb
  );

  return to_jsonb(v_artifact);
end;

functions.definition:
declare
  claims jsonb;
  v_uid uuid := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  system_roles jsonb;
  organization_roles jsonb;
  system_permissions jsonb;
  organization_permissions jsonb;
  user_permissions jsonb;
begin
  claims := event->'claims';

  with
    -- Disabled profiles keep their role memberships but resolve to no
    -- effective permissions, matching authorize_scope.
    actor as (
      select profiles.user_id
      from public.profiles
      where profiles.user_id = v_uid
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
    ),
    actor_roles as (
      select roles.key, roles.scope
      from public.user_roles
      join public.roles on roles.id = user_roles.role_id
      where user_roles.user_id = v_uid
    ),
    actor_memberships as (
      select organization_users.organization_id, roles.key as role_key
      from public.organization_users
      join public.roles on roles.id = organization_users.role_id
      where organization_users.user_id = v_uid
    ),
    system_admin as (
      select exists (
        select 1
        from actor_roles
        cross join actor
        where actor_roles.scope = 'system'
          and actor_roles.key = 'system-admin'
      ) as granted
    ),
    system_permission_keys as (
      select distinct permissions.key
      from actor
      join public.user_roles on user_roles.user_id = actor.user_id
      join public.roles
        on roles.id = user_roles.role_id
        and roles.scope = 'system'
      join public.role_permissions on role_permissions.role_id = roles.id
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.id = role_permissions.permission_id
        and permissions.scope = 'system'
    ),
    -- Only organization-scoped roles bound to this org (or global templates)
    -- carry permission grants; other memberships resolve to an empty set.
    active_memberships as (
      select organization_users.organization_id, organization_users.role_id
      from public.organization_users
      join actor on actor.user_id = organization_users.user_id
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = organization_users.organization_id
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
    ),
    grantable_memberships as (
      select active_memberships.organization_id, active_memberships.role_id
      from active_memberships
      join public.roles
        on roles.id = active_memberships.role_id
        and roles.scope = 'organization'
        and (
          roles.organization_id is null
          or roles.organization_id = active_memberships.organization_id
        )
    ),
    -- Override precedence: an explicit deny removes the role default, an
    -- explicit allow adds a permission the role default does not grant.
    -- The overrides primary key makes deny and allow mutually exclusive per
    -- (organization, role, permission), so the union cannot resurrect a deny.
    organization_permission_rows as (
      select grantable_memberships.organization_id, permissions.key
      from grantable_memberships
      join public.role_permissions
        on role_permissions.role_id = grantable_memberships.role_id
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.id = role_permissions.permission_id
        and permissions.scope = 'organization'
      where not exists (
        select 1
        from public.organization_permission_overrides as denied
        where denied.organization_id = grantable_memberships.organization_id
          and denied.role_id = grantable_memberships.role_id
          and denied.permission_id = permissions.id
          and denied.granted = false
      )
      union
      select grantable_memberships.organization_id, permissions.key
      from grantable_memberships
      join public.organization_permission_overrides as allowed
        on allowed.organization_id = grantable_memberships.organization_id
        and allowed.role_id = grantable_memberships.role_id
        and allowed.granted
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.id = allowed.permission_id
        and permissions.scope = 'organization'
    ),
    organization_permission_sets as (
      select
        organization_permission_rows.organization_id,
        jsonb_agg(organization_permission_rows.key order by organization_permission_rows.key) as keys,
        count(*) as granted_count
      from organization_permission_rows
      group by organization_permission_rows.organization_id
    ),
    organization_permission_total as (
      select count(*) as total
      from public.permissions
      where permissions.scope = 'organization'
    )
  select
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(actor_roles.key) from actor_roles), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_object_agg(
          actor_memberships.organization_id::text,
          actor_memberships.role_key
        )
        from actor_memberships
      ),
      '{}'::jsonb
    ),
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(system_permission_keys.key order by system_permission_keys.key)
        from system_permission_keys
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    -- System admins omit the per-org catalog entirely — clients expand via
    -- system_roles. Full catalogs collapse to ["*"] so multi-org JWTs stay
    -- small enough for chunked auth cookies (~3×3180 bytes).
    case
      when (select system_admin.granted from system_admin) then '{}'::jsonb
      else coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_object_agg(
            active_memberships.organization_id::text,
            case
              when coalesce(organization_permission_sets.granted_count, 0)
                = (select organization_permission_total.total from organization_permission_total)
                then '["*"]'::jsonb
              else coalesce(organization_permission_sets.keys, '[]'::jsonb)
            end
          )
          from active_memberships
          left join organization_permission_sets
            on organization_permission_sets.organization_id = active_memberships.organization_id
        ),
        '{}'::jsonb
      )
    end,
    -- User-scope permissions cover own data (e.g. manage-own-profile); they are
    -- not role-granted, so every active user holds the full user-scope catalog.
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(permissions.key order by permissions.key)
        from public.permissions
        cross join actor
        where permissions.scope = 'user'
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  into
    system_roles,
    organization_roles,
    system_permissions,
    organization_permissions,
    user_permissions;

  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{system_roles}', system_roles);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{organization_roles}', organization_roles);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{system_permissions}', system_permissions);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{organization_permissions}', organization_permissions);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{user_permissions}', user_permissions);
  event := jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);

  return event;
end;
