CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.custom_access_token_hook(event jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  claims jsonb;
  v_uid uuid := (event->>'user_id')::uuid;
  system_roles jsonb;
  organization_roles jsonb;
  system_permissions jsonb;
  organization_permissions jsonb;
  user_permissions jsonb;
begin
  claims := event->'claims';

  with
    -- Disabled profiles keep their role memberships but resolve to no
    -- effective permissions, matching authorize_scope.
    actor as (
      select profiles.user_id
      from public.profiles
      where profiles.user_id = v_uid
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
    ),
    actor_roles as (
      select roles.key, roles.scope
      from public.user_roles
      join public.roles on roles.id = user_roles.role_id
      where user_roles.user_id = v_uid
    ),
    actor_memberships as (
      select organization_users.organization_id, roles.key as role_key
      from public.organization_users
      join public.roles on roles.id = organization_users.role_id
      where organization_users.user_id = v_uid
    ),
    system_admin as (
      select exists (
        select 1
        from actor_roles
        cross join actor
        where actor_roles.scope = 'system'
          and actor_roles.key = 'system-admin'
      ) as granted
    ),
    system_permission_keys as (
      select distinct permissions.key
      from actor
      join public.user_roles on user_roles.user_id = actor.user_id
      join public.roles
        on roles.id = user_roles.role_id
        and roles.scope = 'system'
      join public.role_permissions on role_permissions.role_id = roles.id
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.id = role_permissions.permission_id
        and permissions.scope = 'system'
    ),
    -- Only organization-scoped roles bound to this org (or global templates)
    -- carry permission grants; other memberships resolve to an empty set.
    active_memberships as (
      select organization_users.organization_id, organization_users.role_id
      from public.organization_users
      join actor on actor.user_id = organization_users.user_id
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = organization_users.organization_id
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
    ),
    grantable_memberships as (
      select active_memberships.organization_id, active_memberships.role_id
      from active_memberships
      join public.roles
        on roles.id = active_memberships.role_id
        and roles.scope = 'organization'
        and (
          roles.organization_id is null
          or roles.organization_id = active_memberships.organization_id
        )
    ),
    -- Override precedence: an explicit deny removes the role default, an
    -- explicit allow adds a permission the role default does not grant.
    -- The overrides primary key makes deny and allow mutually exclusive per
    -- (organization, role, permission), so the union cannot resurrect a deny.
    organization_permission_rows as (
      select grantable_memberships.organization_id, permissions.key
      from grantable_memberships
      join public.role_permissions
        on role_permissions.role_id = grantable_memberships.role_id
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.id = role_permissions.permission_id
        and permissions.scope = 'organization'
      where not exists (
        select 1
        from public.organization_permission_overrides as denied
        where denied.organization_id = grantable_memberships.organization_id
          and denied.role_id = grantable_memberships.role_id
          and denied.permission_id = permissions.id
          and denied.granted = false
      )
      union
      select grantable_memberships.organization_id, permissions.key
      from grantable_memberships
      join public.organization_permission_overrides as allowed
        on allowed.organization_id = grantable_memberships.organization_id
        and allowed.role_id = grantable_memberships.role_id
        and allowed.granted
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.id = allowed.permission_id
        and permissions.scope = 'organization'
    ),
    organization_permission_sets as (
      select
        organization_permission_rows.organization_id,
        jsonb_agg(organization_permission_rows.key order by organization_permission_rows.key) as keys,
        count(*) as granted_count
      from organization_permission_rows
      group by organization_permission_rows.organization_id
    ),
    organization_permission_total as (
      select count(*) as total
      from public.permissions
      where permissions.scope = 'organization'
    )
  select
    coalesce((select jsonb_agg(actor_roles.key) from actor_roles), '[]'::jsonb),
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_object_agg(
          actor_memberships.organization_id::text,
          actor_memberships.role_key
        )
        from actor_memberships
      ),
      '{}'::jsonb
    ),
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(system_permission_keys.key order by system_permission_keys.key)
        from system_permission_keys
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    -- System admins omit the per-org catalog entirely — clients expand via
    -- system_roles. Full catalogs collapse to ["*"] so multi-org JWTs stay
    -- small enough for chunked auth cookies (~3×3180 bytes).
    case
      when (select system_admin.granted from system_admin) then '{}'::jsonb
      else coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_object_agg(
            active_memberships.organization_id::text,
            case
              when coalesce(organization_permission_sets.granted_count, 0)
                = (select organization_permission_total.total from organization_permission_total)
                then '["*"]'::jsonb
              else coalesce(organization_permission_sets.keys, '[]'::jsonb)
            end
          )
          from active_memberships
          left join organization_permission_sets
            on organization_permission_sets.organization_id = active_memberships.organization_id
        ),
        '{}'::jsonb
      )
    end,
    -- User-scope permissions cover own data (e.g. manage-own-profile); they are
    -- not role-granted, so every active user holds the full user-scope catalog.
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(permissions.key order by permissions.key)
        from public.permissions
        cross join actor
        where permissions.scope = 'user'
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  into
    system_roles,
    organization_roles,
    system_permissions,
    organization_permissions,
    user_permissions;

  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{system_roles}', system_roles);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{organization_roles}', organization_roles);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{system_permissions}', system_permissions);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{organization_permissions}', organization_permissions);
  claims := jsonb_set(claims, '{user_permissions}', user_permissions);
  event := jsonb_set(event, '{claims}', claims);

  return event;
end;
$function$

declare

begin

  select jsonb_build_object(

    'productName', products.name,

    'model', products.model,
    'serialNumber', customer_assets.serial_number,
    'assetTag', customer_assets.asset_tag,
    'barcode', customer_assets.barcode,
    'installedOn', customer_assets.installed_on,
    'warrantyExpiresOn', customer_assets.warranty_expires_on,
    'condition', customer_assets.condition,
    'status', customer_assets.status,
    'description', customer_assets.description,
    'location', case
      when customer_locations.id is null then null
      else jsonb_build_object(
        'id', customer_locations.id,
        'name', customer_locations.name,
        'addressLine1', customer_locations.address_line1,
        'addressLine2', customer_locations.address_line2,
        'addressCity', customer_locations.address_city,
        'addressState', customer_locations.address_state,

      )
    end,
    'updatedAt', customer_assets.updated_at,
    'warrantyProvider', customer_assets.warranty_provider,
    'warrantyReference', customer_assets.warranty_reference,
    'serviceIntervalDays', customer_assets.service_interval_days
  )
  into v_result
  from public.customer_assets
  join public.products
    on products.id = customer_assets.product_id
    and products.organization_id = customer_assets.organization_id
  left join public.customer_locations
    on customer_locations.id = customer_assets.customer_location_id
    and customer_locations.organization_id = customer_assets.organization_id
  where customer_assets.id = p_customer_asset_id
    and customer_assets.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and customer_assets.status <> 'archived'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.customer_contacts
      join public.contact_profiles
        on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
      where customer_contacts.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and customer_contacts.customer_id = customer_assets.customer_id
        and contact_profiles.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    );

  if v_result is null then
    raise exception 'customer portal asset was not found'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return v_result;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_portal_get_context(p_organization_slug text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_organization_id uuid;
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null then
    raise exception 'authentication is required'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  select organizations.id
  into v_organization_id
  from public.organizations
  where organizations.slug = p_organization_slug
    and organizations.disabled_at is null;

  if v_organization_id is null then
    raise exception 'customer portal organization was not found'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  perform public.customer_portal_assert_access(v_organization_id);

  return (
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'organization', jsonb_build_object(
        'id', organizations.id,
        'name', organizations.name,
        'slug', organizations.slug::text,
        'logoPath', organizations.logo_path,
        'brandPrimaryColor', organizations.brand_primary_color,
        'brandSecondaryColor', organizations.brand_secondary_color
      ),
      'customers', (
        select coalesce(
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', linked_customers.id,
              'displayName', linked_customers.display_name,
              'isBusiness', linked_customers.is_business
            )
            order by linked_customers.display_name, linked_customers.id
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        from (
          select distinct
            customers.id,
            customers.is_business,
            coalesce(
              nullif(customers.company_name, ''),
              nullif(contact_profiles.display_name, ''),
              nullif(
                concat_ws(' ', contact_profiles.first_name, contact_profiles.last_name),
                ''
              ),
              'Customer ' || customers.id::text
            ) as display_name
          from public.customer_contacts
          join public.contact_profiles
            on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
          join public.customers
            on customers.id = customer_contacts.customer_id
            and customers.organization_id = customer_contacts.organization_id
          where customer_contacts.organization_id = v_organization_id
            and contact_profiles.user_id = (select auth.uid())
        ) as linked_customers
      )
    )
    from public.organizations
    where organizations.id = v_organization_id
  );
end;
$function$

functions.name: customer_portal_get_dashboard
functions.definition:
declare
  v_quotes jsonb;
  v_invoices jsonb;
  v_assets jsonb;
begin
  perform public.customer_portal_assert_access(p_organization_id);

  v_quotes := public.customer_portal_list_quotes(p_organization_id);
  v_invoices := public.customer_portal_list_invoices(p_organization_id);
  v_assets := public.customer_portal_list_assets(p_organization_id);

  return (
    with linked_customers as (
      select distinct customer_contacts.customer_id
      from public.customer_contacts
      join public.contact_profiles
        on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
      where customer_contacts.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and contact_profiles.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    )
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'quoteCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.quotes
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = quotes.customer_id
        where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and quotes.archived_at is null
          and quotes.status <> 'draft'
          and not exists (
            select 1
            from public.quotes as replacement
            where replacement.supersedes_quote_id = quotes.id
              and replacement.status <> 'draft'
          )
      ),
      'invoiceCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status <> 'draft'
      ),
      'assetCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.customer_assets
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = customer_assets.customer_id
        where customer_assets.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and customer_assets.status <> 'archived'
      ),
      'awaitingQuoteCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.quotes
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = quotes.customer_id
        where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and quotes.status = 'sent'
      ),
      'unpaidInvoiceCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
      ),
      'overdueInvoiceCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible')
      ),
      'unpaidTotalIncl', (
        select coalesce(sum(invoices.amount_due_cents), 0)::double precision / 100
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
      ),
      'currency', (
        select invoices.currency
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
        order by
          case when invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible') then 0 else 1 end,
          invoices.due_date nulls last,
          invoices.updated_at desc,
          invoices.id
        limit 1
      ),
      'warrantyExpiringCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.customer_assets
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = customer_assets.customer_id
        where customer_assets.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and customer_assets.status <> 'archived'
          and customer_assets.warranty_expires_on is not null
          and customer_assets.warranty_expires_on >= (select current_date)
          and customer_assets.warranty_expires_on <= ((select current_date) + 90)
      ),
      'awaitingQuotes', (
        select coalesce(
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', portal_quotes.id,
              'customerId', portal_quotes.customer_id,
              'displayNumber', portal_quotes.number_prefix || portal_quotes.number::text,
              'version', portal_quotes.version,
              'status', portal_quotes.status,
              'title', portal_quotes.title,
              'validUntil', portal_quotes.valid_until,
              'currency', portal_quotes.currency,
              'totalIncl', portal_quotes.total_incl,
              'sentAt', portal_quotes.sent_at,
              'updatedAt', portal_quotes.updated_at
            )
            order by portal_quotes.updated_at desc, portal_quotes.id
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        from (
          select
            quotes.id,
            quotes.customer_id,
            quotes.number_prefix,
            quotes.number,
            quotes.version,
            quotes.status,
            quotes.title,
            quotes.valid_until,
            quotes.currency,
            quotes.total_incl,
            quotes.sent_at,
            quotes.updated_at
          from public.quotes
          join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = quotes.customer_id
          where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and quotes.status = 'sent'
          order by quotes.updated_at desc, quotes.id
          limit 5
        ) as portal_quotes
      ),
      'unpaidInvoices', (
        select coalesce(
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', portal_invoices.id,
              'customerId', portal_invoices.customer_id,
              'displayNumber', coalesce(
                portal_invoices.formatted_number,
                portal_invoices.number_prefix || portal_invoices.number::text
              ),
              'status', case when portal_invoices.status = 'uncollectible' then 'overdue'::public.invoice_status else portal_invoices.status end,
              'title', portal_invoices.title,
              'issueDate', portal_invoices.issue_date,
              'dueDate', portal_invoices.due_date,
              'currency', portal_invoices.currency,
              'totalIncl', portal_invoices.total_incl,
              'sentAt', portal_invoices.sent_at,
              'paidAt', portal_invoices.paid_at,
              'updatedAt', portal_invoices.updated_at
            )
            order by
              case when portal_invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible') then 0 else 1 end,
              portal_invoices.due_date nulls last,
              portal_invoices.updated_at desc,
              portal_invoices.id
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        from (
          select
            invoices.id,
            invoices.customer_id,
            invoices.formatted_number,
            invoices.number_prefix,
            invoices.number,
            invoices.status,
            invoices.title,
            invoices.issue_date,
            invoices.due_date,
            invoices.currency,
            invoices.total_incl,
            invoices.sent_at,
            invoices.paid_at,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.customer_portal_get_dashboard(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_quotes jsonb;
  v_invoices jsonb;
  v_assets jsonb;
begin
  perform public.customer_portal_assert_access(p_organization_id);

  v_quotes := public.customer_portal_list_quotes(p_organization_id);
  v_invoices := public.customer_portal_list_invoices(p_organization_id);
  v_assets := public.customer_portal_list_assets(p_organization_id);

  return (
    with linked_customers as (
      select distinct customer_contacts.customer_id
      from public.customer_contacts
      join public.contact_profiles
        on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
      where customer_contacts.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and contact_profiles.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    )
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'quoteCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.quotes
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = quotes.customer_id
        where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and quotes.archived_at is null
          and quotes.status <> 'draft'
          and not exists (
            select 1
            from public.quotes as replacement
            where replacement.supersedes_quote_id = quotes.id
              and replacement.status <> 'draft'
          )
      ),
      'invoiceCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status <> 'draft'
      ),
      'assetCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.customer_assets
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = customer_assets.customer_id
        where customer_assets.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and customer_assets.status <> 'archived'
      ),
      'awaitingQuoteCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.quotes
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = quotes.customer_id
        where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and quotes.status = 'sent'
      ),
      'unpaidInvoiceCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
      ),
      'overdueInvoiceCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible')
      ),
      'unpaidTotalIncl', (
        select coalesce(sum(invoices.amount_due_cents), 0)::double precision / 100
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
      ),
      'currency', (
        select invoices.currency
        from public.invoices
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
        where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
        order by
          case when invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible') then 0 else 1 end,
          invoices.due_date nulls last,
          invoices.updated_at desc,
          invoices.id
        limit 1
      ),
      'warrantyExpiringCount', (
        select count(*)::integer
        from public.customer_assets
        join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = customer_assets.customer_id
        where customer_assets.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and customer_assets.status <> 'archived'
          and customer_assets.warranty_expires_on is not null
          and customer_assets.warranty_expires_on >= (select current_date)
          and customer_assets.warranty_expires_on <= ((select current_date) + 90)
      ),
      'awaitingQuotes', (
        select coalesce(
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', portal_quotes.id,
              'customerId', portal_quotes.customer_id,
              'displayNumber', portal_quotes.number_prefix || portal_quotes.number::text,
              'version', portal_quotes.version,
              'status', portal_quotes.status,
              'title', portal_quotes.title,
              'validUntil', portal_quotes.valid_until,
              'currency', portal_quotes.currency,
              'totalIncl', portal_quotes.total_incl,
              'sentAt', portal_quotes.sent_at,
              'updatedAt', portal_quotes.updated_at
            )
            order by portal_quotes.updated_at desc, portal_quotes.id
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        from (
          select
            quotes.id,
            quotes.customer_id,
            quotes.number_prefix,
            quotes.number,
            quotes.version,
            quotes.status,
            quotes.title,
            quotes.valid_until,
            quotes.currency,
            quotes.total_incl,
            quotes.sent_at,
            quotes.updated_at
          from public.quotes
          join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = quotes.customer_id
          where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and quotes.status = 'sent'
          order by quotes.updated_at desc, quotes.id
          limit 5
        ) as portal_quotes
      ),
      'unpaidInvoices', (
        select coalesce(
          jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
              'id', portal_invoices.id,
              'customerId', portal_invoices.customer_id,
              'displayNumber', coalesce(
                portal_invoices.formatted_number,

              ),
              'status', case when portal_invoices.status = 'uncollectible' then 'overdue'::public.invoice_status else portal_invoices.status end,
              'title', portal_invoices.title,
              'issueDate', portal_invoices.issue_date,
              'dueDate', portal_invoices.due_date,
              'currency', portal_invoices.currency,
              'totalIncl', portal_invoices.total_incl,
              'sentAt', portal_invoices.sent_at,
              'paidAt', portal_invoices.paid_at,
              'updatedAt', portal_invoices.updated_at
            )
            order by
              case when portal_invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible') then 0 else 1 end,
              portal_invoices.due_date nulls last,
              portal_invoices.updated_at desc,
              portal_invoices.id
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        from (
          select
            invoices.id,
            invoices.customer_id,
            invoices.formatted_number,
            invoices.number_prefix,
            invoices.number,
            invoices.status,
            invoices.title,
            invoices.issue_date,
            invoices.due_date,
            invoices.currency,
            invoices.total_incl,
            invoices.sent_at,
            invoices.paid_at,
            invoices.updated_at
          from public.invoices
          join linked_customers on linked_customers.customer_id = invoices.customer_id
          where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue', 'uncollectible')
          order by
            case when invoices.status in ('overdue', 'uncollectible') then 0 else 1 end,
            invoices.due_date nulls last,
            invoices.updated_at desc,
            invoices.id
          limit 5
        ) as portal_invoices
      ),
      'recentQuotes', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(recent.value), '[]'::jsonb)
        from (
          select portal_items.value
          from jsonb_array_elements(v_quotes) with ordinality as portal_items(value, position)
          order by portal_items.position
          limit 5
        ) as recent
      ),
      'recentInvoices', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(recent.value), '[]'::jsonb)
        from (
          select portal_items.value
          from jsonb_array_elements(v_invoices) with ordinality as portal_items(value, position)
          order by portal_items.position
          limit 5
        ) as recent
      ),
      'recentAssets', (
        select coalesce(jsonb_agg(recent.value), '[]'::jsonb)
        from (
          select portal_items.value
          from jsonb_array_elements(v_assets) with ordinality as portal_items(value, position)
          order by portal_items.position
          limit 5
        ) as recent
      )
    )
  );
end;

functions.name: customer_portal_get_order
functions.definition:
declare
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  perform public.customer_portal_assert_access(p_organization_id);

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'order', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', orders.id,
      'customerId', orders.customer_id,
      'displayNumber', orders.number_prefix || lpad(orders.number::text, 4, '0'),
      'status', orders.status,
      'deliveryMethod', orders.delivery_method,
      'currency', orders.currency,
      'vatInclusive', orders.vat_inclusive,
      'subtotalExcl', orders.subtotal_excl,
      'vatTotal', orders.vat_total,
      'totalIncl', orders.total_incl,
      'requestedDeliveryDate', orders.requested_delivery_date,
      'customerNote', orders.customer_note,
      'shipTo', jsonb_build_object(
        'name', orders.shipping_name,
        'line1', orders.shipping_address_line1,
        'line2', orders.shipping_address_line2,
        'postalCode', orders.shipping_address_postal_code,
        'city', orders.shipping_address_city,
        'country', orders.shipping_address_country
      ),
      'confirmedAt', orders.confirmed_at,
      'completedAt', orders.completed_at,
      'cancelledAt', orders.cancelled_at,
      'createdAt', orders.created_at
    ),
    'lines', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', order_lines.id,
          'title', order_lines.title,
          'description', order_lines.description,
          'quantity', order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled,
          'unit', order_lines.unit,
          'unitPrice', order_lines.unit_price,
          'vatRate', order_lines.vat_rate,
          'shipped', coalesce((
            select sum(shipment_lines.quantity)
            from public.shipment_lines
            join public.shipments on shipments.id = shipment_lines.shipment_id
            where shipment_lines.order_line_id = order_lines.id
              and shipments.direction = 'outbound'
              and shipments.shipped_at is not null
              and shipments.status <> 'cancelled'
          ), 0),
          'physical', order_lines.line_type = 'product' and coalesce(products.product_type = 'physical', false)
        )
        order by order_lines.position, order_lines.id
      )
      from public.order_lines
      left join public.products on products.id = order_lines.product_id
      where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
        and order_lines.quantity > order_lines.quantity_cancelled
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'shipments', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', shipments.id,
          'displayNumber', shipments.number_prefix || lpad(shipments.number::text, 4, '0'),
          'direction', shipments.direction,
          'status', shipments.status,
          'deliveryMethod', shipments.delivery_method,
          'carrier', shipments.carrier,
          'trackingNumber', shipments.tracking_number,
          'trackingUrl', shipments.tracking_url,
          'shippedAt', shipments.shipped_at,
          'deliveredAt', shipments.delivered_at
        )
        order by shipments.created_at desc, shipments.id
      )
      from public.shipments
      where shipments.order_id = orders.id
        and shipments.status <> 'cancelled'
        and (shipments.shipped_at is not null or shipments.status = 'ready_for_pickup'
          or shipments.direction = 'return')
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'downloads', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', order_digital_grants.id,
          'kind', case when order_digital_grants.license_key_id is null
            then 'file' else 'license_key' end,
          'title', order_lines.title,
          'fileName', product_digital_files.file_name,
          'licenseKey', product_license_keys.license_key
        )
        order by order_lines.position, order_digital_grants.created_at, order_digital_grants.id
      )
      from public.order_digital_grants
      join public.order_lines on order_lines.id = order_digital_grants.order_line_id
      left join public.product_digital_files
        on product_digital_files.id = order_digital_grants.digital_file_id
      left join public.product_license_keys
        on product_license_keys.id = order_digital_grants.license_key_id
      where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
        and order_digital_grants.revoked_at is null
        and (order_digital_grants.expires_at is null or order_digital_grants.expires_at > now())
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'invoices', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', invoices.id,
          'displayNumber', coalesce(
            invoices.formatted_number,
            invoices.number_prefix || invoices.number::text
          ),
          'kind', invoices.kind,
          'status', case when invoices.status = 'uncollectible' then 'overdue'::public.invoice_status else invoices.status end,
          'totalIncl', invoices.total_incl,
          'amountDueCents', invoices.amount_due_cents
        )
        order by invoices.created_at, invoices.id
      )
      from public.invoices
      where invoices.order_id = orders.id
        and invoices.status <> 'draft'
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into v_result
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = p_order_id
    and orders.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and orders.status <> 'draft'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.customer_contacts
      join public.contact_profiles
        on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
      where customer_contacts.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and customer_contacts.customer_id = orders.customer_id
        and contact_profiles.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    );

  if v_result is null then
    raise exception 'order not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return v_result;
end;

      'shipTo', jsonb_build_object(
        'name', orders.shipping_name,
        'line1', orders.shipping_address_line1,
        'line2', orders.shipping_address_line2,
        'postalCode', orders.shipping_address_postal_code,
        'city', orders.shipping_address_city,
        'country', orders.shipping_address_country
      ),
      'confirmedAt', orders.confirmed_at,
      'completedAt', orders.completed_at,
      'cancelledAt', orders.cancelled_at,
      'createdAt', orders.created_at
    ),
    'lines', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', order_lines.id,
          'title', order_lines.title,
          'description', order_lines.description,
          'quantity', order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled,
          'unit', order_lines.unit,
          'unitPrice', order_lines.unit_price,
          'vatRate', order_lines.vat_rate,
          'shipped', coalesce((
            select sum(shipment_lines.quantity)
            from public.shipment_lines
            join public.shipments on shipments.id = shipment_lines.shipment_id
            where shipment_lines.order_line_id = order_lines.id
              and shipments.direction = 'outbound'
              and shipments.shipped_at is not null
              and shipments.status <> 'cancelled'
          ), 0),
          'physical', order_lines.line_type = 'product' and coalesce(products.product_type = 'physical', false)
        )
        order by order_lines.position, order_lines.id
      )
      from public.order_lines
      left join public.products on products.id = order_lines.product_id
      where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
        and order_lines.quantity > order_lines.quantity_cancelled
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'shipments', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', shipments.id,
          'displayNumber', shipments.number_prefix || lpad(shipments.number::text, 4, '0'),
          'direction', shipments.direction,
          'status', shipments.status,
          'deliveryMethod', shipments.delivery_method,
          'carrier', shipments.carrier,
          'trackingNumber', shipments.tracking_number,
          'trackingUrl', shipments.tracking_url,
          'shippedAt', shipments.shipped_at,
          'deliveredAt', shipments.delivered_at
        )
        order by shipments.created_at desc, shipments.id
      )
      from public.shipments
      where shipments.order_id = orders.id
        and shipments.status <> 'cancelled'
        and (shipments.shipped_at is not null or shipments.status = 'ready_for_pickup'
          or shipments.direction = 'return')
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'downloads', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', order_digital_grants.id,
          'kind', case when order_digital_grants.license_key_id is null
            then 'file' else 'license_key' end,
          'title', order_lines.title,
          'fileName', product_digital_files.file_name,
          'licenseKey', product_license_keys.license_key
        )
        order by order_lines.position, order_digital_grants.created_at, order_digital_grants.id
      )
      from public.order_digital_grants
      join public.order_lines on order_lines.id = order_digital_grants.order_line_id
      left join public.product_digital_files
        on product_digital_files.id = order_digital_grants.digital_file_id
      left join public.product_license_keys
        on product_license_keys.id = order_digital_grants.license_key_id
      where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
        and order_digital_grants.revoked_at is null
        and (order_digital_grants.expires_at is null or order_digital_grants.expires_at > now())
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'invoices', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'id', invoices.id,
          'displayNumber', coalesce(
            invoices.formatted_number,
            invoices.number_prefix || invoices.number::text
          ),
          'kind', invoices.kind,
          'status', case when invoices.status = 'uncollectible' then 'overdue'::public.invoice_status else invoices.status end,
          'totalIncl', invoices.total_incl,
          'amountDueCents', invoices.amount_due_cents
        )
        order by invoices.created_at, invoices.id
      )
      from public.invoices
      where invoices.order_id = orders.id
        and invoices.status <> 'draft'
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into v_result
  from public.orders
  where orders.id = p_order_id
    and orders.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and orders.status <> 'draft'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.customer_contacts
      join public.contact_profiles
        on contact_profiles.id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
      where customer_contacts.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and customer_contacts.customer_id = orders.customer_id
        and contact_profiles.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    );

  if v_result is null then
    raise exception 'order not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return v_result;
end;

functions.name: decide_ai_contextual_artifact
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.decide_ai_contextual_artifact(p_artifact_id uuid, p_decision text, p_expected_context_fingerprint text, p_idempotency_key text, p_apply_claim_id text, p_metadata jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_artifact public.ai_contextual_artifacts%rowtype;
  v_base_policy public.organization_ai_policies%rowtype;
  v_action_policy public.organization_ai_action_policies%rowtype;
  v_platform_ceiling text;
  v_effective_ceiling text;
  v_event_kind text;
  v_now timestamptz := (now() at time zone 'utc');
begin
  if v_actor_id is null then
    raise exception 'authentication required' using errcode = '28000';
  end if;
  if p_decision not in ('applying', 'applied', 'rejected', 'stale')
    or jsonb_typeof(p_metadata) <> 'object'
  then
    raise exception 'invalid contextual artifact decision' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select artifact.*
  into v_artifact
  from public.ai_contextual_artifacts as artifact
  where artifact.id = p_artifact_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;
  if not public.has_chat_thread_access(v_artifact.thread_id)
    or not public.has_org_permission(v_artifact.organization_id, v_artifact.origin_permission)
    or not exists (
      select 1
      from public.chat_threads as thread
      where thread.id = v_artifact.thread_id
        and thread.organization_id = v_artifact.organization_id
        and thread.owner_user_id = v_artifact.thread_owner_user_id
        and thread.visibility = v_artifact.thread_visibility
    )
  then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact decision denied' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select policy.*
  into v_base_policy
  from public.organization_ai_policies as policy
  where policy.organization_id = v_artifact.organization_id;

  select policy.*
  into v_action_policy
  from public.organization_ai_action_policies as policy
  where policy.organization_id = v_artifact.organization_id
    and policy.action_id = v_artifact.action_id;

  select coalesce(setting.value ->> 'executionCeiling', 'agent')
  into v_platform_ceiling
  from public.platform_settings as setting
  where setting.key = 'ai_agent_policy';
  v_platform_ceiling := coalesce(v_platform_ceiling, 'agent');

  v_effective_ceiling := case
    when v_action_policy.execution_ceiling is null then
      v_platform_ceiling
    when case v_action_policy.execution_ceiling
      when 'read' then 0 when 'review' then 1 else 2 end
      < case v_platform_ceiling
        when 'read' then 0 when 'review' then 1 else 2 end
    then v_action_policy.execution_ceiling
    else v_platform_ceiling
  end;

  if v_action_policy.enabled is false
    or (case v_effective_ceiling when 'read' then 0 when 'review' then 1 else 2 end)
      < (case v_artifact.origin_execution_policy
        when 'immediate-read' then 0 when 'review-first' then 1 else 2 end)
  then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact disabled by organization policy'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if v_artifact.decision_idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key then
    return to_jsonb(v_artifact);
  end if;

  if v_artifact.status = 'applying'
    and (
      p_apply_claim_id is null
      or v_artifact.apply_claim_id is distinct from p_apply_claim_id
      or v_artifact.applying_by is distinct from v_actor_id
    )
  then
    raise exception 'contextual artifact apply claim conflict' using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  v_event_kind := case
    when v_artifact.context_fingerprint <> p_expected_context_fingerprint then 'stale'
    else p_decision
  end;

  if v_event_kind = 'applying' then
    if v_artifact.status <> 'proposed'
      or p_apply_claim_id is null
      or btrim(p_apply_claim_id) = ''
      or v_artifact.apply_handler is null
    then
      raise exception 'invalid contextual artifact apply claim' using errcode = '23505';
    end if;

    update public.ai_contextual_artifacts
    set
      status = 'applying',
      apply_claim_id = p_apply_claim_id,
      applying_by = v_actor_id,
      applying_at = v_now,
      decision_idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key,
      decision_metadata = p_metadata,
      decided_by = null,
      decided_at = null,
      applied_at = null
    where id = v_artifact.id
    returning * into v_artifact;
  else
    if v_event_kind = 'applied'
      and (
        (v_artifact.apply_handler is not null and v_artifact.status <> 'applying')
        or (v_artifact.apply_handler is null and v_artifact.status <> 'proposed')
      )
    then
      raise exception 'contextual artifact cannot be applied from its current state'
        using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    if v_event_kind = 'rejected' and v_artifact.status <> 'proposed' then
      raise exception 'contextual artifact cannot be rejected from its current state'
        using errcode = '23505';
    end if;
    if v_event_kind = 'stale' and v_artifact.status not in ('proposed', 'applying') then
      raise exception 'contextual artifact cannot be marked stale from its current state'
        using errcode = '23505';
    end if;

    update public.ai_contextual_artifacts
    set
      status = v_event_kind,
      apply_claim_id = null,
      applying_by = null,
      applying_at = null,
      decision_idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key,
      decision_metadata = p_metadata,
      decided_by = v_actor_id,
      decided_at = v_now,
      applied_at = case when v_event_kind = 'applied' then v_now else null end
    where id = v_artifact.id
    returning * into v_artifact;
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_contextual_artifact_events (
    artifact_id,
    organization_id,
    kind,
    actor_user_id,
    payload_summary,
    metadata
  )
  values (
    v_artifact.id,
    v_artifact.organization_id,
    v_event_kind,
    v_actor_id,
    case
      when v_event_kind = 'stale'
        and p_decision <> 'stale'
      then 'Context fingerprint mismatch'
      when v_event_kind = 'stale'
      then coalesce(p_metadata ->> 'reason', 'Local artifact apply failed')
      else null
    end,
    p_metadata
  );

  return to_jsonb(v_artifact);
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_artifact_id uuid, p_decision text, p_expected_context_fingerprint text, p_idempotency_key text, p_apply_claim_id text, p_metadata jsonb
functions.identity_argument_types: p_artifact_id uuid, p_decision text, p_expected_context_fingerprint text, p_idempotency_key text, p_apply_claim_id text, p_metadata jsonb

declare
  v_uid uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_can_manage_system boolean := false;
  v_can_delete_org boolean := false;
begin
  if v_uid is null then
    raise exception 'Not authenticated';
  end if;

  select public.authorize_scope('system', null, 'system.organizations.manage')
  into v_can_manage_system;

  if not v_can_manage_system then
    select public.authorize_scope('organization', p_organization_id, 'organization.general.delete')
    into v_can_delete_org;

    if not v_can_delete_org then
      raise exception 'Only organization owners can delete this organization';
    end if;
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    organization_id,
    organization_name_snapshot,
    scope,
    actor_kind,
    actor_id,
    actor_is_platform_admin,
    event_type,
    category,
    outcome,
    source,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    safe_metadata
  )
  select
    organizations.id,
    organizations.name,
    'organization',
    case when v_can_manage_system then 'platform_admin' else 'user' end,
    v_uid,
    v_can_manage_system,
    'organization.lifecycle.completed',
    'settings',
    'success',
    'database',
    'organization',
    organizations.id::text,
    jsonb_build_object('operation', 'delete')
  from public.organizations
  where organizations.id = p_organization_id;

  delete from public.organizations
  where id = p_organization_id;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Organization not found';
  end if;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.employee_week_summary(p_employee_id uuid, p_week_start date)
 RETURNS TABLE(day date, scheduled_hours numeric, logged_hours numeric, time_off_hours numeric, is_holiday boolean)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_organization_id uuid;
begin
  select organization_id into v_organization_id from public.employees where id = p_employee_id;

  return query
  select
    days.day::date,
    public.employee_scheduled_hours(p_employee_id, days.day::date),
    coalesce((
      select round(sum(coalesce(entries.duration_seconds, 0)) / 3600.0, 2)
      from public.time_entries entries
      where entries.employee_id = p_employee_id
        and (entries.started_at at time zone 'utc')::date = days.day::date
    ), 0),
    coalesce((
      select round(sum(
        case
          when requests.starts_on = requests.ends_on then requests.hours
          else public.compute_time_off_hours(
            p_employee_id, days.day::date, days.day::date,
            case when days.day::date = requests.starts_on then requests.start_part
              when days.day::date = requests.ends_on then requests.end_part
              else 'full'::public.time_off_partial_day end,
            'full'::public.time_off_partial_day, null, null
          )
        end
      ), 2)
      from public.time_off_requests requests
      where requests.employee_id = p_employee_id
        and requests.status = 'approved'
        and days.day::date between requests.starts_on and requests.ends_on
    ), 0),
    exists (
      select 1 from public.public_holidays
      where organization_id = v_organization_id and holiday_date = days.day::date
    )
  from generate_series(p_week_start, p_week_start + 6, interval '1 day') as days(day);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_agenda_planning_calendar(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_calendar_id uuid;
begin
  if not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.agenda.view') then
    raise exception 'not authorized';
  end if;

  select agenda_collections.id
  into v_calendar_id
  from public.agenda_collections
  where agenda_collections.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and agenda_collections.kind = 'planning'
  limit 1;

  if v_calendar_id is not null then
    return v_calendar_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.agenda_collections (
    organization_id,
    name,
    color,
    visibility,
    source,
    is_default,
    position,
    kind,
    default_time_zone
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    'Planning',
    '#4f46e5',
    'public',
    'local',
    false,
    1,
    'planning',
    public.agenda_default_time_zone(p_organization_id, (select auth.uid()), false)
  )
  on conflict (organization_id) where (kind = 'planning') do nothing
  returning agenda_collections.id into v_calendar_id;

  if v_calendar_id is not null then
    return v_calendar_id;
  end if;

  select agenda_collections.id
  into v_calendar_id
  from public.agenda_collections
  where agenda_collections.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and agenda_collections.kind = 'planning'
  limit 1;

  return v_calendar_id;
end;
$function$

functions.name: ensure_comment_thread
functions.definition:
declare
  v_thread_id uuid;
begin
  -- comment_threads has no UPDATE policy. ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE would fail RLS
  -- for every existing thread, including seeded task/customer discussions.
  select comment_thread.id
    into v_thread_id
  from public.comment_threads as comment_thread
  where comment_thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and comment_thread.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and comment_thread.subject_id = p_subject_id;

  if found then
    return v_thread_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.comment_threads (
    organization_id,
    subject_type,
    subject_id,
    customer_id,
    task_id,
    quote_id,
    invoice_id,
    customer_asset_id
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_subject_type,
    p_subject_id,
    p_customer_id,
    p_task_id,
    case when p_subject_type = 'quote' then p_subject_id::uuid else null end,
    case when p_subject_type = 'invoice' then p_subject_id::uuid else null end,
    case
      when p_subject_type = 'customer-asset' then coalesce(p_customer_asset_id, p_subject_id::bigint)
      else null
    end
  )
  on conflict on constraint comment_threads_subject_key
  do nothing
  returning public.comment_threads.id into v_thread_id;

  if v_thread_id is not null then
    return v_thread_id;
  end if;

  select comment_thread.id
    into v_thread_id
  from public.comment_threads as comment_thread
  where comment_thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and comment_thread.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and comment_thread.subject_id = p_subject_id;

  return v_thread_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_notification_subscription(p_organization_id uuid, p_user_id uuid, p_subject_type text, p_subject_id text)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_id uuid;
begin
  if auth.role() is distinct from 'service_role'
    and not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.general.view') then
    raise exception 'Not authorized' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  insert into public.notification_subscriptions (
    organization_id,
    user_id,
    subject_type,
    subject_id
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_subject_type,
    p_subject_id
  )
  on conflict (organization_id, user_id, subject_type, subject_id)
  do update set organization_id = excluded.organization_id
  returning id into v_id;

  return v_id;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ensure_people_defaults(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_vacation_type_id uuid;
  v_year integer := extract(year from (now() at time zone 'utc'))::integer;
begin
  insert into public.hr_settings (organization_id)
  values (p_organization_id)
  on conflict (organization_id) do nothing;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.hr_default_schedule where organization_id = p_organization_id) then
    insert into public.hr_default_schedule (organization_id, cycle_week, weekday, starts_at, ends_at)
    select p_organization_id, 1, weekday, time '08:00', time '17:00'
    from generate_series(1, 5) as weekday;
  end if;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.time_off_types where organization_id = p_organization_id) then
    insert into public.time_off_types (
      organization_id, name, category, color, icon_name, paid, requires_approval,
      deducts_balance, requires_attachment, position
    )
    values
      (p_organization_id, 'Vacation', 'vacation', '#16a34a', 'Beach02Icon', true, null, true, false, 0),
      (p_organization_id, 'Sick leave', 'sick', '#dc2626', 'MedicineBottle01Icon', true, false, false, false, 1),
      (p_organization_id, 'Special leave', 'special', '#7c3aed', 'Calendar03Icon', true, null, false, false, 2),
      (p_organization_id, 'Unpaid leave', 'unpaid', '#64748b', 'MoneyNotFound01Icon', false, null, false, false, 3),
      (p_organization_id, 'Compensatory time', 'compensatory', '#0891b2', 'Clock01Icon', true, null, true, false, 4);

    select id into v_vacation_type_id
    from public.time_off_types
    where organization_id = p_organization_id and category = 'vacation'
    order by position
    limit 1;

    insert into public.time_off_policies (
      organization_id, time_off_type_id, name, annual_hours, accrual_method,
      carryover_max_hours, carryover_expires_after_months, is_default
    )
    values (p_organization_id, v_vacation_type_id, 'Standard vacation', 200, 'upfront', 200, 6, true);
  end if;

  if not exists (select 1 from public.expense_categories where organization_id = p_organization_id) then

functions.name: ensure_user_file_drives
functions.definition:
declare
  v_user_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if v_user_id is null
    or not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.files.view') then
    raise exception 'File drive initialization is not allowed' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  insert into public.file_drives (
    organization_id,
    drive_type,
    name
  )
  select p_organization_id, 'company', 'Company'
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from public.file_drives
    where organization_id = p_organization_id and drive_type = 'company'
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  insert into public.file_drives (
    organization_id,
    drive_type,
    name,
    owner_user_id,
    created_by
  )
  select p_organization_id, 'personal', 'My files', v_user_id, v_user_id
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from public.file_drives
    where organization_id = p_organization_id
      and drive_type = 'personal'
      and owner_user_id = v_user_id
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  insert into public.file_drives (
    organization_id,
    drive_type,
    name
  )
  select p_organization_id, 'customers', 'Customers'
  where not exists (
    select 1
    from public.file_drives
    where organization_id = p_organization_id and drive_type = 'customers'
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  return query
  select
    company.id,
    personal.id
  from public.file_drives as company
  inner join public.file_drives as personal
    on personal.organization_id = company.organization_id
    and personal.drive_type = 'personal'
    and personal.owner_user_id = v_user_id
  where company.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and company.drive_type = 'company';
end;

functions.name: find_expense_duplicates
functions.definition:
begin
  return query
  select other.id, case
    when other.receipt_sha256 is not null and other.receipt_sha256 = subject.receipt_sha256 then 'same_receipt'
    else 'same_amount_date_merchant'
  end
  from public.expenses subject
  join public.expenses other
    on other.organization_id = subject.organization_id
   and other.id <> subject.id
  where subject.id = p_expense_id
    and (
      (subject.receipt_sha256 is not null and other.receipt_sha256 = subject.receipt_sha256)
      or (
        other.amount = subject.amount
        and other.spent_on = subject.spent_on
        and lower(coalesce(other.merchant, '')) = lower(coalesce(subject.merchant, ''))
        and subject.merchant is not null
      )
    )
  limit 5;
end;
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.find_expense_duplicates(p_expense_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(expense_id uuid, reason text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  return query
  select other.id, case
    when other.receipt_sha256 is not null and other.receipt_sha256 = subject.receipt_sha256 then 'same_receipt'
    else 'same_amount_date_merchant'
  end
  from public.expenses subject
  join public.expenses other
    on other.organization_id = subject.organization_id
   and other.id <> subject.id
  where subject.id = p_expense_id
    and (
      (subject.receipt_sha256 is not null and other.receipt_sha256 = subject.receipt_sha256)
      or (
        other.amount = subject.amount
        and other.spent_on = subject.spent_on
        and lower(coalesce(other.merchant, '')) = lower(coalesce(subject.merchant, ''))
        and subject.merchant is not null
      )
    )
  limit 5;
end;
$function$

functions.name: finish_ai_agent_tool
functions.definition:
declare
  v_event_sequence integer;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'finish_ai_agent_tool requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_status not in ('succeeded', 'failed') or p_duration_ms < 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Agent tool finish values'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.ai_agent_runs as run
  join public.chat_threads as thread
    on thread.id = run.thread_id
  where run.id = p_run_id
    and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and run.created_by = p_actor_user_id
    and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
    and run.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    and run.request_id = p_request_id
    and run.mode = 'agent'
    and run.status in (
      'queued',
      'planning',
      'awaiting_approval',
      'running',
      'checking',
      'retrying'
    )
    and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
    and thread.active_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    and thread.stream_status = 'streaming'
  for update of run;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'invalid Agent tool execution context'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.ai_agent_run_steps
  where ai_agent_run_steps.id = p_step_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.run_id = p_run_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.tool_call_id = p_tool_call_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.tool_name = p_tool_name
    and ai_agent_run_steps.status in ('running', p_status)
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Agent tool step transition is invalid'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  update public.ai_agent_run_steps
  set
    status = p_status,
    output = p_output,
    error = p_error,
    completed_at = p_completed_at,
    metadata = ai_agent_run_steps.metadata || p_metadata
  where ai_agent_run_steps.id = p_step_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.status = 'running';

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_agent_run_events
    where ai_agent_run_events.run_id = p_run_id
      and ai_agent_run_events.step_id = p_step_id
      and ai_agent_run_events.kind = 'tool_finished'
  ) then
    select coalesce(max(ai_agent_run_events.sequence), 0) + 1
    into v_event_sequence
    from public.ai_agent_run_events
    where ai_agent_run_events.run_id = p_run_id;

    insert into public.ai_agent_run_events (
      run_id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      request_id,
      step_id,
      kind,
      sequence,
      status,
      title,
      payload,
      metadata,
      created_by
    )
    values (
      p_run_id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      p_request_id,
      p_step_id,
      'tool_finished',
      v_event_sequence,
      p_status,
      p_title,
      coalesce(p_error, p_output),
      p_metadata,
      p_actor_user_id
    );
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_telemetry_events (
    organization_id,
    user_id,
    thread_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    request_id,
    kind,
    status,
    name,
    provider,
    model,
    input_tokens,
    output_tokens,
    cost_micros,
    duration_ms,
    error_code,
    error_message,
    metadata,
    idempotency_key
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_actor_user_id,
    p_thread_id,
    p_workflow_run_id,
    p_request_id,
    'tool_call',
    p_status,
    p_tool_name,
    'workflow',
    p_model,
    null,
    null,
    null,
    p_duration_ms,
    p_error ->> 'errorType',
    p_error ->> 'message',
    p_metadata || jsonb_build_object('toolCallId', p_tool_call_id),
    p_request_id || ':tool:' || p_tool_call_id || ':finished'
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  perform public.record_usage_events_bulk(
    p_organization_id,
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'billable', true,
      'idempotency_key', p_request_id || ':tool:' || p_tool_call_id || ':usage',
      'metadata', p_metadata,
      'meter_key', 'workflow.steps',
      'quantity', 1,
      'source', 'workflow',
      'source_id', p_run_id::text,
      'user_id', p_actor_user_id
    )),
    p_completed_at
  );

  return true;
end;
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.finish_ai_agent_tool(p_step_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text, p_request_id text, p_tool_call_id text, p_tool_name text, p_title text, p_model text, p_status text, p_duration_ms integer, p_output jsonb, p_error jsonb, p_metadata jsonb, p_completed_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_event_sequence integer;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'finish_ai_agent_tool requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_status not in ('succeeded', 'failed') or p_duration_ms < 0 then
    raise exception 'invalid Agent tool finish values'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.ai_agent_runs as run
  join public.chat_threads as thread
    on thread.id = run.thread_id
  where run.id = p_run_id
    and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and run.created_by = p_actor_user_id
    and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
    and run.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    and run.request_id = p_request_id
    and run.mode = 'agent'
    and run.status in (
      'queued',
      'planning',
      'awaiting_approval',
      'running',
      'checking',
      'retrying'
    )
    and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
    and thread.active_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    and thread.stream_status = 'streaming'
  for update of run;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'invalid Agent tool execution context'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.ai_agent_run_steps
  where ai_agent_run_steps.id = p_step_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.run_id = p_run_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.tool_call_id = p_tool_call_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.tool_name = p_tool_name
    and ai_agent_run_steps.status in ('running', p_status)
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'Agent tool step transition is invalid'
      using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  update public.ai_agent_run_steps
  set
    status = p_status,
    output = p_output,
    error = p_error,
    completed_at = p_completed_at,
    metadata = ai_agent_run_steps.metadata || p_metadata
  where ai_agent_run_steps.id = p_step_id
    and ai_agent_run_steps.status = 'running';

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_agent_run_events
    where ai_agent_run_events.run_id = p_run_id
      and ai_agent_run_events.step_id = p_step_id
      and ai_agent_run_events.kind = 'tool_finished'
  ) then
    select coalesce(max(ai_agent_run_events.sequence), 0) + 1
    into v_event_sequence
    from public.ai_agent_run_events
    where ai_agent_run_events.run_id = p_run_id;

    insert into public.ai_agent_run_events (
      run_id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      request_id,
      step_id,
      kind,
      sequence,
      status,
      title,
      payload,
      metadata,
      created_by
    )
    values (
      p_run_id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      p_request_id,
      p_step_id,
      'tool_finished',
      v_event_sequence,
      p_status,
      p_title,
      coalesce(p_error, p_output),
      p_metadata,
      p_actor_user_id
    );
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_telemetry_events (
    organization_id,
    user_id,
    thread_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    request_id,
    kind,
    status,
    name,
    provider,
    model,
    input_tokens,
    output_tokens,
    cost_micros,
    duration_ms,
    error_code,
    error_message,
    metadata,
    idempotency_key
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_actor_user_id,
    p_thread_id,
    p_workflow_run_id,
    p_request_id,
    'tool_call',
    p_status,
    p_tool_name,
    'workflow',
    p_model,
    null,
    null,
    null,
    p_duration_ms,
    p_error ->> 'errorType',
    p_error ->> 'message',
    p_metadata || jsonb_build_object('toolCallId', p_tool_call_id),
    p_request_id || ':tool:' || p_tool_call_id || ':finished'
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  perform public.record_usage_events_bulk(
    p_organization_id,
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'billable', true,
      'idempotency_key', p_request_id || ':tool:' || p_tool_call_id || ':usage',
      'metadata', p_metadata,
      'meter_key', 'workflow.steps',
      'quantity', 1,
      'source', 'workflow',
      'source_id', p_run_id::text,
      'user_id', p_actor_user_id
    )),
    p_completed_at
  );

  return true;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_step_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text, p_request_id text, p_tool_call_id text, p_tool_name text, p_title text, p_model text, p_status text, p_duration_ms integer, p_output jsonb, p_error jsonb, p_metadata jsonb, p_completed_at timestamp with time zone
functions.identity_argument_types: p_step_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text, p_request_id text, p_tool_call_id text, p_tool_name text, p_title text, p_model text, p_status text, p_duration_ms integer, p_output jsonb, p_error jsonb, p_metadata jsonb, p_completed_at timestamp with time zone

declare
  v_finished boolean := false;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' or p_status not in ('completed', 'failed') then
    raise exception 'finish_inbox_automation requires service_role and a terminal status'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update public.inbox_automation_runs as automation_run
  set
    completed_at = now() at time zone 'utc',
    error = case when p_status = 'failed' then p_payload else null end,
    output = case when p_status = 'completed' then p_payload else null end,
    status = p_status,
    updated_at = now() at time zone 'utc'
  where automation_run.channel_thread_id = p_channel_thread_id
    and automation_run.source_message_id = p_source_message_id
    and automation_run.lease_token = p_lease_token
    and automation_run.status = 'claimed'
  returning true into v_finished;

  return coalesce(v_finished, false);
end;
