functions.name: fulfill_digital_order
get_admin_analytics
functions.definition:
declare
  v_comparison_start date;
  v_comparison_end date;
  v_period_days integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if p_start_date is null
    or p_end_date is null
    or p_start_date > p_end_date
    or p_end_date - p_start_date > 1830
  then
    raise exception 'analytics date range must be ordered and no longer than five years'
      using errcode = '22007';
  end if;

  if p_granularity not in ('day', 'week', 'month')
    or p_comparison not in ('none', 'previous-period', 'previous-year')
    or p_time_zone is null
    or length(p_time_zone) > 100
    or coalesce(cardinality(p_currencies), 0) > 20
    or exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      where requested_currency.currency !~ '^[a-z]{3}$'
    )
  then
    raise exception 'invalid analytics query parameters' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform now() at time zone p_time_zone;

  v_period_days := p_end_date - p_start_date + 1;
  if p_comparison = 'previous-period' then
    v_comparison_end := p_start_date - 1;
    v_comparison_start := v_comparison_end - v_period_days + 1;
  elsif p_comparison = 'previous-year' then
    v_comparison_start := p_start_date - interval '1 year';
    v_comparison_end := p_end_date - interval '1 year';
  end if;

  with
    active_subscriptions as (
      select
        organization_subscriptions.id,
        organization_subscriptions.organization_id,
        organization_subscriptions.plan_key::text as plan_key,
        organization_subscriptions.quantity,
        organization_subscriptions.created_at,
        billing_plan_prices.currency,
        (
          billing_plan_prices.amount::numeric
          / case when organization_subscriptions.interval = 'year' then 12 else 1 end
          * organization_subscriptions.quantity
        ) as monthly_amount
      from public.organization_subscriptions
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = organization_subscriptions.organization_id
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
      join public.billing_plan_prices
        on billing_plan_prices.plan_key = organization_subscriptions.plan_key
        and billing_plan_prices.package_key = organization_subscriptions.credit_package_key
        and billing_plan_prices.interval = organization_subscriptions.interval
      where organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due')
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or billing_plan_prices.currency = any (p_currencies)
        )
    ),
    recurring_totals as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount))::bigint as mrr,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount) * 12)::bigint as arr
      from active_subscriptions
      group by active_subscriptions.currency
    ),
    subscription_cash as (
      select
        organization_invoices.organization_id,
        organization_invoices.id,
        organization_invoices.invoice_number,
        organization_invoices.currency,
        organization_invoices.amount_paid::bigint as amount_minor,
        (organization_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date as paid_on
      from public.organization_invoices
      where organization_invoices.paid_at is not null
        and (organization_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or organization_invoices.currency = any (p_currencies)
        )
    ),
    cash_totals as (
      select
        subscription_cash.currency,
        sum(subscription_cash.amount_minor)::bigint as amount_minor
      from subscription_cash
      group by subscription_cash.currency
    ),
    organization_counts as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where (organizations.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
            between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as current_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and (organizations.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_count
      from public.organizations
    ),
    paid_organization_counts as (
      select
        count(distinct organization_subscription_history.organization_id) filter (
          where organization_subscription_history.status in ('active', 'past_due')
            and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as current_count,
        count(distinct organization_subscription_history.organization_id) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and organization_subscription_history.status in ('active', 'past_due')
            and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_count
      from public.organization_subscription_history
    ),
    user_counts as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where (profiles.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
            between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as current_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and (profiles.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_count
      from public.profiles
    ),
    churn_counts as (
      select count(distinct organization_subscription_history.organization_id)::numeric
        as churned_count
      from public.organization_subscription_history
      where organization_subscription_history.status in ('canceled', 'unpaid')
        and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
    ),
    paid_at_start as (
      select count(*)::numeric as paid_count
      from (
        select distinct on (organization_subscription_history.organization_id)
          organization_subscription_history.organization_id,
          organization_subscription_history.status
        from public.organization_subscription_history
        where organization_subscription_history.effective_at
          < p_start_date::timestamp at time zone p_time_zone
        order by
          organization_subscription_history.organization_id,
          organization_subscription_history.effective_at desc
      ) as latest_subscription
      where latest_subscription.status in ('active', 'past_due')
    ),
    usage_totals as (
      select
        coalesce(sum(organization_usage_events.quantity), 0)::numeric as quantity
      from public.organization_usage_events
      where (organization_usage_events.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        between p_start_date and p_end_date
    ),
    overage_totals as (
      select
        coalesce(sum(organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity), 0)::numeric as quantity
      from public.organization_usage_periods
      where (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date <= p_end_date
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_end at time zone p_time_zone)::date >= p_start_date
    ),
    usage_cost_proxy as (
      select
        organization_usage_periods.organization_id,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(
          active_subscriptions.monthly_amount
          * organization_usage_periods.quantity
          / nullif(organization_usage_periods.included_quantity, 0)
        )::bigint as amount_minor
      from public.organization_usage_periods
      join active_subscriptions
        on active_subscriptions.organization_id = organization_usage_periods.organization_id
      where (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date <= p_end_date
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_end at time zone p_time_zone)::date >= p_start_date
        and organization_usage_periods.included_quantity > 0
    ),
    cost_proxy_totals as (
      select
        usage_cost_proxy.currency,
        sum(usage_cost_proxy.amount_minor)::bigint as amount_minor
      from usage_cost_proxy
      group by usage_cost_proxy.currency
    ),
    cash_values as (
      select
        date_trunc(
          p_granularity,
          subscription_cash.paid_on::timestamp
        )::date as bucket_start,
        subscription_cash.currency,
        sum(subscription_cash.amount_minor)::bigint as amount_minor
      from subscription_cash
      group by bucket_start, subscription_cash.currency
    ),
    cash_points as (
      select
        cash_values.bucket_start,
        least(
          p_end_date,
          (
            cash_values.bucket_start
            + case p_granularity
                when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                else interval '1 month'
              end
            - interval '1 day'
          )::date
        ) as bucket_end,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', cash_values.amount_minor,
          'currency', cash_values.currency
        ) order by cash_values.currency) as values
      from cash_values
      group by cash_values.bucket_start
    ),
    usage_points as (
      select
        date_trunc(
          p_granularity,
          organization_usage_events.created_at at time zone p_time_zone
        )::date as bucket_start,
        sum(organization_usage_events.quantity)::numeric as value
      from public.organization_usage_events
      where (organization_usage_events.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by bucket_start
    ),
    plan_mix as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.plan_key,
        count(*)::numeric as subscription_count
      from active_subscriptions
      group by active_subscriptions.plan_key
    ),
    ranked_organization_values as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount))::bigint as amount_minor
      from active_subscriptions
      join public.organizations on organizations.id = active_subscriptions.organization_id
      group by
        active_subscriptions.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        active_subscriptions.currency
    ),
    ranking_currency as (
      select coalesce(p_currencies[1], min(active_subscriptions.currency)) as currency
      from active_subscriptions
    ),
    ranked_organizations as (
      select
        ranked_organization_values.organization_id,
        ranked_organization_values.name,
        coalesce(max(ranked_organization_values.amount_minor) filter (
          where ranked_organization_values.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', ranked_organization_values.amount_minor,
          'currency', ranked_organization_values.currency
        ) order by ranked_organization_values.currency) as values
      from ranked_organization_values
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by
        ranked_organization_values.organization_id,
        ranked_organization_values.name,
        ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    plan_values as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.plan_key,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount))::bigint as amount_minor
      from active_subscriptions
      group by active_subscriptions.plan_key, active_subscriptions.currency
    ),
    ranked_plans as (
      select
        plan_values.plan_key,
        initcap(plan_values.plan_key) as label,
        coalesce(max(plan_values.amount_minor) filter (
          where plan_values.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', plan_values.amount_minor,
          'currency', plan_values.currency
        ) order by plan_values.currency) as values
      from plan_values
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by plan_values.plan_key, ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    ranked_admin_rows as (
      select
        ranked_organizations.organization_id::text as entity_id,
        ranked_organizations.name as label,
        'mrr'::text as metric_key,
        ranked_organizations.sort_amount,
        ranked_organizations.values
      from ranked_organizations
      union all
      select
        ranked_plans.plan_key,
        ranked_plans.label,
        'plan-mix',
        ranked_plans.sort_amount,
        ranked_plans.values
      from ranked_plans
    ),
    subscription_evidence as (
      select
        (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          as occurred_on,
        organization_subscription_history.organization_id,
        organization_subscription_history.id,
        organization_subscription_history.plan_name,
        organization_subscription_history.catalog_currency,
        round(
          organization_subscription_history.catalog_monthly_amount
          * organization_subscription_history.quantity
        )::bigint as amount_minor
      from public.organization_subscription_history
      where organization_subscription_history.catalog_monthly_amount is not null
        and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or organization_subscription_history.catalog_currency = any (p_currencies)
        )
      order by organization_subscription_history.effective_at desc
      limit 250
    ),
    usage_evidence as (
      select
        greatest(
          (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          p_start_date
        ) as occurred_on,
        organization_usage_periods.organization_id,
        organization_usage_periods.id,
        organization_usage_periods.meter_key,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(
          active_subscriptions.monthly_amount
          * organization_usage_periods.quantity
          / nullif(organization_usage_periods.included_quantity, 0)
        )::bigint as amount_minor
      from public.organization_usage_periods
      join active_subscriptions
        on active_subscriptions.organization_id = organization_usage_periods.organization_id
      where organization_usage_periods.included_quantity > 0
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date <= p_end_date
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_end at time zone p_time_zone)::date >= p_start_date
      order by organization_usage_periods.period_start desc
      limit 250
    ),
    currency_dimensions as (
      select requested_currency.currency
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      union
      select recurring_totals.currency from recurring_totals
      union
      select cash_totals.currency from cash_totals
      union
      select cost_proxy_totals.currency from cost_proxy_totals
    ),
    currency_metric_values as (
      select 'mrr'::text as metric_key, recurring_totals.currency,
        recurring_totals.mrr as amount_minor
      from recurring_totals
      union all
      select 'arr', recurring_totals.currency, recurring_totals.arr
      from recurring_totals
      union all
      select 'subscription-cash-revenue', cash_totals.currency, cash_totals.amount_minor
      from cash_totals
      union all
      select 'usage-cost-proxy', cost_proxy_totals.currency, cost_proxy_totals.amount_minor
      from cost_proxy_totals
    ),
    currency_kpis as (
      select
        metric_key.metric_key,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', coalesce(currency_metric_values.amount_minor, 0),
          'currency', currency_dimensions.currency
        ) order by currency_dimensions.currency) as values
      from (
        values
          ('mrr'::text),
          ('arr'),
          ('subscription-cash-revenue'),
          ('usage-cost-proxy')
      ) as metric_key(metric_key)
      cross join currency_dimensions
      left join currency_metric_values
        on currency_metric_values.metric_key = metric_key.metric_key
        and currency_metric_values.currency = currency_dimensions.currency
      group by metric_key.metric_key
    ),
    number_kpis as (
      select 'tenant-growth'::text as metric_key, organization_counts.current_count as value,
        organization_counts.comparison_count as comparison_value, 'count'::text as unit
      from organization_counts
      union all
      select 'paid-tenant-growth', paid_organization_counts.current_count,
        paid_organization_counts.comparison_count, 'count'
      from paid_organization_counts
      union all
      select 'user-growth', user_counts.current_count, user_counts.comparison_count, 'count'
      from user_counts
      union all
      select 'logo-churn',
        coalesce(100 * churn_counts.churned_count / nullif(paid_at_start.paid_count, 0), 0),
        null, 'percent'
      from churn_counts cross join paid_at_start
      union all
      select 'logo-retention',
        100 - coalesce(100 * churn_counts.churned_count / nullif(paid_at_start.paid_count, 0), 0),
        null, 'percent'
      from churn_counts cross join paid_at_start
      union all
      select 'usage', usage_totals.quantity, null, 'quantity' from usage_totals
      union all
      select 'usage-demand', overage_totals.quantity, null, 'quantity' from overage_totals
      union all
      select 'plan-mix', coalesce(sum(plan_mix.subscription_count), 0), null, 'count'
      from plan_mix
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'evidenceRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'occurredOn', evidence.occurred_on,
        'metricKey', evidence.metric_key,
        'reference', evidence.reference,
        'sourceId', evidence.source_id,
        'sourceType', evidence.source_type,
        'values', evidence.values
      ) order by evidence.occurred_on desc, evidence.source_id)
      from (
        select
          subscription_evidence.occurred_on,
          'mrr'::text as metric_key,
          subscription_evidence.plan_name as reference,
          subscription_evidence.id::text as source_id,
          'subscription'::text as source_type,
          jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', subscription_evidence.amount_minor,
            'currency', subscription_evidence.catalog_currency
          )) as values
        from subscription_evidence
        union all
        select
          usage_evidence.occurred_on,
          'usage-cost-proxy',
          usage_evidence.meter_key,
          usage_evidence.id::text,
          'usage',
          jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', usage_evidence.amount_minor,
            'currency', usage_evidence.currency
          ))
        from usage_evidence
      ) as evidence
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'forecasts', '[]'::jsonb,
    'generatedAt', to_jsonb(now()),
    'insights', '[]'::jsonb,
    'kpis', (
      select jsonb_agg(kpi.payload)
      from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'changePercent', null,
          'coveragePercent', null,
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', currency_kpis.metric_key,
          'values', currency_kpis.values
        ) as payload
        from currency_kpis
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'changePercent',
            case when number_kpis.comparison_value <> 0
              then round(
                100 * (number_kpis.value - number_kpis.comparison_value)
                  / abs(number_kpis.comparison_value),
                2
              )
            end,
          'coveragePercent', null,
          'kind', 'number',
          'metricKey', number_kpis.metric_key,
          'unit', number_kpis.unit,
          'value', round(number_kpis.value, 2)
        )
        from number_kpis
      ) as kpi
    ),
    'range', jsonb_build_object(
      'comparison', p_comparison,
      'currencies', coalesce(to_jsonb(p_currencies), '[]'::jsonb),
      'endDate', p_end_date,
      'granularity', p_granularity,
      'startDate', p_start_date,
      'timeZone', p_time_zone
    ),
    'rankedRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'entityId', ranked.entity_id,
        'label', ranked.label,
        'metricKey', ranked.metric_key,
        'rank', ranked.rank,
        'values', ranked.values
      ) order by ranked.metric_key, ranked.rank)
      from (
        select
          ranked_admin_rows.*,
          row_number() over (
            partition by ranked_admin_rows.metric_key
            order by ranked_admin_rows.sort_amount desc,
              ranked_admin_rows.entity_id
          ) as rank
        from ranked_admin_rows
        order by metric_key, sort_amount desc, entity_id
        limit 100
      ) as ranked
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'series', (
      select jsonb_agg(series.payload)
      from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', 'subscription-cash-revenue',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', cash_points.bucket_end,
              'startDate', cash_points.bucket_start,
              'values', cash_points.values
            ) order by cash_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from cash_points
              order by cash_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as cash_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) as payload
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'number',
          'metricKey', 'usage',
          'unit', 'quantity',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', least(
                p_end_date,
                (
                  usage_points.bucket_start
                  + case p_granularity
                      when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                      when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                      else interval '1 month'
                    end
                  - interval '1 day'
                )::date
              ),
              'startDate', usage_points.bucket_start,
              'value', usage_points.value
            ) order by usage_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from usage_points
              order by usage_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as usage_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
      ) as series
    )
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_admin_analytics(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_granularity text, p_comparison text, p_currencies text[], p_time_zone text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_comparison_start date;
  v_comparison_end date;
  v_period_days integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if p_start_date is null
    or p_end_date is null
    or p_start_date > p_end_date
    or p_end_date - p_start_date > 1830
  then
    raise exception 'analytics date range must be ordered and no longer than five years'
      using errcode = '22007';
  end if;

  if p_granularity not in ('day', 'week', 'month')
    or p_comparison not in ('none', 'previous-period', 'previous-year')
    or p_time_zone is null
    or length(p_time_zone) > 100
    or coalesce(cardinality(p_currencies), 0) > 20
    or exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      where requested_currency.currency !~ '^[a-z]{3}$'
    )
  then
    raise exception 'invalid analytics query parameters' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform now() at time zone p_time_zone;

  v_period_days := p_end_date - p_start_date + 1;
  if p_comparison = 'previous-period' then
    v_comparison_end := p_start_date - 1;
    v_comparison_start := v_comparison_end - v_period_days + 1;
  elsif p_comparison = 'previous-year' then
    v_comparison_start := p_start_date - interval '1 year';
    v_comparison_end := p_end_date - interval '1 year';
  end if;

  with
    active_subscriptions as (
      select
        organization_subscriptions.id,
        organization_subscriptions.organization_id,
        organization_subscriptions.plan_key::text as plan_key,
        organization_subscriptions.quantity,
        organization_subscriptions.created_at,
        billing_plan_prices.currency,
        (
          billing_plan_prices.amount::numeric
          / case when organization_subscriptions.interval = 'year' then 12 else 1 end
          * organization_subscriptions.quantity
        ) as monthly_amount
      from public.organization_subscriptions
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = organization_subscriptions.organization_id
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
      join public.billing_plan_prices
        on billing_plan_prices.plan_key = organization_subscriptions.plan_key
        and billing_plan_prices.package_key = organization_subscriptions.credit_package_key
        and billing_plan_prices.interval = organization_subscriptions.interval
      where organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due')
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or billing_plan_prices.currency = any (p_currencies)
        )
    ),
    recurring_totals as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount))::bigint as mrr,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount) * 12)::bigint as arr
      from active_subscriptions
      group by active_subscriptions.currency
    ),
    subscription_cash as (
      select
        organization_invoices.organization_id,
        organization_invoices.id,
        organization_invoices.invoice_number,
        organization_invoices.currency,
        organization_invoices.amount_paid::bigint as amount_minor,
        (organization_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date as paid_on
      from public.organization_invoices
      where organization_invoices.paid_at is not null
        and (organization_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or organization_invoices.currency = any (p_currencies)
        )
    ),
    cash_totals as (
      select
        subscription_cash.currency,
        sum(subscription_cash.amount_minor)::bigint as amount_minor
      from subscription_cash
      group by subscription_cash.currency
    ),
    organization_counts as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where (organizations.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
            between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as current_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and (organizations.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_count
      from public.organizations
    ),
    paid_organization_counts as (
      select
        count(distinct organization_subscription_history.organization_id) filter (
          where organization_subscription_history.status in ('active', 'past_due')
            and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as current_count,
        count(distinct organization_subscription_history.organization_id) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and organization_subscription_history.status in ('active', 'past_due')
            and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_count
      from public.organization_subscription_history
    ),
    user_counts as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where (profiles.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
            between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as current_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and (profiles.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_count
      from public.profiles
    ),
    churn_counts as (
      select count(distinct organization_subscription_history.organization_id)::numeric
        as churned_count
      from public.organization_subscription_history
      where organization_subscription_history.status in ('canceled', 'unpaid')
        and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
    ),
    paid_at_start as (
      select count(*)::numeric as paid_count
      from (
        select distinct on (organization_subscription_history.organization_id)
          organization_subscription_history.organization_id,
          organization_subscription_history.status
        from public.organization_subscription_history
        where organization_subscription_history.effective_at
          < p_start_date::timestamp at time zone p_time_zone
        order by
          organization_subscription_history.organization_id,
          organization_subscription_history.effective_at desc
      ) as latest_subscription
      where latest_subscription.status in ('active', 'past_due')
    ),
    usage_totals as (
      select
        coalesce(sum(organization_usage_events.quantity), 0)::numeric as quantity
      from public.organization_usage_events
      where (organization_usage_events.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        between p_start_date and p_end_date
    ),
    overage_totals as (
      select
        coalesce(sum(organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity), 0)::numeric as quantity
      from public.organization_usage_periods
      where (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date <= p_end_date
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_end at time zone p_time_zone)::date >= p_start_date
    ),
    usage_cost_proxy as (
      select
        organization_usage_periods.organization_id,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(
          active_subscriptions.monthly_amount
          * organization_usage_periods.quantity
          / nullif(organization_usage_periods.included_quantity, 0)
        )::bigint as amount_minor
      from public.organization_usage_periods
      join active_subscriptions
        on active_subscriptions.organization_id = organization_usage_periods.organization_id
      where (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date <= p_end_date
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_end at time zone p_time_zone)::date >= p_start_date
        and organization_usage_periods.included_quantity > 0
    ),
    cost_proxy_totals as (
      select
        usage_cost_proxy.currency,
        sum(usage_cost_proxy.amount_minor)::bigint as amount_minor
      from usage_cost_proxy
      group by usage_cost_proxy.currency
    ),
    cash_values as (
      select
        date_trunc(
          p_granularity,
          subscription_cash.paid_on::timestamp
        )::date as bucket_start,
        subscription_cash.currency,
        sum(subscription_cash.amount_minor)::bigint as amount_minor
      from subscription_cash
      group by bucket_start, subscription_cash.currency
    ),
    cash_points as (
      select
        cash_values.bucket_start,
        least(
          p_end_date,
          (
            cash_values.bucket_start
            + case p_granularity
                when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                else interval '1 month'
              end
            - interval '1 day'
          )::date
        ) as bucket_end,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', cash_values.amount_minor,
          'currency', cash_values.currency
        ) order by cash_values.currency) as values
      from cash_values
      group by cash_values.bucket_start
    ),
    usage_points as (
      select
        date_trunc(
          p_granularity,
          organization_usage_events.created_at at time zone p_time_zone
        )::date as bucket_start,
        sum(organization_usage_events.quantity)::numeric as value
      from public.organization_usage_events
      where (organization_usage_events.created_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by bucket_start
    ),
    plan_mix as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.plan_key,
        count(*)::numeric as subscription_count
      from active_subscriptions
      group by active_subscriptions.plan_key
    ),
    ranked_organization_values as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount))::bigint as amount_minor
      from active_subscriptions
      join public.organizations on organizations.id = active_subscriptions.organization_id
      group by
        active_subscriptions.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        active_subscriptions.currency
    ),
    ranking_currency as (
      select coalesce(p_currencies[1], min(active_subscriptions.currency)) as currency
      from active_subscriptions
    ),
    ranked_organizations as (
      select
        ranked_organization_values.organization_id,
        ranked_organization_values.name,
        coalesce(max(ranked_organization_values.amount_minor) filter (
          where ranked_organization_values.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', ranked_organization_values.amount_minor,
          'currency', ranked_organization_values.currency
        ) order by ranked_organization_values.currency) as values
      from ranked_organization_values
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by
        ranked_organization_values.organization_id,
        ranked_organization_values.name,
        ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    plan_values as (
      select
        active_subscriptions.plan_key,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(sum(active_subscriptions.monthly_amount))::bigint as amount_minor
      from active_subscriptions
      group by active_subscriptions.plan_key, active_subscriptions.currency
    ),
    ranked_plans as (
      select
        plan_values.plan_key,
        initcap(plan_values.plan_key) as label,
        coalesce(max(plan_values.amount_minor) filter (
          where plan_values.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', plan_values.amount_minor,
          'currency', plan_values.currency
        ) order by plan_values.currency) as values
      from plan_values
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by plan_values.plan_key, ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    ranked_admin_rows as (
      select
        ranked_organizations.organization_id::text as entity_id,
        ranked_organizations.name as label,
        'mrr'::text as metric_key,
        ranked_organizations.sort_amount,
        ranked_organizations.values
      from ranked_organizations
      union all
      select
        ranked_plans.plan_key,
        ranked_plans.label,
        'plan-mix',
        ranked_plans.sort_amount,
        ranked_plans.values
      from ranked_plans
    ),
    subscription_evidence as (
      select
        (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          as occurred_on,
        organization_subscription_history.organization_id,
        organization_subscription_history.id,
        organization_subscription_history.plan_name,
        organization_subscription_history.catalog_currency,
        round(
          organization_subscription_history.catalog_monthly_amount
          * organization_subscription_history.quantity
        )::bigint as amount_minor
      from public.organization_subscription_history
      where organization_subscription_history.catalog_monthly_amount is not null
        and (organization_subscription_history.effective_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or organization_subscription_history.catalog_currency = any (p_currencies)
        )
      order by organization_subscription_history.effective_at desc
      limit 250
    ),
    usage_evidence as (
      select
        greatest(
          (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          p_start_date
        ) as occurred_on,
        organization_usage_periods.organization_id,
        organization_usage_periods.id,
        organization_usage_periods.meter_key,
        active_subscriptions.currency,
        round(
          active_subscriptions.monthly_amount
          * organization_usage_periods.quantity
          / nullif(organization_usage_periods.included_quantity, 0)
        )::bigint as amount_minor
      from public.organization_usage_periods
      join active_subscriptions
        on active_subscriptions.organization_id = organization_usage_periods.organization_id
      where organization_usage_periods.included_quantity > 0
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_start at time zone p_time_zone)::date <= p_end_date
        and (organization_usage_periods.period_end at time zone p_time_zone)::date >= p_start_date
      order by organization_usage_periods.period_start desc
      limit 250
    ),
    currency_dimensions as (
      select requested_currency.currency
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      union
      select recurring_totals.currency from recurring_totals
      union
      select cash_totals.currency from cash_totals
      union
      select cost_proxy_totals.currency from cost_proxy_totals
    ),
    currency_metric_values as (
      select 'mrr'::text as metric_key, recurring_totals.currency,
        recurring_totals.mrr as amount_minor
      from recurring_totals
      union all
      select 'arr', recurring_totals.currency, recurring_totals.arr
      from recurring_totals
      union all
      select 'subscription-cash-revenue', cash_totals.currency, cash_totals.amount_minor
      from cash_totals
      union all
      select 'usage-cost-proxy', cost_proxy_totals.currency, cost_proxy_totals.amount_minor
      from cost_proxy_totals
    ),
    currency_kpis as (
      select
        metric_key.metric_key,
        jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', coalesce(currency_metric_values.amount_minor, 0),
          'currency', currency_dimensions.currency
        ) order by currency_dimensions.currency) as values
      from (
        values
          ('mrr'::text),
          ('arr'),
          ('subscription-cash-revenue'),
          ('usage-cost-proxy')
      ) as metric_key(metric_key)
      cross join currency_dimensions
      left join currency_metric_values
        on currency_metric_values.metric_key = metric_key.metric_key
        and currency_metric_values.currency = currency_dimensions.currency
      group by metric_key.metric_key
    ),
    number_kpis as (
      select 'tenant-growth'::text as metric_key, organization_counts.current_count as value,
        organization_counts.comparison_count as comparison_value, 'count'::text as unit
      from organization_counts
      union all
      select 'paid-tenant-growth', paid_organization_counts.current_count,
        paid_organization_counts.comparison_count, 'count'
      from paid_organization_counts
      union all
      select 'user-growth', user_counts.current_count, user_counts.comparison_count, 'count'
      from user_counts
      union all
      select 'logo-churn',
        coalesce(100 * churn_counts.churned_count / nullif(paid_at_start.paid_count, 0), 0),
        null, 'percent'
      from churn_counts cross join paid_at_start
      union all
      select 'logo-retention',
        100 - coalesce(100 * churn_counts.churned_count / nullif(paid_at_start.paid_count, 0), 0),
        null, 'percent'
      from churn_counts cross join paid_at_start
      union all
      select 'usage', usage_totals.quantity, null, 'quantity' from usage_totals
      union all
      select 'usage-demand', overage_totals.quantity, null, 'quantity' from overage_totals
      union all
      select 'plan-mix', coalesce(sum(plan_mix.subscription_count), 0), null, 'count'
      from plan_mix
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'evidenceRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'occurredOn', evidence.occurred_on,
        'metricKey', evidence.metric_key,
        'reference', evidence.reference,
        'sourceId', evidence.source_id,
        'sourceType', evidence.source_type,
        'values', evidence.values
      ) order by evidence.occurred_on desc, evidence.source_id)
      from (
        select
          subscription_evidence.occurred_on,
          'mrr'::text as metric_key,
          subscription_evidence.plan_name as reference,
          subscription_evidence.id::text as source_id,
          'subscription'::text as source_type,
          jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', subscription_evidence.amount_minor,
            'currency', subscription_evidence.catalog_currency
          )) as values
        from subscription_evidence
        union all
        select
          usage_evidence.occurred_on,
          'usage-cost-proxy',
          usage_evidence.meter_key,
          usage_evidence.id::text,
          'usage',
          jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', usage_evidence.amount_minor,
            'currency', usage_evidence.currency
          ))
        from usage_evidence
      ) as evidence
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'forecasts', '[]'::jsonb,
    'generatedAt', to_jsonb(now()),
    'insights', '[]'::jsonb,
    'kpis', (
      select jsonb_agg(kpi.payload)
      from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'changePercent', null,
          'coveragePercent', null,
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', currency_kpis.metric_key,
          'values', currency_kpis.values
        ) as payload
        from currency_kpis
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'changePercent',
            case when number_kpis.comparison_value <> 0
              then round(
                100 * (number_kpis.value - number_kpis.comparison_value)
                  / abs(number_kpis.comparison_value),
                2
              )
            end,
          'coveragePercent', null,
          'kind', 'number',
          'metricKey', number_kpis.metric_key,
          'unit', number_kpis.unit,
          'value', round(number_kpis.value, 2)
        )
        from number_kpis
      ) as kpi
    ),
    'range', jsonb_build_object(
      'comparison', p_comparison,
      'currencies', coalesce(to_jsonb(p_currencies), '[]'::jsonb),
      'endDate', p_end_date,
      'granularity', p_granularity,
      'startDate', p_start_date,
      'timeZone', p_time_zone
    ),
    'rankedRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'entityId', ranked.entity_id,
        'label', ranked.label,
        'metricKey', ranked.metric_key,
        'rank', ranked.rank,
        'values', ranked.values
      ) order by ranked.metric_key, ranked.rank)
      from (
        select
          ranked_admin_rows.*,
          row_number() over (
            partition by ranked_admin_rows.metric_key
            order by ranked_admin_rows.sort_amount desc,
              ranked_admin_rows.entity_id
          ) as rank
        from ranked_admin_rows
        order by metric_key, sort_amount desc, entity_id
        limit 100
      ) as ranked
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'series', (
      select jsonb_agg(series.payload)
      from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', 'subscription-cash-revenue',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', cash_points.bucket_end,
              'startDate', cash_points.bucket_start,
              'values', cash_points.values
            ) order by cash_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from cash_points
              order by cash_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as cash_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) as payload
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'number',
          'metricKey', 'usage',
          'unit', 'quantity',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', least(
                p_end_date,
                (
                  usage_points.bucket_start
                  + case p_granularity
                      when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                      when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                      else interval '1 month'
                    end
                  - interval '1 day'
                )::date
              ),
              'startDate', usage_points.bucket_start,
              'value', usage_points.value
            ) order by usage_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from usage_points
              order by usage_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as usage_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
      ) as series
    )
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;

        null,

        agenda_calendar_connections.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        agenda_calendar_connections.id,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        agenda_calendar_connections.user_id
      from public.agenda_calendar_connections
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = agenda_calendar_connections.organization_id

        inbox_connections.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,

        null,
        null,

        inbox_webhook_jobs.status,

        null,
        null,

      where email_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'bounced', 'complained')

    ),
    operational_failures as (
      select

          'kind', operational_failure_rows.kind,
          'severity', operational_failure_rows.severity,
          'organizationId', operational_failure_rows.organization_id,
          'organizationName', operational_failure_rows.organization_name,
          'organizationSlug', operational_failure_rows.organization_slug,
          'userId', operational_failure_rows.user_id,
          'occurredAt', operational_failure_rows.occurred_at,
          'agentRunId', operational_failure_rows.agent_run_id,

          'integrationSlug', operational_failure_rows.integration_slug,
          'calendarConnectionId', operational_failure_rows.calendar_connection_id,
          'externalCalendarId', operational_failure_rows.external_calendar_id,
          'channelConnectionId', operational_failure_rows.channel_connection_id,
          'channelKind', operational_failure_rows.channel_kind,
          'healthStatus', operational_failure_rows.health_status,

          'jobId', operational_failure_rows.job_id
        ) as payload,
        operational_failure_rows.occurred_at
      from operational_failure_rows
      left join public.workflow_definitions
        on workflow_definitions.id = operational_failure_rows.workflow_definition_id
      order by operational_failure_rows.occurred_at desc
      limit 100
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'generatedAt', p_now,
    'failedPayments', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'invoiceId', failed_payments.invoice_id,
            'invoiceNumber', failed_payments.invoice_number,
            'invoiceStatus', failed_payments.invoice_status,
            'amountRemaining', failed_payments.amount_remaining,
            'currency', failed_payments.currency,
            'dueAt', failed_payments.due_at,
            'subscriptionStatus', failed_payments.subscription_status,
            'organizationId', failed_payments.organization_id,
            'organizationName', failed_payments.organization_name,
            'organizationSlug', failed_payments.organization_slug
          )
          order by failed_payments.sort_at desc, failed_payments.invoice_id
        )
        from failed_payments
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'usageAnomalies', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(usage_anomalies.payload order by usage_anomalies.sort_at desc)
        from usage_anomalies
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'operationalFailures', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          operational_failures.payload
          order by operational_failures.occurred_at desc
        )
        from operational_failures
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  );

      join usage_prior_seven_days
        on usage_prior_seven_days.organization_id = usage_last_24_hours.organization_id
        and usage_prior_seven_days.meter_key = usage_last_24_hours.meter_key
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = usage_last_24_hours.organization_id
      where usage_prior_seven_days.daily_average > 0
        and usage_last_24_hours.quantity >= 10
        and usage_last_24_hours.quantity >= usage_prior_seven_days.daily_average * 2
    ),
    usage_anomaly_rows as (
      select
        jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', current_usage_anomalies.kind,
          'severity', current_usage_anomalies.severity,
          'organizationId', current_usage_anomalies.organization_id,
          'organizationName', current_usage_anomalies.organization_name,
          'organizationSlug', current_usage_anomalies.organization_slug,
          'meterKey', current_usage_anomalies.meter_key,
          'quantity', current_usage_anomalies.quantity,
          'overageQuantity', current_usage_anomalies.overage_quantity,
          'periodStart', current_usage_anomalies.period_start,
          'periodEnd', current_usage_anomalies.period_end,
          'stripeSyncError', current_usage_anomalies.stripe_sync_error
        ) as payload,
        current_usage_anomalies.sort_at
      from current_usage_anomalies
      union all
      select
        jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', usage_spikes.kind,
          'severity', usage_spikes.severity,
          'organizationId', usage_spikes.organization_id,
          'organizationName', usage_spikes.organization_name,
          'organizationSlug', usage_spikes.organization_slug,
          'meterKey', usage_spikes.meter_key,
          'currentQuantity', usage_spikes.quantity,
          'priorDailyAverage', usage_spikes.daily_average,
          'windowStart', usage_spikes.window_start,
          'windowEnd', usage_spikes.window_end
        ) as payload,
        usage_spikes.sort_at
      from usage_spikes
    ),
    usage_anomalies as (
      select *
      from usage_anomaly_rows
      order by sort_at desc
      limit 100
    ),
    operational_failure_rows as (
      select
        'agent-run-failure'::text as kind,
        case when ai_agent_runs.status = 'escalated' then 'critical' else 'warning' end as severity,
        ai_agent_runs.organization_id,
        organizations.name as organization_name,
        organizations.slug::text as organization_slug,
        ai_agent_runs.updated_at as occurred_at,
        ai_agent_runs.id as agent_run_id,
        ai_agent_runs.status,
        null::uuid as workflow_definition_id,
        null::uuid as workflow_run_id,
        null::uuid as webhook_event_id,
        null::text as event_type,
        null::uuid as installation_id,
        null::text as integration_slug,
        null::uuid as calendar_connection_id,
        null::uuid as external_calendar_id,
        null::uuid as channel_connection_id,
        null::text as channel_kind,
        null::text as health_status,
        null::uuid as delivery_id,
        null::uuid as job_id,
        ai_agent_runs.created_by as user_id
      from public.ai_agent_runs
      left join public.organizations on organizations.id = ai_agent_runs.organization_id
      where ai_agent_runs.status in ('failed', 'escalated')
        and ai_agent_runs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'workflow-run-failure',
        'critical',
        workflow_runs.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        workflow_runs.updated_at,
        null,
        workflow_runs.status,
        workflow_runs.definition_id,
        workflow_runs.id,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        workflow_runs.created_by
      from public.workflow_runs
      left join public.organizations on organizations.id = workflow_runs.organization_id
      where workflow_runs.status = 'failed'
        and workflow_runs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'stripe-webhook-failure',
        'critical',
        null,
        null,
        null,
        stripe_webhook_events.updated_at,
        null,
        case
          when stripe_webhook_events.processing_status = 'failed' then 'failed'
          else 'stale'
        end,
        null,
        null,
        stripe_webhook_events.id,
        stripe_webhook_events.type,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null
      from public.stripe_webhook_events
      where (
          stripe_webhook_events.processing_status = 'failed'
          or (
            stripe_webhook_events.processing_status in ('pending', 'processing')
            and coalesce(
              stripe_webhook_events.processing_started_at,
              stripe_webhook_events.created_at
            ) <= p_now - interval '15 minutes'
          )
        )
        and stripe_webhook_events.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'integration-failure',
        'warning',
        integration_installations.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        integration_installations.updated_at,
        null,
        integration_installations.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        integration_installations.id,
        integration_definitions.slug,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        integration_installations.user_id
      from public.integration_installations
      join public.integration_definitions
        on integration_definitions.id = integration_installations.definition_id
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = integration_installations.organization_id
      where integration_installations.status = 'error'
        and integration_installations.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'calendar-integration-failure',
        'warning',
        agenda_calendar_connections.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        agenda_calendar_connections.updated_at,
        null,
        agenda_calendar_connections.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        agenda_calendar_connections.id,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        agenda_calendar_connections.user_id
      from public.agenda_calendar_connections
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = agenda_calendar_connections.organization_id
      where agenda_calendar_connections.status = 'error'
        and agenda_calendar_connections.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'calendar-integration-failure',
        'warning',
        agenda_external_calendars.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        agenda_external_calendars.updated_at,
        null,
        agenda_external_calendars.last_sync_status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        agenda_external_calendars.connection_id,
        agenda_external_calendars.id,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        agenda_calendar_connections.user_id
      from public.agenda_external_calendars
      join public.agenda_calendar_connections
        on agenda_calendar_connections.id = agenda_external_calendars.connection_id
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = agenda_external_calendars.organization_id
      where agenda_external_calendars.last_sync_status = 'error'
        and agenda_external_calendars.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'channel-unhealthy',
        case when inbox_connections.health_status = 'unhealthy' then 'critical' else 'warning' end,
        inbox_connections.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        inbox_connections.updated_at,
        null,
        inbox_connections.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        inbox_connections.id,
        inbox_connections.kind,
        inbox_connections.health_status,
        null,
        null,
        null
      from public.inbox_connections
      join public.organizations on organizations.id = inbox_connections.organization_id
      where inbox_connections.health_status in ('degraded', 'unhealthy')
        and inbox_connections.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'channel-delivery-failure',
        case when inbox_deliveries.status = 'dead_lettered' then 'critical' else 'warning' end,
        inbox_deliveries.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        inbox_deliveries.updated_at,
        null,
        inbox_deliveries.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        inbox_deliveries.connection_id,
        null,
        null,
        inbox_deliveries.id,
        null,
        null
      from public.inbox_deliveries
      join public.organizations on organizations.id = inbox_deliveries.organization_id
      where inbox_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'dead_lettered')
        and inbox_deliveries.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'channel-webhook-job-failure',
        case when inbox_webhook_jobs.status = 'dead_lettered' then 'critical' else 'warning' end,
        inbox_webhook_jobs.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        inbox_webhook_jobs.updated_at,
        null,
        inbox_webhook_jobs.status,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        inbox_webhook_jobs.connection_id,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        inbox_webhook_jobs.id,
        null
      from public.inbox_webhook_jobs
      join public.organizations on organizations.id = inbox_webhook_jobs.organization_id
      where inbox_webhook_jobs.status in ('failed', 'dead_lettered')
        and inbox_webhook_jobs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now

      union all

      select
        'email-delivery-failure',
        case when email_deliveries.status in ('bounced', 'complained') then 'critical' else 'warning' end,
        email_deliveries.organization_id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug::text,
        email_deliveries.updated_at,
        null,
        email_deliveries.status::text,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        email_deliveries.id,
        null,
        null
      from public.email_deliveries
      left join public.organizations on organizations.id = email_deliveries.organization_id
      where email_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'bounced', 'complained')
        and email_deliveries.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
    ),
    operational_failures as (
      select
        jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', operational_failure_rows.kind,
          'severity', operational_failure_rows.severity,
          'organizationId', operational_failure_rows.organization_id,
          'organizationName', operational_failure_rows.organization_name,
          'organizationSlug', operational_failure_rows.organization_slug,
          'userId', operational_failure_rows.user_id,
          'occurredAt', operational_failure_rows.occurred_at,
          'agentRunId', operational_failure_rows.agent_run_id,
          'status', operational_failure_rows.status,
          'workflowDefinitionId', operational_failure_rows.workflow_definition_id,
          'workflowRunId', operational_failure_rows.workflow_run_id,
          'workflowName', workflow_definitions.name,
          'webhookEventId', operational_failure_rows.webhook_event_id,
          'eventType', operational_failure_rows.event_type,
          'installationId', operational_failure_rows.installation_id,
          'integrationSlug', operational_failure_rows.integration_slug,
          'calendarConnectionId', operational_failure_rows.calendar_connection_id,
          'externalCalendarId', operational_failure_rows.external_calendar_id,
          'channelConnectionId', operational_failure_rows.channel_connection_id,
          'channelKind', operational_failure_rows.channel_kind,
          'healthStatus', operational_failure_rows.health_status,
          'deliveryId', operational_failure_rows.delivery_id,
          'jobId', operational_failure_rows.job_id
        ) as payload,
        operational_failure_rows.occurred_at
      from operational_failure_rows
      left join public.workflow_definitions
        on workflow_definitions.id = operational_failure_rows.workflow_definition_id
      order by operational_failure_rows.occurred_at desc
      limit 100
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'generatedAt', p_now,
    'failedPayments', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'invoiceId', failed_payments.invoice_id,
            'invoiceNumber', failed_payments.invoice_number,
            'invoiceStatus', failed_payments.invoice_status,
            'amountRemaining', failed_payments.amount_remaining,
            'currency', failed_payments.currency,
            'dueAt', failed_payments.due_at,
            'subscriptionStatus', failed_payments.subscription_status,
            'organizationId', failed_payments.organization_id,
            'organizationName', failed_payments.organization_name,
            'organizationSlug', failed_payments.organization_slug
          )
          order by failed_payments.sort_at desc, failed_payments.invoice_id
        )
        from failed_payments
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'usageAnomalies', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(usage_anomalies.payload order by usage_anomalies.sort_at desc)
        from usage_anomalies
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'operationalFailures', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          operational_failures.payload
          order by operational_failures.occurred_at desc
        )
        from operational_failures
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  );

functions.definition:
with
    active_organizations as (
      select organizations.id
      from public.organizations
      where organizations.disabled_at is null
    ),
    mrr_by_currency as (
      select
        billing_plan_prices.currency,
        sum(
          (
            billing_plan_prices.amount::numeric
            / case when organization_subscriptions.interval = 'year' then 12 else 1 end
          )
          * organization_subscriptions.quantity
        ) as amount
      from public.organization_subscriptions
      join active_organizations
        on active_organizations.id = organization_subscriptions.organization_id
      join public.billing_plans
        on billing_plans.plan_key = organization_subscriptions.plan_key
        and not billing_plans.quote_only
      left join public.billing_plan_credit_packages as default_packages
        on default_packages.plan_key = organization_subscriptions.plan_key
        and default_packages.is_default
        and organization_subscriptions.credit_package_key is null
      join public.billing_plan_prices
        on billing_plan_prices.plan_key = organization_subscriptions.plan_key
        and billing_plan_prices.package_key = coalesce(
          organization_subscriptions.credit_package_key,
          default_packages.package_key
        )
        and billing_plan_prices.interval = organization_subscriptions.interval
      where organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due')
      group by billing_plan_prices.currency
      order by billing_plan_prices.currency
      limit 20
    ),
    usage_last_24_hours as (
      select
        organization_usage_events.organization_id,
        organization_usage_events.meter_key,
        sum(organization_usage_events.quantity) as quantity
      from public.organization_usage_events
      where organization_usage_events.created_at > p_now - interval '24 hours'
        and organization_usage_events.created_at <= p_now
      group by
        organization_usage_events.organization_id,
        organization_usage_events.meter_key
    ),
    usage_prior_seven_days as (
      select
        organization_usage_events.organization_id,
        organization_usage_events.meter_key,
        sum(organization_usage_events.quantity) / 7 as daily_average
      from public.organization_usage_events
      where organization_usage_events.created_at > p_now - interval '8 days'
        and organization_usage_events.created_at <= p_now - interval '24 hours'
      group by
        organization_usage_events.organization_id,
        organization_usage_events.meter_key
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'generatedAt', p_now,
    'activeOrganizations', (select count(*)::integer from active_organizations),
    'activeSubscriptions', (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.organization_subscriptions
      join active_organizations
        on active_organizations.id = organization_subscriptions.organization_id
      where organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due')
    ),
    'mrrByCurrency', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'currency', mrr_by_currency.currency,
            'amount', mrr_by_currency.amount
          )
          order by mrr_by_currency.currency
        )
        from mrr_by_currency
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'failedPaymentCount', (
      select count(*)::integer
      from public.organization_invoices
      join active_organizations
        on active_organizations.id = organization_invoices.organization_id
      where organization_invoices.amount_remaining > 0
        and (
          (
            organization_invoices.status = 'open'
            and organization_invoices.due_at < p_now
          )
          or organization_invoices.status = 'uncollectible'
        )
    ),
    'usageAnomalyCount', (
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.organization_usage_periods
        where organization_usage_periods.period_start <= p_now
          and organization_usage_periods.period_end > p_now
          and (
            organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity > 0
            or organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_status = 'failed'
          )
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from usage_last_24_hours
        join usage_prior_seven_days
          on usage_prior_seven_days.organization_id = usage_last_24_hours.organization_id
          and usage_prior_seven_days.meter_key = usage_last_24_hours.meter_key
        where usage_prior_seven_days.daily_average > 0
          and usage_last_24_hours.quantity >= 10
          and usage_last_24_hours.quantity >= usage_prior_seven_days.daily_average * 2
      )
    )::integer,
    'operationalFailureCount', (
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.ai_agent_runs
        where ai_agent_runs.status in ('failed', 'escalated')
          and ai_agent_runs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.workflow_runs
        where workflow_runs.status = 'failed'
          and workflow_runs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.stripe_webhook_events
        where (
            stripe_webhook_events.processing_status = 'failed'
            or (
              stripe_webhook_events.processing_status in ('pending', 'processing')
              and coalesce(
                stripe_webhook_events.processing_started_at,
                stripe_webhook_events.created_at
              ) <= p_now - interval '15 minutes'
            )
          )
          and stripe_webhook_events.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.integration_installations
        where integration_installations.status = 'error'
          and integration_installations.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_calendar_connections
        where agenda_calendar_connections.status = 'error'
          and agenda_calendar_connections.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_external_calendars
        where agenda_external_calendars.last_sync_status = 'error'
          and agenda_external_calendars.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.health_status in ('degraded', 'unhealthy')
          and inbox_connections.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_deliveries
        where inbox_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'dead_lettered')
          and inbox_deliveries.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_webhook_jobs
        where inbox_webhook_jobs.status in ('failed', 'dead_lettered')
          and inbox_webhook_jobs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.email_deliveries
        where email_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'bounced', 'complained')
          and email_deliveries.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
    )::integer
  );

      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from usage_last_24_hours
        join usage_prior_seven_days
          on usage_prior_seven_days.organization_id = usage_last_24_hours.organization_id
          and usage_prior_seven_days.meter_key = usage_last_24_hours.meter_key
        where usage_prior_seven_days.daily_average > 0
          and usage_last_24_hours.quantity >= 10
          and usage_last_24_hours.quantity >= usage_prior_seven_days.daily_average * 2
      )
    )::integer,
    'operationalFailureCount', (
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.ai_agent_runs
        where ai_agent_runs.status in ('failed', 'escalated')
          and ai_agent_runs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.workflow_runs
        where workflow_runs.status = 'failed'
          and workflow_runs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.stripe_webhook_events
        where (
            stripe_webhook_events.processing_status = 'failed'
            or (
              stripe_webhook_events.processing_status in ('pending', 'processing')
              and coalesce(
                stripe_webhook_events.processing_started_at,
                stripe_webhook_events.created_at
              ) <= p_now - interval '15 minutes'
            )
          )
          and stripe_webhook_events.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.integration_installations
        where integration_installations.status = 'error'
          and integration_installations.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_calendar_connections
        where agenda_calendar_connections.status = 'error'
          and agenda_calendar_connections.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_external_calendars
        where agenda_external_calendars.last_sync_status = 'error'
          and agenda_external_calendars.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.health_status in ('degraded', 'unhealthy')
          and inbox_connections.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_deliveries
        where inbox_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'dead_lettered')
          and inbox_deliveries.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_webhook_jobs
        where inbox_webhook_jobs.status in ('failed', 'dead_lettered')
          and inbox_webhook_jobs.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
      + (
        select count(*)
        from public.email_deliveries
        where email_deliveries.status in ('failed', 'bounced', 'complained')
          and email_deliveries.updated_at between p_now - interval '24 hours' and p_now
      )
    )::integer
  );
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_now timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now()

functions.name: get_admin_operations_plans
functions.definition:
with
    active_organizations as (
      select organizations.id
      from public.organizations
      where organizations.disabled_at is null
    ),
    effective_plans as (
      select
        active_organizations.id as organization_id,
        coalesce(
          organization_subscriptions.plan_key,
          'starter'::public.billing_plan_key
        ) as plan_key
      from active_organizations
      left join public.organization_subscriptions
        on organization_subscriptions.organization_id = active_organizations.id
        and organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due')
    ),
    plan_distribution as (
      select
        plan_keys.plan_key,
        count(effective_plans.organization_id)::integer as organization_count
      from unnest(enum_range(null::public.billing_plan_key)) as plan_keys(plan_key)
      left join effective_plans on effective_plans.plan_key = plan_keys.plan_key
      group by plan_keys.plan_key
    ),
    recent_signups as (
      select
        profiles.user_id,
        profiles.email,
        profiles.username,
        profiles.first_name,
        profiles.last_name,
        profiles.created_at
      from public.profiles
      where profiles.created_at >= p_now - interval '30 days'
        and profiles.created_at <= p_now
        -- RFC 2606 reserved domains only ever come from seed and fixture accounts,
        -- so they must not surface as real registrations.
        and lower(coalesce(profiles.email, '')) not like '%@example.com'
        and lower(coalesce(profiles.email, '')) not like '%@example.net'
        and lower(coalesce(profiles.email, '')) not like '%@example.org'
      order by profiles.created_at desc, profiles.user_id
      limit 50
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'generatedAt', p_now,
    'planDistribution', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'planKey', plan_distribution.plan_key,
            'count', plan_distribution.organization_count
          )
          order by plan_distribution.plan_key
        )
        from plan_distribution
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'recentSignups', coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'userId', recent_signups.user_id,
            'email', recent_signups.email,
            'username', recent_signups.username,
            'firstName', recent_signups.first_name,
            'lastName', recent_signups.last_name,
            'createdAt', recent_signups.created_at
          )
          order by recent_signups.created_at desc, recent_signups.user_id
        )
        from recent_signups
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  );
