functions.name: get_agenda_feed_by_token
functions.definition:
declare
  v_feed public.agenda_calendar_feeds%rowtype;
  v_calendar public.agenda_collections%rowtype;
  v_org jsonb;
  v_items jsonb;
begin
  if p_token is null or length(p_token) < 16 then
    return null;
  end if;

  select * into v_feed
  from public.agenda_calendar_feeds
  where token = p_token
  limit 1;

  if v_feed.id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select * into v_calendar
  from public.agenda_collections
  where id = v_feed.agenda_collection_id
    and organization_id = v_feed.organization_id;

  if v_calendar.id is null
    or not public.agenda_user_has_org_permission(
      v_feed.organization_id,
      v_feed.user_id,
      'organization.agenda.view'
    )
    or not exists (
      select 1
      from public.organization_users
      join public.profiles
        on profiles.user_id = organization_users.user_id
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = organization_users.organization_id
      where organization_users.organization_id = v_feed.organization_id
        and organization_users.user_id = v_feed.user_id
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
    )
    or not (
      v_calendar.visibility = 'public'
      or v_calendar.owner_user_id = v_feed.user_id
      or public.agenda_user_has_org_permission(
        v_feed.organization_id,
        v_feed.user_id,
        'organization.agenda.delete'
      )
      or exists (
        select 1
        from public.agenda_collection_grants
        where agenda_collection_grants.agenda_collection_id = v_feed.agenda_collection_id
          and (
            agenda_collection_grants.user_id = v_feed.user_id
            or exists (
              select 1
              from public.team_members
              where team_members.team_id = agenda_collection_grants.team_id
                and team_members.user_id = v_feed.user_id
            )
          )
      )
    ) then
    return null;
  end if;

  update public.agenda_calendar_feeds
  set last_accessed_at = now() at time zone 'utc'
  where id = v_feed.id;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', organizations.id,
    'name', organizations.name,
    'slug', organizations.slug
  )
  into v_org
  from public.organizations
  where organizations.id = v_feed.organization_id;

  with feed_items as (
    select agenda_items.*
    from public.agenda_items
    where agenda_items.organization_id = v_feed.organization_id
      and agenda_items.agenda_collection_id = v_feed.agenda_collection_id
      and (
        agenda_items.visibility = 'public'
        or agenda_items.owner_user_id = v_feed.user_id
      )
      and agenda_items.starts_at < (now() at time zone 'utc') + interval '2 years'
      and agenda_items.ends_at > (now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '1 year'
    order by agenda_items.starts_at
    limit 1000
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      to_jsonb(feed_items)
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'users', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(agenda_item_users))
          from public.agenda_item_users
          where agenda_item_users.organization_id = feed_items.organization_id
            and agenda_item_users.agenda_item_id = feed_items.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'recurrence_rule', (
          select to_jsonb(agenda_item_recurrence_rules)
          from public.agenda_item_recurrence_rules
          where agenda_item_recurrence_rules.organization_id = feed_items.organization_id
            and agenda_item_recurrence_rules.agenda_item_id = feed_items.id
        ),
        'recurrence_dates', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(agenda_item_recurrence_dates) order by agenda_item_recurrence_dates.occurs_at)
          from public.agenda_item_recurrence_dates
          where agenda_item_recurrence_dates.organization_id = feed_items.organization_id
            and agenda_item_recurrence_dates.agenda_item_id = feed_items.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'reminders', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(agenda_item_reminders) order by agenda_item_reminders.offset_minutes)
          from public.agenda_item_reminders
          where agenda_item_reminders.organization_id = feed_items.organization_id
            and agenda_item_reminders.agenda_item_id = feed_items.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'attendees', coalesce((
          select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(agenda_item_attendees) order by agenda_item_attendees.display_name, agenda_item_attendees.email)
          from public.agenda_item_attendees
          where agenda_item_attendees.organization_id = feed_items.organization_id
            and agenda_item_attendees.agenda_item_id = feed_items.id
        ), '[]'::jsonb)
      )
      order by feed_items.starts_at
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_items
  from feed_items;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'feed', jsonb_build_object(
      'id', v_feed.id,
      'organization_id', v_feed.organization_id,
      'agenda_collection_id', v_feed.agenda_collection_id,
      'user_id', v_feed.user_id,
      'token', v_feed.token,
      'name', v_calendar.name,
      'color', v_calendar.color,
      'created_by', v_feed.created_by,
      'created_at', v_feed.created_at,
      'updated_at', v_feed.updated_at,
      'last_accessed_at', v_feed.last_accessed_at
    ),
    'organization', v_org,
    'items', v_items
  );
end;

functions.name: get_ai_agent_execution_manifest
functions.definition:
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'get_ai_agent_execution_manifest requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  with
    permission_catalog as (
      select
        array_agg(permissions.key order by permissions.key)
          filter (where permissions.scope = 'organization') as organization_keys,
        array_agg(permissions.key order by permissions.key)
          filter (where permissions.scope = 'system') as system_keys
      from public.permissions
    ),
    actor_permissions as (
      select
        public.resolve_actor_scope_permissions(
          p_actor_user_id,
          'organization',
          p_organization_id,
          coalesce(permission_catalog.organization_keys, '{}'::text[])
        ) as organization_keys,
        public.resolve_actor_scope_permissions(
          p_actor_user_id,
          'system',
          null,
          coalesce(permission_catalog.system_keys, '{}'::text[])
        ) as system_keys
      from permission_catalog
    ),
    actor_state as (
      select
        actor_permissions.organization_keys as organization_permission_keys,
        actor_permissions.system_keys as system_permission_keys
      from actor_permissions
      cross join public.profiles
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = p_organization_id
      where profiles.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
        and (
          cardinality(actor_permissions.organization_keys) > 0
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.organization_users
            join public.roles
              on roles.id = organization_users.role_id
              and roles.scope = 'organization'
              and (
                roles.organization_id is null
                or roles.organization_id = organization_users.organization_id
              )
            where organization_users.user_id = p_actor_user_id
              and organization_users.organization_id = p_organization_id
          )
        )
    ),
    organization_effective_permissions as (
      select effective_permission.key
      from actor_state
      cross join lateral unnest(
        actor_state.organization_permission_keys
      ) as effective_permission(key)
    ),
    valid_execution as (
      select
        actor_state.organization_permission_keys,
        actor_state.system_permission_keys
      from actor_state
      join public.ai_agent_delegations
        on ai_agent_delegations.id = p_delegation_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.actor_user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.status = 'active'
        and ai_agent_delegations.revoked_at is null
        and ai_agent_delegations.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
      join public.chat_threads
        on chat_threads.id = p_thread_id
        and chat_threads.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and chat_threads.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
        and chat_threads.active_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
        and chat_threads.stream_status = 'streaming'
        and chat_threads.archived_at is null
      join public.ai_agent_runs
        on ai_agent_runs.id = p_run_id
        and ai_agent_runs.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and ai_agent_runs.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and ai_agent_runs.created_by = p_actor_user_id
        and ai_agent_runs.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
        and ai_agent_runs.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
        and ai_agent_runs.mode = 'agent'
        and ai_agent_runs.status in (
          'queued',
          'planning',
          'awaiting_approval',
          'running',
          'checking',
          'retrying'
        )
      where
        chat_threads.owner_user_id = p_actor_user_id
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.chat_thread_participants
          where chat_thread_participants.thread_id = p_thread_id
            and chat_thread_participants.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and chat_thread_participants.kind = 'user'
            and chat_thread_participants.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        )
        or (
          chat_threads.visibility = 'organization'
          and exists (
            select 1
            from organization_effective_permissions
            where organization_effective_permissions.key = 'organization.chats.view'
          )
        )
    ),
    organization_permissions as (
      select
        case
          when cardinality(valid_execution.organization_permission_keys) = (
            select count(*)
            from public.permissions
            where permissions.scope = 'organization'
          ) then array['*']::text[]
          else valid_execution.organization_permission_keys
        end as keys
      from valid_execution
    ),
    system_permissions as (
      select valid_execution.system_permission_keys as keys
      from valid_execution
    ),
    authorized_integrations as (
      select coalesce(
        array_agg(
          distinct integration_installations.id
          order by integration_installations.id
        ),
        '{}'::uuid[]
      ) as ids
      from valid_execution
      join public.integration_installations
        on integration_installations.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and integration_installations.status = 'active'
      join public.integration_definitions
        on integration_definitions.id = integration_installations.definition_id
        and integration_definitions.enabled
        and integration_definitions.status = 'available'
      join public.integration_user_authorizations
        on integration_user_authorizations.installation_id = integration_installations.id
        and integration_user_authorizations.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and integration_user_authorizations.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and integration_user_authorizations.status = 'active'
        and integration_user_authorizations.revoked_at is null
        and (
          integration_user_authorizations.expires_at is null
          or integration_user_authorizations.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
        )
      where exists (
        select 1
        from organization_effective_permissions
        where organization_effective_permissions.key = 'organization.chats.create'
      )
    )
  select
    organization_permissions.keys,
    system_permissions.keys,
    authorized_integrations.ids
  from valid_execution
  cross join organization_permissions
  cross join system_permissions
  cross join authorized_integrations;
end;
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_ai_agent_execution_manifest(p_delegation_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_run_id uuid, p_workflow_run_id text)
 RETURNS TABLE(organization_permission_keys text[], system_permission_keys text[], authorized_integration_ids uuid[])
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'get_ai_agent_execution_manifest requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  with
    permission_catalog as (
      select
        array_agg(permissions.key order by permissions.key)
          filter (where permissions.scope = 'organization') as organization_keys,
        array_agg(permissions.key order by permissions.key)
          filter (where permissions.scope = 'system') as system_keys
      from public.permissions
    ),
    actor_permissions as (
      select
        public.resolve_actor_scope_permissions(
          p_actor_user_id,
          'organization',
          p_organization_id,
          coalesce(permission_catalog.organization_keys, '{}'::text[])
        ) as organization_keys,
        public.resolve_actor_scope_permissions(
          p_actor_user_id,
          'system',
          null,
          coalesce(permission_catalog.system_keys, '{}'::text[])
        ) as system_keys
      from permission_catalog
    ),
    actor_state as (
      select
        actor_permissions.organization_keys as organization_permission_keys,
        actor_permissions.system_keys as system_permission_keys
      from actor_permissions
      cross join public.profiles
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = p_organization_id
      where profiles.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
        and (
          cardinality(actor_permissions.organization_keys) > 0
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.organization_users
            join public.roles
              on roles.id = organization_users.role_id
              and roles.scope = 'organization'
              and (
                roles.organization_id is null
                or roles.organization_id = organization_users.organization_id
              )
            where organization_users.user_id = p_actor_user_id
              and organization_users.organization_id = p_organization_id
          )
        )
    ),
    organization_effective_permissions as (
      select effective_permission.key
      from actor_state
      cross join lateral unnest(
        actor_state.organization_permission_keys
      ) as effective_permission(key)
    ),
    valid_execution as (
      select
        actor_state.organization_permission_keys,
        actor_state.system_permission_keys
      from actor_state
      join public.ai_agent_delegations
        on ai_agent_delegations.id = p_delegation_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.actor_user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
        and ai_agent_delegations.status = 'active'
        and ai_agent_delegations.revoked_at is null
        and ai_agent_delegations.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
      join public.chat_threads
        on chat_threads.id = p_thread_id
        and chat_threads.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and chat_threads.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
        and chat_threads.active_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
        and chat_threads.stream_status = 'streaming'
        and chat_threads.archived_at is null
      join public.ai_agent_runs
        on ai_agent_runs.id = p_run_id
        and ai_agent_runs.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and ai_agent_runs.thread_id = p_thread_id
        and ai_agent_runs.created_by = p_actor_user_id
        and ai_agent_runs.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
        and ai_agent_runs.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
        and ai_agent_runs.mode = 'agent'
        and ai_agent_runs.status in (
          'queued',
          'planning',
          'awaiting_approval',
          'running',
          'checking',
          'retrying'
        )
      where
        chat_threads.owner_user_id = p_actor_user_id
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.chat_thread_participants
          where chat_thread_participants.thread_id = p_thread_id
            and chat_thread_participants.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and chat_thread_participants.kind = 'user'
            and chat_thread_participants.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        )
        or (
          chat_threads.visibility = 'organization'
          and exists (
            select 1
            from organization_effective_permissions
            where organization_effective_permissions.key = 'organization.chats.view'
          )
        )
    ),
    organization_permissions as (
      select
        case
          when cardinality(valid_execution.organization_permission_keys) = (
            select count(*)
            from public.permissions
            where permissions.scope = 'organization'
          ) then array['*']::text[]
          else valid_execution.organization_permission_keys
        end as keys
      from valid_execution
    ),
    system_permissions as (
      select valid_execution.system_permission_keys as keys
      from valid_execution
    ),
    authorized_integrations as (
      select coalesce(
        array_agg(
          distinct integration_installations.id
          order by integration_installations.id
        ),
        '{}'::uuid[]
      ) as ids
      from valid_execution
      join public.integration_installations
        on integration_installations.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and integration_installations.status = 'active'
      join public.integration_definitions
        on integration_definitions.id = integration_installations.definition_id
        and integration_definitions.enabled
        and integration_definitions.status = 'available'
      join public.integration_user_authorizations
        on integration_user_authorizations.installation_id = integration_installations.id
        and integration_user_authorizations.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and integration_user_authorizations.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and integration_user_authorizations.status = 'active'
        and integration_user_authorizations.revoked_at is null
        and (
          integration_user_authorizations.expires_at is null
          or integration_user_authorizations.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
        )
      where exists (
        select 1
        from organization_effective_permissions
        where organization_effective_permissions.key = 'organization.chats.create'
      )
    )
  select
    organization_permissions.keys,
    system_permissions.keys,
    authorized_integrations.ids
  from valid_execution
  cross join organization_permissions
  cross join system_permissions
  cross join authorized_integrations;
end;
$function$

functions.identity_argument_types: p_delegation_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_run_id uuid, p_workflow_run_id text

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_ai_chat_suggestion_snapshot(p_organization_slug text, p_route_domain text, p_surface text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_organization public.organizations%rowtype;
  v_permissions text[] := '{}'::text[];
  v_permission_candidates constant text[] := array[
    'organization.agenda.view',
    'organization.assets.view',
    'organization.chats.create',
    'organization.chats.view',
    'organization.customers.view',
    'organization.integrations.manage',
    'organization.invoices.view',
    'organization.knowledge.view',
    'organization.members.invite',
    'organization.members.view',
    'organization.products.view',
    'organization.quotes.view',
    'organization.tasks.view',
    'organization.teams.view',
    'organization.workflows.view'
  ]::text[];
  v_snapshot jsonb;
  v_state jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_catalogs jsonb := jsonb_build_object(
    'knowledgeCollections', '[]'::jsonb,
    'workflows', '[]'::jsonb
  );
  v_refreshed_at timestamptz;
  v_refresh_needed boolean := true;
  v_suggestions_model text;
  v_mine_task_total bigint := 0;
  v_mine_task_samples jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if v_user_id is null then
    raise exception 'authentication required'
      using errcode = '28000';
  end if;

  if p_surface not in ('page', 'panel') then
    raise exception 'invalid suggestion surface'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if p_route_domain not in (
    'access',
    'agenda',
    'assets',
    'channels',
    'customers',
    'dashboard',
    'generic',
    'inbox',
    'integrations',
    'invoices',
    'knowledge',
    'quotes',
    'tasks',
    'teams',
    'workflows'
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid suggestion route domain'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select organizations.*
  into v_organization
  from public.organizations
  where organizations.slug = p_organization_slug
    and organizations.disabled_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'organization not found'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  select public.authorize_scope_batch(
    'organization',
    v_organization.id,
    v_permission_candidates
  )
  into v_permissions;

  if not (
    'organization.chats.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.chats.create' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    raise exception 'chat suggestions are not authorized'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select
    chat_suggestion_snapshots.snapshot,
    chat_suggestion_snapshots.refreshed_at
  into
    v_snapshot,
    v_refreshed_at
  from public.chat_suggestion_snapshots
  where chat_suggestion_snapshots.organization_id = v_organization.id;

  if v_snapshot is null then
    select ai_model_use_defaults.model_id
    into v_suggestions_model
    from public.ai_model_use_defaults
    join public.ai_model_settings
      on ai_model_settings.model_id = ai_model_use_defaults.model_id
      and ai_model_settings.enabled
    where ai_model_use_defaults.use_case = 'suggestions';

    v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
      'catalogs',
      v_catalogs,
      'inferenceRegion',
      v_organization.ai_inference_region,
      'organizationId',
      v_organization.id,
      'organizationName',
      v_organization.name,
      'state',
      '{}'::jsonb,
      'suggestionsModel',
      coalesce(v_suggestions_model, 'openai/gpt-5.4')
    );
  else
    v_refresh_needed := v_refreshed_at <= (
      (now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '5 minutes'
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain in ('agenda', 'tasks')
  ) and 'organization.agenda.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'agenda',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'agenda',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'confirmedTodayTotal', 0,
          'conflictTotal', 0,
          'riskSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'suggestedTodayTotal', 0,
          'unscheduledTotal', 0
        )
      )
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'riskSamples',
        coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(
              case
                when 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then
                  risk_sample.value - 'agendaLabel' - 'taskDerived'
                when coalesce((risk_sample.value ->> 'taskDerived')::boolean, false) then
                  (
                    risk_sample.value
                    || jsonb_build_object('label', risk_sample.value ->> 'agendaLabel')
                  ) - 'agendaLabel' - 'taskDerived' - 'status'
                else
                  (
                    risk_sample.value
                    || jsonb_build_object('label', risk_sample.value ->> 'agendaLabel')
                  ) - 'agendaLabel' - 'taskDerived'
              end
            )
            from jsonb_array_elements(
              coalesce(v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'agenda' -> 'riskSamples', '[]'::jsonb)
            ) as risk_sample(value)
            where 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions)
              or jsonb_typeof(risk_sample.value -> 'agendaLabel') = 'string'
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
      )
      || case
        when 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then '{}'::jsonb
        else jsonb_build_object('unscheduledTotal', 0)
      end
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain in ('agenda', 'tasks')
  ) and 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select count(*)
    into v_mine_task_total
    from public.task_assignees
    join public.tasks
      on tasks.id = task_assignees.task_id
      and tasks.organization_id = task_assignees.organization_id
    where task_assignees.organization_id = v_organization.id
      and task_assignees.user_id = v_user_id
      and tasks.parent_task_id is null
      and tasks.archived_at is null
      and tasks.status <> 'done';

    select coalesce(jsonb_agg(actor_tasks.sample), '[]'::jsonb)
    into v_mine_task_samples
    from (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'label',
        left(
          concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title),
          160
        ),
        'status',
        tasks.priority::text
      ) as sample
      from public.task_assignees
      join public.tasks
        on tasks.id = task_assignees.task_id
        and tasks.organization_id = task_assignees.organization_id
      where task_assignees.organization_id = v_organization.id
        and task_assignees.user_id = v_user_id
        and tasks.parent_task_id is null
        and tasks.archived_at is null
        and tasks.status <> 'done'
      order by
        case tasks.priority
          when 'urgent' then 0
          when 'high' then 1
          when 'medium' then 2
          when 'low' then 3
        end,
        tasks.due_at nulls last,
        tasks.updated_at desc
      limit 5
    ) as actor_tasks;

    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'tasks',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'tasks',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'orgSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'orgTotal', 0,
          'urgentSamples', '[]'::jsonb
        )
      )
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'mineSamples', v_mine_task_samples,
        'mineTotal', v_mine_task_total
      )
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain in ('customers', 'assets', 'quotes')
  ) and 'organization.customers.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'customers',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'customers',
        jsonb_build_object('samples', '[]'::jsonb, 'total', 0)
      )
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'samples',
        coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(
              customer_sample.value
              - array_remove(
                array[
                  case
                    when 'organization.quotes.view' <> all(v_permissions)
                      then 'quoteCount'
                    else null
                  end,
                  case
                    when 'organization.tasks.view' <> all(v_permissions)
                      then 'taskCount'
                    else null
                  end
                ]::text[],
                null
              )
            )
            from jsonb_array_elements(
              coalesce(v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'customers' -> 'samples', '[]'::jsonb)
            ) as customer_sample(value)
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
      )
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain = 'quotes'
  ) and 'organization.quotes.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'quotes',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'quotes',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'draftSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'draftTotal', 0,
          'sentSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'sentTotal', 0
        )
      )
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain = 'assets'
  ) and (
    'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'assets',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'assets',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'customerAssetSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'customerAssetTotal', 0,
          'inventoryIssueSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'productSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'productTotal', 0
        )
      )
      || case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then jsonb_build_object(
          'customerAssetSamples',
          coalesce(
            (
              select jsonb_agg(
                (
                  asset_sample.value
                  || case
                    when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions) then '{}'::jsonb
                    else jsonb_build_object('label', asset_sample.value ->> 'assetLabel')
                  end
                ) - 'assetLabel'
              )
              from jsonb_array_elements(
                coalesce(
                  v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'assets' -> 'customerAssetSamples',
                  '[]'::jsonb
                )
              ) as asset_sample(value)
              where 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions)
                or jsonb_typeof(asset_sample.value -> 'assetLabel') = 'string'
            ),
            '[]'::jsonb
          ),
          'inventoryIssueSamples',
          case
            when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions)
              then coalesce(
                v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'assets' -> 'inventoryIssueSamples',
                '[]'::jsonb
              )
            else '[]'::jsonb
          end
        )
        else jsonb_build_object(
          'customerAssetSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'customerAssetTotal', 0,
          'inventoryIssueSamples', '[]'::jsonb
        )
      end
      || case
        when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions) then '{}'::jsonb
        else jsonb_build_object(
          'productSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'productTotal', 0
        )
      end
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain in ('access', 'teams')
  ) and (
    'organization.members.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.members.invite' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.teams.view' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'access',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'access',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'memberTotal', 0,
          'pendingInvitationTotal', 0,
          'teamTotal', 0
        )
      )
      || case
        when 'organization.members.view' = any(v_permissions) then '{}'::jsonb
        else jsonb_build_object('memberTotal', 0)
      end
      || case
        when 'organization.members.invite' = any(v_permissions) then '{}'::jsonb
        else jsonb_build_object('pendingInvitationTotal', 0)
      end
      || case
        when 'organization.teams.view' = any(v_permissions) then '{}'::jsonb
        else jsonb_build_object('teamTotal', 0)
      end
    );
  end if;

  if (
    p_surface = 'page'
    or p_route_domain in ('channels', 'integrations')
  ) and 'organization.integrations.manage' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object(
      'channels',
      coalesce(
        v_snapshot -> 'state' -> 'channels',
        jsonb_build_object(
          'activeTotal', 0,
          'draftTotal', 0,
          'errorSamples', '[]'::jsonb,
          'total', 0
        )
      )
    );
  end if;

  if p_surface = 'panel'
    and p_route_domain = 'knowledge'
    and 'organization.knowledge.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_catalogs := jsonb_set(
      v_catalogs,
      '{knowledgeCollections}',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(actor_knowledge.item)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'description',
              left(collection.description, 500),
              'name',
              left(collection.name, 160)
            ) as item
            from public.knowledge_collections as collection
            where (
                collection.organization_id = v_organization.id
                or collection.organization_id is null
              )
              and collection.visibility <> 'disabled'
              and public.can_read_knowledge_collection_row(
                collection.id,
                collection.organization_id,
                collection.visibility,
                collection.created_by
              )
            order by collection.retrieval_priority, collection.name
            limit 6
          ) as actor_knowledge
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    );
  end if;

  if p_surface = 'panel'
    and p_route_domain = 'workflows'
    and 'organization.workflows.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_catalogs := jsonb_set(
      v_catalogs,
      '{workflows}',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(actor_workflows.item)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'description',
              left(definition.description, 500),
              'name',
              left(definition.name, 160)
            ) as item
            from public.workflow_definitions as definition
            where (
                definition.organization_id = v_organization.id
                or definition.organization_id is null
              )
              and definition.status = 'published'
              and definition.archived_at is null
              and public.can_read_workflow_definition_row(
                definition.id,
                definition.owner_scope,
                definition.organization_id,
                definition.status,
                definition.visibility,
                definition.created_by
              )
            order by definition.updated_at desc
            limit 6
          ) as actor_workflows
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    );
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'catalogs',
    v_catalogs,
    'inferenceRegion',
    coalesce(
      v_snapshot ->> 'inferenceRegion',
      v_organization.ai_inference_region::text
    ),
    'organizationId',
    v_organization.id,
    'organizationName',
    v_organization.name,
    'permissionFingerprint',
    md5(array_to_string(v_permissions, E'\n')),
    'permissionKeys',
    to_jsonb(v_permissions),
    'refreshedAt',
    case when v_refreshed_at is null then null else to_jsonb(v_refreshed_at) end,
    'refreshNeeded',
    v_refresh_needed,
    'snapshotStatus',
    case
      when v_refreshed_at is null then 'missing'

functions.definition:
with
    billing_period as (
      select
        date_trunc('month', p_at at time zone 'utc') at time zone 'utc' as period_start,
        (
          date_trunc('month', p_at at time zone 'utc') + interval '1 month'
        ) at time zone 'utc' as period_end
    ),
    plan_state as (
      select
        coalesce(active_subscription.plan_key, 'starter'::public.billing_plan_key) as plan_key,
        case
          when active_subscription.plan_key is null then 10::numeric
          else coalesce(active_subscription.included_credits, 0)::numeric
        end as included_credits
      from (values (true)) as seed(present)
      left join lateral (
        select
          organization_subscriptions.plan_key,
          organization_subscriptions.included_credits
        from public.organization_subscriptions
        where organization_subscriptions.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due', 'trialing')
        limit 1
      ) as active_subscription on seed.present
    ),
    usage_by_meter as (
      select
        organization_usage_events.meter_key,
        coalesce(sum(organization_usage_events.quantity), 0)::numeric as quantity
      from public.organization_usage_events
      cross join billing_period
      where organization_usage_events.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and organization_usage_events.period_start = billing_period.period_start
        and organization_usage_events.period_end = billing_period.period_end
        and organization_usage_events.billable
      group by organization_usage_events.meter_key
    ),
    plan_limits as (
      select
        billing_plan_usage_limits.meter_key,
        billing_plan_usage_limits.included_quantity,
        billing_plan_usage_limits.is_unlimited,
        billing_plan_usage_limits.credit_weight,
        billing_plan_usage_limits.enforcement_mode,
        billing_usage_meters.name,
        coalesce(usage_by_meter.quantity, 0)::numeric as quantity
      from public.billing_plan_usage_limits
      join plan_state
        on plan_state.plan_key = billing_plan_usage_limits.plan_key
      join public.billing_usage_meters
        on billing_usage_meters.key = billing_plan_usage_limits.meter_key
      left join usage_by_meter
        on usage_by_meter.meter_key = billing_plan_usage_limits.meter_key
    ),
    allowance_state as (
      select
        coalesce(
          (
            select plan_limits.name
            from plan_limits
            where plan_limits.meter_key = 'ai.input_tokens'
              and plan_limits.enforcement_mode = 'hard_limit'
              and not plan_limits.is_unlimited
              and plan_limits.quantity >= plan_limits.included_quantity
          ),
          ''
        ) as blocked_input_name,
        coalesce(
          (
            select plan_limits.name
            from plan_limits
            where plan_limits.meter_key = 'ai.output_tokens'
              and plan_limits.enforcement_mode = 'hard_limit'
              and not plan_limits.is_unlimited
              and plan_limits.quantity >= plan_limits.included_quantity
          ),
          ''
        ) as blocked_output_name,
        plan_state.included_credits + coalesce(
          (
            select sum(billing_credit_rollover_periods.credits_remaining)
            from public.billing_credit_rollover_periods
            where billing_credit_rollover_periods.organization_id = p_organization_id
              and billing_credit_rollover_periods.expires_at > p_at
              and billing_credit_rollover_periods.credits_remaining > 0
          ),
          0
        ) as total_credits_available,
        coalesce(sum(plan_limits.quantity * plan_limits.credit_weight), 0) as total_credits_used,
        coalesce(bool_or(plan_limits.enforcement_mode = 'included_plus_overage'), false)
          as overage_allowed
      from plan_state
      left join plan_limits on true
      group by plan_state.included_credits
    )
  select
    case
      when allowance_state.blocked_input_name <> '' then false
      when allowance_state.blocked_output_name <> '' then false
      when allowance_state.total_credits_available > 0
        and allowance_state.total_credits_used >= allowance_state.total_credits_available
        and not allowance_state.overage_allowed
        then false
      else true
    end as allowed,
    case
      when allowance_state.blocked_input_name <> '' then 'ai_input_token_limit_reached'
      when allowance_state.blocked_output_name <> '' then 'ai_output_token_limit_reached'
      when allowance_state.total_credits_available > 0
        and allowance_state.total_credits_used >= allowance_state.total_credits_available
        and not allowance_state.overage_allowed
        then 'ai_credits_exhausted'
      else null
    end as code,
    case
      when allowance_state.blocked_input_name <> ''
        then 'The ' || allowance_state.blocked_input_name
          || ' limit has been reached for this billing period.'
      when allowance_state.blocked_output_name <> ''
        then 'The ' || allowance_state.blocked_output_name
          || ' limit has been reached for this billing period.'
      when allowance_state.total_credits_available > 0
        and allowance_state.total_credits_used >= allowance_state.total_credits_available
        and not allowance_state.overage_allowed
        then 'The organization has reached its AI credit limit.'
      else null
    end as reason
  from allowance_state;

functions.name: get_employee_history
functions.definition:
declare
  v_organization_id uuid;
begin
  select organization_id into v_organization_id
  from public.employees
  where employees.id = p_employee_id;

  if v_organization_id is null
    or not (
      public.has_org_permission(v_organization_id, 'organization.people.update')
      or public.is_own_employee(p_employee_id)
    ) then
    return;
  end if;

  return query
  with targets(target_type, target_id) as (
    select 'employees', p_employee_id::text
    union all
    select 'employee_contracts', employee_contracts.id::text
    from public.employee_contracts where employee_contracts.employee_id = p_employee_id
    union all
    select 'employee_documents', employee_documents.id::text
    from public.employee_documents where employee_documents.employee_id = p_employee_id
    union all
    select 'employee_skills', employee_skills.id::text
    from public.employee_skills where employee_skills.employee_id = p_employee_id
    union all
    select 'equipment_assignments', equipment_assignments.id::text
    from public.equipment_assignments where equipment_assignments.employee_id = p_employee_id
    union all
    select 'time_off_requests', time_off_requests.id::text
    from public.time_off_requests where time_off_requests.employee_id = p_employee_id
    union all
    select 'employee_journeys', employee_journeys.id::text
    from public.employee_journeys where employee_journeys.employee_id = p_employee_id
  )
  select
    audit_logs.id,
    audit_logs.occurred_at,
    audit_logs.event_type,
    audit_logs.target_type,
    audit_logs.target_id,
    audit_logs.actor_id,
    coalesce(
      audit_logs.actor_display_name,
      nullif(trim(coalesce(profiles.first_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(profiles.last_name, '')), '')
    )
  from public.audit_logs
  join targets
    on targets.target_type = audit_logs.target_type
   and targets.target_id = audit_logs.target_id
  left join public.profiles on profiles.user_id = audit_logs.actor_id
  where audit_logs.organization_id = v_organization_id
  order by audit_logs.occurred_at desc
  limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 100), 1), 500);
end;

functions.name: get_file_node_path
functions.definition:
with recursive walk as (
    select
      node.id, node.organization_id, node.drive_id, node.parent_id, node.kind,
      node.name, node.source, node.external_id, node.external_metadata,
      node.deleted_at, node.created_by, node.created_at, node.updated_at,
      node.current_version_id, 0 as depth, array[node.id] as seen
    from public.file_nodes as node
    where node.id = p_node_id
      and public.has_file_node_access(node.id, 'viewer')

    union all

    select
      parent.id, parent.organization_id, parent.drive_id, parent.parent_id, parent.kind,
      parent.name, parent.source, parent.external_id, parent.external_metadata,
      parent.deleted_at, parent.created_by, parent.created_at, parent.updated_at,
      parent.current_version_id, child.depth + 1, child.seen || parent.id
    from public.file_nodes as parent
    inner join walk as child on child.parent_id = parent.id
    where parent.drive_id = child.drive_id
      and child.depth + 1 <= greatest(p_max_depth, 1)
      and parent.id <> all (child.seen)
  )
  select
    walk.id, walk.organization_id, walk.drive_id, walk.parent_id, walk.kind,
    walk.name, walk.source, walk.external_id, walk.external_metadata,
    walk.deleted_at, walk.created_by, walk.created_at, walk.updated_at,
    walk.current_version_id, walk.depth
  from walk
  order by walk.depth desc;

functions.name: get_file_retention_days
functions.definition:
select case coalesce(subscription.plan_key, 'starter'::public.billing_plan_key)
    when 'starter' then 7
    when 'pro' then 30
    when 'business' then 90
    when 'enterprise' then coalesce(settings.enterprise_retention_days, 365)
  end
  from (select p_organization_id as organization_id) as requested
  left join public.organization_subscriptions as subscription
    on subscription.organization_id = requested.organization_id
    and subscription.status in ('active', 'trialing')
  left join public.file_storage_settings as settings
    on settings.organization_id = requested.organization_id
  limit 1;

functions.name: get_file_storage_summary
functions.definition:
select
    settings.quota_bytes,
    coalesce(versions.stored_bytes, 0),
    coalesce(reservations.reserved_bytes, 0),
    case
      when settings.quota_bytes is null then null
      else greatest(
        settings.quota_bytes
          - coalesce(versions.stored_bytes, 0)
          - coalesce(reservations.reserved_bytes, 0),
        0
      )
    end,
    public.get_file_retention_days(p_organization_id),
    breakdown.segments
  from (
    select public.get_file_storage_quota_bytes(p_organization_id) as quota_bytes
  ) as settings
  cross join lateral (
    select sum(version.byte_size)::bigint as stored_bytes
    from public.file_versions as version
    where version.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) as versions
  cross join lateral (
    select sum(reservation.expected_bytes)::bigint as reserved_bytes
    from public.file_upload_reservations as reservation
    where reservation.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and reservation.status in ('reserved', 'uploaded')
      and reservation.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
  ) as reservations
  cross join lateral (
    select coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('kind', grouped.kind, 'bytes', grouped.bytes)
        order by grouped.kind
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) as segments
    from (
      select
        case
          when node.deleted_at is not null then 'trash'
          when version.media_type like 'video/%' then 'video'
          when version.media_type like 'audio/%' then 'audio'
          when version.media_type like 'image/%' then 'photo'
          when version.media_type like 'application/pdf'
            or version.media_type like 'text/%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/msword'
            or version.media_type like 'application/vnd.ms-%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%word%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%spreadsheet%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%presentation%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%officedocument%'
          then 'document'
          else 'other'
        end as kind,
        coalesce(sum(version.byte_size), 0)::bigint as bytes
      from public.file_nodes as node
      inner join public.file_versions as version
        on version.id = node.current_version_id
      where node.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and node.kind = 'file'
      group by 1
    ) as grouped
  ) as breakdown
  where public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.files.view');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_file_storage_summary(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(quota_bytes bigint, stored_bytes bigint, reserved_bytes bigint, available_bytes bigint, retention_days integer, segments jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select
    settings.quota_bytes,
    coalesce(versions.stored_bytes, 0),
    coalesce(reservations.reserved_bytes, 0),
    case
      when settings.quota_bytes is null then null
      else greatest(
        settings.quota_bytes
          - coalesce(versions.stored_bytes, 0)
          - coalesce(reservations.reserved_bytes, 0),
        0
      )
    end,
    public.get_file_retention_days(p_organization_id),
    breakdown.segments
  from (
    select public.get_file_storage_quota_bytes(p_organization_id) as quota_bytes
  ) as settings
  cross join lateral (
    select sum(version.byte_size)::bigint as stored_bytes
    from public.file_versions as version
    where version.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) as versions
  cross join lateral (
    select sum(reservation.expected_bytes)::bigint as reserved_bytes
    from public.file_upload_reservations as reservation
    where reservation.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and reservation.status in ('reserved', 'uploaded')
      and reservation.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
  ) as reservations
  cross join lateral (
    select coalesce(
      jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object('kind', grouped.kind, 'bytes', grouped.bytes)
        order by grouped.kind
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) as segments
    from (
      select
        case
          when node.deleted_at is not null then 'trash'
          when version.media_type like 'video/%' then 'video'
          when version.media_type like 'audio/%' then 'audio'
          when version.media_type like 'image/%' then 'photo'
          when version.media_type like 'application/pdf'
            or version.media_type like 'text/%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/msword'
            or version.media_type like 'application/vnd.ms-%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%word%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%spreadsheet%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%presentation%'
            or version.media_type like 'application/%officedocument%'
          then 'document'
          else 'other'
        end as kind,
        coalesce(sum(version.byte_size), 0)::bigint as bytes
      from public.file_nodes as node
      inner join public.file_versions as version
        on version.id = node.current_version_id
      where node.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and node.kind = 'file'
      group by 1
    ) as grouped
  ) as breakdown
  where public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.files.view');
$function$
functions.return_type: TABLE(quota_bytes bigint, stored_bytes bigint, reserved_bytes bigint, available_bytes bigint, retention_days integer, segments jsonb)

functions.definition:
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_invoice public.invoices%rowtype;
  v_lines jsonb;
  v_org jsonb;
  v_customer jsonb;
  v_payment jsonb;
begin
  if p_org_slug is null or p_invoice_id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select o.id into v_org_id
  from public.organizations o
  where lower(o.slug) = lower(p_org_slug)
  limit 1;

  if v_org_id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select * into v_invoice
  from public.invoices
  where id = p_invoice_id
    and organization_id = v_org_id
    and archived_at is null
    and status <> 'draft'
  limit 1;

  if v_invoice.id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      to_jsonb(l) - array[
        'direct_cost_unit_amount',
        'direct_cost_currency',
        'direct_cost_source',
        'direct_cost_confidence',
        'direct_cost_snapshotted_at'
      ]
      order by l.position
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_lines
  from public.invoice_lines l
  where l.invoice_id = v_invoice.id;

  -- Anonymous callers may reach this payload, so every joined row is projected
  -- to the fields the portal renders instead of serialising whole tables.
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', o.id,
    'name', o.name,
    'slug', o.slug,
    'logo_path', o.logo_path,
    'brand_primary_color', o.brand_primary_color,
    'brand_secondary_color', o.brand_secondary_color,
    'address_line1', o.address_line1,
    'address_postal_code', o.address_postal_code,
    'address_city', o.address_city,
    'address_country', o.address_country,
    'website', o.website,
    'email_reply_to', o.email_reply_to,
    'phone', o.phone,
    'kvk', o.kvk,
    'btw', o.btw,
    'iban', o.iban
  ) into v_org
  from public.organizations o
  where o.id = v_invoice.organization_id;

  -- Resolve a display name (company -> billing -> primary contact) so private
  -- customers whose name lives on the contact still render a recipient name.
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', c.id,
    'company_name', c.company_name,
    'billing_email', c.billing_email,
    'billing_name', c.billing_name,
    'display_name',
    coalesce(
      nullif(btrim(c.company_name), ''),
      nullif(btrim(c.billing_name), ''),
      nullif(btrim((
        select coalesce(cp.display_name, btrim(concat_ws(' ', cp.first_name, cp.last_name)))
        from public.customer_contacts pe
        join public.contact_profiles cp on cp.id = pe.contact_profile_id
        where pe.customer_id = c.id
        order by pe.is_primary desc
        limit 1
      )), '')
    )
  )
  into v_customer
  from public.customers c
  where c.id = v_invoice.customer_id
    and c.organization_id = v_invoice.organization_id;

  -- Provider identifiers stay server-side; the portal only needs payability.
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'status', p.status,
    'currency', p.currency,
    'amount_total', p.amount_total,
    'paid_at', p.paid_at
  )
  into v_payment
  from public.invoice_payments p
  where p.invoice_id = v_invoice.id
    and p.method = 'stripe'
  order by p.created_at desc
  limit 1;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'invoice', (to_jsonb(v_invoice) - array['uncollectible_at', 'uncollectible_reason'])
      || jsonb_build_object(
        'created_by', null,
        'updated_by', null,
        'status',
        case when v_invoice.status = 'uncollectible' then 'overdue' else v_invoice.status::text end
      ),
    'lines', v_lines,
    'organization', v_org,
    'customer', v_customer,
    'payment', v_payment
  );
end;

functions.name: get_organization_analytics
functions.definition:
declare
  v_comparison_start date;
  v_comparison_end date;
  v_period_days integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if p_start_date is null
    or p_end_date is null
    or p_start_date > p_end_date
    or p_end_date - p_start_date > 1830
  then
    raise exception 'analytics date range must be ordered and no longer than five years'
      using errcode = '22007';
  end if;

  if p_granularity not in ('day', 'week', 'month')
    or p_comparison not in ('none', 'previous-period', 'previous-year')
    or p_time_zone is null
    or length(p_time_zone) > 100
    or coalesce(cardinality(p_currencies), 0) > 20
    or exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      where requested_currency.currency !~ '^[a-z]{3}$'
    )
  then
    raise exception 'invalid analytics query parameters' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform now() at time zone p_time_zone;

  if not public.has_org_permission(
    p_organization_id,
    'organization.analytics.view'
  ) then
    raise exception 'not authorized to view organization analytics' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  v_period_days := p_end_date - p_start_date + 1;
  if p_comparison = 'previous-period' then
    v_comparison_end := p_start_date - 1;
    v_comparison_start := v_comparison_end - v_period_days + 1;
  elsif p_comparison = 'previous-year' then
    v_comparison_start := p_start_date - interval '1 year';
    v_comparison_end := p_end_date - interval '1 year';
  end if;

  with
    selected_invoices as (
      select
        invoices.id,
        invoices.customer_id,
        lower(invoices.currency) as currency,
        invoices.formatted_number,
        invoices.number,
        invoices.number_prefix,
        invoices.issue_date,
        invoices.due_date,
        invoices.paid_at,
        invoices.status,
        invoices.subtotal_excl,
        invoices.total_incl
      from public.invoices
      where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or lower(invoices.currency) = any (p_currencies)
        )
    ),
    current_invoice_metrics as (
      select
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
            and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between p_start_date and p_end_date
        ) * 100)::bigint as paid_revenue,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'paid', 'overdue')
        ) * 100)::bigint as issued_revenue,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.issue_date <= p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue')
        ) * 100)::bigint as receivables,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.issue_date <= p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.due_date < p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue')
        ) * 100)::bigint as overdue_receivables
      from selected_invoices
      group by selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    comparison_invoice_metrics as (
      select
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
            and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        ) * 100)::bigint as paid_revenue
      from selected_invoices
      where v_comparison_start is not null
      group by selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    invoice_line_values as (
      select
        invoice_lines.id,
        invoice_lines.product_id,
        selected_invoices.customer_id,
        selected_invoices.currency,
        selected_invoices.issue_date,
        selected_invoices.paid_at,
        case invoice_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then
            invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price
              * (1 - invoice_lines.discount_value / 100)
          when 'fixed' then
            greatest(
              invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price - invoice_lines.discount_value,
              0
            )
          else invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price
        end as revenue_amount,
        case
          when lower(invoice_lines.direct_cost_currency) = selected_invoices.currency
            and invoice_lines.direct_cost_snapshotted_at is not null
          then invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.direct_cost_unit_amount
        end as direct_cost_amount
      from selected_invoices
      join public.invoice_lines
        on invoice_lines.invoice_id = selected_invoices.id
        and invoice_lines.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and invoice_lines.kind = 'line'
      where selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'paid', 'overdue')
    ),
    current_margin as (
      select
        invoice_line_values.currency,
        round(sum(
          invoice_line_values.revenue_amount - invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount
        ) filter (
          where invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount is not null
            and invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
        ) * 100)::bigint as gross_margin,
        round(
          100 * sum(invoice_line_values.revenue_amount) filter (
            where invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount is not null
              and invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
          )
          / nullif(sum(invoice_line_values.revenue_amount) filter (
            where invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
          ), 0),
          2
        ) as coverage_percent
      from invoice_line_values
      group by invoice_line_values.currency
    ),
    quote_outcomes as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where quotes.status = 'accepted'
            and (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as accepted_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where (
              (quotes.status = 'accepted' and quotes.accepted_at is not null)
              or (quotes.status = 'rejected' and quotes.rejected_at is not null)
              or (quotes.status = 'expired' and quotes.expired_at is not null)
            )
            and (
              coalesce(quotes.accepted_at, quotes.rejected_at, quotes.expired_at)
                at time zone p_time_zone
            )::date between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as decided_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where quotes.status = 'accepted'
            and (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_accepted_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and (
              coalesce(quotes.accepted_at, quotes.rejected_at, quotes.expired_at)
                at time zone p_time_zone
            )::date between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
            and quotes.status in ('accepted', 'rejected', 'expired')
        )::numeric as comparison_decided_count
      from public.quotes
      where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
    ),
    paid_values as (
      select
        date_trunc(
          p_granularity,
          selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone
        )::date as bucket_start,
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from selected_invoices
      where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
        and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by bucket_start, selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    paid_points as (
      select
        paid_values.bucket_start,
        least(
          p_end_date,
          (
            paid_values.bucket_start
            + case p_granularity
                when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                else interval '1 month'
              end
            - interval '1 day'
          )::date
        ) as bucket_end,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', paid_values.amount_minor,
            'currency', paid_values.currency
          )
          order by paid_values.currency
        ) as values
      from paid_values
      group by paid_values.bucket_start
    ),
    margin_values as (
      select
        date_trunc(p_granularity, invoice_line_values.issue_date::timestamp)::date
          as bucket_start,
        invoice_line_values.currency,
        round(sum(
          invoice_line_values.revenue_amount - invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount
        ) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from invoice_line_values
      where invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount is not null
        and invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by bucket_start, invoice_line_values.currency
    ),
    margin_points as (
      select
        margin_values.bucket_start,
        least(
          p_end_date,
          (
            margin_values.bucket_start
            + case p_granularity
                when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                else interval '1 month'
              end
            - interval '1 day'
          )::date
        ) as bucket_end,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', margin_values.amount_minor,
            'currency', margin_values.currency
          )
          order by margin_values.currency
        ) as values
      from margin_values
      group by margin_values.bucket_start
    ),
    product_totals as (
      select
        invoice_line_values.product_id,
        products.name,
        invoice_line_values.currency,
        round(sum(invoice_line_values.revenue_amount) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from invoice_line_values
      join public.products on products.id = invoice_line_values.product_id
      where invoice_line_values.product_id is not null
        and invoice_line_values.paid_at is not null
        and (invoice_line_values.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by invoice_line_values.product_id, products.name, invoice_line_values.currency
    ),
    ranking_currency as (
      select coalesce(p_currencies[1], min(selected_invoices.currency)) as currency
      from selected_invoices
    ),
    ranked_products as (
      select
        product_totals.product_id::text as entity_id,
        product_totals.name as label,
        coalesce(max(product_totals.amount_minor) filter (
          where product_totals.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', product_totals.amount_minor,
            'currency', product_totals.currency
          )
          order by product_totals.currency
        ) as values
      from product_totals
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by product_totals.product_id, product_totals.name, ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    customer_totals as (
      select
        selected_invoices.customer_id,
        -- sort_name already resolves company vs primary contact name per customer type.
        coalesce(
          nullif(btrim(customers.sort_name), ''),
          nullif(btrim(customers.company_name), ''),
          nullif(btrim(customers.billing_email), ''),
          '#' || selected_invoices.customer_id::text
        ) as label,
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from selected_invoices
      join public.customers
        on customers.id = selected_invoices.customer_id
        and customers.organization_id = p_organization_id
      where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
        and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by
        selected_invoices.customer_id,
        customers.sort_name,
        customers.company_name,
        customers.billing_email,
        selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    ranked_customers as (
      select
        customer_totals.customer_id::text as entity_id,
        customer_totals.label,
        coalesce(max(customer_totals.amount_minor) filter (
          where customer_totals.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', customer_totals.amount_minor,
            'currency', customer_totals.currency
          )
          order by customer_totals.currency
        ) as values
      from customer_totals
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by
        customer_totals.customer_id,
        customer_totals.label,
        ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    invoice_evidence as (
      select
        selected_invoices.issue_date as occurred_on,
        'issued-revenue'::text as metric_key,
        coalesce(
          selected_invoices.formatted_number,
          selected_invoices.number_prefix || selected_invoices.number::text,
          selected_invoices.id::text
        ) as reference,
        selected_invoices.id::text as source_id,
        'invoice'::text as source_type,
        jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', round(selected_invoices.total_incl * 100)::bigint,
          'currency', selected_invoices.currency
        )) as values
      from selected_invoices
      where selected_invoices.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'paid', 'overdue')
      order by selected_invoices.issue_date desc, selected_invoices.id
      limit 250
    ),
    quote_evidence as (
      select
        coalesce(
          (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.rejected_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.expired_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.sent_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        ) as occurred_on,
        'quote-win-rate'::text as metric_key,
        quotes.number_prefix || quotes.number::text as reference,
        quotes.id::text as source_id,
        'quote'::text as source_type,
        jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', round(quotes.total_incl * 100)::bigint,
          'currency', lower(quotes.currency)
        )) as values
      from public.quotes
      where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and quotes.status in ('sent', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'expired')
        and coalesce(
          (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.rejected_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.expired_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.sent_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        ) between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or lower(quotes.currency) = any (p_currencies)
        )
      order by occurred_on desc, quotes.id
      limit 250
    ),
    currency_dimensions as (
      select requested_currency.currency
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      union
      select current_invoice_metrics.currency from current_invoice_metrics
      union
      select current_margin.currency from current_margin
    ),
    currency_metric_values as (
      select 'paid-revenue'::text as metric_key, currency, paid_revenue as amount_minor,
        null::numeric as coverage_percent
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'issued-revenue', currency, issued_revenue, null
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'receivables', currency, receivables, null
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'overdue-receivables', currency, overdue_receivables, null
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'gross-margin', currency, gross_margin, coverage_percent
      from current_margin
    ),
    currency_kpis as (
      select
        metric_key.metric_key,
        case
          when count(*) = 1 then max(currency_metric_values.coverage_percent)
        end as coverage_percent,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', coalesce(currency_metric_values.amount_minor, 0),
            'currency', currency_dimensions.currency
          )
          order by currency_dimensions.currency
        ) as values
      from (
        values
          ('paid-revenue'::text),
          ('issued-revenue'),
          ('receivables'),
          ('overdue-receivables'),
          ('gross-margin')
      ) as metric_key(metric_key)
      cross join currency_dimensions
      left join currency_metric_values
        on currency_metric_values.metric_key = metric_key.metric_key
        and currency_metric_values.currency = currency_dimensions.currency
      group by metric_key.metric_key
    ),
    currency_kpi_payload as (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'changePercent',
          case
            when currency_kpis.metric_key = 'paid-revenue'
              and jsonb_array_length(currency_kpis.values) = 1
            then (
              select round(
                100 * (
                  current_invoice_metrics.paid_revenue
                    - comparison_invoice_metrics.paid_revenue
                ) / nullif(abs(comparison_invoice_metrics.paid_revenue), 0),
                2
              )
              from current_invoice_metrics
              join comparison_invoice_metrics using (currency)
              where current_invoice_metrics.currency
                = currency_kpis.values -> 0 ->> 'currency'
            )
          end,
        'coveragePercent', currency_kpis.coverage_percent,
        'kind', 'currency',
        'metricKey', currency_kpis.metric_key,
        'values', currency_kpis.values
      ) as payload
      from currency_kpis
    ),
    quote_kpi as (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'changePercent',
          case
            when quote_outcomes.comparison_decided_count > 0
              and quote_outcomes.decided_count > 0
            then round(
              (
                100 * quote_outcomes.accepted_count / quote_outcomes.decided_count
                - 100 * quote_outcomes.comparison_accepted_count
                  / quote_outcomes.comparison_decided_count
              )
              / nullif(
                100 * quote_outcomes.comparison_accepted_count
                  / quote_outcomes.comparison_decided_count,
                0
              ) * 100,
              2
            )
          end,
        'coveragePercent', null,
        'kind', 'number',
        'metricKey', 'quote-win-rate',
        'unit', 'percent',
        'value', coalesce(
          round(100 * quote_outcomes.accepted_count / nullif(quote_outcomes.decided_count, 0), 2),
          0
        )
      ) as payload
      from quote_outcomes
    ),
    ranked_payload as (
      select *
      from (
        select
          ranked_products.entity_id,
          ranked_products.label,
          'product-revenue'::text as metric_key,
          ranked_products.sort_amount,
          ranked_products.values
        from ranked_products
        union all
        select
          ranked_customers.entity_id,
          ranked_customers.label,
          'customer-revenue',
          ranked_customers.sort_amount,
          ranked_customers.values
        from ranked_customers
      ) as ranked
      order by ranked.metric_key, ranked.sort_amount desc, ranked.entity_id
      limit 100
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'evidenceRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'occurredOn', evidence.occurred_on,
        'metricKey', evidence.metric_key,
        'reference', evidence.reference,
        'sourceId', evidence.source_id,
        'sourceType', evidence.source_type,
        'values', evidence.values
      ) order by evidence.occurred_on desc, evidence.source_id)
      from (
        select * from invoice_evidence
        union all
        select * from quote_evidence
      ) as evidence
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'forecasts', '[]'::jsonb,
    'generatedAt', to_jsonb(now()),
    'insights', '[]'::jsonb,
    'kpis', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(kpi.payload)
      from (
        select currency_kpi_payload.payload from currency_kpi_payload
        union all
        select quote_kpi.payload from quote_kpi
      ) as kpi
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'organizationId', p_organization_id,
    'range', jsonb_build_object(
      'comparison', p_comparison,
      'currencies', coalesce(to_jsonb(p_currencies), '[]'::jsonb),
      'endDate', p_end_date,
      'granularity', p_granularity,
      'startDate', p_start_date,
      'timeZone', p_time_zone
    ),
    'rankedRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'entityId', ranked_payload.entity_id,
        'label', ranked_payload.label,
        'metricKey', ranked_payload.metric_key,
        'rank', ranked_payload.rank,
        'values', ranked_payload.values
      ) order by ranked_payload.metric_key, ranked_payload.rank)
      from (
        select
          ranked_payload.*,
          row_number() over (
            partition by ranked_payload.metric_key
            order by ranked_payload.sort_amount desc, ranked_payload.entity_id
          ) as rank
        from ranked_payload
      ) as ranked_payload
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'series', (
      select jsonb_agg(series.payload)
      from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', 'revenue',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', paid_points.bucket_end,
              'startDate', paid_points.bucket_start,
              'values', paid_points.values
            ) order by paid_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from paid_points
              order by paid_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as paid_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) as payload
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', 'margin-trajectory',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', margin_points.bucket_end,
              'startDate', margin_points.bucket_start,
              'values', margin_points.values
            ) order by margin_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from margin_points
              order by margin_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as margin_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
      ) as series
    )
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
