CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_organization_analytics(p_organization_id uuid, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_granularity text, p_comparison text, p_currencies text[], p_time_zone text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_comparison_start date;
  v_comparison_end date;
  v_period_days integer;
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if p_start_date is null
    or p_end_date is null
    or p_start_date > p_end_date
    or p_end_date - p_start_date > 1830
  then
    raise exception 'analytics date range must be ordered and no longer than five years'
      using errcode = '22007';
  end if;

  if p_granularity not in ('day', 'week', 'month')
    or p_comparison not in ('none', 'previous-period', 'previous-year')
    or p_time_zone is null
    or length(p_time_zone) > 100
    or coalesce(cardinality(p_currencies), 0) > 20
    or exists (
      select 1
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      where requested_currency.currency !~ '^[a-z]{3}$'
    )
  then
    raise exception 'invalid analytics query parameters' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  perform now() at time zone p_time_zone;

  if not public.has_org_permission(
    p_organization_id,
    'organization.analytics.view'
  ) then
    raise exception 'not authorized to view organization analytics' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  v_period_days := p_end_date - p_start_date + 1;
  if p_comparison = 'previous-period' then
    v_comparison_end := p_start_date - 1;
    v_comparison_start := v_comparison_end - v_period_days + 1;
  elsif p_comparison = 'previous-year' then
    v_comparison_start := p_start_date - interval '1 year';
    v_comparison_end := p_end_date - interval '1 year';
  end if;

  with
    selected_invoices as (
      select
        invoices.id,
        invoices.customer_id,
        lower(invoices.currency) as currency,
        invoices.formatted_number,
        invoices.number,
        invoices.number_prefix,
        invoices.issue_date,
        invoices.due_date,
        invoices.paid_at,
        invoices.status,
        invoices.subtotal_excl,
        invoices.total_incl
      from public.invoices
      where invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or lower(invoices.currency) = any (p_currencies)
        )
    ),
    current_invoice_metrics as (
      select
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
            and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between p_start_date and p_end_date
        ) * 100)::bigint as paid_revenue,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'paid', 'overdue')
        ) * 100)::bigint as issued_revenue,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.issue_date <= p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue')
        ) * 100)::bigint as receivables,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.issue_date <= p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.due_date < p_end_date
            and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'overdue')
        ) * 100)::bigint as overdue_receivables
      from selected_invoices
      group by selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    comparison_invoice_metrics as (
      select
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) filter (
          where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
            and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        ) * 100)::bigint as paid_revenue
      from selected_invoices
      where v_comparison_start is not null
      group by selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    invoice_line_values as (
      select
        invoice_lines.id,
        invoice_lines.product_id,
        selected_invoices.customer_id,
        selected_invoices.currency,
        selected_invoices.issue_date,
        selected_invoices.paid_at,
        case invoice_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then
            invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price
              * (1 - invoice_lines.discount_value / 100)
          when 'fixed' then
            greatest(
              invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price - invoice_lines.discount_value,
              0
            )
          else invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price
        end as revenue_amount,
        case
          when lower(invoice_lines.direct_cost_currency) = selected_invoices.currency
            and invoice_lines.direct_cost_snapshotted_at is not null
          then invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.direct_cost_unit_amount
        end as direct_cost_amount
      from selected_invoices
      join public.invoice_lines
        on invoice_lines.invoice_id = selected_invoices.id
        and invoice_lines.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and invoice_lines.kind = 'line'
      where selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'paid', 'overdue')
    ),
    current_margin as (
      select
        invoice_line_values.currency,
        round(sum(
          invoice_line_values.revenue_amount - invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount
        ) filter (
          where invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount is not null
            and invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
        ) * 100)::bigint as gross_margin,
        round(
          100 * sum(invoice_line_values.revenue_amount) filter (
            where invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount is not null
              and invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
          )
          / nullif(sum(invoice_line_values.revenue_amount) filter (
            where invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
          ), 0),
          2
        ) as coverage_percent
      from invoice_line_values
      group by invoice_line_values.currency
    ),
    quote_outcomes as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where quotes.status = 'accepted'
            and (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as accepted_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where (
              (quotes.status = 'accepted' and quotes.accepted_at is not null)
              or (quotes.status = 'rejected' and quotes.rejected_at is not null)
              or (quotes.status = 'expired' and quotes.expired_at is not null)
            )
            and (
              coalesce(quotes.accepted_at, quotes.rejected_at, quotes.expired_at)
                at time zone p_time_zone
            )::date between p_start_date and p_end_date
        )::numeric as decided_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where quotes.status = 'accepted'
            and (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
              between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
        )::numeric as comparison_accepted_count,
        count(*) filter (
          where v_comparison_start is not null
            and (
              coalesce(quotes.accepted_at, quotes.rejected_at, quotes.expired_at)
                at time zone p_time_zone
            )::date between v_comparison_start and v_comparison_end
            and quotes.status in ('accepted', 'rejected', 'expired')
        )::numeric as comparison_decided_count
      from public.quotes
      where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
    ),
    paid_values as (
      select
        date_trunc(
          p_granularity,
          selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone
        )::date as bucket_start,
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from selected_invoices
      where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
        and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by bucket_start, selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    paid_points as (
      select
        paid_values.bucket_start,
        least(
          p_end_date,
          (
            paid_values.bucket_start
            + case p_granularity
                when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                else interval '1 month'
              end
            - interval '1 day'
          )::date
        ) as bucket_end,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', paid_values.amount_minor,
            'currency', paid_values.currency
          )
          order by paid_values.currency
        ) as values
      from paid_values
      group by paid_values.bucket_start
    ),
    margin_values as (
      select
        date_trunc(p_granularity, invoice_line_values.issue_date::timestamp)::date
          as bucket_start,
        invoice_line_values.currency,
        round(sum(
          invoice_line_values.revenue_amount - invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount
        ) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from invoice_line_values
      where invoice_line_values.direct_cost_amount is not null
        and invoice_line_values.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by bucket_start, invoice_line_values.currency
    ),
    margin_points as (
      select
        margin_values.bucket_start,
        least(
          p_end_date,
          (
            margin_values.bucket_start
            + case p_granularity
                when 'day' then interval '1 day'
                when 'week' then interval '1 week'
                else interval '1 month'
              end
            - interval '1 day'
          )::date
        ) as bucket_end,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', margin_values.amount_minor,
            'currency', margin_values.currency
          )
          order by margin_values.currency
        ) as values
      from margin_values
      group by margin_values.bucket_start
    ),
    product_totals as (
      select
        invoice_line_values.product_id,
        products.name,
        invoice_line_values.currency,
        round(sum(invoice_line_values.revenue_amount) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from invoice_line_values
      join public.products on products.id = invoice_line_values.product_id
      where invoice_line_values.product_id is not null
        and invoice_line_values.paid_at is not null
        and (invoice_line_values.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by invoice_line_values.product_id, products.name, invoice_line_values.currency
    ),
    ranking_currency as (
      select coalesce(p_currencies[1], min(selected_invoices.currency)) as currency
      from selected_invoices
    ),
    ranked_products as (
      select
        product_totals.product_id::text as entity_id,
        product_totals.name as label,
        coalesce(max(product_totals.amount_minor) filter (
          where product_totals.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', product_totals.amount_minor,
            'currency', product_totals.currency
          )
          order by product_totals.currency
        ) as values
      from product_totals
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by product_totals.product_id, product_totals.name, ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    customer_totals as (
      select
        selected_invoices.customer_id,
        -- sort_name already resolves company vs primary contact name per customer type.
        coalesce(
          nullif(btrim(customers.sort_name), ''),
          nullif(btrim(customers.company_name), ''),
          nullif(btrim(customers.billing_email), ''),
          '#' || selected_invoices.customer_id::text
        ) as label,
        selected_invoices.currency,
        round(sum(selected_invoices.total_incl) * 100)::bigint as amount_minor
      from selected_invoices
      join public.customers
        on customers.id = selected_invoices.customer_id
        and customers.organization_id = p_organization_id
      where selected_invoices.paid_at is not null
        and (selected_invoices.paid_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
          between p_start_date and p_end_date
      group by
        selected_invoices.customer_id,
        customers.sort_name,
        customers.company_name,
        customers.billing_email,
        selected_invoices.currency
    ),
    ranked_customers as (
      select
        customer_totals.customer_id::text as entity_id,
        customer_totals.label,
        coalesce(max(customer_totals.amount_minor) filter (
          where customer_totals.currency = ranking_currency.currency
        ), 0) as sort_amount,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', customer_totals.amount_minor,
            'currency', customer_totals.currency
          )
          order by customer_totals.currency
        ) as values
      from customer_totals
      cross join ranking_currency
      group by
        customer_totals.customer_id,
        customer_totals.label,
        ranking_currency.currency
    ),
    invoice_evidence as (
      select
        selected_invoices.issue_date as occurred_on,
        'issued-revenue'::text as metric_key,
        coalesce(
          selected_invoices.formatted_number,
          selected_invoices.number_prefix || selected_invoices.number::text,
          selected_invoices.id::text
        ) as reference,
        selected_invoices.id::text as source_id,
        'invoice'::text as source_type,
        jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', round(selected_invoices.total_incl * 100)::bigint,
          'currency', selected_invoices.currency
        )) as values
      from selected_invoices
      where selected_invoices.issue_date between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and selected_invoices.status in ('sent', 'paid', 'overdue')
      order by selected_invoices.issue_date desc, selected_invoices.id
      limit 250
    ),
    quote_evidence as (
      select
        coalesce(
          (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.rejected_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.expired_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.sent_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        ) as occurred_on,
        'quote-win-rate'::text as metric_key,
        quotes.number_prefix || quotes.number::text as reference,
        quotes.id::text as source_id,
        'quote'::text as source_type,
        jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
          'amountMinor', round(quotes.total_incl * 100)::bigint,
          'currency', lower(quotes.currency)
        )) as values
      from public.quotes
      where quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and quotes.status in ('sent', 'accepted', 'rejected', 'expired')
        and coalesce(
          (quotes.accepted_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.rejected_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.expired_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date,
          (quotes.sent_at at time zone p_time_zone)::date
        ) between p_start_date and p_end_date
        and (
          cardinality(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) = 0
          or lower(quotes.currency) = any (p_currencies)
        )
      order by occurred_on desc, quotes.id
      limit 250
    ),
    currency_dimensions as (
      select requested_currency.currency
      from unnest(coalesce(p_currencies, '{}'::text[])) as requested_currency(currency)
      union
      select current_invoice_metrics.currency from current_invoice_metrics
      union
      select current_margin.currency from current_margin
    ),
    currency_metric_values as (
      select 'paid-revenue'::text as metric_key, currency, paid_revenue as amount_minor,
        null::numeric as coverage_percent
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'issued-revenue', currency, issued_revenue, null
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'receivables', currency, receivables, null
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'overdue-receivables', currency, overdue_receivables, null
      from current_invoice_metrics
      union all
      select 'gross-margin', currency, gross_margin, coverage_percent
      from current_margin
    ),
    currency_kpis as (
      select
        metric_key.metric_key,
        case
          when count(*) = 1 then max(currency_metric_values.coverage_percent)
        end as coverage_percent,
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amountMinor', coalesce(currency_metric_values.amount_minor, 0),
            'currency', currency_dimensions.currency
          )
          order by currency_dimensions.currency
        ) as values
      from (
        values
          ('paid-revenue'::text),
          ('issued-revenue'),
          ('receivables'),
          ('overdue-receivables'),
          ('gross-margin')
      ) as metric_key(metric_key)
      cross join currency_dimensions
      left join currency_metric_values
        on currency_metric_values.metric_key = metric_key.metric_key
        and currency_metric_values.currency = currency_dimensions.currency
      group by metric_key.metric_key
    ),
    currency_kpi_payload as (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'changePercent',
          case
            when currency_kpis.metric_key = 'paid-revenue'
              and jsonb_array_length(currency_kpis.values) = 1
            then (
              select round(
                100 * (
                  current_invoice_metrics.paid_revenue
                    - comparison_invoice_metrics.paid_revenue
                ) / nullif(abs(comparison_invoice_metrics.paid_revenue), 0),
                2
              )
              from current_invoice_metrics
              join comparison_invoice_metrics using (currency)
              where current_invoice_metrics.currency
                = currency_kpis.values -> 0 ->> 'currency'
            )
          end,
        'coveragePercent', currency_kpis.coverage_percent,
        'kind', 'currency',
        'metricKey', currency_kpis.metric_key,
        'values', currency_kpis.values
      ) as payload
      from currency_kpis
    ),
    quote_kpi as (
      select jsonb_build_object(
        'changePercent',
          case
            when quote_outcomes.comparison_decided_count > 0
              and quote_outcomes.decided_count > 0
            then round(
              (
                100 * quote_outcomes.accepted_count / quote_outcomes.decided_count
                - 100 * quote_outcomes.comparison_accepted_count
                  / quote_outcomes.comparison_decided_count
              )
              / nullif(
                100 * quote_outcomes.comparison_accepted_count
                  / quote_outcomes.comparison_decided_count,
                0
              ) * 100,
              2
            )
          end,
        'coveragePercent', null,
        'kind', 'number',
        'metricKey', 'quote-win-rate',
        'unit', 'percent',
        'value', coalesce(
          round(100 * quote_outcomes.accepted_count / nullif(quote_outcomes.decided_count, 0), 2),
          0
        )
      ) as payload
      from quote_outcomes
    ),
    ranked_payload as (
      select *
      from (
        select
          ranked_products.entity_id,
          ranked_products.label,
          'product-revenue'::text as metric_key,
          ranked_products.sort_amount,
          ranked_products.values
        from ranked_products
        union all
        select
          ranked_customers.entity_id,
          ranked_customers.label,
          'customer-revenue',
          ranked_customers.sort_amount,
          ranked_customers.values
        from ranked_customers
      ) as ranked
      order by ranked.metric_key, ranked.sort_amount desc, ranked.entity_id
      limit 100
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'evidenceRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'occurredOn', evidence.occurred_on,
        'metricKey', evidence.metric_key,
        'reference', evidence.reference,
        'sourceId', evidence.source_id,
        'sourceType', evidence.source_type,
        'values', evidence.values
      ) order by evidence.occurred_on desc, evidence.source_id)
      from (
        select * from invoice_evidence
        union all
        select * from quote_evidence
      ) as evidence
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'forecasts', '[]'::jsonb,
    'generatedAt', to_jsonb(now()),
    'insights', '[]'::jsonb,
    'kpis', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(kpi.payload)
      from (
        select currency_kpi_payload.payload from currency_kpi_payload
        union all
        select quote_kpi.payload from quote_kpi
      ) as kpi
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'organizationId', p_organization_id,
    'range', jsonb_build_object(
      'comparison', p_comparison,
      'currencies', coalesce(to_jsonb(p_currencies), '[]'::jsonb),
      'endDate', p_end_date,
      'granularity', p_granularity,
      'startDate', p_start_date,
      'timeZone', p_time_zone
    ),
    'rankedRows', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'entityId', ranked_payload.entity_id,
        'label', ranked_payload.label,
        'metricKey', ranked_payload.metric_key,
        'rank', ranked_payload.rank,
        'values', ranked_payload.values
      ) order by ranked_payload.metric_key, ranked_payload.rank)
      from (
        select
          ranked_payload.*,
          row_number() over (
            partition by ranked_payload.metric_key
            order by ranked_payload.sort_amount desc, ranked_payload.entity_id
          ) as rank
        from ranked_payload
      ) as ranked_payload
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'series', (
      select jsonb_agg(series.payload)
      from (
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', 'revenue',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', paid_points.bucket_end,
              'startDate', paid_points.bucket_start,
              'values', paid_points.values
            ) order by paid_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from paid_points
              order by paid_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as paid_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        ) as payload
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object(
          'kind', 'currency',
          'metricKey', 'margin-trajectory',
          'points', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
              'endDate', margin_points.bucket_end,
              'startDate', margin_points.bucket_start,
              'values', margin_points.values
            ) order by margin_points.bucket_start)
            from (
              select *
              from margin_points
              order by margin_points.bucket_start desc
              limit 400
            ) as margin_points
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
      ) as series
    )
  )
  into v_result;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_granularity text, p_comparison text, p_currencies text[], p_time_zone text
functions.identity_argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_granularity text, p_comparison text, p_currencies text[], p_time_zone text

functions.name: get_product_for_portal
get_quote_for_portal
functions.definition:
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_quote public.quotes%rowtype;
  v_version public.quote_versions%rowtype;
  v_lines jsonb;
  v_versions jsonb;
  v_org jsonb;
  v_customer jsonb;
begin
  if p_org_slug is null or p_quote_id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select o.id into v_org_id
  from public.organizations o
  where lower(o.slug) = lower(p_org_slug)
  limit 1;

  if v_org_id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select * into v_quote
  from public.quotes
  where id = p_quote_id
    and organization_id = v_org_id
    and archived_at is null
    and status <> 'draft'
  limit 1;

  if v_quote.id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  if p_version is null then
    select * into v_version
    from public.quote_versions
    where quote_id = v_quote.id
    order by version desc
    limit 1;
  else
    select * into v_version
    from public.quote_versions
    where quote_id = v_quote.id
      and version = p_version
    limit 1;
  end if;

  if v_version.id is null then
    return null;
  end if;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      (
        to_jsonb(l)
        - 'quote_version_id'
        - 'source_line_id'
      ) || jsonb_build_object(
        'quote_id', v_quote.id,
        'id', coalesce(l.source_line_id, l.id),
        'updated_at', l.created_at
      )
      order by l.position
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_lines
  from public.quote_version_lines l
  where l.quote_version_id = v_version.id;

  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', qv.id,
        'version', qv.version,
        'status', qv.status,
        'reason', qv.reason,
        'publishedAt', qv.published_at
      )
      order by qv.version desc
    ),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_versions
  from public.quote_versions qv
  where qv.quote_id = v_quote.id;

  -- Anonymous callers may reach this payload, so every joined row is projected
  -- to the fields the portal renders instead of serialising whole tables.
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'id', o.id,
    'name', o.name,
    'slug', o.slug,
    'logo_path', o.logo_path,
    'brand_primary_color', o.brand_primary_color,
    'brand_secondary_color', o.brand_secondary_color,
    'address_line1', o.address_line1,
    'address_postal_code', o.address_postal_code,
    'address_city', o.address_city,
    'address_country', o.address_country,
    'website', o.website,
    'email_reply_to', o.email_reply_to,
    'phone', o.phone,
    'kvk', o.kvk,
    'btw', o.btw,
    'iban', o.iban
  ) into v_org
  from public.organizations o
  where o.id = v_quote.organization_id;

  select jsonb_build_object(
      'id', c.id,
      'company_name', c.company_name,
      'billing_email', c.billing_email,
      'billing_name', c.billing_name,
      'is_business', c.is_business,
      'kvk', c.kvk,
      'btw', c.btw,
      'primary_contact_name',
      (
        select nullif(
          trim(coalesce(p.first_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(p.last_name, '')),
          ''
        )
        from public.customer_contacts cc
        join public.contact_profiles p on p.id = cc.contact_profile_id
        where cc.customer_id = c.id
        order by cc.is_primary desc, cc.created_at
        limit 1
      )
    )
    into v_customer
  from public.customers c
  where c.id = v_quote.customer_id
    and c.organization_id = v_quote.organization_id;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'quote', to_jsonb(v_quote) || jsonb_build_object(
      -- Acceptance forensics and staff identities never leave the tenant.
      'accepted_ip', null,
      'accepted_user_agent', null,
      'created_by', null,
      'updated_by', null,
      'title', v_version.title,
      'intro', v_version.intro,
      'terms', v_version.terms,
      'public_message', v_version.public_message,
      'valid_until', v_version.valid_until,
      'currency', v_version.currency,
      'vat_inclusive', v_version.vat_inclusive,
      'discount_kind', v_version.discount_kind,
      'discount_value', v_version.discount_value,
      'discount_description', v_version.discount_description,
      'subtotal_excl', v_version.subtotal_excl,
      'vat_total', v_version.vat_total,
      'total_incl', v_version.total_incl,
      'version', v_version.version,
      'issue_date', v_version.issue_date,
      'vat_regime', v_version.vat_regime,
      'seller_name', v_version.seller_name,
      'seller_address_line1', v_version.seller_address_line1,
      'seller_address_line2', v_version.seller_address_line2,
      'seller_address_postal_code', v_version.seller_address_postal_code,
      'seller_address_city', v_version.seller_address_city,
      'seller_address_country', v_version.seller_address_country,
      'seller_email', v_version.seller_email,
      'seller_phone', v_version.seller_phone,
      'seller_kvk', v_version.seller_kvk,
      'seller_btw', v_version.seller_btw,
      'seller_iban', v_version.seller_iban,
      'buyer_name', v_version.buyer_name,
      'buyer_address_line1', v_version.buyer_address_line1,
      'buyer_address_line2', v_version.buyer_address_line2,
      'buyer_address_postal_code', v_version.buyer_address_postal_code,
      'buyer_address_city', v_version.buyer_address_city,
      'buyer_address_country', v_version.buyer_address_country,
      'buyer_email', v_version.buyer_email,
      'buyer_kvk', v_version.buyer_kvk,
      'buyer_btw', v_version.buyer_btw,
      'terms_rich_text', v_version.terms_rich_text,
      'terms_url', v_version.terms_url,
      'terms_pdf_file_id', v_version.terms_pdf_file_id,
      'terms_pdf_version_id', v_version.terms_pdf_version_id,
      'deposit_kind', v_version.deposit_kind,
      'deposit_value', v_version.deposit_value,
      'deposit_required_to_accept', v_version.deposit_required_to_accept
    ),
    'lines', v_lines,
    'versions', v_versions,
    'selectedVersion', v_version.version,
    'organization', v_org,
    'customer', v_customer
  );
end;

functions.definition:
with calendar as (
    select
      agenda_collections.id,
      agenda_collections.organization_id,
      agenda_collections.owner_user_id,
      agenda_collections.visibility
    from public.agenda_collections
    where agenda_collections.id = p_calendar_id
      and agenda_collections.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ),
  effective_role as (
    select greatest(
      case
        when calendar.owner_user_id = (select auth.uid()) then 2
        when public.has_org_permission(calendar.organization_id, 'organization.agenda.delete')
          then 2
        when calendar.visibility = 'public' then 1
        else 0
      end,
      coalesce((
        select max(
          case agenda_collection_grants.role
            when 'editor' then 2
            when 'viewer' then 1
            else 0
          end
        )
        from public.agenda_collection_grants
        where agenda_collection_grants.agenda_collection_id = calendar.id
          and (
            agenda_collection_grants.user_id = (select auth.uid())
            or exists (
              select 1
              from public.team_members
              where team_members.team_id = agenda_collection_grants.team_id
                and team_members.user_id = (select auth.uid())
            )
          )
      ), 0)
    ) as role_rank
    from calendar
  )
  select
    public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.agenda.view')
    and exists (
      select 1
      from effective_role
      where role_rank >= case p_min_role
        when 'viewer' then 1
        when 'editor' then 2
        else 99
      end
    )
    and (
      p_min_role <> 'editor'
      or public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.agenda.update')
    );

functions.name: has_any_org_permission
functions.definition:
declare
  v_uid uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if v_uid is null or p_org_id is null then
    return false;
  end if;

  return (
    with requested as (
      select permissions.id
      from unnest(p_permissions) as requested_permission(key)
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.key = requested_permission.key
       and permissions.scope = 'organization'
    ),
    membership as (
      select organization_users.role_id
      from public.organization_users
      join public.profiles
        on profiles.user_id = organization_users.user_id
      join public.organizations
        on organizations.id = organization_users.organization_id
      where organization_users.user_id = v_uid
        and organization_users.organization_id = p_org_id
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
    ),
    explicit as (
      select
        organization_permission_overrides.permission_id,
        organization_permission_overrides.granted
      from public.organization_permission_overrides
      join membership
        on membership.role_id = organization_permission_overrides.role_id
      join requested
        on requested.id = organization_permission_overrides.permission_id
      where organization_permission_overrides.organization_id = p_org_id
    )
    select exists (
      select 1
      from requested
      where not exists (
        select 1
        from explicit
        where explicit.permission_id = requested.id
          and explicit.granted = false
      )
        and (
          exists (
            select 1
            from explicit
            where explicit.permission_id = requested.id
              and explicit.granted = true
          )
          or exists (
            select 1
            from public.role_permissions
            join membership
              on membership.role_id = role_permissions.role_id
            where role_permissions.permission_id = requested.id
          )
        )
    )
  );
end;

functions.name: has_file_drive_access
functions.definition:
select exists (
    select 1
    from public.file_drives as drive
    where drive.id = p_drive_id
      and drive.lifecycle_state <> 'trashed'
      and public.has_org_permission(drive.organization_id, 'organization.files.view')
      and (
        drive.drive_type <> 'customers'
        or public.has_org_permission(drive.organization_id, 'organization.customers.view')
      )
      and greatest(
        case
          when drive.drive_type in ('company', 'customers')
            and public.has_org_permission(drive.organization_id, 'organization.files.update')
            then 3
          when drive.drive_type in ('company', 'customers') then 1
          when drive.owner_user_id = (select auth.uid()) then 3
          else 0
        end,
        coalesce(
          (
            select max(public.file_access_role_rank(grant_row.role))
            from public.file_drive_grants as grant_row
            where grant_row.drive_id = drive.id
              and (
                grant_row.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                or grant_row.team_id in (
                  select team_member.team_id
                  from public.team_members as team_member
                  where team_member.user_id = (select auth.uid())
                )
              )
          ),
          0
        )
      ) >= public.file_access_role_rank(p_min_role)
  );

      node.drive_id,
      node.organization_id,
      array[node.id] as seen

      parent.id,
      parent.parent_id,
      parent.drive_id,

functions.name: has_org_permission
functions.definition:
declare
  v_uid uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if v_uid is null or p_org_id is null then
    return false;
  end if;

  return (
    with membership as (
      select m.role_id
      from public.organization_users m
      join public.profiles p on p.user_id = m.user_id
      join public.organizations org on org.id = m.organization_id
      where m.user_id = v_uid
        and m.organization_id = p_org_id
        and p.disabled_at is null
        and org.disabled_at is null
    ),
    permission as (
      select c.id
      from public.permissions c
      where c.key = p_permission
        and c.scope = 'organization'
    ),
    explicit as (
      select o.granted
      from public.organization_permission_overrides o
      join membership m on m.role_id = o.role_id
      join permission c on c.id = o.permission_id
      where o.organization_id = p_org_id
    )
    select
      case
        when exists (select 1 from explicit where granted = false) then false
        when exists (select 1 from explicit where granted = true)  then true
        else exists (
          select 1
          from public.role_permissions rc
          join membership m on m.role_id = rc.role_id
          join permission c on c.id = rc.permission_id
        )
      end
  );
end;

functions.definition:
with input as (
    select distinct task_id
    from unnest(coalesce(p_task_ids, '{}'::uuid[])) as input(task_id)
  ),
  visible_organizations as (
    select task.organization_id
    from public.tasks as task
    join input on input.task_id = task.id
    group by task.organization_id
    having public.has_org_permission(task.organization_id, 'organization.tasks.view')
  ),
  requested as (
    select task.id as task_id
    from public.tasks as task
    join input on input.task_id = task.id
    join visible_organizations on visible_organizations.organization_id = task.organization_id
  ),
  assignees as (
    select
      assignment.task_id,
      coalesce(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'user_id', assignment.user_id,
            'username', profile.username,
            'avatar_path', profile.avatar_path,
            'first_name', profile.first_name,
            'last_name', profile.last_name,
            'disabled_at', profile.disabled_at
          )
          order by coalesce(
            nullif(btrim(concat_ws(' ', profile.first_name, profile.last_name)), ''),
            profile.username,
            assignment.user_id::text
          )
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ) as items
    from public.task_assignees as assignment
    join requested on requested.task_id = assignment.task_id
    left join public.profiles as profile on profile.user_id = assignment.user_id
    group by assignment.task_id
  ),
  tags as (
    select
      task_tag.task_id,
      coalesce(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'id', organization_tag.id,
            'organization_id', organization_tag.organization_id,
            'kind', organization_tag.kind,
            'name', organization_tag.name,
            'slug', organization_tag.slug,
            'color', organization_tag.color,
            'description', organization_tag.description,
            'position', organization_tag.position,
            'created_at', organization_tag.created_at,
            'updated_at', organization_tag.updated_at
          )
          order by organization_tag.name
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ) as items
    from public.task_tags as task_tag
    join requested on requested.task_id = task_tag.task_id
    join public.organization_tags as organization_tag
      on organization_tag.id = task_tag.tag_id
    group by task_tag.task_id
  ),
  subtasks as (
    select
      child.parent_task_id as task_id,
      count(*)::integer as total,
      count(*) filter (where child.status = 'done')::integer as done
    from public.tasks as child
    join requested on requested.task_id = child.parent_task_id
    where child.archived_at is null
    group by child.parent_task_id
  ),
  comments as (
    select
      thread.task_id,
      count(comment.id)::integer as comment_count
    from public.comment_threads as thread
    join requested on requested.task_id = thread.task_id
    left join public.comments as comment on comment.thread_id = thread.id
    where thread.subject_type = 'task'
      and thread.task_id is not null
    group by thread.task_id
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_object_agg(
      requested.task_id::text,
      jsonb_build_object(
        'assignees', coalesce(assignees.items, '[]'::jsonb),
        'tags', coalesce(tags.items, '[]'::jsonb),
        'subtask_total', coalesce(subtasks.total, 0),
        'subtask_done', coalesce(subtasks.done, 0),
        'comment_count', coalesce(comments.comment_count, 0)
      )
    ),
    '{}'::jsonb
  )

  left join tags on tags.task_id = requested.task_id
  left join subtasks on subtasks.task_id = requested.task_id
  left join comments on comments.task_id = requested.task_id;

functions.name: inventory_reorder_suggestions
functions.definition:
with rules as (
    select inventory_reorder_rules.variant_id,
      max(inventory_reorder_rules.reorder_point) as reorder_point,
      max(inventory_reorder_rules.reorder_quantity) as reorder_quantity,
      max(inventory_reorder_rules.max_level) as max_level,
      (array_agg(inventory_reorder_rules.supplier_id)
        filter (where inventory_reorder_rules.supplier_id is not null))[1] as supplier_id
    from public.inventory_reorder_rules
    where inventory_reorder_rules.organization_id = p_organization_id
    group by inventory_reorder_rules.variant_id
  ),
  levels as (
    select levels.*, rules.reorder_quantity, rules.max_level, rules.supplier_id as rule_supplier_id
    from public.inventory_variant_levels(p_organization_id) as levels
    join rules on rules.variant_id = levels.variant_id
    where levels.stock_status not in ('not_tracked', 'discontinued')
      and levels.available + coalesce(levels.incoming, 0) <= rules.reorder_point
  ),
  picked as (
    select levels.*,
      links.id as link_id, links.supplier_id as link_supplier_id, links.supplier_sku,
      links.unit_cost as link_unit_cost, links.currency as link_currency,
      links.min_order_quantity, links.order_multiple,
      greatest(
        coalesce(
          levels.reorder_quantity,
          levels.max_level - levels.available - coalesce(levels.incoming, 0),
          levels.reorder_point - levels.available - coalesce(levels.incoming, 0) + 1
        ),
        1
      ) as raw_quantity
    from levels
    left join lateral (
      select product_supplier_links.*
      from public.product_supplier_links
      where product_supplier_links.variant_id = levels.variant_id
        and product_supplier_links.is_active
        and (
          levels.rule_supplier_id is null
          or product_supplier_links.supplier_id = levels.rule_supplier_id
        )
      order by product_supplier_links.is_preferred desc, product_supplier_links.created_at
      limit 1
    ) as links on true
  )
  select picked.variant_id, picked.product_id, products.name, picked.variant_title, picked.sku,
    picked.available, coalesce(picked.incoming, 0), picked.reorder_point,
    case
      when picked.order_multiple is not null
        then ceil(greatest(picked.raw_quantity, coalesce(picked.min_order_quantity, 0))
          / picked.order_multiple) * picked.order_multiple
      else greatest(picked.raw_quantity, coalesce(picked.min_order_quantity, 0))
    end,
    coalesce(picked.link_supplier_id, picked.rule_supplier_id),
    suppliers.name,
    picked.link_id,
    picked.supplier_sku,
    coalesce(picked.link_unit_cost, product_variants.purchase_price, products.default_purchase_price, 0),
    coalesce(picked.link_currency, suppliers.currency, products.currency, 'EUR')
  from picked
  join public.products on products.id = picked.product_id
  join public.product_variants on product_variants.id = picked.variant_id
  left join public.suppliers
    on suppliers.id = coalesce(picked.link_supplier_id, picked.rule_supplier_id);

functions.name: inventory_variant_incoming
functions.definition:
select case when p_variant_id is null then null else coalesce((
    select sum(greatest(
      purchase_order_lines.quantity_ordered
        - purchase_order_lines.quantity_received
        - purchase_order_lines.quantity_cancelled,
      0
    ))
    from public.purchase_order_lines
    join public.purchase_orders on purchase_orders.id = purchase_order_lines.purchase_order_id
    where purchase_order_lines.variant_id = p_variant_id
      and purchase_orders.status in ('sent', 'partially_received')
  ), 0) end;
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventory_variant_incoming(p_variant_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case when p_variant_id is null then null else coalesce((
    select sum(greatest(
      purchase_order_lines.quantity_ordered
        - purchase_order_lines.quantity_received
        - purchase_order_lines.quantity_cancelled,
      0
    ))
    from public.purchase_order_lines
    join public.purchase_orders on purchase_orders.id = purchase_order_lines.purchase_order_id
    where purchase_order_lines.variant_id = p_variant_id
      and purchase_orders.status in ('sent', 'partially_received')
  ), 0) end;
$function$

functions.name: inventory_variant_levels
functions.definition:
with variants as (
    select product_variants.id, product_variants.product_id, product_variants.status,
      product_variants.allow_backorder, products.track_inventory, products.product_type,
      product_variants.title, coalesce(product_variants.sku, products.sku) as sku,
      product_variants.is_default, product_variants.position
    from public.product_variants
    join public.products on products.id = product_variants.product_id
    where product_variants.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and product_variants.status <> 'archived'
      and (p_product_ids is null or product_variants.product_id = any (p_product_ids))
  ),
  stock as (
    select inventory_stock_records.variant_id,
      sum(inventory_stock_records.on_hand_quantity) as on_hand,
      sum(inventory_stock_records.allocated_quantity) as allocated
    from public.inventory_stock_records
    where inventory_stock_records.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and inventory_stock_records.status = 'available'
      and (
        inventory_stock_records.expires_on is null
        or inventory_stock_records.expires_on >= current_date
      )
    group by inventory_stock_records.variant_id
  ),
  backorders as (
    select inventory_allocations.variant_id, sum(inventory_allocations.quantity) as quantity
    from public.inventory_allocations
    where inventory_allocations.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and inventory_allocations.state = 'backordered'
    group by inventory_allocations.variant_id
  ),
  rules as (
    select inventory_reorder_rules.variant_id,
      max(inventory_reorder_rules.reorder_point) as reorder_point
    from public.inventory_reorder_rules
    where inventory_reorder_rules.organization_id = p_organization_id
    group by inventory_reorder_rules.variant_id
  ),
  levels as (
    select variants.*,
      coalesce(stock.on_hand, 0) as on_hand,
      coalesce(stock.allocated, 0) as allocated,
      coalesce(stock.on_hand, 0) - coalesce(stock.allocated, 0) as available,
      coalesce(backorders.quantity, 0) as backordered,
      public.inventory_variant_incoming(variants.id) as incoming,
      rules.reorder_point
    from variants
    left join stock on stock.variant_id = variants.id
    left join backorders on backorders.variant_id = variants.id
    left join rules on rules.variant_id = variants.id
  )
  select levels.id, levels.product_id, levels.on_hand, levels.allocated, levels.available,
    levels.backordered, levels.incoming, levels.reorder_point,
    case
      when levels.product_type = 'digital' or not levels.track_inventory then 'not_tracked'
      when levels.status = 'discontinued' then 'discontinued'
      when levels.available <= 0 and levels.backordered = 0 and not levels.allow_backorder
        then 'out_of_stock'
      when levels.backordered > 0 or levels.available <= 0 then 'backordered'
      when levels.reorder_point is not null and levels.available <= levels.reorder_point
        then 'low_stock'
      else 'in_stock'
    end,
    levels.title, levels.sku, levels.is_default, levels.position
  from levels;

is_employee_manager_of
functions.definition:
declare
  v_uid uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_today date := (now() at time zone 'utc')::date;
begin
  if v_uid is null or p_employee_id is null then
    return false;
  end if;

  return exists (
    with recursive chain as (
      select employees.reports_to_employee_id as manager_id, 1 as depth
      from public.employees
      where employees.id = p_employee_id
      union all
      select employees.reports_to_employee_id, chain.depth + 1
      from chain
      join public.employees on employees.id = chain.manager_id
      where chain.depth < 20 and employees.reports_to_employee_id is not null
    )
    select 1
    from chain
    join public.employees manager on manager.id = chain.manager_id
    where manager.user_id = v_uid
    union all
    select 1
    from public.approval_delegations delegation
    join public.employees delegate on delegate.id = delegation.delegate_employee_id
    join public.employees subject on subject.id = p_employee_id
    where delegate.user_id = v_uid
      and delegation.employee_id in (select chain.manager_id from chain)
      and v_today between delegation.starts_on and delegation.ends_on
  );
end;

functions.name: link_ai_agent_workflow_ownership
functions.definition:
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_authorized boolean := false;
begin
  if v_actor_id is null
    or p_workflow_run_id is null
    or length(p_workflow_run_id) not between 1 and 240
    or (p_message_id is null) <> (p_dispatch_id is null)
  then
    return false;
  end if;

  if p_message_id is null then
    -- Approval continuations leave message_id null. Regenerations already point the
    -- run at the assistant message being replaced, and still need ownership linking.
    select true
    into v_authorized
    from public.chat_threads as thread
    join public.ai_agent_runs as run
      on run.id = p_run_id
    where thread.id = p_thread_id
      and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and thread.stream_status = 'submitted'
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode = 'agent'
      and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and run.workflow_run_id is null
      and (
        (
          run.message_id is null
          and jsonb_typeof(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses') = 'array'
          and jsonb_array_length(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses') > 0
          and (
            select count(*)
            from public.approval_requests as approval
            where approval.response_run_id = run.id
              and approval.response_active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
              and approval.response_workflow_run_id is null
          ) = jsonb_array_length(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses')
        )
        or (
          run.message_id is not null
          and coalesce(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses', '[]'::jsonb)), 0) = 0
          and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.chat_messages as message
            where message.id = run.message_id
              and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
              and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
              and message.role = 'assistant'
              and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
          )
        )
      )
      and (
        thread.owner_user_id = v_actor_id
        or (
          thread.visibility = 'organization'
          and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.view')
        )
      )
    for update of thread, run;
  else
    select true
    into v_authorized
    from public.chat_messages as message
    join public.chat_threads as thread
      on thread.id = message.thread_id
    join public.ai_agent_runs as run
      on run.id = p_run_id
    where message.id = p_message_id
      and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and message.created_by = v_actor_id
      and message.role = 'user'
      and message.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
      and message.dispatch_linked_at is null
      and thread.id = p_thread_id
      and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and thread.stream_status = 'submitted'
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode = 'agent'
      and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and run.workflow_run_id is null
      and run.message_id is null
      and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
      and (
        thread.owner_user_id = v_actor_id
        or (
          thread.visibility = 'organization'
          and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.view')
        )
      )
    for update of message, thread, run;
  end if;

  if not coalesce(v_authorized, false) then
    return false;
  end if;

  if p_message_id is not null then
    update public.chat_messages as message
    set
      dispatch_linked_at = now() at time zone 'utc',
      metadata = message.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'activeStreamId',
        p_active_stream_id,
        'agentRunId',

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.link_ai_agent_workflow_ownership(p_message_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_dispatch_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_authorized boolean := false;
begin
  if v_actor_id is null
    or p_workflow_run_id is null
    or length(p_workflow_run_id) not between 1 and 240
    or (p_message_id is null) <> (p_dispatch_id is null)
  then
    return false;
  end if;

  if p_message_id is null then
    -- Approval continuations leave message_id null. Regenerations already point the
    -- run at the assistant message being replaced, and still need ownership linking.
    select true
    into v_authorized
    from public.chat_threads as thread
    join public.ai_agent_runs as run
      on run.id = p_run_id
    where thread.id = p_thread_id
      and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and thread.stream_status = 'submitted'
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode = 'agent'
      and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and run.workflow_run_id is null
      and (
        (
          run.message_id is null
          and jsonb_typeof(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses') = 'array'
          and jsonb_array_length(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses') > 0
          and (
            select count(*)
            from public.approval_requests as approval
            where approval.response_run_id = run.id
              and approval.response_active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
              and approval.response_workflow_run_id is null
          ) = jsonb_array_length(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses')
        )
        or (
          run.message_id is not null
          and coalesce(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(run.metadata -> 'approvalResponses', '[]'::jsonb)), 0) = 0
          and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.chat_messages as message
            where message.id = run.message_id
              and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
              and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
              and message.role = 'assistant'
              and not (message.metadata ? 'supersededByRunId')
          )
        )
      )
      and (
        thread.owner_user_id = v_actor_id
        or (
          thread.visibility = 'organization'
          and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.view')
        )
      )
    for update of thread, run;
  else
    select true
    into v_authorized
    from public.chat_messages as message
    join public.chat_threads as thread
      on thread.id = message.thread_id
    join public.ai_agent_runs as run
      on run.id = p_run_id
    where message.id = p_message_id
      and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and message.created_by = v_actor_id
      and message.role = 'user'
      and message.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
      and message.dispatch_linked_at is null
      and thread.id = p_thread_id
      and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and thread.stream_status = 'submitted'
      and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
      and run.created_by = v_actor_id
      and run.mode = 'agent'
      and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and run.workflow_run_id is null
      and run.message_id is null
      and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
      and (
        thread.owner_user_id = v_actor_id
        or (
          thread.visibility = 'organization'
          and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.view')
        )
      )
    for update of message, thread, run;
  end if;

  if not coalesce(v_authorized, false) then
    return false;
  end if;

  if p_message_id is not null then
    update public.chat_messages as message
    set
      dispatch_linked_at = now() at time zone 'utc',
      metadata = message.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
        'activeStreamId',
        p_active_stream_id,
        'agentRunId',
        p_run_id,
        'localEventIndex',
        coalesce((message.metadata ->> 'localEventIndex')::integer, 0) + 1,
        'outboxState',
        'running',
        'workflowRunId',
        p_workflow_run_id
      )
    where message.id = p_message_id;
  else
    update public.approval_requests as approval
    set response_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    where approval.response_run_id = p_run_id
      and approval.response_active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
      and approval.response_workflow_run_id is null;
  end if;

  update public.chat_threads as thread
  set
    active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id,
    active_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id,
    stream_status = 'streaming'
  where thread.id = p_thread_id;

  update public.ai_agent_runs as run
  set
    -- Regenerations already store the assistant target on the run; keep it when
    -- ownership links with a null dispatch message id.
    message_id = coalesce(p_message_id, run.message_id),
    workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
  where run.id = p_run_id;

  return true;
end;

functions.name: list_admin_billing
functions.definition:
declare
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.is_system_user_with('system.billing.view') then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'Admin billing lists require system.billing.view';
  end if;

  with
    filtered_organizations as materialized (
      select
        organizations.id,
        organizations.name,
        organizations.slug,
        billing_customers.billing_email,
        billing_customers.stripe_customer_id,
        subscriptions.current_period_end,
        subscriptions.current_period_start,
        subscriptions.credit_package_key,
        subscriptions.interval,
        subscriptions.plan_key,
        subscriptions.plan_name,
        subscriptions.status,
        subscriptions.stripe_subscription_id
      from public.organizations
      left join public.organization_billing_customers as billing_customers
        on billing_customers.organization_id = organizations.id
      left join public.organization_subscriptions as subscriptions
        on subscriptions.organization_id = organizations.id
      where organizations.disabled_at is null
        and (
          nullif(btrim(p_search), '') is null
          or position(
            lower(btrim(p_search)) in lower(
              concat_ws(
                ' ',
                organizations.name,
                organizations.slug,
                billing_customers.billing_email,
                subscriptions.plan_name
              )
            )
          ) > 0
        )
        and (
          coalesce(cardinality(p_plan_keys), 0) = 0
          or coalesce(subscriptions.plan_key::text, 'none') = any (p_plan_keys)
        )
        and (
          coalesce(cardinality(p_statuses), 0) = 0
          or coalesce(subscriptions.status::text, 'none') = any (p_statuses)
        )
    ),
    page_organizations as (
      select filtered_organizations.*
      from filtered_organizations
      order by filtered_organizations.name, filtered_organizations.id
      limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1), 100)
      offset greatest(p_offset, 0)
    ),
    page_rows as (
      select
        page_organizations.*,
        coalesce(invoice_totals.amount_due, 0) as amount_due,
        coalesce(invoice_totals.amount_paid, 0) as amount_paid,
        coalesce(invoice_totals.invoice_count, 0) as invoice_count,
        coalesce(invoice_totals.open_invoice_amount, 0) as open_invoice_amount,
        coalesce(invoice_totals.open_invoice_count, 0) as open_invoice_count,
        coalesce(
          case
            when plan_prices.interval = 'year' then round(plan_prices.amount::numeric / 12)
            else plan_prices.amount
          end,
          0
        ) as monthly_amount,
        coalesce(plan_prices.currency, invoice_totals.currency, 'eur') as currency
      from page_organizations
      left join public.billing_plan_credit_packages as default_packages
        on default_packages.plan_key = page_organizations.plan_key
        and default_packages.is_default
        and page_organizations.credit_package_key is null
      left join public.billing_plan_prices as plan_prices
        on plan_prices.plan_key = page_organizations.plan_key
        and plan_prices.package_key = coalesce(
          page_organizations.credit_package_key,
          default_packages.package_key
        )
        and plan_prices.interval = page_organizations.interval
      left join lateral (
        select
          coalesce(sum(invoices.amount_due), 0) as amount_due,
          coalesce(sum(invoices.amount_paid), 0) as amount_paid,
          min(invoices.currency) as currency,
          count(*) as invoice_count,
          coalesce(
            sum(invoices.amount_remaining) filter (
              where invoices.status = 'open' or invoices.amount_remaining > 0
            ),
            0
          ) as open_invoice_amount,
          count(*) filter (
            where invoices.status = 'open' or invoices.amount_remaining > 0
          ) as open_invoice_count
        from public.organization_invoices as invoices
        where invoices.organization_id = page_organizations.id
      ) as invoice_totals on true
    ),
    subscription_summary as (
      select
        count(*) filter (
          where subscriptions.status in ('active', 'trialing')
        ) as active_subscriptions,
        coalesce(
          sum(
            case
              when plan_prices.interval = 'year' then round(plan_prices.amount::numeric / 12)
              else plan_prices.amount
            end
          ),
          0
        ) as mrr,
        count(*) filter (
          where subscriptions.status = 'past_due'
        ) as past_due_subscriptions,
        min(plan_prices.currency) as currency
      from public.organization_subscriptions as subscriptions
      left join public.billing_plan_credit_packages as default_packages
        on default_packages.plan_key = subscriptions.plan_key
        and default_packages.is_default
        and subscriptions.credit_package_key is null
      left join public.billing_plan_prices as plan_prices
        on plan_prices.plan_key = subscriptions.plan_key
        and plan_prices.package_key = coalesce(
          subscriptions.credit_package_key,
          default_packages.package_key
        )
        and plan_prices.interval = subscriptions.interval
    ),
    invoice_summary as (
      select
        min(invoices.currency) as currency,
        coalesce(
          sum(invoices.amount_remaining) filter (
            where invoices.status = 'open' or invoices.amount_remaining > 0
          ),
          0
        ) as open_invoice_amount,
        count(*) filter (
          where invoices.status = 'open' or invoices.amount_remaining > 0
        ) as open_invoices
      from public.organization_invoices as invoices
    )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'rows',
    coalesce(
      (
        select jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'amount_due', page_rows.amount_due,
            'amount_paid', page_rows.amount_paid,
            'billing_email', page_rows.billing_email,
            'current_period_end', page_rows.current_period_end,
            'current_period_start', page_rows.current_period_start,
            'currency', page_rows.currency,
            'interval', page_rows.interval,
            'invoice_count', page_rows.invoice_count,
            'monthly_amount', page_rows.monthly_amount,
            'open_invoice_amount', page_rows.open_invoice_amount,
            'open_invoice_count', page_rows.open_invoice_count,
            'organization_id', page_rows.id,
            'organization_name', page_rows.name,
            'organization_slug', page_rows.slug,
            'plan_key', page_rows.plan_key,
            'plan_name', coalesce(page_rows.plan_name, 'Starter'),
            'status', coalesce(page_rows.status::text, 'none'),
            'stripe_customer_id', page_rows.stripe_customer_id,
            'stripe_subscription_id', page_rows.stripe_subscription_id
          )
          order by page_rows.name, page_rows.id
        )
        from page_rows
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'summary',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'active_subscriptions', subscription_summary.active_subscriptions,
      'currency', coalesce(subscription_summary.currency, invoice_summary.currency, 'eur'),
      'mrr', subscription_summary.mrr,
      'open_invoice_amount', invoice_summary.open_invoice_amount,
      'open_invoices', invoice_summary.open_invoices,
      'organization_count', (select count(*) from public.organizations where disabled_at is null),
      'past_due_subscriptions', subscription_summary.past_due_subscriptions
    ),
    'total',
    (select count(*) from filtered_organizations)
  )
  into v_result
  from subscription_summary
  cross join invoice_summary;

  return v_result;
end;

            'organization_id', page_rows.id,
            'organization_name', page_rows.name,
            'organization_slug', page_rows.slug,
            'plan_key', page_rows.plan_key,
            'plan_name', coalesce(page_rows.plan_name, 'Starter'),
            'status', coalesce(page_rows.status::text, 'none'),
            'stripe_customer_id', page_rows.stripe_customer_id,
            'stripe_subscription_id', page_rows.stripe_subscription_id
          )
          order by page_rows.name, page_rows.id
        )
        from page_rows
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),
    'summary',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'active_subscriptions', subscription_summary.active_subscriptions,
      'currency', coalesce(subscription_summary.currency, invoice_summary.currency, 'eur'),
      'mrr', subscription_summary.mrr,
      'open_invoice_amount', invoice_summary.open_invoice_amount,
      'open_invoices', invoice_summary.open_invoices,
      'organization_count', (select count(*) from public.organizations where disabled_at is null),
      'past_due_subscriptions', subscription_summary.past_due_subscriptions
    ),
    'total',
    (select count(*) from filtered_organizations)
  )
  into v_result
  from subscription_summary
  cross join invoice_summary;

  return v_result;
end;

with current_user_id as (
    select auth.uid() as uid
  ),
  org_flags as (
    select
      public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.agenda.view') as has_view,
      public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.agenda.update') as has_update,
      public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.agenda.delete') as has_delete
    from current_user_id
    where current_user_id.uid is not null
  ),
  calendar_roles as (
    select
      agenda_collections.id,
      agenda_collections.organization_id,
      agenda_collections.owner_user_id,
      agenda_collections.name,
      agenda_collections.description,
      agenda_collections.color,
      agenda_collections.visibility,
      agenda_collections.source,
      agenda_collections.external_calendar_id,
      agenda_collections.is_default,
      agenda_collections.position,
      agenda_collections.default_time_zone,
      agenda_collections.kind,
      agenda_collections.created_by,
      agenda_collections.created_at,
      agenda_collections.updated_at,
      preferences.is_visible as pref_is_visible_raw,
      preferences.position as pref_position_raw,
      greatest(
        case
          when agenda_collections.owner_user_id = current_user_id.uid then 2
          when org_flags.has_delete then 2
          when agenda_collections.visibility = 'public' then 1
          else 0
        end,
        coalesce((
          select max(
            case agenda_collection_grants.role
              when 'editor' then 2
              when 'viewer' then 1
              else 0
            end
          )
          from public.agenda_collection_grants
          where agenda_collection_grants.agenda_collection_id = agenda_collections.id
            and (
              agenda_collection_grants.user_id = current_user_id.uid
              or exists (
                select 1
                from public.team_members
                where team_members.team_id = agenda_collection_grants.team_id
                  and team_members.user_id = current_user_id.uid
              )
            )
        ), 0)
      ) as role_rank,
      (
        -- every org-shared calendar anchors, not just the default one, so a
        -- lost `is_default` flag can never hide shared events org-wide
        agenda_collections.owner_user_id is null
        or agenda_collections.owner_user_id = current_user_id.uid
        or preferences.agenda_collection_id is not null
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.agenda_collection_grants
          where agenda_collection_grants.agenda_collection_id = agenda_collections.id
            and (
              agenda_collection_grants.user_id = current_user_id.uid
              or exists (
                select 1
                from public.team_members
                where team_members.team_id = agenda_collection_grants.team_id
                  and team_members.user_id = current_user_id.uid
              )
            )
        )
      ) as has_subscribe_anchor,
      org_flags.has_view,
      org_flags.has_update,
      org_flags.has_delete,
      current_user_id.uid as uid
    from public.agenda_collections
    cross join current_user_id
    cross join org_flags
    left join public.agenda_collection_preferences as preferences
      on preferences.agenda_collection_id = agenda_collections.id
      and preferences.user_id = current_user_id.uid
    where agenda_collections.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and org_flags.has_view
      and (p_calendar_id is null or agenda_collections.id = p_calendar_id)
  )
  select
    calendar_roles.id,
    calendar_roles.organization_id,
    calendar_roles.owner_user_id,
    calendar_roles.name,
    calendar_roles.description,
    calendar_roles.color,
    calendar_roles.visibility,
    calendar_roles.source,
    calendar_roles.external_calendar_id,
    calendar_roles.is_default,
    calendar_roles.position as "position",
    calendar_roles.default_time_zone,
    calendar_roles.kind,
    calendar_roles.created_by,
    calendar_roles.created_at,
    calendar_roles.updated_at,
    coalesce(calendar_roles.pref_is_visible_raw, true) as pref_is_visible,
    calendar_roles.pref_position_raw as pref_position,
    (
      calendar_roles.role_rank >= 2
      and calendar_roles.has_update
    ) as can_edit,
    (
      calendar_roles.has_delete
      or (
        calendar_roles.has_update
        and calendar_roles.owner_user_id = calendar_roles.uid
      )
    ) as can_manage,
    (
      calendar_roles.role_rank >= 1
      and calendar_roles.has_subscribe_anchor
    ) as is_subscribed
  from calendar_roles
  where
    calendar_roles.owner_user_id = calendar_roles.uid
    or calendar_roles.has_delete
    or calendar_roles.role_rank >= 1
  order by
    coalesce(calendar_roles.pref_position_raw, calendar_roles.position),
    calendar_roles.name;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.list_document_promotions(p_organization_id uuid, p_subject_type promotion_subject_type, p_customer_id bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not public.has_any_org_permission(
    p_organization_id,
    array[
      'organization.quotes.create', 'organization.quotes.update',
      'organization.orders.create', 'organization.orders.update',
      'organization.invoices.create', 'organization.invoices.update',
      'organization.promotions.view'
    ]
  ) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'promotion access required';
  end if;

  return coalesce((
    select jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'id', promotions.id,
        'name', promotions.name,
        'code', promotions.code,
        'kind', promotions.kind,
        'value', promotions.value,
        'currency', promotions.currency,
        'appliesTo', promotions.applies_to
      )
      order by promotions.name, promotions.id
    )
    from public.promotions
    where promotions.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and public.promotion_rejection(promotions.id, p_subject_type, p_customer_id) is null
  ), '[]'::jsonb);
end;
