functions.name: list_inbox_threads
functions.definition:
begin
  if (select auth.uid()) is null
    or not (
      public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.view')
      or public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.integrations.manage')
    )
  then
    raise exception 'Not authorized to list Inbox threads'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  return query
  with visible_threads as (
    select
      channel_threads.*,
      chat_threads.archived_at,
      chat_threads.pinned_at,
      chat_threads.stream_status,
      chat_threads.title as chat_thread_title,
      connections.kind as connection_kind,
      connections.name as connection_name,
      connections.status as connection_status
    from public.inbox_threads as channel_threads
    join public.inbox_connections as connections
      on connections.id = channel_threads.connection_id
      and connections.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
    left join public.chat_threads as chat_threads
      on chat_threads.id = channel_threads.chat_thread_id
      and chat_threads.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
    where channel_threads.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and chat_threads.archived_at is null
    order by channel_threads.updated_at desc, channel_threads.id desc
    limit greatest(1, least(p_limit, 100))
    offset greatest(p_offset, 0)
  )
  select
    channel_threads.id,
    channel_threads.organization_id,
    channel_threads.connection_id,
    channel_threads.chat_thread_id,
    channel_threads.customer_id,
    channel_threads.external_thread_id,
    channel_threads.external_channel_id,
    channel_threads.external_actor_id,
    channel_threads.assigned_team_id,
    channel_threads.assigned_user_id,
    channel_threads.continuation_cursor,
    channel_threads.takeover_status,
    channel_threads.takeover_at,
    channel_threads.takeover_reason,
    channel_threads.metadata,
    channel_threads.created_at,
    channel_threads.updated_at,
    channel_threads.archived_at,
    channel_threads.chat_thread_title,
    contact_profile.avatar_path as contact_avatar_path,
    contact_profile.display_name as contact_display_name,
    contact_email.value as contact_email,
    contact_profile.first_name as contact_first_name,
    contact_profile.last_name as contact_last_name,
    contact_phone.value as contact_phone,
    channel_threads.connection_kind,
    channel_threads.connection_name,
    channel_threads.connection_status,
    latest_delivery.error_message as last_delivery_error,
    latest_delivery.status as last_delivery_status,
    latest_message.created_at as last_message_at,
    latest_message.id as last_message_id,
    latest_message.role as last_message_role,
    coalesce(
      latest_message.text,
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'lastInboundText'), '')
    ) as last_message_text,
    channel_threads.pinned_at,
    case
      when nullif(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt', '') is null then null
      else (channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt')::timestamptz
    end as read_at,
    channel_threads.stream_status,
    coalesce((channel_threads.metadata ->> 'manuallyUnread')::boolean, false)
      or (
        latest_message.role = 'user'
        and latest_message.created_at > coalesce(
          nullif(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt', '')::timestamptz,
          '-infinity'::timestamptz
        )
      ) as unread
  from visible_threads as channel_threads
  left join lateral (
    select
      messages.id,
      messages.role,
      messages.created_at,
      (
        select nullif(
          pg_catalog.btrim(
            pg_catalog.string_agg(message_part.value ->> 'text', '' order by message_part.ordinality)
          ),
          ''
        )
        from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(messages.parts)
          with ordinality as message_part(value, ordinality)
        where message_part.value ->> 'type' = 'text'
      ) as text
    from public.chat_messages as messages
    where messages.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and messages.thread_id = channel_threads.chat_thread_id
    order by messages.created_at desc, messages.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as latest_message on true
  left join lateral (
    select
      deliveries.error_message,
      deliveries.status
    from public.inbox_deliveries as deliveries
    where deliveries.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and deliveries.chat_message_id = latest_message.id
    order by deliveries.created_at desc, deliveries.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as latest_delivery on true
  left join lateral (
    select customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
    from public.customer_contacts
    where customer_contacts.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and (
        (
          channel_threads.customer_id is not null
          and customer_contacts.customer_id = channel_threads.customer_id
        )
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.contact_methods as matching_method
          where matching_method.contact_profile_id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
            and matching_method.value in (
              channel_threads.external_actor_id,
              channel_threads.external_thread_id
            )
        )
      )
    order by
      case
        when channel_threads.customer_id is not null
          and customer_contacts.customer_id = channel_threads.customer_id then 0
        when exists (
          select 1
          from public.contact_methods as actor_method
          where actor_method.contact_profile_id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
            and actor_method.value = channel_threads.external_actor_id
        ) then 1
        else 2
      end,
      customer_contacts.is_primary desc,
      customer_contacts.created_at,
      customer_contacts.id
    limit 1
  ) as contact_link on true
  left join public.contact_profiles as contact_profile
    on contact_profile.id = contact_link.contact_profile_id
  left join lateral (
    select contact_methods.value
    from public.contact_methods
    where contact_methods.contact_profile_id = contact_profile.id
      and contact_methods.type = 'email'
    order by contact_methods.position, contact_methods.id
    limit 1
  ) as contact_email on true
  left join lateral (
    select contact_methods.value
    from public.contact_methods
    where contact_methods.contact_profile_id = contact_profile.id
      and contact_methods.type in ('phone', 'whatsapp')
    order by contact_methods.position, contact_methods.id
    limit 1
  ) as contact_phone on true
  order by channel_threads.updated_at desc, channel_threads.id desc;
end;

    latest_delivery.status as last_delivery_status,
    latest_message.created_at as last_message_at,
    latest_message.id as last_message_id,
    latest_message.role as last_message_role,
    coalesce(
      latest_message.text,
      nullif(pg_catalog.btrim(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'lastInboundText'), '')
    ) as last_message_text,
    channel_threads.pinned_at,
    case
      when nullif(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt', '') is null then null
      else (channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt')::timestamptz
    end as read_at,
    channel_threads.stream_status,
    coalesce((channel_threads.metadata ->> 'manuallyUnread')::boolean, false)
      or (
        latest_message.role = 'user'
        and latest_message.created_at > coalesce(
          nullif(channel_threads.metadata ->> 'readAt', '')::timestamptz,
          '-infinity'::timestamptz
        )
      ) as unread
  from visible_threads as channel_threads
  left join lateral (
    select
      messages.id,
      messages.role,
      messages.created_at,
      (
        select nullif(
          pg_catalog.btrim(
            pg_catalog.string_agg(message_part.value ->> 'text', '' order by message_part.ordinality)
          ),
          ''
        )
        from pg_catalog.jsonb_array_elements(messages.parts)
          with ordinality as message_part(value, ordinality)
        where message_part.value ->> 'type' = 'text'
      ) as text
    from public.chat_messages as messages
    where messages.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and messages.thread_id = channel_threads.chat_thread_id
    order by messages.created_at desc, messages.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as latest_message on true
  left join lateral (
    select
      deliveries.error_message,
      deliveries.status
    from public.inbox_deliveries as deliveries
    where deliveries.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and deliveries.chat_message_id = latest_message.id
    order by deliveries.created_at desc, deliveries.id desc
    limit 1
  ) as latest_delivery on true
  left join lateral (
    select customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
    from public.customer_contacts
    where customer_contacts.organization_id = channel_threads.organization_id
      and (
        (
          channel_threads.customer_id is not null
          and customer_contacts.customer_id = channel_threads.customer_id
        )
        or exists (
          select 1
          from public.contact_methods as matching_method
          where matching_method.contact_profile_id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
            and matching_method.value in (
              channel_threads.external_actor_id,
              channel_threads.external_thread_id
            )
        )
      )
    order by
      case
        when channel_threads.customer_id is not null
          and customer_contacts.customer_id = channel_threads.customer_id then 0
        when exists (
          select 1
          from public.contact_methods as actor_method
          where actor_method.contact_profile_id = customer_contacts.contact_profile_id
            and actor_method.value = channel_threads.external_actor_id
        ) then 1
        else 2
      end,
      customer_contacts.is_primary desc,
      customer_contacts.created_at,
      customer_contacts.id
    limit 1
  ) as contact_link on true
  left join public.contact_profiles as contact_profile
    on contact_profile.id = contact_link.contact_profile_id
  left join lateral (
    select contact_methods.value
    from public.contact_methods
    where contact_methods.contact_profile_id = contact_profile.id
      and contact_methods.type = 'email'
    order by contact_methods.position, contact_methods.id
    limit 1
  ) as contact_email on true
  left join lateral (
    select contact_methods.value
    from public.contact_methods
    where contact_methods.contact_profile_id = contact_profile.id
      and contact_methods.type in ('phone', 'whatsapp')
    order by contact_methods.position, contact_methods.id
    limit 1
  ) as contact_phone on true
  order by channel_threads.updated_at desc, channel_threads.id desc;
end;
$function$

  )
  select distinct tree.id

  where tree.id not in (

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.mark_ai_memory_items_used(p_memory_ids uuid[], p_used_at timestamp with time zone, p_why_used text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_updated integer;
begin
  if coalesce(array_length(p_memory_ids, 1), 0) < 1
    or array_length(p_memory_ids, 1) > 50
  then
    raise exception 'p_memory_ids must contain between 1 and 50 ids'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if p_used_at is null
    or nullif(btrim(p_why_used), '') is null
    or length(p_why_used) > 500
  then
    raise exception 'invalid memory usage metadata'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  update public.ai_memory_items
  set
    last_used_at = p_used_at,
    use_count = ai_memory_items.use_count + 1,
    metadata = ai_memory_items.metadata || jsonb_build_object('whyUsed', p_why_used)
  where ai_memory_items.id = any (p_memory_ids)
    and ai_memory_items.user_id = (select auth.uid())
    and ai_memory_items.visibility = 'private'
    and ai_memory_items.deleted_at is null
    and (ai_memory_items.expires_at is null or ai_memory_items.expires_at > p_used_at);

  get diagnostics v_updated = row_count;
  return v_updated;
end;
$function$

declare
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  if not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.orders.view') then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'order view permission required';
  end if;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'ossWarning', (
      exists (
        select 1
        from public.order_lines
        join public.products on products.id = order_lines.product_id
        where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
          and products.product_type = 'digital'
          and order_lines.quantity > order_lines.quantity_cancelled
      )
      and not customers.is_business
      and upper(coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(orders.buyer_address_country), ''),
        nullif(btrim(orders.shipping_address_country), '')
      )) = any (array[
        'AT', 'BE', 'BG', 'CY', 'CZ', 'DE', 'DK', 'EE', 'ES', 'FI', 'FR', 'GR', 'HR', 'HU',
        'IE', 'IT', 'LT', 'LU', 'LV', 'MT', 'NL', 'PL', 'PT', 'RO', 'SE', 'SI', 'SK'
      ])
      and upper(coalesce(
        nullif(btrim(orders.buyer_address_country), ''),
        nullif(btrim(orders.shipping_address_country), '')
      )) is distinct from upper(nullif(btrim(organizations.address_country), ''))
    ),
    'lines', coalesce((
      select jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
          'orderLineId', order_lines.id,
          'title', order_lines.title,
          'delivery', products.digital_delivery,
          'quantity', order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled,
          'keysAvailable', case when products.digital_delivery = 'license_key' then (
            select count(*)
            from public.product_license_keys
            where product_license_keys.product_id = order_lines.product_id
              and (
                product_license_keys.variant_id is null
                or product_license_keys.variant_id = order_lines.variant_id
              )
              and product_license_keys.order_line_id is null
              and product_license_keys.revoked_at is null
          ) end,
          'grants', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'id', order_digital_grants.id,
                'kind', case when order_digital_grants.license_key_id is null
                  then 'file' else 'license_key' end,
                'fileName', product_digital_files.file_name,
                'licenseKey', product_license_keys.license_key,
                'downloadCount', order_digital_grants.download_count,
                'revokedAt', order_digital_grants.revoked_at,
                'createdAt', order_digital_grants.created_at
              )
              order by order_digital_grants.created_at, order_digital_grants.id
            )
            from public.order_digital_grants
            left join public.product_digital_files
              on product_digital_files.id = order_digital_grants.digital_file_id
            left join public.product_license_keys
              on product_license_keys.id = order_digital_grants.license_key_id
            where order_digital_grants.order_line_id = order_lines.id
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
        order by order_lines.position, order_lines.id
      )
      from public.order_lines
      join public.products on products.id = order_lines.product_id
      where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
        and products.product_type = 'digital'
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into v_result
  from public.orders
  join public.customers on customers.id = orders.customer_id
  join public.organizations on organizations.id = orders.organization_id
  where orders.id = p_order_id
    and orders.organization_id = p_organization_id;

  if v_result is null then
    raise exception 'order not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return v_result;
end;

                'revokedAt', order_digital_grants.revoked_at,
                'createdAt', order_digital_grants.created_at
              )
              order by order_digital_grants.created_at, order_digital_grants.id
            )
            from public.order_digital_grants
            left join public.product_digital_files
              on product_digital_files.id = order_digital_grants.digital_file_id
            left join public.product_license_keys
              on product_license_keys.id = order_digital_grants.license_key_id
            where order_digital_grants.order_line_id = order_lines.id
          ), '[]'::jsonb)
        )
        order by order_lines.position, order_lines.id
      )
      from public.order_lines
      join public.products on products.id = order_lines.product_id
      where order_lines.order_id = orders.id
        and products.product_type = 'digital'
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  )
  into v_result
  from public.orders
  join public.customers on customers.id = orders.customer_id
  join public.organizations on organizations.id = orders.organization_id
  where orders.id = p_order_id
    and orders.organization_id = p_organization_id;

  if v_result is null then
    raise exception 'order not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$

functions.name: patch_ai_message_outbox_metadata
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.patch_ai_message_outbox_metadata(p_message_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text, p_expected_state text, p_state text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_current_state text;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'patch_ai_message_outbox_metadata requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_expected_state not in ('pending', 'running')
    or p_state not in ('running', 'completed', 'failed', 'cancelled')
  then
    raise exception 'invalid outbox state'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select message.metadata ->> 'outboxState'
  into v_current_state
  from public.chat_messages as message
  join public.ai_agent_runs as run
    on run.id = p_run_id
  where message.id = p_message_id
    and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and message.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and message.created_by = p_actor_user_id
    and message.role = 'user'
    and message.dispatch_linked_at is not null
    and message.metadata ->> 'activeStreamId' = p_active_stream_id
    and message.metadata ->> 'agentRunId' = p_run_id::text
    and message.metadata ->> 'workflowRunId' = p_workflow_run_id
    and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and run.created_by = p_actor_user_id
    and run.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
  for update of message;

  if not found then
    return false;
  end if;

  if v_current_state = p_state then
    return true;
  end if;

  if v_current_state is distinct from p_expected_state then
    return false;
  end if;

  update public.chat_messages
  set metadata = chat_messages.metadata || jsonb_build_object(
    'localEventIndex',
    coalesce((chat_messages.metadata ->> 'localEventIndex')::integer, 0) + 1,
    'outboxState',
    p_state,
    'workflowRunId',
    p_workflow_run_id
  )
  where chat_messages.id = p_message_id;

  return true;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_message_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text, p_expected_state text, p_state text
functions.identity_argument_types: p_message_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid, p_run_id uuid, p_active_stream_id text, p_workflow_run_id text, p_expected_state text, p_state text

functions.definition:
declare
  v_on date := coalesce(p_on, (now() at time zone 'utc')::date);
begin
  update public.time_off_requests as requests
  set ends_on = v_on
  from public.sick_leave_cases as cases
  where cases.time_off_request_id = requests.id
    and cases.organization_id = requests.organization_id
    and cases.status <> 'closed'
    and requests.status = 'approved'
    and requests.ends_on < v_on;

  return query
  select
    cases.organization_id,
    cases.employee_id,
    cases.id,
    cases.reported_on,
    (
      cases.expected_return_on is null
      and extract(isodow from v_on) = 1
      and cases.reported_on <= v_on - 7
    )
  from public.sick_leave_cases as cases
  where cases.status <> 'closed';
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promotion_document_basis(p_subject_type promotion_subject_type, p_subject_id uuid, OUT subtotal numeric, OUT quantity numeric)
 RETURNS record
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if p_subject_type = 'quote' then
    select coalesce(quotes.subtotal_excl, 0) into subtotal
    from public.quotes where quotes.id = p_subject_id;
    select coalesce(sum(quote_lines.quantity), 0) into quantity
    from public.quote_lines
    where quote_lines.quote_id = p_subject_id
      and quote_lines.kind = 'line'
      and not quote_lines.is_optional;
  elsif p_subject_type = 'order' then
    select coalesce(orders.subtotal_excl, 0) into subtotal
    from public.orders where orders.id = p_subject_id;
    select coalesce(sum(order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled), 0) into quantity
    from public.order_lines
    where order_lines.order_id = p_subject_id and order_lines.line_type <> 'shipping';
  else
    select coalesce(invoices.subtotal_excl, 0) into subtotal
    from public.invoices where invoices.id = p_subject_id;
    select coalesce(sum(invoice_lines.quantity), 0) into quantity
    from public.invoice_lines
    where invoice_lines.invoice_id = p_subject_id and invoice_lines.kind = 'line';
  end if;
end;
$function$

functions.name: promotion_redemption_amount
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promotion_redemption_amount(p_subject_type promotion_subject_type, p_subject_id uuid, p_promotion_id uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_lines numeric := 0;
  v_after_lines numeric := 0;
  v_kind public.discount_kind;
  v_value numeric;
  v_header uuid;
begin
  if p_subject_type = 'quote' then
    select
      coalesce(sum(case when quote_lines.promotion_id = p_promotion_id then
        case quote_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then quote_lines.quantity * quote_lines.unit_price * quote_lines.discount_value / 100
          when 'fixed' then least(quote_lines.discount_value, quote_lines.quantity * quote_lines.unit_price)
          else 0 end
        else 0 end), 0),
      coalesce(sum(quote_lines.quantity * quote_lines.unit_price - case quote_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then quote_lines.quantity * quote_lines.unit_price * quote_lines.discount_value / 100
          when 'fixed' then least(quote_lines.discount_value, quote_lines.quantity * quote_lines.unit_price)
          else 0 end), 0)
    into v_lines, v_after_lines
    from public.quote_lines
    where quote_lines.quote_id = p_subject_id
      and quote_lines.kind = 'line'
      and not quote_lines.is_optional;
    select quotes.promotion_id, quotes.discount_kind, quotes.discount_value
    into v_header, v_kind, v_value
    from public.quotes where quotes.id = p_subject_id;
  elsif p_subject_type = 'order' then
    select
      coalesce(sum(case when order_lines.promotion_id = p_promotion_id then
        case order_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then (order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled) * order_lines.unit_price * order_lines.discount_value / 100
          when 'fixed' then least(order_lines.discount_value, (order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled) * order_lines.unit_price)
          else 0 end
        else 0 end), 0),
      coalesce(sum((order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled) * order_lines.unit_price - case order_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then (order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled) * order_lines.unit_price * order_lines.discount_value / 100
          when 'fixed' then least(order_lines.discount_value, (order_lines.quantity - order_lines.quantity_cancelled) * order_lines.unit_price)
          else 0 end), 0)
    into v_lines, v_after_lines
    from public.order_lines
    where order_lines.order_id = p_subject_id;
    select orders.promotion_id, orders.discount_kind, orders.discount_value
    into v_header, v_kind, v_value
    from public.orders where orders.id = p_subject_id;
  else
    select
      coalesce(sum(case when invoice_lines.promotion_id = p_promotion_id then
        case invoice_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price * invoice_lines.discount_value / 100
          when 'fixed' then least(invoice_lines.discount_value, invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price)
          else 0 end
        else 0 end), 0),
      coalesce(sum(invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price - case invoice_lines.discount_kind
          when 'percentage' then invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price * invoice_lines.discount_value / 100
          when 'fixed' then least(invoice_lines.discount_value, invoice_lines.quantity * invoice_lines.unit_price)
          else 0 end), 0)
    into v_lines, v_after_lines
    from public.invoice_lines
    where invoice_lines.invoice_id = p_subject_id and invoice_lines.kind = 'line';
    select invoices.promotion_id, invoices.discount_kind, invoices.discount_value
    into v_header, v_kind, v_value
    from public.invoices where invoices.id = p_subject_id;
  end if;

  if v_header is not distinct from p_promotion_id then
    v_lines := v_lines + case v_kind
      when 'percentage' then greatest(v_after_lines, 0) * v_value / 100
      when 'fixed' then least(v_value, greatest(v_after_lines, 0))
      else 0 end;
  end if;
  return round(greatest(v_lines, 0), 2);
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_subject_type promotion_subject_type, p_subject_id uuid, p_promotion_id uuid
functions.identity_argument_types: p_subject_type promotion_subject_type, p_subject_id uuid, p_promotion_id uuid

functions.name: publish_quote_version
functions.definition:
declare
  v_quote public.quotes%rowtype;
  v_next_version integer;
  v_version_id uuid;
begin
  select * into v_quote
  from public.quotes
  where id = p_quote_id
  for update;

  if v_quote.id is null then
    raise exception 'quote not found';
  end if;

  select coalesce(max(qv.version), 0) + 1
  into v_next_version
  from public.quote_versions qv
  where qv.quote_id = p_quote_id;

  insert into public.quote_versions (
    quote_id, organization_id, version, status, title, intro, terms, public_message,
    valid_until, currency, vat_inclusive, discount_kind, discount_value,
    discount_description, subtotal_excl, vat_total, total_incl, published_by,
    issue_date, vat_regime,
    seller_name, seller_address_line1, seller_address_line2, seller_address_postal_code,
    seller_address_city, seller_address_country, seller_email, seller_phone,
    seller_kvk, seller_btw, seller_iban,
    buyer_name, buyer_address_line1, buyer_address_line2, buyer_address_postal_code,
    buyer_address_city, buyer_address_country, buyer_email, buyer_kvk, buyer_btw,
    terms_rich_text, terms_url, terms_pdf_file_id, terms_pdf_version_id,
    deposit_kind, deposit_value, deposit_required_to_accept
  )
  values (
    v_quote.id, v_quote.organization_id, v_next_version, 'sent', v_quote.title,
    v_quote.intro, v_quote.terms, v_quote.public_message, v_quote.valid_until,
    v_quote.currency, v_quote.vat_inclusive, v_quote.discount_kind, v_quote.discount_value,
    v_quote.discount_description,
    v_quote.subtotal_excl, v_quote.vat_total, v_quote.total_incl, p_actor_user_id,
    v_quote.issue_date, v_quote.vat_regime,
    v_quote.seller_name, v_quote.seller_address_line1, v_quote.seller_address_line2,
    v_quote.seller_address_postal_code, v_quote.seller_address_city,
    v_quote.seller_address_country, v_quote.seller_email, v_quote.seller_phone,
    v_quote.seller_kvk, v_quote.seller_btw, v_quote.seller_iban,
    v_quote.buyer_name, v_quote.buyer_address_line1, v_quote.buyer_address_line2,
    v_quote.buyer_address_postal_code, v_quote.buyer_address_city,
    v_quote.buyer_address_country, v_quote.buyer_email, v_quote.buyer_kvk, v_quote.buyer_btw,
    v_quote.terms_rich_text, v_quote.terms_url, v_quote.terms_pdf_file_id,
    v_quote.terms_pdf_version_id,
    v_quote.deposit_kind, v_quote.deposit_value, v_quote.deposit_required_to_accept
  )
  returning id into v_version_id;

  insert into public.quote_version_lines (
    organization_id, quote_version_id, source_line_id, kind, line_type, product_id, task_id,
    title, description, quantity, unit, unit_price, vat_rate, discount_kind, discount_value,
    is_optional, pricing_mode, subscription_interval, subscription_periods, position, stock_mode,
    variant_id
  )
  select
    l.organization_id, v_version_id, l.id, l.kind, l.line_type, l.product_id, l.task_id,

functions.name: publish_workflow_definition
functions.definition:
declare
  v_source public.workflow_definitions;
  v_previous_id uuid;
  v_previous_is_default boolean := false;
  v_published public.workflow_definitions;
  v_now timestamptz := now();
begin
  select * into v_source
  from public.workflow_definitions
  where id = p_definition_id
  for update;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'workflow definition not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  if auth.role() is distinct from 'service_role' then
    if v_source.owner_scope = 'system' then
      if not public.authorize_scope('system', null, 'system.workflows.manage') then
        raise exception 'not allowed to publish system workflows' using errcode = '42501';
      end if;
    elsif not public.has_org_permission(v_source.organization_id, 'organization.workflows.update') then
      raise exception 'not allowed to publish this workflow' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;
  end if;

  if v_source.status = 'archived' then
    raise exception 'archived workflow definitions cannot be published' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

  select id, is_default into v_previous_id, v_previous_is_default
  from public.workflow_definitions
  where key = v_source.key
    and owner_scope = v_source.owner_scope
    and organization_id is not distinct from v_source.organization_id
    and status = 'published'
  order by version desc
  limit 1;

  -- Republishing a published row archives it too and publishes a copy as the next version.
  update public.workflow_definitions
  set status = 'archived', archived_at = v_now
  where key = v_source.key
    and owner_scope = v_source.owner_scope
    and organization_id is not distinct from v_source.organization_id
    and status = 'published';

  delete from public.workflow_schedules s
  using public.workflow_definitions d
  where s.definition_id = d.id
    and d.key = v_source.key
    and d.owner_scope = v_source.owner_scope
    and d.organization_id is not distinct from v_source.organization_id
    and d.status = 'archived';

  -- The published rows were just archived, so the default flag can move onto
  -- the new version without tripping the one-default-per-subject index.
  update public.workflow_definitions
  set is_default = false
  where key = v_source.key
    and owner_scope = v_source.owner_scope
    and organization_id is not distinct from v_source.organization_id
    and status = 'archived'
    and is_default;

  if v_source.status = 'draft' then
    update public.workflow_definitions
    set
      status = 'published',
      published_at = v_now,
      archived_at = null,
      is_default = coalesce(v_previous_is_default, false) or v_source.is_default
    where id = v_source.id
    returning * into v_published;
  else
    insert into public.workflow_definitions (
      organization_id, owner_scope, key, name, description, status, version, visibility,
      graph, metadata, created_by, published_at, purpose, subject_type,
      forked_from_definition_id, forked_from_version, is_default
    )
    select
      v_source.organization_id, v_source.owner_scope, v_source.key, v_source.name,
      v_source.description, 'published',
      (
        select max(version) + 1 from public.workflow_definitions
        where key = v_source.key
          and owner_scope = v_source.owner_scope
          and organization_id is not distinct from v_source.organization_id
      ),
      v_source.visibility, v_source.graph, v_source.metadata, v_source.created_by, v_now,
      v_source.purpose, v_source.subject_type, v_source.forked_from_definition_id,
      v_source.forked_from_version, coalesce(v_previous_is_default, false) or v_source.is_default
    returning * into v_published;
  end if;

  if v_previous_id is not null and v_published.organization_id is not null then
    insert into public.workflow_grants (definition_id, organization_id, team_id, user_id, created_by)
    select v_published.id, g.organization_id, g.team_id, g.user_id, g.created_by
    from public.workflow_grants g
    where g.definition_id = v_previous_id
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.workflow_grants existing
        where existing.definition_id = v_published.id
      );

    insert into public.notification_subscriptions (organization_id, user_id, subject_type, subject_id, level)
    select ns.organization_id, ns.user_id, ns.subject_type, v_published.id::text, ns.level
    from public.notification_subscriptions ns
    where ns.subject_type = 'workflow'
      and ns.subject_id = v_previous_id::text
    on conflict (organization_id, user_id, subject_type, subject_id) do nothing;
  end if;

  return v_published;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_owner_allocations(p_organization_id uuid, p_product_id uuid, p_target_quantity numeric, p_task_material_id uuid, p_quote_version_line_id uuid, p_invoice_line_id uuid, p_reason text, p_quote_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid, p_created_by uuid)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_held numeric(12, 3);
begin
  perform public.lock_product_stock(p_organization_id, p_product_id);

  v_held := public.allocation_owner_quantity(
    p_organization_id,
    p_task_material_id,
    p_quote_version_line_id,
    p_invoice_line_id,
    'reserved'
  );

  if v_held > p_target_quantity then
    perform public.release_allocations(
      p_organization_id,
      p_task_material_id,
      p_quote_version_line_id,
      p_invoice_line_id,
      v_held - p_target_quantity,
      p_reason,
      p_created_by
    );
  elsif v_held < p_target_quantity then
    perform public.allocate_product_stock(
      p_organization_id,
      p_product_id,
      p_target_quantity - v_held,
      p_task_material_id,
      p_quote_version_line_id,
      p_invoice_line_id,
      p_reason,
      p_quote_id,
      p_invoice_id,
      p_created_by
    );
  end if;

  v_held := public.allocation_owner_quantity(
    p_organization_id,
    p_task_material_id,
    p_quote_version_line_id,
    p_invoice_line_id,
    'reserved'
  );

  if p_task_material_id is not null then
    perform public.sync_task_material_backorder(
      p_organization_id,
      p_task_material_id,
      greatest(p_target_quantity - v_held, 0)
    );
  end if;

  return v_held;
end;
$function$

functions.name: reconcile_quote_version_stock
functions.definition:
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_product_id uuid;
  v_new_line record;
  v_old_line record;
  v_need numeric(12, 3);
  v_moved numeric(12, 3);
  v_held numeric(12, 3);
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.quotes
    where quotes.id = p_quote_id
      and public.has_org_permission(quotes.organization_id, 'organization.quotes.update')
  ) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'quote update permission required';
  end if;

  select quotes.organization_id
  into v_org_id
  from public.quotes
  where quotes.id = p_quote_id;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'quote not found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  for v_product_id in
    select distinct lines.product_id
    from (
      select quote_version_lines.product_id
      from public.quote_version_lines
      where quote_version_lines.quote_version_id = p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id is not null
      union
      select quote_version_lines.product_id
      from public.quote_version_lines
      join public.quote_versions
        on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
      join public.inventory_allocations
        on inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
        and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
      where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
        and quote_versions.id <> p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id is not null
    ) lines
  loop
    for v_new_line in
      select quote_version_lines.id, quote_version_lines.quantity
      from public.quote_version_lines
      where quote_version_lines.quote_version_id = p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.organization_id = v_org_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id = v_product_id
        and quote_version_lines.kind = 'line'
        and quote_version_lines.line_type = 'product'
        and quote_version_lines.stock_mode = 'auto'
        and quote_version_lines.pricing_mode <> 'subscription'
        and quote_version_lines.quantity > 0
      order by quote_version_lines.position, quote_version_lines.id
    loop
      v_need := v_new_line.quantity;

      for v_old_line in
        select
          quote_version_lines.id,
          coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) as held
        from public.quote_version_lines
        join public.quote_versions
          on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
        join public.inventory_allocations
          on inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
          and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
        where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
          and quote_versions.id <> p_version_id
          and quote_version_lines.product_id = v_product_id
        group by quote_version_lines.id
        having coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) > 0
        order by quote_version_lines.position, quote_version_lines.id
      loop
        exit when v_need <= 0;
        v_moved := public.transfer_allocations(
          v_org_id,
          v_product_id,
          least(v_old_line.held, v_need),
          null,
          v_old_line.id,
          null,
          null,
          v_new_line.id,
          null,
          'quote version republished',
          p_actor_user_id
        );
        v_need := v_need - v_moved;
      end loop;

      v_held := public.allocation_owner_quantity(
        v_org_id,
        null,
        v_new_line.id,
        null,
        'reserved'
      );

      if v_held < v_new_line.quantity then
        perform public.allocate_product_stock(
          v_org_id,
          v_product_id,
          v_new_line.quantity - v_held,
          null,
          v_new_line.id,
          null,
          'quote line reserved',

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.reconcile_quote_version_stock(p_quote_id uuid, p_version_id uuid, p_actor_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_org_id uuid;
  v_product_id uuid;
  v_new_line record;
  v_old_line record;
  v_need numeric(12, 3);
  v_moved numeric(12, 3);
  v_held numeric(12, 3);
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.quotes
    where quotes.id = p_quote_id
      and public.has_org_permission(quotes.organization_id, 'organization.quotes.update')
  ) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'quote update permission required';
  end if;

  select quotes.organization_id
  into v_org_id
  from public.quotes
  where quotes.id = p_quote_id;

  if v_org_id is null then
    raise exception 'quote not found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  for v_product_id in
    select distinct lines.product_id
    from (
      select quote_version_lines.product_id
      from public.quote_version_lines
      where quote_version_lines.quote_version_id = p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id is not null
      union
      select quote_version_lines.product_id
      from public.quote_version_lines
      join public.quote_versions
        on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
      join public.inventory_allocations
        on inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
        and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
      where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
        and quote_versions.id <> p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id is not null
    ) lines
  loop
    for v_new_line in
      select quote_version_lines.id, quote_version_lines.quantity
      from public.quote_version_lines
      where quote_version_lines.quote_version_id = p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.organization_id = v_org_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id = v_product_id
        and quote_version_lines.kind = 'line'
        and quote_version_lines.line_type = 'product'
        and quote_version_lines.stock_mode = 'auto'
        and quote_version_lines.pricing_mode <> 'subscription'
        and quote_version_lines.quantity > 0
      order by quote_version_lines.position, quote_version_lines.id
    loop
      v_need := v_new_line.quantity;

      for v_old_line in
        select
          quote_version_lines.id,
          coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) as held
        from public.quote_version_lines
        join public.quote_versions
          on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
        join public.inventory_allocations
          on inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
          and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
        where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
          and quote_versions.id <> p_version_id
          and quote_version_lines.product_id = v_product_id
        group by quote_version_lines.id
        having coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) > 0
        order by quote_version_lines.position, quote_version_lines.id
      loop
        exit when v_need <= 0;
        v_moved := public.transfer_allocations(
          v_org_id,
          v_product_id,
          least(v_old_line.held, v_need),
          null,
          v_old_line.id,
          null,
          null,
          v_new_line.id,
          null,
          'quote version republished',
          p_actor_user_id
        );
        v_need := v_need - v_moved;
      end loop;

      v_held := public.allocation_owner_quantity(
        v_org_id,
        null,
        v_new_line.id,
        null,
        'reserved'
      );

      if v_held < v_new_line.quantity then
        perform public.allocate_product_stock(
          v_org_id,
          v_product_id,
          v_new_line.quantity - v_held,
          null,
          v_new_line.id,
          null,
          'quote line reserved',
          p_quote_id,
          null,
          p_actor_user_id
        );
      end if;
    end loop;

    for v_old_line in
      select quote_version_lines.id
      from public.quote_version_lines
      join public.quote_versions
        on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
      where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
        and quote_versions.id <> p_version_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id = v_product_id
        and exists (
          select 1
          from public.inventory_allocations
          where inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
            and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
        )
    loop
      perform public.release_allocations(
        v_org_id,
        null,
        v_old_line.id,
        null,
        null,
        'quote version replaced',
        p_actor_user_id
      );
    end loop;
  end loop;
end;

functions.definition:
declare
  v_events jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_telemetry_id uuid;
  v_usage_events jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'record_ai_turn_usage requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_status is null
    or p_status not in ('started', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')
    or (p_input_tokens is not null and p_input_tokens < 0)
    or (p_output_tokens is not null and p_output_tokens < 0)
    or (p_duration_ms is not null and p_duration_ms < 0)
    or p_metadata is null
    or jsonb_typeof(p_metadata) <> 'object'
  then
    raise exception 'invalid AI turn usage values'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.organizations
    where organizations.id = p_organization_id
      and organizations.disabled_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'active organization not found'
      using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  if p_thread_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_threads
    where chat_threads.id = p_thread_id
      and chat_threads.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'thread does not belong to organization'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_workflow_run_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_agent_runs
    where ai_agent_runs.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and ai_agent_runs.thread_id is not distinct from p_thread_id
      and ai_agent_runs.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'workflow run correlation is invalid'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select ai_telemetry_events.id
  into v_telemetry_id
  from public.ai_telemetry_events
  where ai_telemetry_events.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and ai_telemetry_events.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key || ':model';

  if v_telemetry_id is not null and exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_telemetry_events
    where ai_telemetry_events.id = v_telemetry_id
      and (
        ai_telemetry_events.user_id is distinct from p_user_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.thread_id is distinct from p_thread_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.workflow_run_id is distinct from p_workflow_run_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.request_id is distinct from p_request_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.kind is distinct from 'model_call'
        or ai_telemetry_events.name is distinct from p_name
        or ai_telemetry_events.provider is distinct from p_provider
        or ai_telemetry_events.model is distinct from p_model
        or ai_telemetry_events.status is distinct from p_status
        or ai_telemetry_events.input_tokens is distinct from p_input_tokens
        or ai_telemetry_events.output_tokens is distinct from p_output_tokens
        or ai_telemetry_events.duration_ms is distinct from p_duration_ms
        or ai_telemetry_events.metadata is distinct from (
          p_metadata || jsonb_build_object('functionId', p_function_id)
        )
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'telemetry idempotency key reused with different data'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  if v_telemetry_id is null then
    insert into public.ai_telemetry_events (
      organization_id,
      user_id,
      thread_id,
      workflow_run_id,
      request_id,
      kind,
      status,
      name,
      provider,
      model,
      input_tokens,
      output_tokens,
      cost_micros,
      duration_ms,
      error_code,
      error_message,
      metadata,
      idempotency_key
    )
    values (
      p_organization_id,
      p_user_id,
      p_thread_id,
      p_workflow_run_id,
      p_request_id,
      'model_call',
      p_status,
      p_name,
      p_provider,
      p_model,
      p_input_tokens,
      p_output_tokens,
      null,
      p_duration_ms,
      null,
      null,
      coalesce(p_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('functionId', p_function_id),
      p_idempotency_key || ':model'
    )
    on conflict do nothing
    returning id into v_telemetry_id;

    if v_telemetry_id is null then
      select ai_telemetry_events.id
      into v_telemetry_id
      from public.ai_telemetry_events
      where ai_telemetry_events.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and ai_telemetry_events.idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key || ':model';
    end if;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_telemetry_events
    where ai_telemetry_events.id = v_telemetry_id
      and (
        ai_telemetry_events.user_id is distinct from p_user_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.thread_id is distinct from p_thread_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.workflow_run_id is distinct from p_workflow_run_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.request_id is distinct from p_request_id
        or ai_telemetry_events.kind is distinct from 'model_call'
        or ai_telemetry_events.name is distinct from p_name
        or ai_telemetry_events.provider is distinct from p_provider
        or ai_telemetry_events.model is distinct from p_model
        or ai_telemetry_events.status is distinct from p_status
        or ai_telemetry_events.input_tokens is distinct from p_input_tokens
        or ai_telemetry_events.output_tokens is distinct from p_output_tokens
        or ai_telemetry_events.duration_ms is distinct from p_duration_ms
        or ai_telemetry_events.metadata is distinct from (
          p_metadata || jsonb_build_object('functionId', p_function_id)
        )
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'telemetry idempotency key reused with different data'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  if coalesce(p_input_tokens, 0) > 0 then
    v_events := v_events || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'billable', true,
      'idempotency_key', p_idempotency_key || ':input',
      'metadata', p_metadata,
      'meter_key', 'ai.input_tokens',
      'quantity', p_input_tokens,
      'source', 'ai',
      'source_id', coalesce(p_source_id, p_request_id),
      'user_id', p_user_id
    ));
  end if;

  if coalesce(p_output_tokens, 0) > 0 then
    v_events := v_events || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
      'billable', true,
      'idempotency_key', p_idempotency_key || ':output',
      'metadata', p_metadata,
      'meter_key', 'ai.output_tokens',
      'quantity', p_output_tokens,
      'source', 'ai',
      'source_id', coalesce(p_source_id, p_request_id),
      'user_id', p_user_id
    ));
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(v_events) > 0 then
    v_usage_events := public.record_usage_events_bulk(
      p_organization_id,
      v_events,
      p_at
    );
  end if;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'telemetry_event_id', v_telemetry_id,
    'usage_events', v_usage_events
  );
end;

functions.name: record_audit_log_event
functions.definition:
declare
  v_actor_id uuid;
  v_actor_kind text;
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_organization_name text;
begin
  if pg_column_size(coalesce(p_safe_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) > 4096 then
    raise exception 'Audit safe metadata exceeds 4 KiB';
  end if;

  if pg_column_size(coalesce(p_restricted_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) > 4096 then
    raise exception 'Audit restricted metadata exceeds 4 KiB';
  end if;

  if auth.role() = 'service_role' then
    v_actor_id := p_actor_id;
    v_actor_kind := p_actor_kind;
  else
    v_actor_id := auth.uid();
    v_actor_kind := 'user';
  end if;

  if p_organization_id is not null then
    select name
    into v_organization_name
    from public.organizations
    where id = p_organization_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    organization_id,
    organization_name_snapshot,
    scope,
    actor_kind,
    actor_id,
    actor_display_name,
    actor_is_platform_admin,
    event_type,
    category,
    outcome,
    source,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    target_display_name,
    summary,
    request_id,
    correlation_id,
    safe_metadata,
    idempotency_key
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    v_organization_name,
    p_scope,
    v_actor_kind,
    v_actor_id,
    p_actor_display_name,
    p_actor_is_platform_admin,
    p_event_type,
    p_category,
    p_outcome,
    p_source,
    p_target_type,
    p_target_id,
    p_target_display_name,
    p_summary,
    p_request_id,
    p_correlation_id,
    coalesce(p_safe_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    p_idempotency_key
  )
  on conflict (idempotency_key) where idempotency_key is not null
  do nothing
  returning id into v_event_id;

  if v_event_id is null and p_idempotency_key is not null then
    select id
    into v_event_id
    from public.audit_logs
    where idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
  end if;

  if p_ip_address is not null
    or p_user_agent is not null
    or p_session_id is not null
    or coalesce(p_restricted_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) <> '{}'::jsonb
  then
    insert into public.audit_log_restricted_details (
      event_id,
      ip_address,
      user_agent,
      session_id,
      restricted_metadata
    )
    values (
      v_event_id,
      p_ip_address,
      p_user_agent,
      p_session_id,
      coalesce(p_restricted_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
    )

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_audit_log_event(p_organization_id uuid, p_scope text, p_actor_kind text, p_actor_id uuid, p_actor_display_name text, p_actor_is_platform_admin boolean, p_event_type text, p_category text, p_outcome text, p_source text, p_target_type text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_target_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_target_display_name text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_summary text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_request_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_correlation_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_safe_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb, p_idempotency_key text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_ip_address inet DEFAULT NULL::inet, p_user_agent text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_session_id text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_restricted_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_id uuid;
  v_actor_kind text;
  v_event_id uuid;
  v_organization_name text;
begin
  if pg_column_size(coalesce(p_safe_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) > 4096 then
    raise exception 'Audit safe metadata exceeds 4 KiB';
  end if;

  if pg_column_size(coalesce(p_restricted_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)) > 4096 then
    raise exception 'Audit restricted metadata exceeds 4 KiB';
  end if;

  if auth.role() = 'service_role' then
    v_actor_id := p_actor_id;
    v_actor_kind := p_actor_kind;
  else
    v_actor_id := auth.uid();
    v_actor_kind := 'user';
  end if;

  if p_organization_id is not null then
    select name
    into v_organization_name
    from public.organizations
    where id = p_organization_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.audit_logs (
    organization_id,
    organization_name_snapshot,
    scope,
    actor_kind,
    actor_id,
    actor_display_name,
    actor_is_platform_admin,
    event_type,
    category,
    outcome,
    source,
    target_type,
    target_id,
    target_display_name,
    summary,
    request_id,
    correlation_id,
    safe_metadata,
    idempotency_key
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    v_organization_name,
    p_scope,
    v_actor_kind,
    v_actor_id,
    p_actor_display_name,
    p_actor_is_platform_admin,
    p_event_type,
    p_category,
    p_outcome,
    p_source,
    p_target_type,
    p_target_id,
    p_target_display_name,
    p_summary,
    p_request_id,
    p_correlation_id,
    coalesce(p_safe_metadata, '{}'::jsonb),
    p_idempotency_key
  )
  on conflict (idempotency_key) where idempotency_key is not null
  do nothing
  returning id into v_event_id;

  if v_event_id is null and p_idempotency_key is not null then
    select id
    into v_event_id
    from public.audit_logs
    where idempotency_key = p_idempotency_key;
  end if;

  if p_ip_address is not null
    or p_user_agent is not null
    or p_session_id is not null
    or coalesce(p_restricted_metadata, '{}'::jsonb) <> '{}'::jsonb
  then
    insert into public.audit_log_restricted_details (
      event_id,
      ip_address,
      user_agent,
      session_id,
      restricted_metadata
    )
    values (
      v_event_id,
      p_ip_address,
      p_user_agent,
      p_session_id,
      coalesce(p_restricted_metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
    )
    on conflict (event_id) do nothing;
  end if;

  return v_event_id;
end;

declare
  v_inserted jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_period_end timestamptz;
  v_period_start timestamptz;
  v_result jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'record_usage_events_bulk requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if jsonb_typeof(p_events) <> 'array'
    or jsonb_array_length(p_events) < 1
    or jsonb_array_length(p_events) > 100
  then
    raise exception 'p_events must contain between 1 and 100 events'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.organizations
    where organizations.id = p_organization_id
      and organizations.disabled_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'active organization not found'
      using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  v_period_start := date_trunc('month', p_at at time zone 'utc') at time zone 'utc';
  v_period_end := (
    date_trunc('month', p_at at time zone 'utc') + interval '1 month'
  ) at time zone 'utc';

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
    where nullif(event ->> 'idempotency_key', '') is null
      or length(event ->> 'idempotency_key') > 240
      or nullif(event ->> 'meter_key', '') is null
      or nullif(event ->> 'source', '') is null
      or coalesce((event ->> 'quantity')::numeric, 0) <= 0
      or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(event -> 'metadata', '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object'
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid bulk usage event'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if (
    select count(*)
    from (
      select event ->> 'idempotency_key'
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
      group by event ->> 'idempotency_key'
      having count(*) > 1
    ) as duplicate_keys
  ) > 0 then
    raise exception 'duplicate idempotency key in usage batch'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if exists (
    with parsed_events as (
      select
        event ->> 'idempotency_key' as idempotency_key,
        (event ->> 'billable')::boolean as billable,
        event ->> 'meter_key' as meter_key,
        coalesce(event -> 'metadata', '{}'::jsonb) as metadata,
        (event ->> 'quantity')::numeric as quantity,
        event ->> 'source' as source,
        event ->> 'source_id' as source_id,
        (event ->> 'user_id')::uuid as user_id
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
    )
    select 1
    from parsed_events
    join public.organization_usage_events
      on organization_usage_events.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and organization_usage_events.idempotency_key = parsed_events.idempotency_key
    where organization_usage_events.meter_key <> parsed_events.meter_key
      or organization_usage_events.quantity <> parsed_events.quantity
      or organization_usage_events.source <> parsed_events.source
      or organization_usage_events.source_id is distinct from parsed_events.source_id
      or organization_usage_events.user_id is distinct from parsed_events.user_id
      or organization_usage_events.billable <> parsed_events.billable
      or organization_usage_events.metadata <> parsed_events.metadata
  ) then
    raise exception 'usage idempotency key reused with different data'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  with
    parsed_events as (
      select
        event ->> 'idempotency_key' as idempotency_key,
        coalesce((event ->> 'billable')::boolean, true) as billable,
        event ->> 'meter_key' as meter_key,
        coalesce(event -> 'metadata', '{}'::jsonb) as metadata,
        (event ->> 'quantity')::numeric as quantity,
        event ->> 'source' as source,
        nullif(event ->> 'source_id', '') as source_id,
        nullif(event ->> 'user_id', '')::uuid as user_id
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
    ),
    validated_events as (
      select *
      from parsed_events
      where idempotency_key is not null
        and length(idempotency_key) between 1 and 240
        and quantity > 0
    ),
    inserted_events as (
      insert into public.organization_usage_events (
        organization_id,
        meter_key,
        user_id,
        quantity,
        source,
        source_id,
        idempotency_key,
        period_start,
        period_end,
        billable,
        metadata
      )
      select
        p_organization_id,
        validated_events.meter_key,
        validated_events.user_id,
        validated_events.quantity,
        validated_events.source,
        validated_events.source_id,
        validated_events.idempotency_key,
        v_period_start,
        v_period_end,
        validated_events.billable,
        validated_events.metadata
      from validated_events
      on conflict do nothing
      returning *
    )
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(inserted_events)), '[]'::jsonb)
  into v_inserted
  from inserted_events;

  if exists (
    with parsed_events as (
      select
        event ->> 'idempotency_key' as idempotency_key,
        coalesce((event ->> 'billable')::boolean, true) as billable,
        event ->> 'meter_key' as meter_key,
        coalesce(event -> 'metadata', '{}'::jsonb) as metadata,
        (event ->> 'quantity')::numeric as quantity,
        event ->> 'source' as source,
        nullif(event ->> 'source_id', '') as source_id,
        nullif(event ->> 'user_id', '')::uuid as user_id
      from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
    )
    select 1
    from parsed_events
    join public.organization_usage_events
      on organization_usage_events.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and organization_usage_events.idempotency_key = parsed_events.idempotency_key
    where organization_usage_events.meter_key <> parsed_events.meter_key
      or organization_usage_events.quantity <> parsed_events.quantity
      or organization_usage_events.source <> parsed_events.source
      or organization_usage_events.source_id is distinct from parsed_events.source_id
      or organization_usage_events.user_id is distinct from parsed_events.user_id
      or organization_usage_events.billable <> parsed_events.billable
      or organization_usage_events.metadata <> parsed_events.metadata
  ) then
    raise exception 'usage idempotency key reused with different data'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  if jsonb_array_length(v_inserted) > 0 then
    with
      inserted_events as (
        select *
        from jsonb_to_recordset(v_inserted) as event(
          billable boolean,
          meter_key text,
          quantity numeric
        )
      ),
      event_totals as (
        select
          inserted_events.meter_key,
          sum(inserted_events.quantity) as quantity
        from inserted_events
        where inserted_events.billable
        group by inserted_events.meter_key
      )
    insert into public.organization_usage_periods (
      organization_id,
      meter_key,
      period_start,
      period_end,
      quantity,
      included_quantity,
      overage_quantity,
      overage_amount_micros,
      stripe_event_name,
      stripe_sync_status
    )
    select
      p_organization_id,
      event_totals.meter_key,
      v_period_start,
      v_period_end,
      event_totals.quantity,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      null,
      'not_billable'
    from event_totals
    on conflict (organization_id, meter_key, period_start, period_end)
    do update
    set quantity = organization_usage_periods.quantity + excluded.quantity;

    with
      active_plan as (
        select coalesce(
          (
            select organization_subscriptions.plan_key
            from public.organization_subscriptions
            where organization_subscriptions.organization_id = p_organization_id
              and organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due', 'trialing')
            limit 1
          ),
          'starter'::public.billing_plan_key
        ) as plan_key
      ),
      affected_meters as (
        select distinct event.meter_key
        from jsonb_to_recordset(v_inserted) as event(
          billable boolean,
          meter_key text
        )
        where event.billable
      ),
      calculated_periods as (
        select
          organization_usage_periods.id,
          case
            when coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.is_unlimited, false)
              then organization_usage_periods.quantity
            else coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.included_quantity, 0)
          end as included_quantity,
          case
            when coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.is_unlimited, false)
              then 0
            else greatest(
              organization_usage_periods.quantity
                - coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.included_quantity, 0),
              0
            )
          end as overage_quantity,
          billing_usage_meters.stripe_event_name,
          case
            when billing_plan_usage_limits.pricing_model = 'cost_plus'
              then round(
                coalesce(
                  billing_plan_usage_limits.base_cost_unit_price_micros,
                  billing_plan_usage_limits.overage_unit_price_micros,
                  0
                ) * (1 + billing_plan_usage_limits.markup_bps::numeric / 10000)
              )
            else coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.overage_unit_price_micros, 0)
          end as unit_price_micros
        from public.organization_usage_periods
        join affected_meters
          on affected_meters.meter_key = organization_usage_periods.meter_key
        join public.billing_usage_meters
          on billing_usage_meters.key = organization_usage_periods.meter_key
        cross join active_plan
        left join public.billing_plan_usage_limits
          on billing_plan_usage_limits.plan_key = active_plan.plan_key
          and billing_plan_usage_limits.meter_key = organization_usage_periods.meter_key
        where organization_usage_periods.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and organization_usage_periods.period_start = v_period_start
          and organization_usage_periods.period_end = v_period_end
      )
    update public.organization_usage_periods
    set
      included_quantity = calculated_periods.included_quantity,
      overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity,
      overage_amount_micros = round(
        calculated_periods.overage_quantity * calculated_periods.unit_price_micros
      )::bigint,
      stripe_event_name = case
        when calculated_periods.overage_quantity > 0
          then calculated_periods.stripe_event_name
        else null
      end,
      stripe_event_id = case
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          then organization_usage_periods.stripe_event_id
        else null
      end,
      stripe_sync_error = case
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          then organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_error
        else null
      end,
      stripe_sync_status = case
        when calculated_periods.overage_quantity <= 0
          or calculated_periods.stripe_event_name is null
          then 'not_billable'
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          and organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_status = 'synced'
          then 'synced'
        else 'pending'
      end,
      stripe_synced_at = case
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          and organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_status = 'synced'
          then organization_usage_periods.stripe_synced_at
        else null
      end
    from calculated_periods
    where organization_usage_periods.id = calculated_periods.id;
  end if;

  with requested_keys as (
    select event ->> 'idempotency_key' as idempotency_key
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(organization_usage_events) order by organization_usage_events.created_at),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_result
  from public.organization_usage_events
  join requested_keys
    on requested_keys.idempotency_key = organization_usage_events.idempotency_key
  where organization_usage_events.organization_id = p_organization_id;

  return v_result;
end;
