      v_period_start,
      v_period_end,
      event_totals.quantity,
      0,
      0,
      0,
      null,
      'not_billable'
    from event_totals
    on conflict (organization_id, meter_key, period_start, period_end)
    do update
    set quantity = organization_usage_periods.quantity + excluded.quantity;

    with
      active_plan as (
        select coalesce(
          (
            select organization_subscriptions.plan_key
            from public.organization_subscriptions
            where organization_subscriptions.organization_id = p_organization_id
              and organization_subscriptions.status in ('active', 'past_due', 'trialing')
            limit 1
          ),
          'starter'::public.billing_plan_key
        ) as plan_key
      ),
      affected_meters as (
        select distinct event.meter_key
        from jsonb_to_recordset(v_inserted) as event(
          billable boolean,
          meter_key text
        )
        where event.billable
      ),
      calculated_periods as (
        select
          organization_usage_periods.id,
          case
            when coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.is_unlimited, false)
              then organization_usage_periods.quantity
            else coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.included_quantity, 0)
          end as included_quantity,
          case
            when coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.is_unlimited, false)
              then 0
            else greatest(
              organization_usage_periods.quantity
                - coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.included_quantity, 0),
              0
            )
          end as overage_quantity,
          billing_usage_meters.stripe_event_name,
          case
            when billing_plan_usage_limits.pricing_model = 'cost_plus'
              then round(
                coalesce(
                  billing_plan_usage_limits.base_cost_unit_price_micros,
                  billing_plan_usage_limits.overage_unit_price_micros,
                  0
                ) * (1 + billing_plan_usage_limits.markup_bps::numeric / 10000)
              )
            else coalesce(billing_plan_usage_limits.overage_unit_price_micros, 0)
          end as unit_price_micros
        from public.organization_usage_periods
        join affected_meters
          on affected_meters.meter_key = organization_usage_periods.meter_key
        join public.billing_usage_meters
          on billing_usage_meters.key = organization_usage_periods.meter_key
        cross join active_plan
        left join public.billing_plan_usage_limits
          on billing_plan_usage_limits.plan_key = active_plan.plan_key
          and billing_plan_usage_limits.meter_key = organization_usage_periods.meter_key
        where organization_usage_periods.organization_id = p_organization_id
          and organization_usage_periods.period_start = v_period_start
          and organization_usage_periods.period_end = v_period_end
      )
    update public.organization_usage_periods
    set
      included_quantity = calculated_periods.included_quantity,
      overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity,
      overage_amount_micros = round(
        calculated_periods.overage_quantity * calculated_periods.unit_price_micros
      )::bigint,
      stripe_event_name = case
        when calculated_periods.overage_quantity > 0
          then calculated_periods.stripe_event_name
        else null
      end,
      stripe_event_id = case
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          then organization_usage_periods.stripe_event_id
        else null
      end,
      stripe_sync_error = case
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          then organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_error
        else null
      end,
      stripe_sync_status = case
        when calculated_periods.overage_quantity <= 0
          or calculated_periods.stripe_event_name is null
          then 'not_billable'
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          and organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_status = 'synced'
          then 'synced'
        else 'pending'
      end,
      stripe_synced_at = case
        when organization_usage_periods.overage_quantity = calculated_periods.overage_quantity
          and organization_usage_periods.stripe_sync_status = 'synced'
          then organization_usage_periods.stripe_synced_at
        else null
      end
    from calculated_periods
    where organization_usage_periods.id = calculated_periods.id;
  end if;

  with requested_keys as (
    select event ->> 'idempotency_key' as idempotency_key
    from jsonb_array_elements(p_events) as input(event)
  )
  select coalesce(
    jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(organization_usage_events) order by organization_usage_events.created_at),
    '[]'::jsonb
  )
  into v_result
  from public.organization_usage_events
  join requested_keys
    on requested_keys.idempotency_key = organization_usage_events.idempotency_key
  where organization_usage_events.organization_id = p_organization_id;

  return v_result;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_events jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT (now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'::text)
functions.identity_argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_events jsonb, p_at timestamp with time zone

functions.name: refresh_ai_chat_suggestion_snapshot
functions.definition:
declare
  v_user_id uuid := null;
  v_organization public.organizations%rowtype;
  v_permissions text[] := array[
    'organization.agenda.view',
    'organization.assets.view',
    'organization.chats.create',
    'organization.chats.view',
    'organization.customers.view',
    'organization.integrations.manage',
    'organization.knowledge.view',
    'organization.members.invite',
    'organization.members.view',
    'organization.products.view',
    'organization.quotes.view',
    'organization.tasks.view',
    'organization.teams.view',
    'organization.workflows.view'
  ]::text[];
  v_suggestions_model text;
  v_state jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_catalogs jsonb := jsonb_build_object(
    'knowledgeCollections', '[]'::jsonb,
    'workflows', '[]'::jsonb
  );
  v_domain_state jsonb;
  v_today_start timestamptz;
  v_today_end timestamptz;
  v_snapshot jsonb;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'refresh_ai_chat_suggestion_snapshot requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if not pg_catalog.pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_organization_id::text, 928374)
  ) then
    return false;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_suggestion_snapshots
    where chat_suggestion_snapshots.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and chat_suggestion_snapshots.refreshed_at > (
        (now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '5 minutes'
      )
  ) then
    return false;
  end if;

  select organizations.*
  into v_organization
  from public.organizations
  where organizations.id = p_organization_id
    and organizations.disabled_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'organization not found'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  v_today_start := date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC';
  v_today_end := v_today_start + interval '1 day';

  select ai_model_use_defaults.model_id
  into v_suggestions_model
  from public.ai_model_use_defaults
  join public.ai_model_settings
    on ai_model_settings.model_id = ai_model_use_defaults.model_id
    and ai_model_settings.enabled
  where ai_model_use_defaults.use_case = 'suggestions';

  v_suggestions_model := coalesce(v_suggestions_model, 'openai/gpt-5.4');

  if 'organization.agenda.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'confirmedTodayTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_items
        where agenda_items.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and agenda_items.starts_at < v_today_end
          and agenda_items.ends_at > v_today_start
          and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
      ),
      'conflictTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_items
        where agenda_items.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and agenda_items.starts_at < v_today_end
          and agenda_items.ends_at > v_today_start
          and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
          and not agenda_items.is_all_day
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.agenda_items as overlapping_items
            where overlapping_items.organization_id = agenda_items.organization_id
              and overlapping_items.id <> agenda_items.id
              and overlapping_items.status <> 'cancelled'
              and not overlapping_items.is_all_day
              and overlapping_items.starts_at < agenda_items.ends_at
              and overlapping_items.ends_at > agenda_items.starts_at
          )
      ),
      'riskSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(risk_items.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_strip_nulls(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(
                  case
                    when tasks.id is null then agenda_items.title
                    else concat(
                      v_organization.task_number_prefix,
                      tasks.number,
                      ' ',
                      agenda_items.title
                    )
                  end,
                  160
                ),
                'agendaLabel',
                left(agenda_items.title, 160),
                'taskDerived',
                tasks.id is not null,
                'status',
                case
                  when agenda_items.is_all_day then 'all-day'
                  else tasks.priority::text
                end
              )
            ) as sample
            from public.agenda_items
            left join public.tasks
              on tasks.id = agenda_items.task_id
              and tasks.organization_id = agenda_items.organization_id
            where agenda_items.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and agenda_items.starts_at < v_today_end
              and agenda_items.ends_at > v_today_start
              and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
            order by agenda_items.is_all_day desc, tasks.priority desc nulls last, agenda_items.starts_at
            limit 5
          ) as risk_items
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'suggestedTodayTotal',
      0,
      'unscheduledTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.tasks
          where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
            and tasks.parent_task_id is null
            and tasks.archived_at is null
            and tasks.status <> 'done'
            and not exists (
              select 1
              from public.agenda_items
              where agenda_items.organization_id = tasks.organization_id
                and agenda_items.task_id = tasks.id
                and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
            )
        )
        else 0
      end
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('agenda', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'mineSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(mine_tasks.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title), 160),
              'status',
              tasks.priority::text
            ) as sample
            from public.tasks
            where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              and tasks.archived_at is null
              and tasks.status <> 'done'
              and exists (
                select 1
                from public.task_assignees
                where task_assignees.task_id = tasks.id
                  and task_assignees.organization_id = tasks.organization_id
                  and task_assignees.user_id = v_user_id
              )
            order by
              case tasks.priority
                when 'urgent' then 0
                when 'high' then 1
                when 'medium' then 2
                when 'low' then 3
              end,
              tasks.due_at nulls last,
              tasks.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as mine_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'mineTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.tasks
        where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and tasks.parent_task_id is null
          and tasks.archived_at is null
          and tasks.status <> 'done'
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.task_assignees
            where task_assignees.task_id = tasks.id
              and task_assignees.organization_id = tasks.organization_id
              and task_assignees.user_id = v_user_id
          )
      ),
      'orgSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(organization_tasks.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title), 160),
              'status',
              tasks.priority::text
            ) as sample
            from public.tasks
            where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              and tasks.archived_at is null
              and tasks.status <> 'done'
            order by
              case tasks.priority
                when 'urgent' then 0
                when 'high' then 1
                when 'medium' then 2
                when 'low' then 3
              end,
              tasks.due_at nulls last,
              tasks.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as organization_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'orgTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.tasks
        where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and tasks.parent_task_id is null
          and tasks.archived_at is null
          and tasks.status <> 'done'
      ),
      'urgentSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(urgent_tasks.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title), 160),
              'status',
              tasks.priority::text
            ) as sample
            from public.tasks
            where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              and tasks.archived_at is null
              and tasks.status <> 'done'
              and tasks.priority in ('urgent', 'high')
            order by
              case tasks.priority when 'urgent' then 0 else 1 end,
              tasks.due_at nulls last,
              tasks.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as urgent_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('tasks', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.customers.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'samples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(customer_samples.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(
                coalesce(
                  nullif(customers.company_name, ''),
                  concat('Customer ', customers.id)
                ),
                160
              ),
              'quoteCount',
              (
                select count(*)
                from public.quotes
                where quotes.organization_id = customers.organization_id
                  and quotes.customer_id = customers.id
                  and quotes.archived_at is null
              ),
              'taskCount',
              (
                select count(*)
                from public.tasks
                where tasks.organization_id = customers.organization_id
                  and tasks.customer_id = customers.id
                  and tasks.archived_at is null
                  and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              )
            ) as sample
            from public.customers
            where customers.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and customers.archived_at is null
            order by customers.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as customer_samples
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'total',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.customers
        where customers.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and customers.archived_at is null
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('customers', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.quotes.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'draftSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(draft_quotes.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(quotes.number_prefix, quotes.number, ' ', quotes.title), 160),
              'status',
              quotes.status::text
            ) as sample
            from public.quotes
            where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and quotes.status = 'draft'
              and quotes.archived_at is null
            order by quotes.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as draft_quotes
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'draftTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.quotes
        where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and quotes.status = 'draft'
          and quotes.archived_at is null
      ),
      'sentSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(sent_quotes.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(quotes.number_prefix, quotes.number, ' ', quotes.title), 160),
              'status',
              quotes.status::text
            ) as sample
            from public.quotes
            where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and quotes.status = 'sent'
              and quotes.archived_at is null
            order by quotes.sent_at desc nulls last, quotes.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as sent_quotes
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'sentTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.quotes
        where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and quotes.status = 'sent'
          and quotes.archived_at is null
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('quotes', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if (
    'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'customerAssetSamples',
      case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(asset_samples.sample)
            from (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(
                  coalesce(
                    products.name,
                    customer_assets.asset_tag,
                    concat('Asset ', customer_assets.id)
                  ),
                  160
                ),
                'assetLabel',
                left(
                  coalesce(
                    customer_assets.asset_tag,
                    concat('Asset ', customer_assets.id)
                  ),
                  160
                ),
                'status',
                customer_assets.status::text
              ) as sample
              from public.customer_assets
              left join public.products
                on products.id = customer_assets.product_id
                and products.organization_id = customer_assets.organization_id
              where customer_assets.organization_id = v_organization.id
              order by customer_assets.updated_at desc
              limit 5
            ) as asset_samples
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end,
      'customerAssetTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.customer_assets
          where customer_assets.organization_id = v_organization.id
        )
        else 0
      end,
      'inventoryIssueSamples',
      case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(inventory_issues.sample)
            from (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(concat_ws(' — ', products.name, nullif(product_variants.title, '')), 160),
                'status',
                levels.stock_status
              ) as sample
              from public.inventory_variant_levels(v_organization.id) as levels
              join public.products on products.id = levels.product_id
              join public.product_variants on product_variants.id = levels.variant_id
              where levels.stock_status in ('low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'backordered')
                and (levels.on_hand > 0 or levels.backordered > 0 or levels.reorder_point is not null)
              order by products.updated_at desc
              limit 5
            ) as inventory_issues
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end,
      'productSamples',
      case
        when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions) then coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(product_samples.sample)
            from (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(products.name, 160),
                'status',
                products.status::text
              ) as sample
              from public.products
              where products.organization_id = v_organization.id
              order by products.updated_at desc
              limit 5
            ) as product_samples
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end,
      'productTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.products
          where products.organization_id = v_organization.id
        )
        else 0
      end
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('assets', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if (
    'organization.members.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.members.invite' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.teams.view' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'memberTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.members.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.organization_users
          where organization_users.organization_id = v_organization.id
        )
        else 0
      end,
      'pendingInvitationTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.members.invite' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.organization_invitations
          where organization_invitations.organization_id = v_organization.id
            and organization_invitations.accepted_at is null
            and organization_invitations.declined_at is null
            and organization_invitations.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
        )
        else 0
      end,
      'teamTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.teams.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.teams
          where teams.organization_id = v_organization.id
            and teams.status = 'active'
        )
        else 0
      end
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('access', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.integrations.manage' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'activeTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and inbox_connections.status = 'active'
      ),
      'draftTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and inbox_connections.status = 'draft'
      ),
      'errorSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(channel_errors.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(inbox_connections.name, 160),
              'status',
              inbox_connections.kind
            ) as sample
            from public.inbox_connections
            where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and inbox_connections.status = 'error'
            order by inbox_connections.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as channel_errors
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'total',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('channels', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.knowledge.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_catalogs := jsonb_set(
      v_catalogs,
      '{knowledgeCollections}',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(knowledge_catalog.item)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'description',
              left(knowledge_collections.description, 500),
              'name',
              left(knowledge_collections.name, 160)
            ) as item
            from public.knowledge_collections
            where (
                knowledge_collections.organization_id = v_organization.id
                or knowledge_collections.organization_id is null
              )
              and knowledge_collections.visibility <> 'disabled'
            order by knowledge_collections.retrieval_priority, knowledge_collections.name
            limit 6
          ) as knowledge_catalog
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    );
  end if;

  if 'organization.workflows.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_catalogs := jsonb_set(
      v_catalogs,
      '{workflows}',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(workflow_catalog.item)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'description',
              left(workflow_definitions.description, 500),
              'name',
              left(workflow_definitions.name, 160)
            ) as item
            from public.workflow_definitions
            where (
                workflow_definitions.organization_id = v_organization.id
                or workflow_definitions.organization_id is null
              )
              and workflow_definitions.status = 'published'
              and workflow_definitions.archived_at is null
            order by workflow_definitions.updated_at desc
            limit 6
          ) as workflow_catalog
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    );
  end if;

  v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
    'catalogs',
    v_catalogs,
    'inferenceRegion',
    v_organization.ai_inference_region,
    'organizationId',
    v_organization.id,
    'organizationName',
    v_organization.name,
    'state',
    v_state,
    'suggestionsModel',
    v_suggestions_model
  );

  insert into public.chat_suggestion_snapshots (
    organization_id,
    snapshot,
    refreshed_at
  )
  values (
    v_organization.id,
    v_snapshot,
    now() at time zone 'utc'
  )
  on conflict (organization_id) do update
  set
    snapshot = excluded.snapshot,
    refreshed_at = excluded.refreshed_at;

  return true;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.refresh_ai_chat_suggestion_snapshot(p_organization_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_user_id uuid := null;
  v_organization public.organizations%rowtype;
  v_permissions text[] := array[
    'organization.agenda.view',
    'organization.assets.view',
    'organization.chats.create',
    'organization.chats.view',
    'organization.customers.view',
    'organization.integrations.manage',
    'organization.knowledge.view',
    'organization.members.invite',
    'organization.members.view',
    'organization.products.view',
    'organization.quotes.view',
    'organization.tasks.view',
    'organization.teams.view',
    'organization.workflows.view'
  ]::text[];
  v_suggestions_model text;
  v_state jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_catalogs jsonb := jsonb_build_object(
    'knowledgeCollections', '[]'::jsonb,
    'workflows', '[]'::jsonb
  );
  v_domain_state jsonb;
  v_today_start timestamptz;
  v_today_end timestamptz;
  v_snapshot jsonb;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'refresh_ai_chat_suggestion_snapshot requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if not pg_catalog.pg_try_advisory_xact_lock(
    pg_catalog.hashtextextended(p_organization_id::text, 928374)
  ) then
    return false;
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_suggestion_snapshots
    where chat_suggestion_snapshots.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and chat_suggestion_snapshots.refreshed_at > (
        (now() at time zone 'utc') - interval '5 minutes'
      )
  ) then
    return false;
  end if;

  select organizations.*
  into v_organization
  from public.organizations
  where organizations.id = p_organization_id
    and organizations.disabled_at is null;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'organization not found'
      using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;

  v_today_start := date_trunc('day', now() at time zone 'UTC') at time zone 'UTC';
  v_today_end := v_today_start + interval '1 day';

  select ai_model_use_defaults.model_id
  into v_suggestions_model
  from public.ai_model_use_defaults
  join public.ai_model_settings
    on ai_model_settings.model_id = ai_model_use_defaults.model_id
    and ai_model_settings.enabled
  where ai_model_use_defaults.use_case = 'suggestions';

  v_suggestions_model := coalesce(v_suggestions_model, 'openai/gpt-5.4');

  if 'organization.agenda.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'confirmedTodayTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_items
        where agenda_items.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and agenda_items.starts_at < v_today_end
          and agenda_items.ends_at > v_today_start
          and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
      ),
      'conflictTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.agenda_items
        where agenda_items.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and agenda_items.starts_at < v_today_end
          and agenda_items.ends_at > v_today_start
          and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
          and not agenda_items.is_all_day
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.agenda_items as overlapping_items
            where overlapping_items.organization_id = agenda_items.organization_id
              and overlapping_items.id <> agenda_items.id
              and overlapping_items.status <> 'cancelled'
              and not overlapping_items.is_all_day
              and overlapping_items.starts_at < agenda_items.ends_at
              and overlapping_items.ends_at > agenda_items.starts_at
          )
      ),
      'riskSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(risk_items.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_strip_nulls(
              jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(
                  case
                    when tasks.id is null then agenda_items.title
                    else concat(
                      v_organization.task_number_prefix,
                      tasks.number,
                      ' ',
                      agenda_items.title
                    )
                  end,
                  160
                ),
                'agendaLabel',
                left(agenda_items.title, 160),
                'taskDerived',
                tasks.id is not null,
                'status',
                case
                  when agenda_items.is_all_day then 'all-day'
                  else tasks.priority::text
                end
              )
            ) as sample
            from public.agenda_items
            left join public.tasks
              on tasks.id = agenda_items.task_id
              and tasks.organization_id = agenda_items.organization_id
            where agenda_items.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and agenda_items.starts_at < v_today_end
              and agenda_items.ends_at > v_today_start
              and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
            order by agenda_items.is_all_day desc, tasks.priority desc nulls last, agenda_items.starts_at
            limit 5
          ) as risk_items
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'suggestedTodayTotal',
      0,
      'unscheduledTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.tasks
          where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
            and tasks.parent_task_id is null
            and tasks.archived_at is null
            and tasks.status <> 'done'
            and not exists (
              select 1
              from public.agenda_items
              where agenda_items.organization_id = tasks.organization_id
                and agenda_items.task_id = tasks.id
                and agenda_items.status <> 'cancelled'
            )
        )
        else 0
      end
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('agenda', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.tasks.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'mineSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(mine_tasks.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title), 160),
              'status',
              tasks.priority::text
            ) as sample
            from public.tasks
            where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              and tasks.archived_at is null
              and tasks.status <> 'done'
              and exists (
                select 1
                from public.task_assignees
                where task_assignees.task_id = tasks.id
                  and task_assignees.organization_id = tasks.organization_id
                  and task_assignees.user_id = v_user_id
              )
            order by
              case tasks.priority
                when 'urgent' then 0
                when 'high' then 1
                when 'medium' then 2
                when 'low' then 3
              end,
              tasks.due_at nulls last,
              tasks.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as mine_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'mineTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.tasks
        where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and tasks.parent_task_id is null
          and tasks.archived_at is null
          and tasks.status <> 'done'
          and exists (
            select 1
            from public.task_assignees
            where task_assignees.task_id = tasks.id
              and task_assignees.organization_id = tasks.organization_id
              and task_assignees.user_id = v_user_id
          )
      ),
      'orgSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(organization_tasks.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title), 160),
              'status',
              tasks.priority::text
            ) as sample
            from public.tasks
            where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              and tasks.archived_at is null
              and tasks.status <> 'done'
            order by
              case tasks.priority
                when 'urgent' then 0
                when 'high' then 1
                when 'medium' then 2
                when 'low' then 3
              end,
              tasks.due_at nulls last,
              tasks.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as organization_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'orgTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.tasks
        where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and tasks.parent_task_id is null
          and tasks.archived_at is null
          and tasks.status <> 'done'
      ),
      'urgentSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(urgent_tasks.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(v_organization.task_number_prefix, tasks.number, ' ', tasks.title), 160),
              'status',
              tasks.priority::text
            ) as sample
            from public.tasks
            where tasks.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              and tasks.archived_at is null
              and tasks.status <> 'done'
              and tasks.priority in ('urgent', 'high')
            order by
              case tasks.priority when 'urgent' then 0 else 1 end,
              tasks.due_at nulls last,
              tasks.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as urgent_tasks
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('tasks', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.customers.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'samples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(customer_samples.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(
                coalesce(
                  nullif(customers.company_name, ''),
                  concat('Customer ', customers.id)
                ),
                160
              ),
              'quoteCount',
              (
                select count(*)
                from public.quotes
                where quotes.organization_id = customers.organization_id
                  and quotes.customer_id = customers.id
                  and quotes.archived_at is null
              ),
              'taskCount',
              (
                select count(*)
                from public.tasks
                where tasks.organization_id = customers.organization_id
                  and tasks.customer_id = customers.id
                  and tasks.archived_at is null
                  and tasks.parent_task_id is null
              )
            ) as sample
            from public.customers
            where customers.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and customers.archived_at is null
            order by customers.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as customer_samples
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'total',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.customers
        where customers.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and customers.archived_at is null
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('customers', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.quotes.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'draftSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(draft_quotes.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(quotes.number_prefix, quotes.number, ' ', quotes.title), 160),
              'status',
              quotes.status::text
            ) as sample
            from public.quotes
            where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and quotes.status = 'draft'
              and quotes.archived_at is null
            order by quotes.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as draft_quotes
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'draftTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.quotes
        where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and quotes.status = 'draft'
          and quotes.archived_at is null
      ),
      'sentSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(sent_quotes.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(concat(quotes.number_prefix, quotes.number, ' ', quotes.title), 160),
              'status',
              quotes.status::text
            ) as sample
            from public.quotes
            where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and quotes.status = 'sent'
              and quotes.archived_at is null
            order by quotes.sent_at desc nulls last, quotes.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as sent_quotes
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'sentTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.quotes
        where quotes.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and quotes.status = 'sent'
          and quotes.archived_at is null
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('quotes', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if (
    'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'customerAssetSamples',
      case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(asset_samples.sample)
            from (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(
                  coalesce(
                    products.name,
                    customer_assets.asset_tag,
                    concat('Asset ', customer_assets.id)
                  ),
                  160
                ),
                'assetLabel',
                left(
                  coalesce(
                    customer_assets.asset_tag,
                    concat('Asset ', customer_assets.id)
                  ),
                  160
                ),
                'status',
                customer_assets.status::text
              ) as sample
              from public.customer_assets
              left join public.products
                on products.id = customer_assets.product_id
                and products.organization_id = customer_assets.organization_id
              where customer_assets.organization_id = v_organization.id
              order by customer_assets.updated_at desc
              limit 5
            ) as asset_samples
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end,
      'customerAssetTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.customer_assets
          where customer_assets.organization_id = v_organization.id
        )
        else 0
      end,
      'inventoryIssueSamples',
      case
        when 'organization.assets.view' = any(v_permissions) then coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(inventory_issues.sample)
            from (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(concat_ws(' — ', products.name, nullif(product_variants.title, '')), 160),
                'status',
                levels.stock_status
              ) as sample
              from public.inventory_variant_levels(v_organization.id) as levels
              join public.products on products.id = levels.product_id
              join public.product_variants on product_variants.id = levels.variant_id
              where levels.stock_status in ('low_stock', 'out_of_stock', 'backordered')
                and (levels.on_hand > 0 or levels.backordered > 0 or levels.reorder_point is not null)
              order by products.updated_at desc
              limit 5
            ) as inventory_issues
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end,
      'productSamples',
      case
        when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions) then coalesce(
          (
            select jsonb_agg(product_samples.sample)
            from (
              select jsonb_build_object(
                'label',
                left(products.name, 160),
                'status',
                products.status::text
              ) as sample
              from public.products
              where products.organization_id = v_organization.id
              order by products.updated_at desc
              limit 5
            ) as product_samples
          ),
          '[]'::jsonb
        )
        else '[]'::jsonb
      end,
      'productTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.products.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.products
          where products.organization_id = v_organization.id
        )
        else 0
      end
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('assets', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if (
    'organization.members.view' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.members.invite' = any(v_permissions)
    or 'organization.teams.view' = any(v_permissions)
  ) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'memberTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.members.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.organization_users
          where organization_users.organization_id = v_organization.id
        )
        else 0
      end,
      'pendingInvitationTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.members.invite' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.organization_invitations
          where organization_invitations.organization_id = v_organization.id
            and organization_invitations.accepted_at is null
            and organization_invitations.declined_at is null
            and organization_invitations.expires_at > (now() at time zone 'utc')
        )
        else 0
      end,
      'teamTotal',
      case
        when 'organization.teams.view' = any(v_permissions) then (
          select count(*)
          from public.teams
          where teams.organization_id = v_organization.id
            and teams.status = 'active'
        )
        else 0
      end
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('access', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.integrations.manage' = any(v_permissions) then
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'activeTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and inbox_connections.status = 'active'
      ),
      'draftTotal',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
          and inbox_connections.status = 'draft'
      ),
      'errorSamples',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(channel_errors.sample)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'label',
              left(inbox_connections.name, 160),
              'status',
              inbox_connections.kind
            ) as sample
            from public.inbox_connections
            where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
              and inbox_connections.status = 'error'
            order by inbox_connections.updated_at desc
            limit 5
          ) as channel_errors
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'total',
      (
        select count(*)
        from public.inbox_connections
        where inbox_connections.organization_id = v_organization.id
      )
    )
    into v_domain_state;
    v_state := v_state || jsonb_build_object('channels', v_domain_state);
  end if;

  if 'organization.knowledge.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_catalogs := jsonb_set(
      v_catalogs,
      '{knowledgeCollections}',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(knowledge_catalog.item)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'description',
              left(knowledge_collections.description, 500),
              'name',
              left(knowledge_collections.name, 160)
            ) as item
            from public.knowledge_collections
            where (
                knowledge_collections.organization_id = v_organization.id
                or knowledge_collections.organization_id is null
              )
              and knowledge_collections.visibility <> 'disabled'
            order by knowledge_collections.retrieval_priority, knowledge_collections.name
            limit 6
          ) as knowledge_catalog
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    );
  end if;

  if 'organization.workflows.view' = any(v_permissions) then
    v_catalogs := jsonb_set(
      v_catalogs,
      '{workflows}',
      coalesce(
        (
          select jsonb_agg(workflow_catalog.item)
          from (
            select jsonb_build_object(
              'description',
              left(workflow_definitions.description, 500),
              'name',
              left(workflow_definitions.name, 160)
            ) as item
            from public.workflow_definitions
            where (
                workflow_definitions.organization_id = v_organization.id
                or workflow_definitions.organization_id is null
              )
              and workflow_definitions.status = 'published'
              and workflow_definitions.archived_at is null
            order by workflow_definitions.updated_at desc
            limit 6
          ) as workflow_catalog
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
      )
    );
  end if;

  v_snapshot := jsonb_build_object(
    'catalogs',
    v_catalogs,
    'inferenceRegion',
    v_organization.ai_inference_region,
    'organizationId',
    v_organization.id,
    'organizationName',
    v_organization.name,
    'state',
    v_state,
    'suggestionsModel',
    v_suggestions_model
  );

  insert into public.chat_suggestion_snapshots (
    organization_id,
    snapshot,
    refreshed_at
  )
  values (
    v_organization.id,
    v_snapshot,
    now() at time zone 'utc'
  )
  on conflict (organization_id) do update
  set
    snapshot = excluded.snapshot,
    refreshed_at = excluded.refreshed_at;

  return true;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.regexp_matches(citext, citext)
 RETURNS SETOF text[]
 LANGUAGE sql

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_ai_message_dispatch(p_message_id uuid, p_thread_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_dispatch_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_actor_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
  v_released boolean := false;
begin
  if v_actor_id is null then
    return false;
  end if;

  update public.chat_messages as message
  set
    dispatch_id = null,
    dispatch_claimed_at = null
  from public.chat_threads as thread
  where message.id = p_message_id
    and message.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and message.thread_id = thread.id
    and message.organization_id is not distinct from p_organization_id
    and thread.organization_id is not distinct from p_organization_id
    and message.created_by = v_actor_id
    and message.dispatch_id = p_dispatch_id
    and message.dispatch_linked_at is null
    and (
      thread.owner_user_id = v_actor_id
      or (
        p_organization_id is not null
        and public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.chats.create')
      )
    )
  returning true into v_released;

  return coalesce(v_released, false);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.release_quote_allocations(p_organization_id uuid, p_quote_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
begin
  if auth.uid() is null then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'authentication required';
  end if;

  if not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.quotes.update') then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'quote update permission required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.quotes
    where quotes.id = p_quote_id
      and quotes.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'quote not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  for v_line in
    select quote_version_lines.id
    from public.quote_version_lines
    join public.quote_versions
      on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
    where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
      and quote_versions.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and exists (
        select 1
        from public.inventory_allocations
        where inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
          and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
      )
  loop
    perform public.release_allocations(
      p_organization_id,
      null,
      v_line.id,
      null,
      null,
      'quote stock released',
      auth.uid()
    );
  end loop;
end;
$function$

declare
  v_content text := regexp_replace(btrim(p_content), '\s+', ' ', 'g');
  v_content_hash text;
  v_existing public.ai_memory_items;
  v_inserted public.ai_memory_items;
begin
  if p_user_id is null
    or p_organization_id is null
    or p_scope not in ('thread', 'user', 'organization', 'customer', 'asset', 'task', 'quote', 'tool')
    or p_kind not in ('preference', 'correction', 'fact')
    or nullif(btrim(p_subject_type), '') is null
    or nullif(btrim(p_subject_id), '') is null
    or nullif(v_content, '') is null
    or length(v_content) > 1000
    or nullif(btrim(p_source), '') is null
    or p_confidence < 0
    or p_confidence > 1
    or p_expires_at is null
    or p_expires_at <= p_now
    or p_now is null
    or (p_scope = 'thread' and p_thread_id is null)
  then
    raise exception 'invalid private memory proposal'
      using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if current_user <> 'service_role' and (select auth.uid()) is distinct from p_user_id then
    raise exception 'private memory target user does not match caller'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_users
    where organization_users.user_id = p_user_id
      and organization_users.organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'private memory target user is not in the organization'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_thread_id is not null and not exists (
    select 1
    from public.chat_threads
    where chat_threads.id = p_thread_id
      and chat_threads.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and chat_threads.owner_user_id = p_user_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'private memory thread does not match target user and organization'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_source = 'chat-extraction' and (
    select count(*)
    from public.ai_memory_items
    where ai_memory_items.user_id = p_user_id
      and ai_memory_items.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and ai_memory_items.source = p_source
      and ai_memory_items.created_at >= p_now - interval '1 hour'
  ) >= 5 then
    raise exception 'private memory extraction rate limit exceeded'
      using errcode = '54000';
  end if;

  v_content_hash := md5(lower(v_content));

  select memory.*
  into v_existing
  from public.ai_memory_items as memory
  where memory.user_id = p_user_id
    and memory.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and memory.scope = p_scope
    and memory.thread_id is not distinct from p_thread_id
    and memory.content_hash = v_content_hash
    and memory.deleted_at is null
  limit 1
  for update;

  if found then
    update public.ai_memory_items
    set
      confidence = greatest(ai_memory_items.confidence, p_confidence),
      expires_at = greatest(ai_memory_items.expires_at, p_expires_at),
      embedding = coalesce(p_embedding, ai_memory_items.embedding),
      metadata = ai_memory_items.metadata || p_metadata,
      updated_at = p_now
    where ai_memory_items.id = v_existing.id
    returning * into v_existing;
    return v_existing;
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_memory_items (
    organization_id,
    user_id,
    scope,
    visibility,
    subject_type,
    subject_id,
    content,
    source,
    confidence,
    metadata,
    expires_at,
    created_by,
    thread_id,
    kind,
    embedding
  ) values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_user_id,
    p_scope,
    'private',
    p_subject_type,
    p_subject_id,
    v_content,
    p_source,
    p_confidence,
    p_metadata,
    p_expires_at,
    p_user_id,
    p_thread_id,
    p_kind,
    p_embedding
  )
  returning * into v_inserted;

  update public.ai_memory_items
  set deleted_at = p_now
  where ai_memory_items.id in (
    select retained.id
    from public.ai_memory_items as retained
    where retained.user_id = p_user_id
      and retained.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and retained.deleted_at is null
    order by retained.updated_at desc, retained.id
    offset 100
  );

  return v_inserted;
exception
  when unique_violation then
    select memory.*
    into v_existing
    from public.ai_memory_items as memory
    where memory.user_id = p_user_id
      and memory.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and memory.scope = p_scope
      and memory.thread_id is not distinct from p_thread_id
      and memory.content_hash = v_content_hash
      and memory.deleted_at is null
    limit 1;
    return v_existing;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.replace_agenda_collection_grants(p_organization_id uuid, p_calendar_id uuid, p_grants jsonb, p_created_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS SETOF agenda_collection_grants
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_grants, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'calendar grants must be an array' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.agenda_collections
    where id = p_calendar_id
      and organization_id = p_organization_id
      and source = 'local'
  ) then
    raise exception 'editable calendar not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  if exists (
    select 1
    from jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(p_grants, '[]'::jsonb))
      as requested(user_id uuid, team_id bigint, role text, position integer)
    where (requested.user_id is null) = (requested.team_id is null)
      or requested.role not in ('viewer', 'editor')
      or coalesce(requested.position, 0) < 0
      or (
        requested.user_id is not null
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from public.organization_users
          where organization_users.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and organization_users.user_id = requested.user_id
        )
      )
      or (
        requested.team_id is not null
        and not exists (
          select 1
          from public.teams
          where teams.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and teams.id = requested.team_id
        )
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'invalid calendar grant principal or role' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  delete from public.agenda_collection_grants
  where organization_id = p_organization_id
    and agenda_collection_id = p_calendar_id;

  insert into public.agenda_collection_grants (
    organization_id,
    agenda_collection_id,
    user_id,
    team_id,
    role,
    position,
    created_by
  )
  select
    p_organization_id,
    p_calendar_id,
    requested.user_id,
    requested.team_id,
    requested.role,
    coalesce(requested.position, (row_number() over () - 1)::integer),
    p_created_by
  from jsonb_to_recordset(coalesce(p_grants, '[]'::jsonb))
    as requested(user_id uuid, team_id bigint, role text, position integer);

  return query
  select *
  from public.agenda_collection_grants
  where organization_id = p_organization_id
    and agenda_collection_id = p_calendar_id
  order by position, created_at, id;
end;
$function$
functions.argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_calendar_id uuid, p_grants jsonb, p_created_by uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid
functions.identity_argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_calendar_id uuid, p_grants jsonb, p_created_by uuid

declare
  v_user_id uuid := (select auth.uid());
begin
  if v_user_id is null then

  if jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_preferences, '{}'::jsonb)) <> 'object'
    or jsonb_typeof(coalesce(p_reminders, '[]'::jsonb)) <> 'array' then

functions.name: resolve_actor_scope_permissions
functions.definition:
with
    active_actor as (
      select profiles.user_id
      from public.profiles
      where profiles.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and profiles.disabled_at is null
    ),
    requested as (
      select distinct
        permissions.id,
        permissions.key
      from unnest(coalesce(p_permissions, '{}'::text[])) as requested_permission(key)
      join public.permissions
        on permissions.key = requested_permission.key
        and permissions.scope = p_scope
    ),
    system_admin as (
      select exists (
        select 1
        from active_actor
        join public.user_roles
          on user_roles.user_id = active_actor.user_id
        join public.roles
          on roles.id = user_roles.role_id
          and roles.scope = 'system'
          and roles.key = 'system-admin'
      ) as granted
    ),
    system_grants as (
      select requested.key
      from requested
      join public.role_permissions
        on role_permissions.permission_id = requested.id
      join public.user_roles
        on user_roles.role_id = role_permissions.role_id
        and user_roles.user_id = p_actor_user_id
      join public.roles
        on roles.id = user_roles.role_id
        and roles.scope = 'system'
      join active_actor
        on active_actor.user_id = user_roles.user_id
      where p_scope = 'system'
    ),
    active_organization as (
      select organizations.id
      from public.organizations
      where p_scope = 'organization'
        and organizations.id = p_scope_id
        and organizations.disabled_at is null
    ),
    membership as (
      select organization_users.role_id
      from public.organization_users
      join active_actor
        on active_actor.user_id = organization_users.user_id
      join active_organization
        on active_organization.id = organization_users.organization_id
      join public.roles
        on roles.id = organization_users.role_id
        and roles.scope = 'organization'
        and (
          roles.organization_id is null
          or roles.organization_id = organization_users.organization_id
        )
      where organization_users.user_id = p_actor_user_id
        and organization_users.organization_id = p_scope_id
    ),
    organization_explicit as (
      select
        organization_permission_overrides.permission_id,
        organization_permission_overrides.granted
      from public.organization_permission_overrides
      join membership
        on membership.role_id = organization_permission_overrides.role_id
      where organization_permission_overrides.organization_id = p_scope_id
    ),
    organization_grants as (
      select requested.key
      from requested
      cross join active_organization
      cross join system_admin
      where p_scope = 'organization'
        and (
          system_admin.granted
          or (
            not exists (
              select 1
              from organization_explicit
              where organization_explicit.permission_id = requested.id
                and organization_explicit.granted = false
            )
            and (
              exists (
                select 1
                from organization_explicit
                where organization_explicit.permission_id = requested.id
                  and organization_explicit.granted = true
              )
              or exists (
                select 1
                from public.role_permissions
                join membership
                  on membership.role_id = role_permissions.role_id
                where role_permissions.permission_id = requested.id
              )
            )
          )
        )
    ),
    granted as (
      select system_grants.key
      from system_grants
      union
      select organization_grants.key
      from organization_grants
    )
  select coalesce(array_agg(granted.key order by granted.key), '{}'::text[])
  from granted;

functions.name: resolve_lifecycle_definition
functions.definition:
declare
  v_key text;
  v_org_key text;
  v_result public.workflow_definitions;
begin
  if public.lifecycle_subject_view_permission(p_subject_type) is null then
    raise exception 'unknown lifecycle subject type' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if auth.role() is distinct from 'service_role'
    and not public.has_org_permission(
      p_organization_id, public.lifecycle_subject_view_permission(p_subject_type)
    ) then
    raise exception 'not allowed to read this lifecycle' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_template_id is not null then
    select t.lifecycle_workflow_key into v_key
    from public.templates t
    where t.id = p_template_id
      and t.organization_id = p_organization_id;
  end if;

  select case p_subject_type
      when 'quote' then o.default_quote_lifecycle_key
      when 'invoice' then o.default_invoice_lifecycle_key
      when 'task' then o.default_task_lifecycle_key
      when 'order' then o.default_order_lifecycle_key
      when 'purchase_order' then o.default_purchase_order_lifecycle_key
      when 'shipment' then o.default_shipment_lifecycle_key
    end
  into v_org_key
  from public.organizations o
  where o.id = p_organization_id;

  -- Template key, then organization default; an org copy wins over a system
  -- definition sharing its key. A key that no longer resolves falls through.
  select d.* into v_result
  from public.workflow_definitions d
  cross join lateral (
    select 1 as rank, v_key as key
    union all
    select 2, v_org_key
  ) candidate
  where candidate.key is not null
    and d.key = candidate.key
    and d.status = 'published'
    and d.purpose = 'lifecycle'
    and d.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and (
      d.organization_id = p_organization_id
      or (
        d.owner_scope = 'system'
        and not exists (
          select 1 from public.workflow_opt_outs o
          where o.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and o.definition_key = d.key
        )
      )
    )
  order by candidate.rank, (d.organization_id is null), d.version desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return v_result;
  end if;

  -- The default flag stays on the version that was marked; newer published
  -- versions of the same key take over.
  select d.* into v_result
  from public.workflow_definitions d
  where d.owner_scope = 'system'
    and d.status = 'published'
    and d.purpose = 'lifecycle'
    and d.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and d.key = (
      select marked.key
      from public.workflow_definitions marked
      where marked.owner_scope = 'system'
        and marked.is_default
        and marked.subject_type = p_subject_type
      limit 1
    )
  order by d.version desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return v_result;
  end if;
  return null;
end;

    raise exception 'not allowed to read this lifecycle' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_template_id is not null then
    select t.lifecycle_workflow_key into v_key
    from public.templates t
    where t.id = p_template_id
      and t.organization_id = p_organization_id;
  end if;

  select case p_subject_type
      when 'quote' then o.default_quote_lifecycle_key
      when 'invoice' then o.default_invoice_lifecycle_key
      when 'task' then o.default_task_lifecycle_key
      when 'order' then o.default_order_lifecycle_key
      when 'purchase_order' then o.default_purchase_order_lifecycle_key
      when 'shipment' then o.default_shipment_lifecycle_key
    end
  into v_org_key
  from public.organizations o
  where o.id = p_organization_id;

  -- Template key, then organization default; an org copy wins over a system
  -- definition sharing its key. A key that no longer resolves falls through.
  select d.* into v_result
  from public.workflow_definitions d
  cross join lateral (
    select 1 as rank, v_key as key
    union all
    select 2, v_org_key
  ) candidate
  where candidate.key is not null
    and d.key = candidate.key
    and d.status = 'published'
    and d.purpose = 'lifecycle'
    and d.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and (
      d.organization_id = p_organization_id
      or (
        d.owner_scope = 'system'
        and not exists (
          select 1 from public.workflow_opt_outs o
          where o.organization_id = p_organization_id
            and o.definition_key = d.key
        )
      )
    )
  order by candidate.rank, (d.organization_id is null), d.version desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return v_result;
  end if;

  -- The default flag stays on the version that was marked; newer published
  -- versions of the same key take over.
  select d.* into v_result
  from public.workflow_definitions d
  where d.owner_scope = 'system'
    and d.status = 'published'
    and d.purpose = 'lifecycle'
    and d.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and d.key = (
      select marked.key
      from public.workflow_definitions marked
      where marked.owner_scope = 'system'
        and marked.is_default
        and marked.subject_type = p_subject_type
      limit 1
    )
  order by d.version desc
  limit 1;

  if found then
    return v_result;
  end if;
  return null;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resolve_notification_recipients(p_organization_id uuid, p_type text, p_subject_type text, p_subject_id text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_count integer;
begin
  if not public.has_org_permission(p_organization_id, 'organization.general.view') then
    raise exception 'Not authorized' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  update public.notification_recipients as recipient
  set
    resolved_at = coalesce(recipient.resolved_at, (now() at time zone 'utc')),
    read_at = coalesce(recipient.read_at, (now() at time zone 'utc'))
  from public.notification_events as event
  where event.id = recipient.event_id
    and event.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and event.type = p_type
    and event.subject_type = p_subject_type
    and event.subject_id = p_subject_id
    and recipient.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and recipient.dismissed_at is null
    and recipient.resolved_at is null;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;

functions.name: restore_allocations
functions.definition:
declare
  v_allocation record;
  v_on_hand numeric(12, 3);
  v_reserved numeric(12, 3);
  v_restored numeric(12, 3) := 0;
  v_product_id uuid;
begin
  select coalesce(
    (select task_materials.product_id from public.task_materials where task_materials.id = p_task_material_id),
    (select quote_version_lines.product_id from public.quote_version_lines where quote_version_lines.id = p_quote_version_line_id),
    (select invoice_lines.product_id from public.invoice_lines where invoice_lines.id = p_invoice_line_id)
  ) into v_product_id;

  if v_product_id is null then
    return 0;
  end if;

  perform public.lock_product_stock(p_organization_id, v_product_id);

  for v_allocation in
    select
      inventory_allocations.id,
      inventory_allocations.quantity,
      inventory_stock_records.id as stock_record_id,
      inventory_stock_records.product_id,
      inventory_stock_records.location_id
    from public.inventory_allocations
    join public.inventory_stock_records
      on inventory_stock_records.id = inventory_allocations.stock_record_id
    where inventory_allocations.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and inventory_allocations.state = 'consumed'
      and inventory_allocations.task_material_id is not distinct from p_task_material_id
      and inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id is not distinct from p_quote_version_line_id
      and inventory_allocations.invoice_line_id is not distinct from p_invoice_line_id
    order by inventory_stock_records.id
  loop
    update public.inventory_stock_records
    set
      on_hand_quantity = on_hand_quantity + v_allocation.quantity,
      allocated_quantity = allocated_quantity + v_allocation.quantity
    where inventory_stock_records.id = v_allocation.stock_record_id
    returning on_hand_quantity, allocated_quantity
    into v_on_hand, v_reserved;

    update public.inventory_allocations
    set state = 'reserved', consumed_at = null
    where inventory_allocations.id = v_allocation.id;

    perform public.write_inventory_movement(
      p_organization_id,
      v_allocation.stock_record_id,
      v_allocation.product_id,
      v_allocation.location_id,
      'return',
      v_allocation.quantity,
      v_allocation.quantity,
      v_on_hand,
      v_reserved,
      coalesce(p_reason, 'stock restored'),
      p_created_by,
      p_task_material_id,
      p_quote_id,
      p_invoice_id
    );

    v_restored := v_restored + v_allocation.quantity;
  end loop;

  return v_restored;
end;

with scoped as (
    select
      chunk.id,
      chunk.file_id,
      chunk.collection_id,
      chunk.organization_id,
      chunk.content,
      chunk.position,
      chunk.embedding,
      chunk.content_tsv,
      col.retrieval_priority
    from public.knowledge_chunks chunk
    join public.knowledge_collections col on col.id = chunk.collection_id
    where col.visibility <> 'disabled'
      and (
        (p_organization_id is not null and chunk.organization_id = p_organization_id)
        or (p_include_system and chunk.organization_id is null)
      )
      and (p_collection_ids is null or chunk.collection_id = any (p_collection_ids))
  ),
  vector_ranked as (
    select ranked.id, row_number() over (order by ranked.distance) as rank
    from (
      select scoped.id, scoped.embedding operator(public.<=>) p_query_embedding as distance
      from scoped
      where p_query_embedding is not null and scoped.embedding is not null
      order by distance
      limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1) * 4, 100)
    ) ranked
  ),
  text_ranked as (
    select ranked.id, row_number() over (order by ranked.rank_score desc) as rank
    from (
      select
        scoped.id,
        ts_rank_cd(scoped.content_tsv, websearch_to_tsquery('simple', p_query)) as rank_score
      from scoped
      where p_query is not null
        and length(trim(p_query)) > 0
        and scoped.content_tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', p_query)
      order by rank_score desc
      limit least(greatest(p_limit, 1) * 4, 100)
    ) ranked
  ),
  fused as (
    select
      coalesce(vector_ranked.id, text_ranked.id) as id,
      coalesce(1.0 / (60 + vector_ranked.rank), 0)
        + coalesce(1.0 / (60 + text_ranked.rank), 0) as rrf_score
    from vector_ranked
    full outer join text_ranked on text_ranked.id = vector_ranked.id
  )
  select
    scoped.id as chunk_id,
    scoped.file_id,
    scoped.collection_id,
    scoped.organization_id,
    scoped.content,
    scoped.position as chunk_position,
    fused.rrf_score as score
  from fused
  join scoped on scoped.id = fused.id
  order by fused.rrf_score desc, scoped.retrieval_priority asc, scoped.id
  limit greatest(p_limit, 1);

      limit least(p_limit * 4, 100)
    ) as ranked

  candidates as (
    select
      coalesce(vector_ranked.id, text_ranked.id) as id,
      coalesce(1.0 / (60 + vector_ranked.rank), 0)

    from candidates

  select

    ranked.updated_at,
    ranked.thread_id,
    ranked.kind,
    ranked.content_hash,
    ranked.last_used_at,
    ranked.use_count,
    ranked.final_score
  from ranked
  order by ranked.final_score desc, ranked.updated_at desc, ranked.id
  limit p_limit;
end;

declare

      using errcode = 'P0001';

  insert into public.organization_vat_rates (
    organization_id,
    rate,
    is_default,
    position
  )
  values
    (p_organization_id, 21, false, 0),
    (p_organization_id, 9, false, 1),

  on conflict (organization_id, rate) do nothing;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_vat_rates
    where organization_vat_rates.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and organization_vat_rates.rate = v_default

      organization_id,
      rate,
      is_default,
      position
    )
    values (
      p_organization_id,
      v_default,
      false,
      coalesce(
        (
          select max(organization_vat_rates.position) + 1
          from public.organization_vat_rates
          where organization_vat_rates.organization_id = p_organization_id
        ),
        0
      )
    )
    on conflict (organization_id, rate) do nothing;
  end if;

  update public.organization_vat_rates
  set is_default = false
  where organization_vat_rates.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and organization_vat_rates.is_default;

  update public.organization_vat_rates
  set is_default = true
  where organization_vat_rates.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and organization_vat_rates.rate = v_default;
end;
