functions.name: seed_public_holidays
functions.definition:
declare
  v_country text;
  v_easter date := public.easter_sunday(p_year);
  v_kings_day date := make_date(p_year, 4, 27);
  v_count integer;
begin
  select public_holiday_country into v_country
  from public.hr_settings
  where organization_id = p_organization_id;

  v_country := coalesce(v_country, 'NL');

  if extract(isodow from v_kings_day) = 7 then
    v_kings_day := v_kings_day - 1;
  end if;

  with holidays(holiday_date, name) as (
    select * from (
      values
        (make_date(p_year, 1, 1), 'New Year''s Day'),
        (v_easter + 1, 'Easter Monday'),
        (make_date(p_year, 12, 25), 'Christmas Day'),
        (make_date(p_year, 12, 26), 'Boxing Day')
    ) base
    union all
    select * from (
      values
        (v_easter, 'Easter Sunday'),
        (v_kings_day, 'King''s Day'),
        (v_easter + 39, 'Ascension Day'),
        (v_easter + 49, 'Whit Sunday'),
        (v_easter + 50, 'Whit Monday')
    ) nl
    where v_country = 'NL'
    union all
    select make_date(p_year, 5, 5), 'Liberation Day'
    where v_country = 'NL' and p_year % 5 = 0
    union all
    select * from (
      values
        (v_easter + 39, 'Ascension Day'),
        (v_easter + 50, 'Whit Monday'),
        (make_date(p_year, 5, 1), 'Labour Day'),
        (make_date(p_year, 7, 21), 'National Day'),
        (make_date(p_year, 8, 15), 'Assumption Day'),
        (make_date(p_year, 11, 1), 'All Saints'' Day'),
        (make_date(p_year, 11, 11), 'Armistice Day')
    ) be
    where v_country = 'BE'
    union all
    select * from (
      values
        (v_easter - 2, 'Good Friday'),
        (v_easter + 39, 'Ascension Day'),
        (v_easter + 50, 'Whit Monday'),
        (make_date(p_year, 5, 1), 'Labour Day'),
        (make_date(p_year, 10, 3), 'German Unity Day')
    ) de
    where v_country = 'DE'
  )
  insert into public.public_holidays (organization_id, holiday_date, name)
  select distinct on (holiday_date) p_organization_id, holiday_date, name
  from holidays
  order by holiday_date
  on conflict (organization_id, holiday_date) do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end;

functions.name: start_ai_agent_tool
functions.definition:
declare
  v_event_sequence integer;
  v_step_sequence integer;
  v_step_id uuid;
begin
  if current_user <> 'service_role' then
    raise exception 'start_ai_agent_tool requires service_role'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  perform 1
  from public.ai_agent_runs as run
  join public.chat_threads as thread
    on thread.id = run.thread_id
  where run.id = p_run_id
    and run.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and run.thread_id = p_thread_id
    and run.created_by = p_actor_user_id
    and run.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
    and run.workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    and run.request_id = p_request_id
    and run.mode = 'agent'
    and run.status in (
      'queued',
      'planning',
      'awaiting_approval',
      'running',
      'checking',
      'retrying'
    )
    and thread.organization_id = p_organization_id
    and thread.active_stream_id = p_active_stream_id
    and thread.active_workflow_run_id = p_workflow_run_id
    and thread.stream_status = 'streaming'
  for update of run;

  if not found then
    raise exception 'invalid Agent tool execution context'
      using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select step.id
  into v_step_id
  from public.ai_agent_run_steps as step
  where step.run_id = p_run_id
    and step.tool_call_id = p_tool_call_id;

  if v_step_id is null then
    select greatest(p_sequence, coalesce(max(step.sequence), 0) + 1)
    into v_step_sequence
    from public.ai_agent_run_steps as step
    where step.run_id = p_run_id;

    insert into public.ai_agent_run_steps (
      id,
      run_id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      kind,
      status,
      title,
      sequence,
      tool_call_id,
      tool_name,
      input,
      metadata,
      started_at
    )
    values (
      p_step_id,
      p_run_id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      'tool',
      'running',
      p_title,
      v_step_sequence,
      p_tool_call_id,
      p_tool_name,
      p_input,
      p_metadata,
      now() at time zone 'utc'
    )
    returning id into v_step_id;
  elsif exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_agent_run_steps
    where ai_agent_run_steps.id = v_step_id
      and (
        ai_agent_run_steps.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id
        or ai_agent_run_steps.thread_id is distinct from p_thread_id
        or ai_agent_run_steps.tool_name is distinct from p_tool_name
        or ai_agent_run_steps.input is distinct from p_input
      )
  ) then
    raise exception 'tool call id reused with different start data'
      using errcode = '23505';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.ai_agent_run_events
    where ai_agent_run_events.run_id = p_run_id
      and ai_agent_run_events.step_id = v_step_id
      and ai_agent_run_events.kind = 'tool_started'
  ) then
    select coalesce(max(ai_agent_run_events.sequence), 0) + 1
    into v_event_sequence
    from public.ai_agent_run_events
    where ai_agent_run_events.run_id = p_run_id;

    insert into public.ai_agent_run_events (
      run_id,
      organization_id,
      thread_id,
      request_id,
      step_id,
      kind,
      sequence,
      status,
      title,
      payload,
      metadata,
      created_by
    )
    values (
      p_run_id,
      p_organization_id,
      p_thread_id,
      p_request_id,
      v_step_id,
      'tool_started',
      v_event_sequence,
      'running',
      p_title,
      p_input,
      p_metadata,
      p_actor_user_id
    );
  end if;

  insert into public.ai_telemetry_events (
    organization_id,
    user_id,
    thread_id,
    workflow_run_id,
    request_id,
    kind,
    status,
    name,
    provider,
    model,
    input_tokens,
    output_tokens,
    cost_micros,
    duration_ms,
    error_code,
    error_message,
    metadata,
    idempotency_key
  )
  values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_actor_user_id,
    p_thread_id,
    p_workflow_run_id,
    p_request_id,
    'tool_call',
    'started',
    p_tool_name,
    'workflow',
    p_model,
    null,
    null,
    null,
    null,
    null,
    null,
    p_metadata || jsonb_build_object('toolCallId', p_tool_call_id),
    p_request_id || ':tool:' || p_tool_call_id || ':started'
  )
  on conflict do nothing;

  return v_step_id;
end;

functions.name: sweep_approval_requests
functions.definition:
begin
  return query
  with expired as (
    update public.approval_requests request
    set status = 'expired'
    where request.status = 'requested'
      and request.expires_at is not null
      and request.expires_at <= now()
    returning request.id
  ),
  escalated as (
    update public.approval_requests request
    set escalated_at = now()
    where request.status = 'requested'
      and request.escalate_at is not null
      and request.escalate_at <= now()
      and request.escalated_at is null
      and (request.expires_at is null or request.expires_at > now())
    returning request.id, request.organization_id
  ),
  escalation_events as (
    insert into public.approval_events (request_id, organization_id, kind)
    select escalated.id, escalated.organization_id, 'escalated'
    from escalated
    returning approval_events.request_id
  )
  select expired.id, 'expired'::text from expired
  union all
  select escalation_events.request_id, 'escalated'::text from escalation_events;
end;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.time_off_balance(p_employee_id uuid, p_time_off_type_id uuid, p_on date DEFAULT NULL::date)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_on date := coalesce(p_on, (now() at time zone 'utc')::date);
  v_total numeric;
begin
  select coalesce(sum(hours), 0) into v_total
  from public.time_off_ledger
  where employee_id = p_employee_id
    and time_off_type_id = p_time_off_type_id
    and (kind = 'taken' or effective_on <= v_on);

  return round(v_total, 2);
end;
$function$

functions.definition:
update public.promotion_redemptions
  set subject_type = p_to_type, subject_id = p_to_id
  where promotion_redemptions.subject_type = p_from_type
    and promotion_redemptions.subject_id = p_from_id
    and promotion_redemptions.state <> 'released'
    and not exists (

functions.name: transfer_quote_allocations_to_invoice
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.transfer_quote_allocations_to_invoice(p_organization_id uuid, p_quote_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare
  v_line record;
  v_source record;
  v_left numeric(12, 3);
  v_moved numeric(12, 3);
begin
  if auth.uid() is not null and not public.has_org_permission(
    p_organization_id,
    'organization.invoices.create'
  ) then
    raise insufficient_privilege using message = 'invoice create permission required';
  end if;

  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.invoices
    where invoices.id = p_invoice_id
      and invoices.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and invoices.source_quote_id = p_quote_id
      and invoices.status = 'draft'
  ) then
    raise exception 'draft invoice for quote not found' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;

  for v_line in
    select invoice_lines.*
    from public.invoice_lines
    where invoice_lines.invoice_id = p_invoice_id
      and invoice_lines.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and invoice_lines.kind = 'line'
      and invoice_lines.line_type = 'product'
      and invoice_lines.product_id is not null
      and invoice_lines.stock_mode = 'auto'
      and invoice_lines.quantity > 0
    order by invoice_lines.position, invoice_lines.id
  loop
    if exists (
      select 1
      from public.task_materials
      where task_materials.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and task_materials.quote_id = p_quote_id
        and task_materials.product_id = v_line.product_id
    ) then
      update public.invoice_lines
      set stock_mode = 'task'
      where invoice_lines.id = v_line.id;
      continue;
    end if;

    v_left := v_line.quantity;

    for v_source in
      select
        quote_version_lines.id,
        coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) as held
      from public.quote_version_lines
      join public.quote_versions
        on quote_versions.id = quote_version_lines.quote_version_id
      join public.inventory_allocations
        on inventory_allocations.quote_version_line_id = quote_version_lines.id
        and inventory_allocations.state = 'reserved'
      where quote_versions.quote_id = p_quote_id
        and quote_versions.organization_id = p_organization_id
        and quote_version_lines.product_id = v_line.product_id
      group by quote_version_lines.id
      having coalesce(sum(inventory_allocations.quantity), 0) > 0
      order by quote_version_lines.position, quote_version_lines.id
    loop
      exit when v_left <= 0;
      v_moved := public.transfer_allocations(
        p_organization_id,
        v_line.product_id,
        least(v_source.held, v_left),
        null,
        v_source.id,
        null,
        null,
        null,
        v_line.id,
        'quote hold transferred to invoice',
        auth.uid()
      );
      v_left := v_left - v_moved;
    end loop;
  end loop;
end;
$function$

functions.identity_argument_types: p_organization_id uuid, p_quote_id uuid, p_invoice_id uuid

declare
  v_item public.agenda_items%rowtype;
  v_item_id uuid;
begin
  if jsonb_typeof(p_item) <> 'object' then
    raise exception 'agenda item must be an object' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  if not exists (
    select 1
    from public.agenda_external_calendars
    where id = p_external_calendar_id
      and organization_id = p_organization_id
  ) then
    raise exception 'external calendar not found in organization' using errcode = '23503';
  end if;
  v_item := jsonb_populate_record(null::public.agenda_items, p_item);
  if v_item.organization_id is distinct from p_organization_id
    or v_item.external_calendar_id is distinct from p_external_calendar_id
    or v_item.external_event_id is distinct from p_external_event_id then
    raise exception 'external agenda item scope mismatch' using errcode = '23514';

  select agenda_item_id into v_item_id
  from public.agenda_external_event_mappings
  where organization_id = p_organization_id
    and external_calendar_id = p_external_calendar_id
    and external_event_id = p_external_event_id
  for update;

  if v_item_id is null then
    insert into public.agenda_items (
      organization_id, title, description, starts_at, ends_at, is_all_day,
      created_by, source, visibility, owner_user_id, location, online_meeting_url,
      transparency, status, ical_uid, sequence, provider_time_zone, external_etag,

      external_event_id, external_html_link, agenda_collection_id, description_html,

    ) values (
      p_organization_id, v_item.title, v_item.description, v_item.starts_at, v_item.ends_at,
      v_item.is_all_day, v_item.created_by, v_item.source, v_item.visibility,
      v_item.owner_user_id, v_item.location, v_item.online_meeting_url,

      v_item.organizer_email, v_item.organizer_display_name, v_item.recurrence_parent_item_id,
      v_item.recurrence_id_at, p_external_calendar_id, p_external_event_id,
      v_item.external_html_link, v_item.agenda_collection_id, v_item.description_html,
      v_item.time_zone
    )
    returning id into v_item_id;

    update public.agenda_items

      recurrence_parent_item_id = v_item.recurrence_parent_item_id,
      recurrence_id_at = v_item.recurrence_id_at,
      external_html_link = v_item.external_html_link,
      agenda_collection_id = v_item.agenda_collection_id,
      description_html = v_item.description_html,
      time_zone = v_item.time_zone
    where id = v_item_id
      and organization_id = p_organization_id;
  end if;

  perform public.replace_agenda_item_children(
    p_organization_id, v_item_id, p_user_ids, p_metadata
  );

  insert into public.agenda_external_event_mappings (
    organization_id,
    external_calendar_id,
    external_event_id,
    agenda_item_id,
    etag,
    status
  ) values (
    p_organization_id,
    p_external_calendar_id,
    p_external_event_id,
    v_item_id,
    p_etag,
    p_status
  )
  on conflict (external_calendar_id, external_event_id) do update
  set
    agenda_item_id = excluded.agenda_item_id,
    organization_id = excluded.organization_id,
    etag = excluded.etag,
    status = excluded.status;

  return v_item_id;
end;

functions.name: workflow_email_recipient_allowed
functions.definition:
select exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_users ou
    join public.profiles p on p.user_id = ou.user_id
    where ou.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and lower(p.email) = lower(trim(p_email))
  )
  or exists (
    select 1
    from public.customers c
    where c.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and lower(c.billing_email) = lower(trim(p_email))
  )
  or exists (
    select 1
    from public.customer_contacts cc
    join public.contact_methods cm on cm.contact_profile_id = cc.contact_profile_id
    where cc.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and cm.type = 'email'
      and lower(cm.value) = lower(trim(p_email))
  );
functions.complete_statement:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workflow_email_recipient_allowed(p_organization_id uuid, p_email text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.organization_users ou
    join public.profiles p on p.user_id = ou.user_id
    where ou.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and lower(p.email) = lower(trim(p_email))
  )
  or exists (
    select 1
    from public.customers c
    where c.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and lower(c.billing_email) = lower(trim(p_email))
  )
  or exists (
    select 1
    from public.customer_contacts cc
    join public.contact_methods cm on cm.contact_profile_id = cc.contact_profile_id
    where cc.organization_id = p_organization_id
      and cm.type = 'email'
      and lower(cm.value) = lower(trim(p_email))
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.workflow_grant_targets_valid(p_definition_id uuid, p_organization_id uuid, p_team_id bigint, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from public.workflow_definitions def
    where def.id = p_definition_id
      and def.organization_id = p_organization_id
  )
  and (
    (
      p_team_id is not null
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.teams t
        where t.id = p_team_id and t.organization_id = p_organization_id
      )
    )
    or (
      p_user_id is not null
      and exists (
        select 1 from public.organization_users ou
        where ou.user_id = p_user_id and ou.organization_id = p_organization_id
      )
    )
  );
$function$
